name: NLAlib.GolubKahanDecomp.B_apply_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem B_apply_eq_zero_of_lt (D : GolubKahanDecomp A b k) {i : Fin (k + 1)} {j : Fin k}
    (h : (i : ℕ) < j) : D.B i j = 0

name: NLAlib.GolubKahanDecomp.mul_V_eq_U_mul_B
statement: theorem mul_V_eq_U_mul_B (D : GolubKahanDecomp A b k) : A * D.V = D.U * D.B

name: NLAlib.GolubKahanDecomp.range_mul_V_le
statement:
theorem range_mul_V_le (D : GolubKahanDecomp A b k) :
    LinearMap.range (A * D.V).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range D.U.mulVecLin

name: NLAlib.GolubKahanDecomp.transpose_B_mul_B_eq_T
statement: theorem transpose_B_mul_B_eq_T (D : GolubKahanDecomp A b k) : D.Bᵀ * D.B = D.lanczosV.T

name: NLAlib.GolubKahanDecomp.transpose_mulVec_U_col_mem_range_V
statement:
theorem transpose_mulVec_U_col_mem_range_V (D : GolubKahanDecomp A b k) {j : Fin (k + 1)}
    (hj : (j : ℕ) < k) : Aᵀ *ᵥ D.U.col j ∈ LinearMap.range D.V.mulVecLin

name: NLAlib.mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_mul_transpose
NLAlib.transpose_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem transpose_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) {q : ℕ} {x : m → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ krylovSpace (A * Aᵀ) b q) : Aᵀ *ᵥ x ∈ krylovSpace (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) q

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.eq_of_forall_col_dotProduct_eq
NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mulVec_col_eq_sum
statement:
theorem mulVec_col_eq_sum (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) {j : Fin q} (hj : (j : ℕ) + 1 < q) :
    A *ᵥ D.Q.col j = ∑ i, D.H i j • D.Q.col i

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mul_Q_eq_mul_H_iff
statement:
theorem mul_Q_eq_mul_H_iff (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (hq : 0 < q) :
    A * D.Q = D.Q * D.H ↔ krylovGrade A b = q

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mul_Q_eq_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem mul_Q_eq_of_krylovGrade_le (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (h : krylovGrade A b ≤ q) :
    A * D.Q = D.Q * D.H

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_smul
statement:
theorem mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_smul (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b (q + 1)) (hq : 0 < q) :
    A * (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q = (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q * (D.restrict q.le_succ).H +
      D.H (Fin.last q) ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ •
        vecMulVec (D.Q.col (Fin.last q)) (Pi.single (⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin q) 1)

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_vecMulVec (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b (q + 1)) :
    A * (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q = (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q * (D.restrict q.le_succ).H +
      vecMulVec (D.Q.col (Fin.last q)) (fun j => D.H (Fin.last q) j.castSucc)

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_mul
statement:
theorem mul_restrict_Q_eq_mul (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b (q + 1)) :
    A * (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q = D.Q * D.Hbar

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.sq_transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_zero
statement:
theorem sq_transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_zero (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩ ^ 2 = b ⬝ᵥ b

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_eq_zero (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) {i : Fin q}
    (hi : 0 < (i : ℕ)) : (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) i = 0

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos
statement:
theorem beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (h : q ≤ krylovGrade A b)
    {j : ℕ} (h0 : 0 < j) (hj : j < q) : 0 < LanczosDecomp.beta (arnoldiDecomp A b q h) j

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta_ne_zero
statement:
theorem beta_ne_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) {j : ℕ} (h0 : 0 < j) (hj : j < q) :
    D.beta j ≠ 0

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.col_dotProduct_vec
statement:
theorem col_dotProduct_vec (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (i : Fin q) (k : ℕ) :
    D.Q.col i ⬝ᵥ D.vec k = if (i : ℕ) = k then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q)
    {p : Polynomial ℝ} (hp : p.degree < 2 * q) :
    b ⬝ᵥ (Polynomial.aeval A p *ᵥ b) =
      (b ⬝ᵥ b) * Polynomial.aeval D.T p ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.mulVec_vec_eq
statement:
theorem mulVec_vec_eq (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j + 1 < q) :
    A *ᵥ D.vec j =
      D.beta j • D.vec (j - 1) + D.alpha j • D.vec j + D.beta (j + 1) • D.vec (j + 1)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_beta_smul
statement:
theorem mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_beta_smul (D : LanczosDecomp A b (q + 1)) (hq : 0 < q) :
    A * (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q =
      (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q * LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict q.le_succ) +
        D.beta q • vecMulVec (D.vec q) (Pi.single (⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin q) 1)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.vec_mem
statement: theorem vec_mem (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : D.vec j ∈ krylovSpace A b q

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.vec_of_lt
statement: theorem vec_of_lt (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) : D.vec j = D.Q.col ⟨j, hj⟩

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_mulVec_eq_of_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem dotProduct_mulVec_eq_of_apply_eq_zero {k : Type*} [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    (M : Matrix k k ℝ) {c : k → ℝ} (i₀ : k) (hc : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → c i = 0) :
    c ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ c) = c i₀ ^ 2 * M i₀ i₀

name: NLAlib.isGradedKrylovBasis_lanczosRecurrence
statement:
theorem isGradedKrylovBasis_lanczosRecurrence {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    {q : ℕ} (h : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) :
    IsGradedKrylovBasis A b (Matrix.of fun r (j : Fin q) => lanczosRecurrence A b j r)

name: NLAlib.lanczosAlpha_eq_alpha
NLAlib.lanczosBeta_add_two_smul
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_add_two_smul (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosBeta A b (j + 2) • lanczosRecurrence A b (j + 2) =
      A *ᵥ lanczosRecurrence A b (j + 1) - lanczosAlpha A b (j + 1) • lanczosRecurrence A b (j + 1)
        - lanczosBeta A b (j + 1) • lanczosRecurrence A b j

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_eq_beta
NLAlib.lanczosBeta_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_eq_zero_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) {j : ℕ}
    (h0 : 0 < j) : lanczosBeta A b j = 0 ↔ krylovGrade A b ≤ j

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : krylovGrade A b ≤ j) : lanczosBeta A b j = 0

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_nonneg
statement: theorem lanczosBeta_nonneg (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ lanczosBeta A b j

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_one_smul
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_one_smul (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) :
    lanczosBeta A b 1 • lanczosRecurrence A b 1 =
      A *ᵥ lanczosRecurrence A b 0 - lanczosAlpha A b 0 • lanczosRecurrence A b 0

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_pos
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_pos {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) {j : ℕ} (h0 : 0 < j)
    (hj : j < krylovGrade A b) : 0 < lanczosBeta A b j

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_succ_eq
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_succ_eq (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosBeta A b (j + 1) = lanczosRecurrence A b (j + 1) ⬝ᵥ
      (A *ᵥ lanczosRecurrence A b j - lanczosAlpha A b j • lanczosRecurrence A b j -
        lanczosBeta A b j • (lanczosState A b j).prev)

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_succ_eq_dotProduct
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_succ_eq_dotProduct {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    (j : ℕ) : lanczosBeta A b (j + 1) = arnoldiBasis A b (j + 1) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ arnoldiBasis A b j)

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem lanczosBeta_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) : lanczosBeta A b 0 = 0

name: NLAlib.lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis
statement:
theorem lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    (j : ℕ) : lanczosRecurrence A b j = arnoldiBasis A b j

name: NLAlib.lanczosRecurrence_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem lanczosRecurrence_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (b : n → ℝ) {j : ℕ} (hj : krylovGrade A b ≤ j) : lanczosRecurrence A b j = 0

name: NLAlib.lanczosRecurrence_zero
statement:
theorem lanczosRecurrence_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) :
    lanczosRecurrence A b 0 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖⁻¹ • b

name: NLAlib.lanczosState_succ
statement:
theorem lanczosState_succ (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosState A b (j + 1) = lanczosStep A (lanczosState A b j)

name: NLAlib.lanczosState_succ_prev
statement:
theorem lanczosState_succ_prev (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (lanczosState A b (j + 1)).prev = lanczosRecurrence A b j

name: NLAlib.lanczosState_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem lanczosState_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) :
    lanczosState A b 0 = lanczosInit b

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_alpha
statement:
theorem dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_alpha (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v) =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).alpha

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_beta
statement:
theorem dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_beta (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v) =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).beta

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_dilation_even_succ
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_dilation_even_succ (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosBeta (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ)) (2 * (j + 1)) =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).beta

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_dilation_odd
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_dilation_odd (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosBeta (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ)) (2 * j + 1) =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).alpha

name: NLAlib.lanczosRecurrence_dilation_even
statement:
theorem lanczosRecurrence_dilation_even (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosRecurrence (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ)) (2 * j) =
      Sum.elim (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).u (0 : n → ℝ)

name: NLAlib.lanczosRecurrence_dilation_odd
statement:
theorem lanczosRecurrence_dilation_odd (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosRecurrence (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ)) (2 * j + 1) =
      Sum.elim (0 : m → ℝ) (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v

name: NLAlib.golubKahanRecurrence_mem
statement:
theorem golubKahanRecurrence_mem (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).u ∈ krylovSpace (A * Aᵀ) b (j + 1) ∧
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v ∈ krylovSpace (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) (j + 1)

name: NLAlib.isGradedKrylovBasis_golubKahan_of_dilationGrade
statement:
theorem isGradedKrylovBasis_golubKahan_of_dilationGrade {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ}
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q ≤ krylovGrade (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ))) :
    IsGradedKrylovBasis (A * Aᵀ) b (golubKahanU A b q) ∧
      IsGradedKrylovBasis (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) (golubKahanV A b q)

name: NLAlib.two_mul_le_dilationGrade_of_golubKahanSucceeds
NLAlib.pow_dilation_mulVec_even
statement:
theorem pow_dilation_mulVec_even (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (dilation A) ^ (2 * j) *ᵥ Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ) =
      Sum.elim ((A * Aᵀ) ^ j *ᵥ b) (0 : n → ℝ)

name: NLAlib.pow_dilation_mulVec_odd
statement:
theorem pow_dilation_mulVec_odd (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (dilation A) ^ (2 * j + 1) *ᵥ Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ) =
      Sum.elim (0 : m → ℝ) ((Aᵀ * A) ^ j *ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ b))

name: NLAlib.two_mul_le_krylovGrade_dilation
statement:
theorem two_mul_le_krylovGrade_dilation {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
    (hleft : q ≤ krylovGrade (A * Aᵀ) b)
    (hright : q ≤ krylovGrade (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b)) :
    2 * q ≤ krylovGrade (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ))

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_golubKahan_eq
statement:
theorem dotProduct_golubKahan_eq {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ} {k : ℕ}
    (_h : GolubKahanSucceeds A b k) :
    (∀ j ≤ k, (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v) =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).alpha) ∧
    (∀ j < k, (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v) =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).beta)

name: NLAlib.golubKahanSucceeds_iff
statement:
theorem golubKahanSucceeds_iff (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    GolubKahanSucceeds A b k ↔
      k + 1 ≤ krylovGrade (A * Aᵀ) b ∧ k + 1 ≤ krylovGrade (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b)

name: NLAlib.isGradedKrylovBasis_golubKahanU_V
statement:
theorem isGradedKrylovBasis_golubKahanU_V {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ} {k : ℕ}
    (h : GolubKahanSucceeds A b k) :
    IsGradedKrylovBasis (A * Aᵀ) b (golubKahanU A b (k + 1)) ∧
      IsGradedKrylovBasis (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) (golubKahanV A b (k + 1))

name: NLAlib.golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp_B_diag
statement:
theorem golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp_B_diag (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (h : GolubKahanSucceeds A b k) (j : Fin k) :
    (golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp A b k h).B j.castSucc j =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).alpha

name: NLAlib.golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp_B_subdiag
statement:
theorem golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp_B_subdiag (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (h : GolubKahanSucceeds A b k) (j : Fin k) :
    (golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp A b k h).B j.succ j =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).beta

name: NLAlib.golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp_transpose_mulVec
statement:
theorem golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp_transpose_mulVec (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (h : GolubKahanSucceeds A b k) (j : Fin (k + 1)) :
    Aᵀ *ᵥ (golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp A b k h).U.col j =
      (golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp A b k h).V *ᵥ
        (golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp A b k h).Bᵀ.col j +
      if j = Fin.last k then
        (golubKahanRecurrence A b k).alpha • (golubKahanRecurrence A b k).v else 0

name: NLAlib.abs_re_sub_eval_chebyshevAnalyticTrunc_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem abs_re_sub_eval_chebyshevAnalyticTrunc_le_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) (N : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |(F x).re - (chebyshevAnalyticTrunc F N).eval x| ≤
      2 * M / ρ ^ N / (ρ - 1)

name: NLAlib.degree_chebyshevAnalyticTrunc_le
statement:
theorem degree_chebyshevAnalyticTrunc_le (F : ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) :
    (chebyshevAnalyticTrunc F N).degree ≤ N

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M)
    (hmatch : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F x = (f x : ℂ)) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |f x - p.eval x| ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ N / (ρ - 1)

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse_interval
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse_interval
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ} {a c ρ M : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M)
    (hmatch : ∀ t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F t = (f (((c - a) * t + c + a) / 2) : ℂ))
    (N : ℕ) : ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc a c,
      |f x - p.eval x| ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ N / (ρ - 1)

name: NLAlib.hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_cos_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_cos_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) (θ : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ))
      (F (Real.cos θ)).re

name: NLAlib.hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval x) (F x).re

name: NLAlib.re_fourier_pair_eq_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T
statement:
theorem re_fourier_pair_eq_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_T (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (θ : ℝ) :
    ((fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) (k : ℤ) *
      fourier (k : ℤ) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))) +
      (fourierCoeff (chebyshevCircleFunction F) (-(k : ℤ)) *
        fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)))).re =
      chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k * (T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos θ)

name: NLAlib.summable_abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem summable_abs_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) :
    Summable (fun k => |chebyshevAnalyticCoeff F k|)

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (v : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hK : krylovSpace A v q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ} {a c ρ M : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M)
    (hmatch : ∀ t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F t = (f (((c - a) * t + c + a) / 2) : ℂ)) :
    |v ⬝ᵥ (cfc f A *ᵥ v) -
      (Qᵀ *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (cfc f (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ v))| ≤
        4 * M / ρ ^ (2 * q - 1) / (ρ - 1) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (v : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hK : krylovSpace A v q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ} {a c ρ M : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M)
    (hmatch : ∀ t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F t = (f (((c - a) * t + c + a) / 2) : ℂ)) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (cfc f A *ᵥ v - krylovFunApprox A f v Q)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (4 * M / ρ ^ (q - 1) / (ρ - 1)) ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_add_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_add_le {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i j : Fin (Fintype.card n))
    (hij : (i : ℕ) + j < Fintype.card n) :
    (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ ⟨i + j, hij⟩ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i + hB.eigenvalues₀ j

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_compression_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_compression_le {r : Type*} [Fintype r]
    [DecidableEq r] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card r)) :
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues₀ i ≤
      hA.eigenvalues₀ (Fin.castLE (card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ) i)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_eq_iInf_iSup
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_eq_iInf_iSup {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ k =
      ⨅ W : {W : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜) // Fintype.card n ≤ finrank 𝕜 W + k},
        ⨆ x : {x : n → 𝕜 // x ∈ W.1 ∧ x ≠ 0}, rayleighQuotient A x.1

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_eq_iSup_iInf
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_eq_iSup_iInf {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ k =
      ⨆ S : {S : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜) // (k : ℕ) + 1 ≤ finrank 𝕜 S},
        ⨅ x : {x : n → 𝕜 // x ∈ S.1 ∧ x ≠ 0}, rayleighQuotient A x.1

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_compression
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_compression {r : Type*}
    [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card r)) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i + (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card r),
      by have := card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ; omega⟩ ≤
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues₀ i

Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_submatrix
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_submatrix {r : Type*}
    [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (e : r ↪ n)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card r)) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i + (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card r),

Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_submatrix_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_submatrix_le {r : Type*} [Fintype r]
    [DecidableEq r] {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (e : r ↪ n)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_eigenvalues₀_mul_le {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    ∃ S : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜), (k : ℕ) + 1 ≤ finrank 𝕜 S ∧
      ∀ x ∈ S, hA.eigenvalues₀ k * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ RCLike.re (quadForm A x)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.exists_submodule_le_eigenvalues₀_mul {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) :
    ∃ W : Submodule 𝕜 (n → 𝕜), Fintype.card n ≤ finrank 𝕜 W + k ∧
      ∀ x ∈ W, RCLike.re (quadForm A x) ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ k * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ x)

NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.X_mul_poly
statement:
theorem X_mul_poly (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j + 1 < q) :
    X * D.poly j = C (D.beta j) * D.poly (j - 1) + C (D.alpha j) * D.poly j +
      C (D.beta (j + 1)) * D.poly (j + 1)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.cfc_T_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem cfc_T_apply_zero_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    cfc f D.T ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩ = ∑ i, f ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i) *
      ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_T_monic
statement:
theorem charpoly_T_monic (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) :
    D.T.charpoly.Monic ∧ D.T.charpoly.natDegree = q

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_restrict_T_mul_poly_zero
statement:
theorem charpoly_restrict_T_mul_poly_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : j < q) :
    (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict hj.le)).charpoly * D.poly 0 =
      C (∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, D.beta k) * D.poly j

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.degree_poly
statement: theorem degree_poly (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) : (D.poly j).degree = j

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.degree_poly_le
statement: theorem degree_poly_le (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : (D.poly j).degree ≤ j

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hq : 0 < q) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < 2 * q) :
    b ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b) = (b ⬝ᵥ b) * ∑ i,
      p.eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i) *
        ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.dotProduct_cfc_T_mulVec_eq_sum
statement:
theorem dotProduct_cfc_T_mulVec_eq_sum (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hq : 0 < q) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (cfc f D.T *ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b)) = (b ⬝ᵥ b) * ∑ i,
      f ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i) *
        ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_restrict_T
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_restrict_T (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {q' : ℕ} (h : q' ≤ q) (i : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin q'))) :
    (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues₀ ⟨i + (Fintype.card (Fin q) - Fintype.card (Fin q')),
      by have := i.isLt; simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at this ⊢; omega⟩ ≤
      (isHermitian_T (D.restrict h) hA).eigenvalues₀ i

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues₀_restrict_T_le
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_restrict_T_le (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {q' : ℕ}
    (h : q' ≤ q) (i : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin q'))) :
    (isHermitian_T (D.restrict h) hA).eigenvalues₀ i ≤
      (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues₀ (Fin.castLE (by simpa using h) i)

theorem exists_col_eq_aeval (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : Fin q) :

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sub_mul_sum_eval_poly_mul
statement:
theorem sub_mul_sum_eval_poly_mul (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {m : ℕ}
    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : m < q) (x y : ℝ) :
    (x - y) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (D.poly j).eval x * (D.poly j).eval y =
      D.beta m * ((D.poly m).eval x * (D.poly (m - 1)).eval y -
        (D.poly (m - 1)).eval x * (D.poly m).eval y)

name: NLAlib.det_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem det_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] (a β : ℕ → 𝕜) (m : ℕ) (x : 𝕜) :
    (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) 𝕜) - jacobiMatrix a β (m + 2)).det =
      (x - a 0) * (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) 𝕜) -
          jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => β (i + 1)) (m + 1)).det -
        β 1 ^ 2 * (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜) -
          jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 2)) (fun i => β (i + 2)) m).det

theorem map_jacobiMatrix {𝕜 𝕜' : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [Field 𝕜']

theorem submatrix_succ_jacobiMatrix {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] (a β : ℕ → 𝕜) (m : ℕ) :
    (jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1)).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =
      jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => β (i + 1)) m

name: NLAlib.submatrix_succ_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem submatrix_succ_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] (a β : ℕ → 𝕜) (m : ℕ) (x : 𝕜) :
    (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) 𝕜) - jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1)).submatrix
        Fin.succ Fin.succ =
      x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) 𝕜) -
        jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => β (i + 1)) m

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.inv_smul_one_sub_T_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_T_apply_zero_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hq : 0 < q) {x : ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i < x) :
    (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ) - D.T)⁻¹ ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩ =

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.posDef_smul_one_sub_T
NLAlib.inv_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero (a β : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) {x : ℝ}

statement:
theorem gauss_quadrature_of_orthogonal_nodal
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b)
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : InjOn v s)
    (horth : ∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree < s.card →
      ∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x * q.eval x ∂μ = 0)
    (hsupport : ∃ u : ι → ℝ, InjOn u s ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, u i ∈ μ.support) :
    (∀ i ∈ s, 0 < ∫ x, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x ∂μ) ∧
      (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ x, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x ∂μ) = (μ univ).toReal ∧
      (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * s.card : ℕ) →
        (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) =
          ∑ i ∈ s, (∫ x, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x ∂μ) * p.eval (v i))

    (∀ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree < (2 * s.card : ℕ) →

    (hv : Function.Injective v) (hu : Function.Injective u)
    (hL : ∀ r : ℝ[X], r.degree < n → r ≠ 0 → L (r ^ 2) ≠ 0)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) → L p = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    (ha : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) → L p = ∑ i, a i * p.eval (u i)) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (∀ i, u (e i) = v i) ∧ (∀ i, a (e i) = w i)

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_quadrature_iff
statement:
theorem integral_eq_quadrature_iff {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)

    {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : InjOn v s) (w : ι → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (s.card + k : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * p.eval (v i)) ↔
      (∀ i ∈ s, w i = ∫ x, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x ∂μ) ∧
        (∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree < k →
          (∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x * q.eval x ∂μ) = 0)

theorem rule_eq_up_to_permutation_of_moments (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)

statement:
theorem X_sub_C_mul_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (y : 𝕜) :
    (X - C y) * monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial L (n + 1) y =
      C ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval y / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n) *
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1) -
      C ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval y / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n) *

    (monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial L (n + 1) x).eval x =
      ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).derivative.eval x *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x -
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).derivative.eval x *
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval x) /
        orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_prod_beta

theorem orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_prod_beta

      ∏ i ∈ range n, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (i + 1)

name: NLAlib.sub_mul_eval_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial
statement:
theorem sub_mul_eval_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (x y : 𝕜) :
    (x - y) * (monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial L (n + 1) y).eval x =
      ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval x *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval y -
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x *
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval y) /
        orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_mul_prod_beta_eq
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialNorm_mul_prod_beta_eq {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜]
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ j ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k *
      (∏ i ∈ Ico (k + 1) (n + 1), orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L i) =
        orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n

name: NLAlib.sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial
statement:
theorem sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial {L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hH : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n) (x : ℝ) :
    (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L n).eval x ^ 2 =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x ^ 2 / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n

name: NLAlib.sub_mul_sum_prod_beta_mul_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
statement:
theorem sub_mul_sum_prod_beta_mul_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜]
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ j ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (x y : 𝕜) :
    (x - y) * (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1),
      (∏ i ∈ Ico (k + 1) (n + 1), orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L i) *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval x * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval y) =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval x * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval y -
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval y

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_eq_confluent_and_pos
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_eq_confluent_and_pos
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ j ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ j ≤ n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j) (x : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k).eval x ^ 2) =
      ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).derivative.eval x *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x -
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).derivative.eval x *
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval x) / orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ∧
      0 < ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k).eval x ^ 2

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_eq_normalized_confluent_and_pos
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_eq_normalized_confluent_and_pos
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ j ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ j ≤ n + 1, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j) (x : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k).eval x ^ 2) =
      Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1)) *
        ((orthonormalMomentPolynomial L (n + 1)).derivative.eval x *
          (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L n).eval x -
          (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L n).derivative.eval x *
            (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval x) ∧
      0 < ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L k).eval x ^ 2

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_restrict_eq_jacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem T_restrict_eq_jacobiMatrix (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ q) : (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict hj)) = jacobiMatrix D.alpha D.beta j

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.jacobiContinuant_eq_charpoly_restrict_T
statement:
theorem jacobiContinuant_eq_charpoly_restrict_T (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ q) :
    jacobiContinuant D.alpha D.beta j = (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict hj)).charpoly

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_sub_nextCoeff
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_sub_nextCoeff
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).nextCoeff -
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).nextCoeff

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_restrict_T_succ_eq
statement:
theorem charpoly_restrict_T_succ_eq (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j + 1 ≤ q) :
    (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict hj)).charpoly =
      (X - C (D.alpha j)) * (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict (by omega : j ≤ q))).charpoly -
        C (D.beta j ^ 2) * (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict (by omega : j - 1 ≤ q))).charpoly

name: NLAlib.X_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial
statement:
theorem X_mul_orthonormalMomentPolynomial (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) :
    X * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L n =
      C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L n)) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L (n - 1) +
      C (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L n +
      C (Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1))) * orthonormalMomentPolynomial L (n + 1)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_self_eq_alpha
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_apply_self_eq_alpha (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (hH : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L i.val) :
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n i i = orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L i.val

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_eq_jacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_eq_jacobiMatrix (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) :
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n =
      jacobiMatrix (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L) (fun i => Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L i)) n

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_eq_sqrt_beta
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_eq_sqrt_beta
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n i j = Real.sqrt (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L j.val)

name: NLAlib.sq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_eq_beta
statement:
theorem sq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_superdiagonal_eq_beta
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ k < n, 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k) (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L n i j ^ 2 = orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L j.val

name: NLAlib.jacobiMatrix_lanczosAlpha_lanczosBeta_eq_T
statement:
theorem jacobiMatrix_lanczosAlpha_lanczosBeta_eq_T
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) :
    jacobiMatrix (lanczosAlpha A b) (lanczosBeta A b) q =
      LanczosDecomp.T (arnoldiDecomp A b q hq)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_mulVec_eval_poly_eq_smul
statement:
theorem T_mulVec_eval_poly_eq_smul (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (i : Fin q) :
    D.T *ᵥ (fun j : Fin q => (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i)) =
      (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i •
        (fun j : Fin q => (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i))

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.aeval_poly_T_mulVec_transpose_Q_eq_single
statement:
theorem aeval_poly_T_mulVec_transpose_Q_eq_single (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (j : Fin q) : aeval D.T (D.poly j.val) *ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) = Pi.single j 1

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_eq_eval_poly_mul
statement:
theorem eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_eq_eval_poly_mul (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (i j : Fin q) :
    (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i j =
      (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i) *
        ((D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩ * (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.exists_eigenvectorBasis_T_eq_sign_smul_eval_poly
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvectorBasis_T_eq_sign_smul_eval_poly (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (i : Fin q) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, ε ^ 2 = 1 ∧
      (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i =
        (ε / ‖WithLp.toLp 2
          (fun j : Fin q => (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i))‖) •
        (fun j : Fin q => (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i))

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.mul_sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_eq_inv_sum_sq_eval_poly
statement:
theorem mul_sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_eq_inv_sum_sq_eval_poly
    (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (i : Fin q) :
    (b ⬝ᵥ b) * ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2 =
      (∑ j : Fin q, ((D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i)) ^ 2)⁻¹

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_weight_mul_eval_poly_mul_eval_poly
statement:
theorem sum_weight_mul_eval_poly_mul_eval_poly (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (j k : Fin q) :
    (∑ i : Fin q, (b ⬝ᵥ b) * ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2 *
      (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i) *
      (D.poly k.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i)) = if j = k then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual_le
statement:
theorem abs_trace_compression_add_quadForm_residual_le
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {Q : Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (w : n → ℝ) :
    |(Qᵀ * A * Q).trace + quadForm ((1 - Q * Qᵀ) * A * (1 - Q * Qᵀ)) w| ≤
      specNorm A * (Fintype.card n + ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos_and_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos_and_le_specNorm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) {j : ℕ} (hj0 : 0 < j) (hj : j < q) :
    0 < LanczosDecomp.beta (arnoldiDecomp A b q hq) j ∧
      LanczosDecomp.beta (arnoldiDecomp A b q hq) j ≤ specNorm A

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_sq_eval_poly_eq_confluent_and_pos
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eval_poly_eq_confluent_and_pos (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {m : ℕ} (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : m < q) (x : ℝ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range m, (D.poly j).eval x ^ 2) =
      D.beta m * ((D.poly m).derivative.eval x * (D.poly (m - 1)).eval x -
        (D.poly (m - 1)).derivative.eval x * (D.poly m).eval x) ∧
      0 < ∑ j ∈ range m, (D.poly j).eval x ^ 2

statement:

    (C (y i) * hermiteValueBasis s v i + C (d i) * hermiteDerivativeBasis s v i).natDegree ≤

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_nodal_chebyshevZero_le
statement:
theorem abs_eval_nodal_chebyshevZero_le (q : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |(Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ (chebyshevZero q)).eval x| ≤ 1 / 2 ^ (q - 1)

name: NLAlib.abs_sub_eval_interpolate_chebyshevZero_le
statement:
theorem abs_sub_eval_interpolate_chebyshevZero_le {f : ℝ → ℝ} {q : ℕ} {M : ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1) 1))
    (hf' : ∀ k ≤ q, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo (-1) 1))
    (hM : ∀ ξ ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, |iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ| ≤ M) :
    ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |f x - (Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (chebyshevZero (q + 1))
        (f ∘ chebyshevZero (q + 1))).eval x| ≤ M / (2 ^ q * (q + 1).factorial)

name: NLAlib.eval_T_real_chebyshevZero
statement:
theorem eval_T_real_chebyshevZero (q : ℕ) (k : Fin q) :
    (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (chebyshevZero q k) = 0

name: NLAlib.exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_card
statement:
theorem exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_card {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {q : ℕ} {s : Finset ℝ}
    (hs : s.card = q + 2) (hsab : ∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ Icc a b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < q, ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) f) (Ioo a b))
    (hz : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = 0) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b, iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ = 0

name: NLAlib.exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_strictMono
statement:
theorem exists_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero_of_strictMono {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {q : ℕ}
    {v : Fin (q + 2) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v) (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < q, ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) f) (Ioo a b))
    (hz : ∀ i, f (v i) = 0) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b, iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ = 0

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_eval_interpolate_eq
statement:
theorem exists_sub_eval_interpolate_eq {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b x : ℝ} {q : ℕ} {v : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hv : Function.Injective v) (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k ≤ q, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b, f x - (Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ v (f ∘ v)).eval x =
      iteratedDeriv (q + 1) f ξ / (q + 1).factorial * (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ v).eval x

name: NLAlib.nodal_chebyshevZero
statement:
theorem nodal_chebyshevZero (q : ℕ) :
    Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ (chebyshevZero q) = C (1 / 2 ^ (q - 1)) * Chebyshev.T ℝ q

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_eval_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_of_multiset
statement:
theorem exists_sub_eval_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_of_multiset
    {a b x : ℝ} (m : Multiset ℝ) (hm : 0 < m.card)
    (hmem : ∀ y ∈ m, y ∈ Icc a b)
    (hrep : ∀ y ∈ m, 1 < m.count y → y ∈ Ioo a b)
    {H ω : ℝ[X]} (hH : H.degree < m.card) (hω : ω.Monic) (hωdeg : ω.natDegree = m.card)
    (hωjet : ∀ y ∈ m, ∀ k < m.count y, (derivative^[k] ω).eval y = 0)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hjet : ∀ y ∈ m, ∀ k < m.count y,
      iteratedDeriv k f y = (derivative^[k] H).eval y)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < m.card, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) (hωx : ω.eval x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b, f x - H.eval x =
      iteratedDeriv m.card f ξ / m.card.factorial * ω.eval x

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_eval_hermiteInterpolate_eq
statement:
theorem exists_sub_eval_hermiteInterpolate_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {a b x : ℝ} (hab : a < b) {v : Fin n → ℝ} (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * n, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
      f x - (Lagrange.hermiteInterpolate univ v (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)).eval x =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f ξ / (2 * n).factorial *
          (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_nodal_sq
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_nodal_sq
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (v w : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v) (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * n : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * n, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b, (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i, w i * f (v i) =
      iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f ξ / (2 * n).factorial *
        ∫ x, (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_gaussRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_norm
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_gaussRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_norm
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * n, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f) (Ioo a b)) :
    let hMom := hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
      (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, gaussWeights μ hMom n i * f (gaussNodes μ hMom n i) =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * n) f ξ / (2 * n).factorial *
          orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialIntegral μ hMom) n

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.exists_quadForm_sub_cfc_T_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_norm
statement:
theorem exists_quadForm_sub_cfc_T_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_norm
    (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q)
    {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q) f) (Ioo a c)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a c,
      quadForm (cfc f A) b - ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 * cfc f D.T ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩ =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * q) f ξ / (2 * q).factorial *
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (aeval A D.T.charpoly *ᵥ b)‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.quadForm_le_norm_sq_mul_cfc_T_of_iteratedDeriv_nonpos

name: NLAlib.abs_pow_sub_eval_monomialChebyshevApprox_le
statement:
theorem abs_pow_sub_eval_monomialChebyshevApprox_le {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (d : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |x ^ s - (monomialChebyshevApprox s d).eval x| ≤
      2 * exp (- (d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * s))

name: NLAlib.abs_pow_sub_eval_monomialChebyshevApprox_le_sum
statement:
theorem abs_pow_sub_eval_monomialChebyshevApprox_le_sum (s d : ℕ) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |x ^ s - (monomialChebyshevApprox s d).eval x| ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ *
      (∑ j ∈ (range (s + 1)).filter
        (fun j : ℕ => d < Int.natAbs ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))), (s.choose j : ℝ))

    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ d ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |x ^ s - p.eval x| ≤ 2 * exp (- (d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * s))

name: NLAlib.inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_abs_tail_le
statement:
theorem inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_abs_tail_le (s : ℕ) {d θ : ℝ}
    (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ *
      (∑ j ∈ (range (s + 1)).filter
        (fun j : ℕ => d < |(((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ)|),
          (s.choose j : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * exp (-θ * d + (s : ℝ) * θ ^ 2 / 2)

name: NLAlib.inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_mul_exp_le
statement:
theorem inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_mul_exp_le (s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ *
      (∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), (s.choose j : ℝ) * exp (θ * (((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ))) ≤
        exp ((s : ℝ) * θ ^ 2 / 2)

name: NLAlib.inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_natAbs_tail_le
statement:
theorem inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_natAbs_tail_le {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (d : ℕ) :
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ *
      (∑ j ∈ (range (s + 1)).filter
        (fun j : ℕ => d < Int.natAbs ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))), (s.choose j : ℝ)) ≤
      2 * exp (- (d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * s))

name: NLAlib.monomialChebyshevApprox_eq_X_pow
statement:
theorem monomialChebyshevApprox_eq_X_pow {s d : ℕ} (hsd : s ≤ d) :

name: NLAlib.monomialChebyshevApprox_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem monomialChebyshevApprox_zero (d : ℕ) : monomialChebyshevApprox 0 d = 1

name: NLAlib.pow_eq_inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_eval_T
statement:
theorem pow_eq_inv_two_pow_mul_sum_choose_eval_T (s : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ^ s = ((2 : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ *
      (∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), (s.choose j : ℝ) * (T ℝ ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))).eval x)

name: NLAlib.sum_choose_int_sub_two_mul_succ
statement:
theorem sum_choose_int_sub_two_mul_succ {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (f : ℤ → R) (s : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (s + 2), ((s + 1).choose j : R) * f ((s + 1 : ℕ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))) =
      ∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), (s.choose j : R) *
        (f ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) + 1) + f ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) - 1))

name: NLAlib.sum_choose_mul_chebyshev_eq_two_mul_X_pow
statement:
theorem sum_choose_mul_chebyshev_eq_two_mul_X_pow (s : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), C (s.choose j : ℝ) * T ℝ ((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ))) =
      (2 * X : ℝ[X]) ^ s

name: NLAlib.sum_choose_mul_exp_int_sub_two_mul
statement:
theorem sum_choose_mul_exp_int_sub_two_mul (s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (s + 1), (s.choose j : ℝ) * exp (θ * (((s : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ))) =
      (exp θ + exp (-θ)) ^ s

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_neg_sub_eval_exponentialApprox_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_neg_sub_eval_exponentialApprox_le {b δ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) b) :

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_sub_eval_exponentialChebyshevApprox_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_sub_eval_exponentialChebyshevApprox_le {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    {t : ℕ} (_ht0 : 0 < t) (ht : exp 2 * ℓ ≤ (t : ℝ)) (d : ℕ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |exp (-ℓ) * exp (-ℓ * y) - (exponentialChebyshevApprox ℓ t d).eval y| ≤
      exp (-(t : ℝ)) + 2 * exp (-(d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * t))

name: NLAlib.abs_exp_sub_sum_pow_div_factorial_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_sub_sum_pow_div_factorial_le {ℓ u : ℝ} (_hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hu : |u| ≤ ℓ)
    (t : ℕ) :
    |exp u - ∑ i ∈ range t, u ^ i / (i.factorial : ℝ)| ≤
      ∑' i : ℕ, ℓ ^ (i + t) / ((i + t).factorial : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.degree_exponentialApprox_le

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_exp_neg_sub_eval_le
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_exp_neg_sub_eval_le {b δ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ exponentialApproxDegree b δ ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) b, |exp (-x) - p.eval x| ≤ δ

name: NLAlib.exp_neg_mul_tsum_pow_div_factorial_nat_add_le
statement:
theorem exp_neg_mul_tsum_pow_div_factorial_nat_add_le {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_cfc_exp_neg_mulVec_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_cfc_exp_neg_mulVec_sub_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {b δ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) b)
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (v : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hK : krylovSpace A v q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    (hq : exponentialApproxDegree b δ < 2 * q) :
    |v ⬝ᵥ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => exp (-x)) A *ᵥ v) -
      (Qᵀ *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => exp (-x)) (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ v))| ≤
        2 * δ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_cfc_pow_mulVec_sub_le_of_degree_cutoff
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_cfc_pow_mulVec_sub_le_of_degree_cutoff {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (v : n → ℝ)
    {q s d : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hd : d < 2 * q)
    (hK : krylovSpace A v q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |v ⬝ᵥ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ s) A *ᵥ v) -
      (Qᵀ *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ s) (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ v))| ≤
        4 * exp (-(d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * s)) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cfc_exp_neg_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_cfc_exp_neg_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {b δ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) b)
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (v : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hK : krylovSpace A v q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    (hq : exponentialApproxDegree b δ < q) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (cfc (fun x : ℝ => exp (-x)) A *ᵥ v -
      krylovFunApprox A (fun x : ℝ => exp (-x)) v Q)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (2 * δ) ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.inv_smul_one_sub_map_apply_eq_sum
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_map_apply_eq_sum {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (f : ℝ →+* 𝕜) {z : 𝕜} (hz : ∀ i, z ≠ f (hA.eigenvalues i)) (r s : ι) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) - A.map f)⁻¹ r s =
      ∑ i, f ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) r) *
        f ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) s) / (z - f (hA.eigenvalues i))

name: NLAlib.inv_smul_one_sub_map_eq_eigenvector_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_map_eq_eigenvector_mul_diagonal
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ →+* 𝕜) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : ∀ i, z ≠ f (hA.eigenvalues i)) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) - A.map f)⁻¹ =
      (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).map f *
        diagonal (fun i => (z - f (hA.eigenvalues i))⁻¹) *
          ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).map f)ᵀ

statement:
theorem det_smul_one_sub_map_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :

name: NLAlib.inv_smul_one_sub_map_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_map_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero (a β : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) -
      (jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1)).map Complex.ofRealHom)⁻¹ 0 0 =
        jacobiFraction (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ a) (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ β) z (m + 1) 0

name: NLAlib.inv_smul_one_sub_map_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero_eq_det_ratio
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_map_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero_eq_det_ratio
    (a β : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) -
      (jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1)).map Complex.ofRealHom)⁻¹ 0 0 =
      (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) -
        (jacobiMatrix (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => β (i + 1)) m).map Complex.ofRealHom).det /
      (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) -
        (jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1)).map Complex.ofRealHom).det

name: NLAlib.jacobiFraction_map_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero
statement:
theorem jacobiFraction_map_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero (a β : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :

name: NLAlib.jacobiFraction_step_denominator_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero
statement:
theorem jacobiFraction_step_denominator_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero (a β : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    z - Complex.ofRealHom (a 0) - Complex.ofRealHom (β 1) ^ 2 *
      jacobiFraction (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ a) (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ β) z m 1 ≠ 0

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.inv_smul_one_sub_map_T_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_map_T_apply_zero_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℂ) - D.T.map Complex.ofRealHom)⁻¹
      ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩ =
      jacobiFraction (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ D.alpha) (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ D.beta) z q 0

theorem dotProduct_mulVec_vecCons (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ)

    vecCons x₀ y ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ vecCons x₀ y =
      A 0 0 * x₀ ^ 2 + x₀ * (∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j) + x₀ * (∑ i, y i * A i.succ 0) +
        y ⬝ᵥ A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ *ᵥ y

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_pivotSchur_mulVec
statement:
theorem dotProduct_pivotSchur_mulVec (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (y : Fin n → ℝ) :
    y ⬝ᵥ pivotSchur A *ᵥ y = y ⬝ᵥ A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ *ᵥ y -
      (A 0 0)⁻¹ * ((∑ i, y i * A i.succ 0) * (∑ j, A 0 j.succ * y j))

name: NLAlib.eq_borderedMatrix_mul_borderedMatrix_pivotSchur

      borderedMatrix (A 0 0) (fun j => A 0 j.succ) 0 (pivotSchur A)

statement:
theorem darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_apply {n : ℕ} (e : ℕ → 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (i j : Fin n) :
    (darbouxLowerMatrix n e * B) i j = B i j +
      if hi : 0 < i.val then e (i.val-1) * B ⟨i.val-1, by omega⟩ j else 0

name: NLAlib.darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_darbouxUpperMatrix
statement:
theorem darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_darbouxUpperMatrix (n : ℕ) (q e : ℕ → 𝕜) :
    darbouxLowerMatrix n e * darbouxUpperMatrix n q =
      monicJacobiMatrix n (fun i => q i + if i=0 then 0 else e (i-1))
        (fun i => q (i-1) * e (i-1))

name: NLAlib.darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_darbouxLowerMatrix
statement:
theorem darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_darbouxLowerMatrix (n : ℕ) (q e : ℕ → 𝕜) :
    darbouxUpperMatrix n q * darbouxLowerMatrix n e =
      monicJacobiMatrix n
        (fun i => q i + if i+1<n then e i else 0)
        (fun i => q i * e (i-1))

name: NLAlib.monicJacobiMatrix_eq_darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_darbouxLowerMatrix_add_boundary
statement:
theorem monicJacobiMatrix_eq_darbouxUpperMatrix_mul_darbouxLowerMatrix_add_boundary
    (n : ℕ) (q e : ℕ → 𝕜) :
    monicJacobiMatrix n (fun i => q i + e i) (fun i => q i * e (i-1)) =
      darbouxUpperMatrix n q * darbouxLowerMatrix n e +
        e (n-1) • terminalCoordinateMatrix n

name: NLAlib.darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose_apply
statement:
theorem darbouxLowerMatrix_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose_apply {n : ℕ}
    (d e : ℕ → 𝕜) (i j : Fin n) :
    (darbouxLowerMatrix n e * diagonal (fun k : Fin n => d k.val) *
      (darbouxLowerMatrix n e)ᵀ) i j =
    if i.val = j.val then d i.val +
      (if i.val = 0 then 0 else e (i.val - 1) ^ 2 * d (i.val - 1))
    else if i.val + 1 = j.val then e i.val * d i.val
    else if j.val + 1 = i.val then e j.val * d j.val else 0

name: NLAlib.sub_jacksonPeriodicApprox_eq_integral
statement:
theorem sub_jacksonPeriodicApprox_eq_integral {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hg : LipschitzWith L g)
    (hper : Function.Periodic g (2 * Real.pi)) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    g x - jacksonPeriodicApprox n g x = -(2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      ∫ t : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi, sawtoothError n t * deriv (fun s : ℝ => g (x - s)) t

name: NLAlib.even_realChebyshevCircleFunction

theorem even_realChebyshevCircleFunction (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) :

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_unit
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_unit {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      |f x - p.eval x| ≤ Real.pi * (L : ℝ) / (2 * (n + 1))

name: NLAlib.exists_polynomial_circle_convolution
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_circle_convolution {K : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ} (hK : K.degree ≤ n)
    {g : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) (heven : ∀ t, g (-t) = g t) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ a : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi),
      (∫ t : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi), K.eval ((fourier 1 t).re) * g (a - t)
        ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = p.eval ((fourier 1 a).re)

name: NLAlib.exists_polynomial_jacksonPeriodicApprox
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_jacksonPeriodicApprox {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ x : ℝ,
      jacksonPeriodicApprox n (fun t => f (cos t)) x = p.eval (cos x)

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_interval
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_interval {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a c : ℝ}
    {L : NNReal} (hac : a < c) (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc a c)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc a c,
      |f x - p.eval x| ≤ Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (c - a) / (4 * (n + 1))

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (v : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hK : krylovSpace A v q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a c : ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hac : a < c)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c) (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc a c)) :
    |v ⬝ᵥ (cfc f A *ᵥ v) -
      (Qᵀ *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (cfc f (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ v))| ≤
        Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (c - a) / (4 * q) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.IsAffineMinimizer.le_aeval
statement:
theorem IsAffineMinimizer.le_aeval {E : (n → K) → ℝ} {A : Matrix n n K} {c x₀ xs x : n → K}

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_krylovSpace_add_sub_eq_aeval_mulVec
statement:
theorem exists_mem_krylovSpace_add_sub_eq_aeval_mulVec {A : Matrix n n K} {c xs : n → K}

name: NLAlib.isCGIterate_iff
statement:
theorem isCGIterate_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {c x₀ : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} {x : n → ℝ} :
    IsCGIterate A c x₀ q x ↔
      x - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q ∧
        ∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q, cgObjective A c x ≤ cgObjective A c (x₀ + y)

name: NLAlib.isCGIterate_iff_isAffineMinimizer_quadForm_sub
statement:
theorem isCGIterate_iff_isAffineMinimizer_quadForm_sub {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {c x₀ xs x : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) {q : ℕ} :
    IsCGIterate A c x₀ q x ↔
      IsAffineMinimizer (fun y => quadForm A (y - xs)) x₀ (krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) x

name: NLAlib.isCGIterate_of_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isCGIterate_of_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hpsd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues i) {c x₀ x : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
    (hx : x - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q)
    (horth : ∀ z ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q, z ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) = 0) :
    IsCGIterate A c x₀ q x

name: NLAlib.quadForm_sub_le_of_isCGIterate
statement:
theorem quadForm_sub_le_of_isCGIterate {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    {c x₀ xs x : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) {q : ℕ} (hx : IsCGIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    quadForm A (x - xs) ≤ (2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q) ^ 2 * quadForm A (x₀ - xs)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevIterate_add_two
statement:
theorem chebyshevIterate_add_two {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (q + 2) =
      ((Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)))⁻¹ •
        ((4 / (b - a) * (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) •
            (((b + a) / 2) • chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (q + 1) +
              (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (q + 1))) -
          (Chebyshev.T ℝ (q : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) • chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ q)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevIterate_one
statement:
theorem chebyshevIterate_one {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ 1 = x₀ + (2 / (b + a)) • (c - A *ᵥ x₀)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevIterate_sub
statement:
theorem chebyshevIterate_sub {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {c xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ q - xs =
      aeval A (chebyshevResidual a b q) *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevIterate_sub_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem chebyshevIterate_sub_mem_krylovSpace {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ q - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q

name: NLAlib.chebyshevIterate_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevIterate_zero (a b : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ 0 = x₀

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_chebyshevIterate_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_chebyshevIterate_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ q) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ q) ≤
      (2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q) ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_polyIterate_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_polyIterate_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {s : ℝ[X]} {S : Set ℝ} {M : ℝ} (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ S)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ S, |(1 - X * s).eval x| ≤ M) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    (c - A *ᵥ polyIterate A c x₀ s) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ polyIterate A c x₀ s) ≤
      M ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_richardsonIterate_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_richardsonIterate_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b ω : ℝ} (hω : 0 ≤ ω) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) (c x₀ : n → ℝ)
    (q : ℕ) :
    (c - A *ᵥ richardsonIterate ω A c x₀ q) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ richardsonIterate ω A c x₀ q) ≤
      (max |1 - ω * a| |1 - ω * b| ^ q) ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))

name: NLAlib.polyIterate_sub
statement:
theorem polyIterate_sub {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {c xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ)
    (s : ℝ[X]) : polyIterate A c x₀ s - xs = aeval A (1 - X * s) *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)

name: NLAlib.polyIterate_sub_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem polyIterate_sub_mem_krylovSpace (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) {s : ℝ[X]} {q : ℕ}
    (hs : s.degree < q) : polyIterate A c x₀ s - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q

name: NLAlib.quadForm_chebyshevIterate_sub_le
NLAlib.quadForm_polyIterate_sub_le
statement:
theorem quadForm_polyIterate_sub_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {g s : ℝ[X]}
    {S : Set ℝ} {M : ℝ} (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ S) (hg : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ g.eval x)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ S, |(1 - X * s).eval x| ≤ M) {c xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c)
    (x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (aeval A g) (polyIterate A c x₀ s - xs) ≤ M ^ 2 * quadForm (aeval A g) (x₀ - xs)

name: NLAlib.quadForm_richardsonIterate_sub_le
NLAlib.quadForm_richardsonIterate_sub_le_of_optimal
statement:
theorem quadForm_richardsonIterate_sub_le_of_optimal {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    {c xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    quadForm A (richardsonIterate (2 / (a + b)) A c x₀ q - xs) ≤
      (((b - a) / (b + a)) ^ q) ^ 2 * quadForm A (x₀ - xs)

name: NLAlib.richardsonIterate_succ
statement:
theorem richardsonIterate_succ (ω : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    richardsonIterate ω A c x₀ (q + 1) =
      richardsonIterate ω A c x₀ q + ω • (c - A *ᵥ richardsonIterate ω A c x₀ q)

name: NLAlib.richardsonIterate_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem richardsonIterate_zero (ω : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    richardsonIterate ω A c x₀ 0 = x₀

name: NLAlib.sub_mulVec_chebyshevIterate
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_chebyshevIterate {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    c - A *ᵥ chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ q =
      aeval A (chebyshevResidual a b q) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)

name: NLAlib.sub_mulVec_polyIterate
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_polyIterate (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ[X]) :
    c - A *ᵥ polyIterate A c x₀ s = aeval A (1 - X * s) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRecurrenceDirection_succ
statement:
theorem chebyshevRecurrenceDirection_succ (a b : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevRecurrenceDirection a b A c x₀ (k + 1) =
      (chebyshevRho a b (k + 1) * chebyshevRho a b k) •
          chebyshevRecurrenceDirection a b A c x₀ k +
        (4 * chebyshevRho a b (k + 1) / (b - a)) •
          (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1))

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRecurrenceDirection_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevRecurrenceDirection_zero (a b : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    chebyshevRecurrenceDirection a b A c x₀ 0 = (2 / (b + a)) • (c - A *ᵥ x₀)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_eq_chebyshevIterate
statement:
theorem chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_eq_chebyshevIterate {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k = chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ k

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_succ
statement:
theorem chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_succ (a b : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1) =
      chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k + chebyshevRecurrenceDirection a b A c x₀ k

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_zero (a b : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) : chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ 0 = x₀

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRho_eq_eval_T_div_eval_T_succ
statement:
theorem chebyshevRho_eq_eval_T_div_eval_T_succ {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevRho a b k = (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) /
      (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRho_pos
statement:
theorem chebyshevRho_pos {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < chebyshevRho a b k

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRho_succ
statement:
theorem chebyshevRho_succ (a b : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevRho a b (k + 1) =
      (2 * ((b + a) / (b - a)) - chebyshevRho a b k)⁻¹

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRho_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevRho_zero (a b : ℝ) :
    chebyshevRho a b 0 = ((b + a) / (b - a))⁻¹

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_le
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k)‖ ≤
      (1 / (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_le_two_mul_pow
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_le_two_mul_pow
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k)‖ ≤
      (2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ k) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖

name: NLAlib.quadForm_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_sub_le
statement:
theorem quadForm_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_sub_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) {c xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    quadForm A (chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k - xs) ≤
      (1 / (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) ^ 2 *
        quadForm A (x₀ - xs)

name: NLAlib.quadForm_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_sub_le_two_mul_pow
statement:
theorem quadForm_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_sub_le_two_mul_pow
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) {c xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    quadForm A (chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k - xs) ≤
      (2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ k) ^ 2 * quadForm A (x₀ - xs)

name: NLAlib.sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    c - A *ᵥ chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k =
      aeval A (chebyshevResidual a b k) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)

name: NLAlib.two_mul_div_sub_chebyshevRho_pos
statement:
theorem two_mul_div_sub_chebyshevRho_pos {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < 2 * ((b + a) / (b - a)) - chebyshevRho a b k

name: NLAlib.columnSpace_orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace
statement:
theorem columnSpace_orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace
    (S : Submodule 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)) :
    columnSpace (orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace S) = S

name: NLAlib.finrank_toCoordinateSubmodule
statement:
theorem finrank_toCoordinateSubmodule (S : Submodule 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)) :
    Module.finrank 𝕜 (toCoordinateSubmodule S) = Module.finrank 𝕜 S

name: NLAlib.finrank_toEuclideanSubmodule
statement:
theorem finrank_toEuclideanSubmodule (S : Submodule 𝕜 (m → 𝕜)) :
    Module.finrank 𝕜 (toEuclideanSubmodule S) = Module.finrank 𝕜 S

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix (S : Submodule 𝕜 (m → 𝕜)) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (orthonormalBasisMatrix S)

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace
    (S : Submodule 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (orthonormalBasisMatrixOfEuclideanSubspace S)

statement:
theorem range_orthonormalBasisMatrix (S : Submodule 𝕜 (m → 𝕜)) :
    LinearMap.range (orthonormalBasisMatrix S).mulVecLin = S

name: NLAlib.toCoordinateSubmodule_toEuclideanSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] theorem toCoordinateSubmodule_toEuclideanSubmodule
    (S : Submodule 𝕜 (m → 𝕜)) :
    toCoordinateSubmodule (toEuclideanSubmodule S) = S

statement:
theorem toEuclideanSubmodule_range_mulVecLin {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    toEuclideanSubmodule (LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin) = columnSpace B

statement:
@[simp] theorem toEuclideanSubmodule_toCoordinateSubmodule
    (S : Submodule 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)) :
    toEuclideanSubmodule (toCoordinateSubmodule S) = S

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.dotProduct_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.dotProduct_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_Icc (hA : A.IsHermitian) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) ≤
      (2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q) ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.dotProduct_le_of_eq_mul_diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.dotProduct_le_of_eq_mul_diagonal_mul {V W : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {d : n → ℝ} (hVW : V * W = 1) (hAd : A = V * Matrix.diagonal d * W)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ i, |p.eval (d i)| ≤ M) :
    (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) ≤
      (specNorm V * specNorm W * M) ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.dotProduct_le_sq_mul_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.dotProduct_le_sq_mul_of_isHermitian (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ i, |p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i)| ≤ M) :
    (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) ≤ M ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.eq_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.eq_of_isUnit {x' : n → ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) (hx' : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x') : x = x'

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.exists_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.exists_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ q ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ∧ c - A *ᵥ x = aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.isLeast_dotProduct_aeval
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.isLeast_dotProduct_aeval (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    IsLeast {v | ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ q ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ∧
        v = (aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))}
      ((c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x))

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.le_aeval
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.le_aeval (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) {p : ℝ[X]}
    (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) :
    (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) ≤
      (aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.le_of_le
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.le_of_le {q' : ℕ} {x' : n → ℝ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x)
    (hx' : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q' x') (h : q ≤ q') :
    (c - A *ᵥ x') ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x') ≤ (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x)

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.sub_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.sub_mulVec_eq {x' : n → ℝ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x)
    (hx' : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x') : c - A *ᵥ x = c - A *ᵥ x'

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.sub_mulVec_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.sub_mulVec_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le (hA : IsUnit A)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) (hq : krylovGrade A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) ≤ q) :
    c - A *ᵥ x = 0

name: NLAlib.exists_isGMRESIterate
statement:
theorem exists_isGMRESIterate (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ x, IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x

name: NLAlib.isGMRESIterate_iff_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_iff_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero :
    IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x ↔ x - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q ∧
      ∀ z ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q, (A *ᵥ z) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) = 0

name: NLAlib.isGMRESIterate_iff_isAffineMinimizer
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_iff_isAffineMinimizer (hA : A.IsHermitian) {xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) :
    IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x ↔
      IsAffineMinimizer (fun y => quadForm (aeval A (X ^ 2 : ℝ[X])) (y - xs)) x₀
        (krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) x

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem dotProduct_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1))
    (y : Fin q → ℝ) :
    (c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y)) ⬝ᵥ
        (c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y)) =
      (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y)

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.exists_eq_add_mulVec_of_isGMRESIterate
statement:
theorem exists_eq_add_mulVec_of_isGMRESIterate (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1))
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    ∃ y, x = x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.exists_eq_mulVec_of_mem
statement:
theorem exists_eq_mulVec_of_mem (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b (q + 1)) {z : n → ℝ}

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.forall_dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem forall_dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq_zero_iff (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q)
    (y : Fin q → ℝ) :
    (∀ z ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q, z ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + D.Q *ᵥ y)) = 0) ↔
      D.H *ᵥ y = D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.isCGIterate_add_mulVec_of_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem isCGIterate_add_mulVec_of_mulVec_eq (hA : A.PosDef) (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q)

    IsCGIterate A c x₀ q (x₀ + D.Q *ᵥ y)

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_iff
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_iff (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1))
    (y : Fin q → ℝ) :
    IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q (x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y) ↔
      ∀ y' : Fin q → ℝ,
        (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) ≤
          (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y') ⬝ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y')

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_iff_of_pos
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_iff_of_pos (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1))
    (hD : 0 < D.Q.col 0 ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) (y : Fin q → ℝ) :
    IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q (x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y) ↔
      ∀ y' : Fin q → ℝ,
        (√((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) • Pi.single 0 1 - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ
            (√((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) • Pi.single 0 1 - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) ≤
          (√((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) • Pi.single 0 1 - D.Hbar *ᵥ y') ⬝ᵥ
            (√((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) • Pi.single 0 1 - D.Hbar *ᵥ y')

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.isLeast_dotProduct_of_isGMRESIterate
statement:
theorem isLeast_dotProduct_of_isGMRESIterate (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1))
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    IsLeast (Set.range fun y : Fin q → ℝ =>
        (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y))
      ((c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x))

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_smul_single
statement:
theorem transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_smul_single (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (hq : 0 < q) :

statement:
theorem transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_sqrt_smul_single (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (hq : 0 < q)
