name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.exists_eq_add_mulVec_of_isFOMIterate
NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.fomIterate_eq_of_pos
statement:
theorem fomIterate_eq_of_pos (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hD : 0 < D.Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ b) (x₀ : n → ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.norm_sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_arnoldiDecomp
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_arnoldiDecomp
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hgrade : q + 1 ≤ krylovGrade A (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
    (hH : IsUnit ((arnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1) hgrade).restrict
      q.le_succ).H) :
    let D := arnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1) hgrade
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ (D.restrict q.le_succ).fomIterate x₀)‖ =
      D.H (Fin.last q) ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ *
        |((D.restrict q.le_succ).H⁻¹ *ᵥ Pi.single (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q) 1)
          ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩| * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.norm_sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_of_pos
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_of_pos
    (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hD : 0 < (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
    (hs : 0 ≤ D.H (Fin.last q) ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩)
    (hH : IsUnit (D.restrict q.le_succ).H) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ (D.restrict q.le_succ).fomIterate x₀)‖ =
      D.H (Fin.last q) ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ *
        |((D.restrict q.le_succ).H⁻¹ *ᵥ Pi.single (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q) 1)
          ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩| * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_neg_smul
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_neg_smul
    (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1)) (hq : 0 < q)
    {y : Fin q → ℝ}
    (hy : (D.restrict q.le_succ).H *ᵥ y =
      (D.restrict q.le_succ).Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) :
    c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y) =
      -(D.H (Fin.last q) ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ * y ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩) •
        D.Q.col (Fin.last q)

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_neg_smul_of_pos
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_neg_smul_of_pos
    (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hD : 0 < (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
    (hH : IsUnit (D.restrict q.le_succ).H) :
    c - A *ᵥ (D.restrict q.le_succ).fomIterate x₀ =
      -(D.H (Fin.last q) ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ *
        ((D.restrict q.le_succ).H⁻¹ *ᵥ Pi.single (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q) 1)
          ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖) •
        D.Q.col (Fin.last q)

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.exists_norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.exists_norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_le
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hAZ : A * Z = V * H)
    (hr : b - A *ᵥ x₀ = V *ᵥ g) :
    ∃ y : p → 𝕜, ∀ z ∈ LinearMap.range Z.mulVecLin,
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (x₀ + Z *ᵥ y))‖ ≤
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (x₀ + z))‖

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.forall_norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_le_iff
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.forall_norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_le_iff
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hAZ : A * Z = V * H)
    (hr : b - A *ᵥ x₀ = V *ᵥ g) (y : p → 𝕜) :
    (∀ y' : p → 𝕜, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (g - H *ᵥ y)‖ ≤
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (g - H *ᵥ y')‖) ↔
    ∀ z ∈ LinearMap.range Z.mulVecLin,
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (x₀ + Z *ᵥ y))‖ ≤
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (x₀ + z))‖

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_of_mul_eq_mul
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_of_mul_eq_mul
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hAZ : A * Z = V * H)

    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (x₀ + Z *ᵥ y))‖ =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (g - H *ᵥ y)‖

name: NLAlib.sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_mulVec_sub_of_mul_eq_mul
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_mulVec_sub_of_mul_eq_mul
    (hAZ : A * Z = V * H) (hr : b - A *ᵥ x₀ = V *ᵥ g) (y : p → 𝕜) :

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_iff_trace_mul_nonneg
statement:
theorem posSemidef_iff_trace_mul_nonneg {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    A.PosSemidef ↔ ∀ B : Matrix n n 𝕜, B.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ (A * B).trace

name: NLAlib.psd_trace_pairing_characterizations
statement:
theorem psd_trace_pairing_characterizations {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (A.PosSemidef ↔ ∀ B : Matrix n n 𝕜, B.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ (A * B).trace) ∧
    (∀ B : Matrix n n 𝕜, A.PosSemidef → B.PosSemidef →
      ((A * B).trace = 0 ↔ A * B = 0)) ∧
    (∀ B C : Matrix n n 𝕜, A.PosSemidef → B ≤ C →
      (A * B).trace ≤ (A * C).trace)

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_eq_sum_mul_star
statement:
theorem trace_mul_eq_sum_mul_star {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (A * B).trace = ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * star (B i j)

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_eq_trace_sqrt_conjTranspose_mul
statement:
theorem trace_mul_eq_trace_sqrt_conjTranspose_mul {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    (A * B).trace =
      ((CFC.sqrt A * CFC.sqrt B)ᴴ * (CFC.sqrt A * CFC.sqrt B)).trace

theorem trace_mul_eq_zero_iff_of_posSemidef {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}

statement:
theorem trace_mul_le_trace_mul_of_posSemidef {A B C : Matrix n n 𝕜}

statement:
theorem trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef {A B : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) : 0 ≤ (A * B).trace

name: NLAlib.trace_conjStarAlgAut
statement:
theorem trace_conjStarAlgAut {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [StarRing R]
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι R) (A : Matrix ι ι R) :
    Matrix.trace (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut R _ U A) = Matrix.trace A

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_mul_diagonal_pow
statement:
theorem trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_mul_diagonal_pow (B : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hB : Bᵀ = B) (ev : ι → ℝ) (a c : ℕ) :
    Matrix.trace (B * (Matrix.diagonal ev) ^ a * B * (Matrix.diagonal ev) ^ c) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, B i j ^ 2 * ev j ^ a * ev i ^ c

name: NLAlib.trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hR : R.IsHermitian) (n : ℕ) :
    Matrix.trace (R ^ n) = ∑ i, hR.eigenvalues i ^ n

name: NLAlib.cfc_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem cfc_eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_conjTranspose {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    hA.cfc f = (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜) *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (f (hA.eigenvalues i) : 𝕜)) *
        (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n 𝕜)ᴴ

name: NLAlib.mul_card_le_re_trace_cfc_of_le
statement:
theorem mul_card_le_re_trace_cfc_of_le {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hb : ∀ i, b ≤ f (hA.eigenvalues i)) :
    b * Fintype.card n ≤ RCLike.re (cfc f A).trace

statement:
theorem posSemidef_cfc_of_nonneg_eigenvalues {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian)

name: NLAlib.re_trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem re_trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    RCLike.re (cfc f A).trace = ∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i)

name: NLAlib.trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (cfc f A).trace = ∑ i, (f (hA.eigenvalues i) : 𝕜)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.frobSq_spectralClip_sub
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.frobSq_spectralClip_sub {H : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hH : H.IsHermitian) (δ : ℝ) :
    frobSq (hH.spectralClip δ - H) =
      ∑ i, max (δ - hH.eigenvalues i) 0 ^ 2

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.isHermitian_spectralClip
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.isHermitian_spectralClip {H : Matrix n n 𝕜}

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.spectralClip_properties
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.spectralClip_properties {H : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hH : H.IsHermitian) (δ : ℝ) :
    (hH.spectralClip δ - δ • 1).PosSemidef ∧
      (hH.spectralClip δ - H).PosSemidef ∧
      (hH.spectralClip δ - H) * (hH.spectralClip δ - δ • 1) = 0

statement:
theorem frobInner_eq_zero_of_skewHermitian_of_isHermitian {K X : Matrix n n 𝕜}

name: NLAlib.frobInner_sub_nearestPSD_le_zero
statement:
theorem frobInner_sub_nearestPSD_le_zero (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (δ : ℝ)
    {X : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hX : X.IsHermitian) (hfloor : (X - δ • 1).PosSemidef) :

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_nearestPSD_sub_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_nearestPSD_sub_le (A B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (δ : ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sub_nearestPSD_eq
statement:
theorem frobSq_sub_nearestPSD_eq (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (δ : ℝ) :
    frobSq (A - nearestPSD A δ) = frobSq (matrixSkewHermitianPart A) +
      ∑ i, max (δ - (isHermitian_matrixHermitianPart A).eigenvalues i) 0 ^ 2

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_matrixHermitianPart
statement:
theorem isHermitian_matrixHermitianPart (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    (matrixHermitianPart A).IsHermitian

name: NLAlib.matrixSkewHermitianPart_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem matrixSkewHermitianPart_conjTranspose (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :

name: NLAlib.nearestPSD_unique_minimizer
statement:
theorem nearestPSD_unique_minimizer (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (δ : ℝ) :
    (nearestPSD A δ).IsHermitian ∧ (nearestPSD A δ - δ • 1).PosSemidef ∧
      ∀ X : Matrix n n 𝕜, X.IsHermitian → (X - δ • 1).PosSemidef →
        frobSq (A - nearestPSD A δ) ≤ frobSq (A - X) ∧
          (frobSq (A - X) ≤ frobSq (A - nearestPSD A δ) → X = nearestPSD A δ)

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_le_trace_of_posSemidef
statement:

theorem lambdaMin_gram_le_norm_mulVec_sq [Nonempty n] (C : Matrix m n 𝕜)

name: NLAlib.norm_mulVec_sq_eq_lambdaMin_gram_iff
statement:
theorem norm_mulVec_sq_eq_lambdaMin_gram_iff [Nonempty n] (C : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {v : n → 𝕜} (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 = lambdaMin (Cᴴ * C) ↔

name: NLAlib.re_quadForm_gram_sub_lambdaMin
statement:
theorem re_quadForm_gram_sub_lambdaMin (C : Matrix m n 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜) :

      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 - lambdaMin (Cᴴ * C) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_posDef_hermitianPart
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_posDef_hermitianPart
    {c x₀ x : n → ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ k x)
    (hM : (matrixHermitianPart A).PosDef) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      (1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) ^ ((k : ℝ) / 2) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt_pow_of_posDef_hermitianPart
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt_pow_of_posDef_hermitianPart
    {c x₀ x : n → ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ k x)
    (hM : (matrixHermitianPart A).PosDef) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) ^ k *

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_restarted_gmres
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_restarted_gmres
    {c : n → ℝ} (hM : (matrixHermitianPart A).PosDef)
    (xs : ℕ → n → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hcycle : ∀ j, IsGMRESIterate A c (xs j) m (xs (j + 1))) (j : ℕ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ xs j)‖ ≤
      (1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) ^ (((j * m : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ xs 0)‖

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt_pow_of_restarted_gmres
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt_pow_of_restarted_gmres
    {c : n → ℝ} (hM : (matrixHermitianPart A).PosDef)
    (xs : ℕ → n → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hcycle : ∀ j, IsGMRESIterate A c (xs j) m (xs (j + 1))) (j : ℕ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ xs j)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) ^ (j * m) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ xs 0)‖

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_abs_eval_le_on_two_intervals
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_abs_eval_le_on_two_intervals {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hb : b < 0) (hc : 0 < c) (hcd : c < d)
    (hlen : d - c = b - a) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ (2 * k : ℕ) ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc a b ∪ Icc c d,
        |p.eval x| ≤ 2 * ((√|a * d| - √|b * c|) / (√|a * d| + √|b * c|)) ^ k

name: NLAlib.quadratic_mem_Icc_of_mem_two_intervals
statement:
theorem quadratic_mem_Icc_of_mem_two_intervals {a b c d x : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) (hcd : c < d) (hlen : d - c = b - a)
    (hx : x ∈ Icc a b ∪ Icc c d) :
    x ^ 2 - (b + c) * x ∈ Icc (-(b * c)) (-(a * d))

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_Icc
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      (2 * ((Real.sqrt b - Real.sqrt a) / (Real.sqrt b + Real.sqrt a)) ^ q) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_symmetric_intervals
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_symmetric_intervals
    {c₁ d : ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hc : 0 < c₁) (hcd : c₁ < d) (k : ℕ)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (-d) (-c₁) ∪ Set.Icc c₁ d)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ (2 * k) x) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      (2 * ((d - c₁) / (d + c₁)) ^ k) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_symmetric_intervals_ratio
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_symmetric_intervals_ratio
    {c₁ d : ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hc : 0 < c₁) (hcd : c₁ < d) (k : ℕ)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (-d) (-c₁) ∪ Set.Icc c₁ d)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ (2 * k) x) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      (2 * (((d / c₁) - 1) / ((d / c₁) + 1)) ^ k) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_two_intervals
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_two_intervals
    {a b c₁ d : ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hab : a < b) (hb : b < 0) (hc : 0 < c₁) (hcd : c₁ < d)
    (hlen : d - c₁ = b - a) (k : ℕ)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b ∪ Set.Icc c₁ d)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ (2 * k) x) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      (2 * ((Real.sqrt |a * d| - Real.sqrt |b * c₁|) /
        (Real.sqrt |a * d| + Real.sqrt |b * c₁|)) ^ k) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_isHermitian
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1)

    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤ M * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖

statement:
theorem cgObjective_mulVec (A W : Matrix n n ℝ) (c y : n → ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_mulVec_sub_le_of_isCGLSIterate
statement:
theorem dotProduct_mulVec_sub_le_of_isCGLSIterate {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {σlo σhi : ℝ}
    (hlo : 0 < σlo) (hlohi : σlo ≤ σhi)
    (hlow : ∀ v, σlo ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v))
    (hup : ∀ v, (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) ≤ σhi ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v)) {b : m → ℝ} {x₀ xs x : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : Aᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ xs) = Aᵀ *ᵥ b) {q : ℕ} (hx : IsCGLSIterate A b x₀ q x) :
    (A *ᵥ (x - xs)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x - xs)) ≤
      (2 * ((σhi - σlo) / (σhi + σlo)) ^ q) ^ 2 * ((A *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)))

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_le_of_isCGLSIterate
statement:
theorem dotProduct_sub_mulVec_le_of_isCGLSIterate {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {σlo σhi : ℝ}
    (hlo : 0 < σlo) (hlohi : σlo ≤ σhi)
    (hlow : ∀ v, σlo ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v))
    (hup : ∀ v, (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) ≤ σhi ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v)) {b : m → ℝ} {x₀ xs x : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : Aᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ xs) = Aᵀ *ᵥ b) {q : ℕ} (hx : IsCGLSIterate A b x₀ q x) :
    (b - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x) ≤ (b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs) +
      (2 * ((σhi - σlo) / (σhi + σlo)) ^ q) ^ 2 * ((A *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)))

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_self_eq
statement:
theorem dotProduct_sub_mulVec_self_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (y : n → ℝ) :
    (b - A *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ y) = 2 * cgObjective (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) y + b ⬝ᵥ b

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_self_eq_add
statement:
theorem dotProduct_sub_mulVec_self_eq_add {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ} {xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : Aᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ xs) = Aᵀ *ᵥ b) (x : n → ℝ) :
    (b - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x) =
      (b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs) + (A *ᵥ (x - xs)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x - xs))

      Ideal.span {vectorMinpoly A b}

statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_charpoly_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mem_range {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (Fintype.card k) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    x ⬝ᵥ (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) = 0

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_charpoly_mulVec_self_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_charpoly_mulVec_self_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (Fintype.card k) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.Monic) (hpdeg : p.degree = Fintype.card k) :
    (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
        (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) ≤
      (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_charpoly_add
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_charpoly_add {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (Fintype.card k) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.Monic) (hpdeg : p.degree = Fintype.card k) :
    (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b) =
      (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
          (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) +
        (aeval A (p - (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly) *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
          (aeval A (p - (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly) *ᵥ b)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_charpoly_iff
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_charpoly_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (Fintype.card k) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    (hq : Fintype.card k ≤ krylovGrade A b)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.Monic) (hpdeg : p.degree = Fintype.card k) :
    (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b) =
        (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
          (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) ↔ p = (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly

theorem rayleighQuotient_toEuclideanCLM_bounds {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)

      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A).rayleighQuotient (WithLp.toLp 2 b) ≤ specNorm A

name: NLAlib.rayleighQuotient_toEuclideanCLM_eq

name: NLAlib.sub_rayleighQuotient_pow_div_specNorm_le_log_overlap_div
statement:
theorem sub_rayleighQuotient_pow_div_specNorm_le_log_overlap_div
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hL : 0 < specNorm A)
    (i₀ : n) (h₀ : hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i₀ = specNorm A) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hb : (hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorBasis i₀ : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0) (q : ℕ) :
    (specNorm A - (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A).rayleighQuotient
      (WithLp.toLp 2 ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b))) / specNorm A ≤
      Real.log ((b ⬝ᵥ b) / ((hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorBasis i₀ : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2) /
        ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)

theorem lambdaMax_compression_eq_sSup_rayleigh {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]

statement:
theorem lanczosRitzValue_eq_iSup_rat {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    lanczosRitzValue A b q = if q = 0 then 0 else ⨆ c : Fin q → ℚ,
      let v := krylovCoefficientVector A b (fun j => (c j : ℝ))
      if v = 0 then rayleighQuotient A b else rayleighQuotient A v

theorem lanczosRitzValue_eq_ritzValues {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] [Nonempty r]

    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hlocal : q ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (he : e ≤ M * q / (1 + q)) : e ≤ g / 4

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.error_le_tangent_sq_cube
statement:
theorem error_le_tangent_sq_cube {g M q q' e' : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hstep : q' ≤ (2 * M / g) ^ 2 * q ^ 3) (herr : e' ≤ M * q') :
    e' ≤ (4 * M ^ 3 / g ^ 2) * q ^ 3

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.error_step_le_cube
statement:
theorem error_step_le_cube {g M q e q' e' : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hqone : q ≤ 1) (heg : e ≤ g / 4)
    (hlower : g * q / (1 + q) ≤ e)
    (hstep : q' ≤ (e / (g - e)) ^ 2 * q) (herr : e' ≤ M * q') :
    e' ≤ (8 * M / g ^ 3) * e ^ 3

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangent_sq_cubic_le
statement:
theorem tangent_sq_cubic_le {g M q e q' : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hlocal : q ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (herr : e ≤ M * q / (1 + q))
    (hstep : q' ≤ (e / (g - e)) ^ 2 * q) :
    q' ≤ (2 * M / g) ^ 2 * q ^ 3 ∧ q' ≤ q / 4

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.abs_weighted_average_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_weighted_average_sub_le {lam w : n → ℝ} {i : n} {M : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hi : 0 < w i)
    (hM : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |lam j - lam i| ≤ M) :
    |(∑ j, lam j * w j) / (∑ j, w j) - lam i| ≤
      M * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j) / w i) /
        (1 + (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j) / w i)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.gap_mul_weight_ratio_le_weighted_average_sub
statement:
theorem gap_mul_weight_ratio_le_weighted_average_sub {lam w : n → ℝ} {i : n} {g : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hi : 0 < w i)
    (hg : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ lam j - lam i) :
    g * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j) / w i) /
        (1 + (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j) / w i) ≤
      (∑ j, lam j * w j) / (∑ j, w j) - lam i

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.inverse_weight_ratio_le
statement:
theorem inverse_weight_ratio_le {w a : n → ℝ} {i : n} {d : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hi : 0 < w i) (hai : a i ≠ 0) (hd : 0 < d)
    (ha : ∀ j, j ≠ i → d ≤ |a j|) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j / a j ^ 2) / (w i / a i ^ 2) ≤
      (|a i| / d) ^ 2 * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j) / w i)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.abs_rayleighQuotient_step_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_rayleighQuotient_step_sub_le (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hμ : ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A x) :
    |rayleighQuotient A (step A x) - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤
      (4 * M ^ 3 / g ^ 2) * tangent hA i x ^ 6

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {M : ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0) :
    |rayleighQuotient A x - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤
      M * tangentSq hA i x / (1 + tangentSq hA i x)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.eigenvectorCoordinates_inverse_ne_zero
NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.step_norm_and_coordinates_ne_zero
statement:
theorem step_norm_and_coordinates_ne_zero (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {x : n → 𝕜}
    (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hμ : ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A x) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (step A x)‖ = 1 ∧
      hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (step A x) i ≠ 0 ∧
      tangentSq hA i (step A x) =
        tangentSq hA i ((A - rayleighQuotient A x • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))⁻¹ *ᵥ x)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangentSq_inverse_le
statement:
theorem tangentSq_inverse_le (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {μ d : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ μ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hsep : ∀ j, j ≠ i → d ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - μ|)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0) :
    tangentSq hA i ((A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))⁻¹ *ᵥ x) ≤
      (|hA.eigenvalues i - μ| / d) ^ 2 * tangentSq hA i x

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangentSq_nonneg
statement:
theorem tangentSq_nonneg (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    0 ≤ tangentSq hA i x

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangentSq_smul
statement:
theorem tangentSq_smul (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) (x : n → 𝕜)
    {c : 𝕜} (hc : c ≠ 0) : tangentSq hA i (c • x) = tangentSq hA i x

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangentSq_step_le
statement:
theorem tangentSq_step_le (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hμ : ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A x) :
    tangentSq hA i (step A x) ≤ (2 * M / g) ^ 2 * tangentSq hA i x ^ 3 ∧
      tangentSq hA i (step A x) ≤ tangentSq hA i x / 4

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangentSq_step_le_neighborhood
statement:
theorem tangentSq_step_le_neighborhood (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hμ : ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A x) :
    tangentSq hA i (step A x) ≤ g / (4 * M)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangent_sq
statement:
theorem tangent_sq (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    tangent hA i x ^ 2 = tangentSq hA i x

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangent_step_le
statement:
theorem tangent_step_le (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hμ : ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A x) :
    tangent hA i (step A x) ≤ (2 * M / g) * tangent hA i x ^ 3 ∧
      tangent hA i (step A x) ≤ tangent hA i x / 2

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.coordinate_ne_zero_iff_overlap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coordinate_ne_zero_iff_overlap_ne_zero (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n}
    (hsimple : ∀ j, j ≠ i → hA.eigenvalues j ≠ hA.eigenvalues i)
    {u : n → 𝕜} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues i • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0 ↔ star u ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.eq_coordinate_smul_eigenvectorBasis
statement:
theorem eq_coordinate_smul_eigenvectorBasis (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n}
    (hsimple : ∀ j, j ≠ i → hA.eigenvalues j ≠ hA.eigenvalues i)
    {u : n → 𝕜} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues i • u) :
    u = hA.eigenvectorCoordinates u i • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.exact_eigenvector_of_tangentSq_eq_zero
NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.mulVec_eq_rayleighQuotient_smul_of_unique
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_rayleighQuotient_smul_of_unique [Unique n] (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1) :
    A *ᵥ x = rayleighQuotient A x • x

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.sum_sq_coordinates_erase_eq_norm_sub_sq
statement:
theorem sum_sq_coordinates_erase_eq_norm_sub_sq (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x j‖ ^ 2) =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i))‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangentSq_pos_of_not_eigenvector
NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangent_eq_norm_sub_div
statement:
theorem tangent_eq_norm_sub_div (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    tangent hA i x =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - (star ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x) •
        ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i))‖ / ‖star ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x‖

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangent_eq_norm_sub_div_of_eigenvector
statement:
theorem tangent_eq_norm_sub_div_of_eigenvector (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n}
    (hsimple : ∀ j, j ≠ i → hA.eigenvalues j ≠ hA.eigenvalues i)
    {u : n → 𝕜} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues i • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    tangent hA i x = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - (star u ⬝ᵥ x) • u)‖ / ‖star u ⬝ᵥ x‖

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.abs_rayleighQuotient_step_sub_le_cube_of_extremal
statement:
theorem abs_rayleighQuotient_step_sub_le_cube_of_extremal (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i : n} {g M : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) (hgM : g ≤ M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    (hextreme : (∀ j, hA.eigenvalues i ≤ hA.eigenvalues j) ∨
      (∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≤ hA.eigenvalues i))
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hnot : A *ᵥ x ≠ rayleighQuotient A x • x) :
    |rayleighQuotient A (step A x) - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤
      (8 * M / g ^ 3) * |rayleighQuotient A x - hA.eigenvalues i| ^ 3

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.eigenvalues_ne_rayleighQuotient_of_extremal
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_ne_rayleighQuotient_of_extremal (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    (hextreme : (∀ j, hA.eigenvalues i ≤ hA.eigenvalues j) ∨
      (∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≤ hA.eigenvalues i))
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hnot : A *ᵥ x ≠ rayleighQuotient A x • x) :
    ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A x

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.gap_mul_tangentSq_div_le_abs_rayleighQuotient_sub
statement:
theorem gap_mul_tangentSq_div_le_abs_rayleighQuotient_sub (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i : n} {g : ℝ}
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hextreme : (∀ j, hA.eigenvalues i ≤ hA.eigenvalues j) ∨
      (∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≤ hA.eigenvalues i))
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0) :
    g * tangentSq hA i x / (1 + tangentSq hA i x) ≤
      |rayleighQuotient A x - hA.eigenvalues i|

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.advance_eq_breakdown_iff
statement:
theorem advance_eq_breakdown_iff (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    advance A x = .breakdown ↔ A *ᵥ x ≠ rayleighQuotient A x • x ∧
      ¬ IsUnit (A - rayleighQuotient A x • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.advance_eq_next_iff
statement:
theorem advance_eq_next_iff (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (x y : n → 𝕜) :
    advance A x = .next y ↔
      A *ᵥ x ≠ rayleighQuotient A x • x ∧
        IsUnit (A - rayleighQuotient A x • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)) ∧ step A x = y

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.advance_eq_success_iff
statement:
theorem advance_eq_success_iff (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (x y : n → 𝕜) :
    advance A x = .success y ↔ A *ᵥ x = rayleighQuotient A x • x ∧ x = y

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.eigenvalue_eq_of_advance_success
NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.mulVec_eq_rayleighQuotient_smul_of_run_success
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_rayleighQuotient_smul_of_run_success (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (x₀ : n → 𝕜) (k : ℕ) {y : n → 𝕜} (hsuccess : run A x₀ k = .success y) :
    A *ᵥ y = rayleighQuotient A y • y

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.run_invariants
statement:
theorem run_invariants (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : ℕ → n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x 0) i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i (x 0) ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hstep : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = step A (x k))
    (hshift : ∀ k j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A (x k)) (k : ℕ) :
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x k) i ≠ 0 ∧ tangentSq hA i (x k) ≤ g / (4 * M)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.run_state_invariants
statement:
theorem run_state_invariants (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x₀ : n → 𝕜} (hunit : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x₀‖ = 1)
    (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x₀ i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x₀ ≤ g / (4 * M)) (k : ℕ) :
    match run A x₀ k with
    | .breakdown => True
    | .success y | .next y => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ = 1 ∧
        hA.eigenvectorCoordinates y i ≠ 0 ∧ tangentSq hA i y ≤ g / (4 * M)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.run_success_target
statement:
theorem run_success_target (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x₀ : n → 𝕜} (hunit : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x₀‖ = 1)
    (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x₀ i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x₀ ≤ g / (4 * M)) {k : ℕ} {y : n → 𝕜}
    (hsuccess : run A x₀ k = .success y) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ = 1 ∧ rayleighQuotient A y = hA.eigenvalues i ∧
      A *ᵥ y = hA.eigenvalues i • y

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.run_tangent_le
statement:
theorem run_tangent_le (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : ℕ → n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x 0) i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i (x 0) ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hstep : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = step A (x k))
    (hshift : ∀ k j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A (x k)) (k : ℕ) :
    tangent hA i (x (k + 1)) ≤ (2 * M / g) * tangent hA i (x k) ^ 3 ∧
      tangent hA i (x k) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * tangent hA i (x 0)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tendsto_of_advance_next
statement:
theorem tendsto_of_advance_next (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : ℕ → n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x 0) i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i (x 0) ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hadvance : ∀ k, advance A (x k) = .next (x (k + 1))) :
    Tendsto (fun k => tangent hA i (x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => rayleighQuotient A (x k)) atTop (𝓝 (hA.eigenvalues i))

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tendsto_rayleighQuotient_run
statement:
theorem tendsto_rayleighQuotient_run (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : ℕ → n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x 0) i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i (x 0) ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hstep : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = step A (x k))
    (hshift : ∀ k j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A (x k)) :
    Tendsto (fun k => rayleighQuotient A (x k)) atTop (𝓝 (hA.eigenvalues i))

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tendsto_tangent_run
statement:
theorem tendsto_tangent_run (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : ℕ → n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x 0) i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i (x 0) ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hstep : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = step A (x k))
    (hshift : ∀ k j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A (x k)) :
    Tendsto (fun k => tangent hA i (x k)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq
Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_le_eigenvalues₀_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_le_eigenvalues₀_zero [Nonempty n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    hA.eigenvalues i ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ 0

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_ne_zero
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_ne_zero {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {u : n → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = L • u) (p : ℝ[X]) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0) (hp : p.eval L ≠ 0) : u ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ≠ 0

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_of_mulVec_eq_smul
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_of_mulVec_eq_smul {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {u : n → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = L • u) (p : ℝ[X]) (b : n → ℝ) :
    u ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b) = p.eval L * (u ⬝ᵥ b)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_eq_mul_dotProduct_of_forall_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq
NLAlib.dotProduct_eq_sum_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul
statement:
theorem dotProduct_eq_sum_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul (v w : n → ℝ) :
    v ⬝ᵥ w = ∑ i, ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ v) *
      ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_mulVec_le_of_mem_range
NLAlib.eigenvalues_sub_eigenvalues_le_mul_overlapTangentSq
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_sub_eigenvalues_le_mul_overlapTangentSq {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i₀ : Fin (Fintype.card n)} {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {a : ℝ} (ha : ∀ i, a ≤ hA.eigenvalues i)
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) {j₁ : k}
    (hj₁ : ∀ j, (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j ≤
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j₁)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hxQ : x ∈ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) (hx : u ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ - (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j₁ ≤
      (hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ - a) * overlapTangentSq u x

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues_sub_eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_le
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_sub_eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_le [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hc : c < hA.eigenvalues₀ 0)
    (hspec : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → hA.eigenvalues₀ i ∈ Set.Icc a c) {b : n → ℝ} (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0)
    (q : ℕ) {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (q + 1) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) {j₁ : k}
    (hj₁ : ∀ j, (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j ≤
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j₁) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j₁ ≤
      (hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - a) * (overlapTangentSq u b /
        (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + 2 * ((hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - c) / (c - a))) ^ 2)

theorem exists_degree_le_eval_eq_one_abs_eval_le {a c L : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hcL : c < L)

    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ q ∧ p.eval L = 1 ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a c,
      |p.eval x| ≤ 1 / (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + 2 * ((L - c) / (c - a)))

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_ge
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_ge [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) {b : n → ℝ}
    (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0) (q : ℕ) {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (q + 1) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    ∃ j, hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 -
        (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA.isHermitian).eigenvalues j ≤
      ε * hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 + hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 *
        (2 / (1 + √(2 * (ε / (1 - ε)))) ^ q) ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 / (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_krylovSpace_overlapTangentSq_le
statement:
theorem exists_mem_krylovSpace_overlapTangentSq_le [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hc : c < hA.eigenvalues₀ 0)
    (hspec : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → hA.eigenvalues₀ i ∈ Set.Icc a c) {b : n → ℝ} (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0)
    (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ x ∈ krylovSpace A b (q + 1), u ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0 ∧
      overlapTangentSq u x ≤ overlapTangentSq u b /
        (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + 2 * ((hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - c) / (c - a))) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_krylovSpace_overlapTangentSq_le_two_div_pow
statement:
theorem exists_mem_krylovSpace_overlapTangentSq_le_two_div_pow [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hc : c < hA.eigenvalues₀ 0)
    (hspec : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → hA.eigenvalues₀ i ∈ Set.Icc a c) {b : n → ℝ} (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0)
    (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ x ∈ krylovSpace A b (q + 1), u ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0 ∧
      overlapTangentSq u x ≤
        (2 / (1 + 2 * ((hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - c) / (c - a)) +
          2 * √((hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - c) / (c - a) + ((hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - c) / (c - a)) ^ 2))
            ^ q) ^ 2 * overlapTangentSq u b

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_krylovSpace_sub_rayleigh_le
statement:
theorem exists_mem_krylovSpace_sub_rayleigh_le [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) {b : n → ℝ}
    (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ y ∈ krylovSpace A b (q + 1), y ≠ 0 ∧
      hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ ^ 2 - y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) ≤
        (ε * hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 + hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 *
          (2 / (1 + √(2 * (ε / (1 - ε)))) ^ q) ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 / (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2) *
            ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentSq_aeval_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem overlapTangentSq_aeval_mulVec_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i₀ : Fin (Fintype.card n)} {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ • u)

    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m k ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix m r ℝ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n k ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix n r' ℝ}
    {S₁ : Matrix k k ℝ} {S₂ : Matrix r r' ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ)
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁)
    (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) :
    aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω =
      U₁ * S₁ * aeval (S₁ᵀ * S₁) p * (V₁ᵀ * Ω) +
      U₂ * S₂ * aeval (S₂ᵀ * S₂) p * (V₂ᵀ * Ω)

statement:
theorem residual_sq_le_of_polynomial_filter
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m k ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix m r ℝ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n k ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix n r' ℝ}
    {S₁ : Matrix k k ℝ} {S₂ : Matrix r r' ℝ}
    (hA : A = U₁ * S₁ * V₁ᵀ + U₂ * S₂ * V₂ᵀ)
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁)
    (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) (R : Matrix t k ℝ) (Cinv : Matrix k k ℝ)
    (hR : (V₁ᵀ * Ω) * R = 1)
    (hC : aeval (S₁ᵀ * S₁) p * Cinv = 1)
    {Q : Matrix m q ℝ} (hQo : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQ : Q * (Qᵀ * (aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω)) =
      aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω) :
    specNorm (projResidual Q A) ^ 2 ≤ specNorm S₂ ^ 2 +
      specNorm (S₂ * aeval (S₂ᵀ * S₂) p * (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * R * Cinv) ^ 2 ∧
    frobSq (projResidual Q A) ≤ frobSq S₂ +
      frobSq (S₂ * aeval (S₂ᵀ * S₂) p * (V₂ᵀ * Ω) * R * Cinv)

statement:
theorem specNorm_residual_sq_le_filterTailMaxAbs_div_filterHeadMinAbs
    [DecidableEq t] {κ a b : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin κ)] {A : Matrix m n ℝ}
    {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin κ) ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix m (Fin a) ℝ}
    {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin κ) ℝ} {V₂ : Matrix n (Fin b) ℝ}
    (s₁ : Fin κ → ℝ) (s₂ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA : A = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal s₁ * V₁ᵀ +
      U₂ * (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) * V₂ᵀ)
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁)
    (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) (R : Matrix t (Fin κ) ℝ)
    (hR : (V₁ᵀ * Ω) * R = 1) (hc : 0 < filterHeadMinAbs s₁ p)
    {Q : Matrix m q ℝ} (hQo : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQ : Q * (Qᵀ * (aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω)) = aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω) :
    specNorm (projResidual Q A) ^ 2 ≤
      specNorm (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) ^ 2 +
        (filterTailMaxAbs s₂ p a b / filterHeadMinAbs s₁ p) ^ 2 *
          specNorm (V₂ᵀ * Ω) ^ 2 * specNorm R ^ 2

name: NLAlib.specNorm_residual_sq_le_of_polynomial_filter_envelopes
statement:
theorem specNorm_residual_sq_le_of_polynomial_filter_envelopes
    [DecidableEq t] {κ a b : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix m (Fin κ) ℝ}
    {U₂ : Matrix m (Fin a) ℝ} {V₁ : Matrix n (Fin κ) ℝ}
    {V₂ : Matrix n (Fin b) ℝ} (s₁ : Fin κ → ℝ) (s₂ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA : A = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal s₁ * V₁ᵀ +
      U₂ * (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) * V₂ᵀ)
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (hV₁ : HasOrthonormalCols V₁)
    (hV₂ : HasOrthonormalCols V₂) (hV : V₁ᵀ * V₂ = 0)
    (p : ℝ[X]) (Ω : Matrix n t ℝ) (R : Matrix t (Fin κ) ℝ)
    (hR : (V₁ᵀ * Ω) * R = 1) {c τ : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hmin : ∀ i, c ≤ |p.eval ((s₁ i) ^ 2)|)
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hmax : ∀ i, i < min a b → |s₂ i * p.eval (s₂ i ^ 2)| ≤ τ)
    {Q : Matrix m q ℝ} (hQo : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQ : Q * (Qᵀ * (aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω)) = aeval (A * Aᵀ) p * A * Ω) :
    specNorm (projResidual Q A) ^ 2 ≤
      specNorm (rectDiag s₂ : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) ^ 2 +
        (τ / c) ^ 2 * specNorm (V₂ᵀ * Ω) ^ 2 * specNorm R ^ 2

name: NLAlib.Assembly.gn_explicit

theorem gn_explicit [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X Y cfac Zsq : Ω → ℝ} {k t s OPTsq : ℝ}
    (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hkt : k + 2 ≤ t) (hts : t + 2 ≤ s)
    (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (hc : ∀ ω, cfac ω ≤ 1 + t / (s - t - 1))
    (hcond : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = ∫ ω, cfac ω * Y ω ∂μ)
    (hstruct : ∀ ω, Y ω ≤ OPTsq + Zsq ω) (hZ : ∫ ω, Zsq ω ∂μ = k / (t - k - 1) * OPTsq)
    (hcYi : Integrable (fun ω => cfac ω * Y ω) μ) (hYi : Integrable Y μ)
    (hZi : Integrable Zsq μ) :
    ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ≤ (1 + t / (s - t - 1)) * ((1 + k / (t - k - 1)) * OPTsq)

statement:
theorem subspaceTangent_subspaceIterate_le
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix n k ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0)
    {L₁ Linv : Matrix k k ℝ} {L₂ : Matrix r r ℝ}
    (hA₁ : A * U₁ = U₁ * L₁) (hA₂ : A * U₂ = U₂ * L₂)
    {Ω : Matrix n k ℝ} {Ω₁ R : Matrix k k ℝ} {Ω₂ : Matrix r k ℝ}
    (hΩ : Ω = U₁ * Ω₁ + U₂ * Ω₂) (hR : Ω₁ * R = 1)
    (hL : L₁ * Linv = 1) (t : ℕ) :
    subspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (subspaceIterate A Ω t) ≤
      (specNorm L₂ * specNorm Linv) ^ t *
        subspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (LinearMap.range Ω.mulVecLin)

theorem subspaceTangent_subspaceIterate_le_of_diagonal

    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (eig₁ : k → ℝ) (eig₂ : r → ℝ)
    (hA₁ : A * U₁ = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal eig₁)
    (hA₂ : A * U₂ = U₂ * Matrix.diagonal eig₂)
    {Ω : Matrix n k ℝ} {Ω₁ R : Matrix k k ℝ} {Ω₂ : Matrix r k ℝ}
    (hΩ : Ω = U₁ * Ω₁ + U₂ * Ω₂) (hR : Ω₁ * R = 1)
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hgap : ∀ i, α ≤ |eig₁ i|) (t : ℕ) :
    subspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (subspaceIterate A Ω t) ≤
      (specNorm (Matrix.diagonal eig₂) / α) ^ t *
        subspaceTangent U₁ U₂ (LinearMap.range Ω.mulVecLin)

statement:
theorem vectorTangentToFrame_subspaceIterate_le_of_diagonal

    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {U₁ : Matrix n k ℝ} {U₂ : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hU₁ : HasOrthonormalCols U₁) (hU₂ : HasOrthonormalCols U₂)
    (hU : U₁ᵀ * U₂ = 0) (eig₁ : k → ℝ) (L₂ : Matrix r r ℝ)
    (hA₁ : A * U₁ = U₁ * Matrix.diagonal eig₁) (hA₂ : A * U₂ = U₂ * L₂)
    {Ω : Matrix n k ℝ} {Ω₁ R : Matrix k k ℝ} {Ω₂ : Matrix r k ℝ}
    (hΩ : Ω = U₁ * Ω₁ + U₂ * Ω₂) (hR : Ω₁ * R = 1)
    (hEigen : ∀ i, eig₁ i ≠ 0) (t : ℕ) {Q : Matrix n l ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hRange : subspaceIterate A Ω t ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) (i : k) :
    vectorTangentToFrame Q (U₁.col i) ≤
      (specNorm L₂ / |eig₁ i|) ^ t * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((Ω₂ * R).col i)‖

name: NLAlib.cauchy_binet_properties
statement:
theorem cauchy_binet_properties [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] :
    (∀ (A : Matrix m k R) (B : Matrix k n R) (α : r → m) (β : r → n),
      ((A * B).submatrix α β).det = ∑ S : SizedSubset k r,
        (A.submatrix α (sizedSubsetIndex S)).det *
          (B.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex S) β).det) ∧
    (∀ (A : Matrix m k R) (B : Matrix k n R),
      compoundMatrix r (A * B) = compoundMatrix r A * compoundMatrix r B) ∧
    (∀ A : Matrix m r ℝ, (Aᵀ * A).det = ∑ S : SizedSubset m r,
      (A.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex S) id).det ^ 2)

statement:
theorem quadraticObjective_add_of_mulVec_eq {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian)

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.isUnit_kktMatrix_iff
NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.kkt_solution
statement:
theorem IsKernelFrame.kkt_solution {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Z : Matrix n r 𝕜}
    (hZ : IsKernelFrame B Z) (hB : IsUnit (B * Bᴴ)) (H : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (f : n → 𝕜) (g : m → 𝕜) (xp : n → 𝕜) (hxp : B *ᵥ xp = g)
    (y : r → 𝕜) (hy : reducedHessian H Z *ᵥ y = Zᴴ *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ xp)) :
    let x := xp + Z *ᵥ y
    let l := (B * Bᴴ)⁻¹ *ᵥ (B *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ x))
    B *ᵥ x = g ∧ H *ᵥ x + Bᴴ *ᵥ l = f

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.reduced_equation
statement:
theorem IsKernelFrame.reduced_equation {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Z : Matrix n r 𝕜}
    (hZ : IsKernelFrame B Z) (H : Matrix n n 𝕜) (f xp : n → 𝕜)
    (y : r → 𝕜) (l : m → 𝕜)
    (he : H *ᵥ (xp + Z *ᵥ y) + Bᴴ *ᵥ l = f) :
    reducedHessian H Z *ᵥ y = Zᴴ *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ xp)

statement:

    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Z : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hZ : IsKernelFrame B Z)
    (hB : IsUnit (B * Bᴴ)) {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (hG : (reducedHessian H Z).PosDef) (f : n → 𝕜) (g : m → 𝕜) :
    ∃ x, IsUniqueConstrainedQuadraticMinimum H B f g x

name: NLAlib.IsKernelFrame.quadratic_minimizer_of_reduced_posDef
statement:
theorem IsKernelFrame.quadratic_minimizer_of_reduced_posDef
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} {Z : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hZ : IsKernelFrame B Z)
    {H : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hH : H.IsHermitian) (hG : (reducedHessian H Z).PosDef)
    (f x : n → 𝕜) (hstat : Zᴴ *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ x) = 0) :
    (∀ y, B *ᵥ y = B *ᵥ x → quadraticObjective H f x ≤ quadraticObjective H f y) ∧
      ∀ y, B *ᵥ y = B *ᵥ x →
        quadraticObjective H f y ≤ quadraticObjective H f x → y = x

statement:

    (reducedHessian H Z).PosDef ↔
      ∀ (f : n → 𝕜) (g : m → 𝕜), ∃ x, IsUniqueConstrainedQuadraticMinimum H B f g x

statement:
theorem IsKernelFrame.reduced_posDef_of_unique_constrained_minimum_zero

name: NLAlib.quadraticObjective_add_kernel_of_stationary
statement:
theorem quadraticObjective_add_kernel_of_stationary {H : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hH : H.IsHermitian) (Z : Matrix n r 𝕜) (f x : n → 𝕜)
    (hstat : Zᴴ *ᵥ (f - H *ᵥ x) = 0) (y : r → 𝕜) :

statement:

    Module.finrank K (S.map f) + Module.finrank K (S ⊓ LinearMap.ker f : Submodule K E) =
      Module.finrank K S

name: NLAlib.mulVec_eq_iff_sub_mem_ker
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_iff_sub_mem_ker (A : Matrix m n K) (b : m → K) (x₀ : n → K)
    (h₀ : A *ᵥ x₀ = b) (x : n → K) :
    A *ᵥ x = b ↔ x - x₀ ∈ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin

name: NLAlib.rank_add_rank_sub_card_le_rank_mul
statement:
theorem rank_add_rank_sub_card_le_rank_mul (A : Matrix m n K) (B : Matrix n p K) :
    A.rank + B.rank - Fintype.card n ≤ (A * B).rank

name: NLAlib.rank_fromCols_eq_iff_exists_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem rank_fromCols_eq_iff_exists_mulVec_eq [Fintype m]
    (A : Matrix m n K) (b : m → K) :
    (Matrix.fromCols A (fun i (_ : Unit) => b i)).rank = A.rank ↔
      ∃ x : n → K, A *ᵥ x = b

name: NLAlib.rank_mul_add_rank_mul_le_rank_add_rank_mul_mul
statement:
theorem rank_mul_add_rank_mul_le_rank_add_rank_mul_mul
    (A : Matrix m n K) (B : Matrix n p K) (C : Matrix p q K) :
    (A * B).rank + (B * C).rank ≤ B.rank + (A * B * C).rank

name: NLAlib.rank_mul_bounds
statement:
theorem rank_mul_bounds (A : Matrix m n K) (B : Matrix n p K) :
    A.rank + B.rank - Fintype.card n ≤ (A * B).rank ∧
      (A * B).rank ≤ min A.rank B.rank

name: NLAlib.solution_set_eq_add_ker
statement:
theorem solution_set_eq_add_ker (A : Matrix m n K) (b : m → K) (x₀ : n → K)
    (h₀ : A *ᵥ x₀ = b) :
    {x : n → K | A *ᵥ x = b} =
      {x : n → K | ∃ z ∈ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin, x = x₀ + z}

name: NLAlib.frobInner_vecMulVec_star
statement:
theorem frobInner_vecMulVec_star (u : m → 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜) (M : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobInner (Matrix.vecMulVec u (star v)) M = RCLike.re (star u ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ v))

name: NLAlib.frobSq_correction_decomposition
statement:
theorem frobSq_correction_decomposition (C D : Matrix m n 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜)
    (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) (hD : D *ᵥ v = -(C *ᵥ v)) :
    frobSq D = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 + frobSq (D - rankOneCancel C v)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_correction_minimum_iff
statement:
theorem frobSq_correction_minimum_iff (C D : Matrix m n 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜)
    (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) (hD : D *ᵥ v = -(C *ᵥ v)) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 ≤ frobSq D ∧
      (frobSq D = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 ↔ D = rankOneCancel C v)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_rankOneCancel
statement:
theorem frobSq_rankOneCancel (C : Matrix m n 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜)
    (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) :
    frobSq (rankOneCancel C v) = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (C *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.frobSq_vecMulVec_star
statement:
theorem frobSq_vecMulVec_star (u : m → 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜) :
    frobSq (Matrix.vecMulVec u (star v)) =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.rankOneCancel_mulVec
statement:
theorem rankOneCancel_mulVec (C : Matrix m n 𝕜) (v : n → 𝕜)
    (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) : rankOneCancel C v *ᵥ v = -(C *ᵥ v)

name: Matrix.inv_add_smul_vecMulVec_self
statement:
theorem inv_add_smul_vecMulVec_self (M : Matrix n n K) (v : n → K) (t : K)
    (hM : IsUnit M.det)
    (hd : 1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) ≠ 0) :
    (M + t • vecMulVec v v)⁻¹ =
      M⁻¹ - (t / (1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)))) •
        (M⁻¹ * vecMulVec v v * M⁻¹)

name: Matrix.inv_add_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem inv_add_vecMulVec (M : Matrix n n K) (u v : n → K)
    (hM : IsUnit M.det) (hd : 1 + v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ u) ≠ 0) :
    (M + vecMulVec u v)⁻¹ =
      M⁻¹ - ((1 + v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ u))⁻¹ : K) •
        (M⁻¹ * vecMulVec u v * M⁻¹)

name: Matrix.trace_mul_inv_add_smul_vecMulVec_self
statement:
theorem trace_mul_inv_add_smul_vecMulVec_self (M H : Matrix n n K)
    (v : n → K) (t : K) (hM : IsUnit M.det)
    (hd : 1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)) ≠ 0) :
    (H * (M + t • vecMulVec v v)⁻¹).trace =
      (H * M⁻¹).trace -
        (t / (1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ v)))) *
          (v ⬝ᵥ ((M⁻¹ * H * M⁻¹) *ᵥ v))

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_re_sq_add_norm_toLp_im_sq
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_re_sq_add_norm_toLp_im_sq (u : n → ℂ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (u i).re)‖ ^ 2 +
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (u i).im)‖ ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.re_quadForm_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem re_quadForm_map_ofReal (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (u : n → ℂ) :
    (quadForm (A.map Complex.ofReal) u).re =
      quadForm A (fun i => (u i).re) + quadForm A (fun i => (u i).im)

name: NLAlib.mulVec_eq_of_residualEnergy_minimizers
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_of_residualEnergy_minimizers (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜)
    (x y : n → 𝕜) (hx : ∀ z, residualEnergy A b x ≤ residualEnergy A b z)
    (hy : residualEnergy A b y ≤ residualEnergy A b x) : A *ᵥ (x - y) = 0

name: NLAlib.residualEnergy_midpoint
statement:
theorem residualEnergy_midpoint (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) (x y : n → 𝕜) :
    4 * residualEnergy A b ((1 / 2 : 𝕜) • (x + y)) +
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (x - y))‖ ^ 2 =
        2 * residualEnergy A b x + 2 * residualEnergy A b y

name: NLAlib.det_coordinateSelector_mul_submatrix
statement:
theorem det_coordinateSelector_mul_submatrix (X : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (S : Finset n) (J : SizedSubset n d) :
    (((coordinateSelector S : Matrix n n 𝕜) * X).submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det =
      if J.val ⊆ S then (X.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det else 0

name: NLAlib.ofReal_rowSubsetVolume

theorem ofReal_rowSubsetVolume (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :

theorem re_det_conjTranspose_mul_self_pos (X : Matrix n d 𝕜)

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetGram_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem rowSubsetGram_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetGram_eq_sum
statement:
theorem rowSubsetGram_eq_sum (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    rowSubsetGram X S = ∑ i ∈ S, Matrix.vecMulVec (star (X i)) (X i)

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetGram_erase
statement:
theorem rowSubsetGram_erase (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) {i : n} (hi : i ∈ T) :
    rowSubsetGram X (T.erase i) = rowSubsetGram X T - Matrix.vecMulVec (star (X i)) (X i)

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetGram_posSemidef
statement:
theorem rowSubsetGram_posSemidef (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_eq_sum_minors
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_eq_sum_minors (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    rowSubsetVolume X S = ∑ J : SizedSubset n d,
      if J.val ⊆ S then ‖(X.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det‖ ^ 2 else 0

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_mono
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_mono (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) {S T : Finset n} (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    rowSubsetVolume X S ≤ rowSubsetVolume X T

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_nonneg
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_nonneg (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    0 < rowSubsetVolume X S ↔ IsUnit (rowSubsetGram X S)

name: NLAlib.sum_rowSubsetVolume_eq_choose_mul
statement:
theorem sum_rowSubsetVolume_eq_choose_mul (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (s : ℕ)
    (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) :
    (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard s, rowSubsetVolume X S) =
      ((Fintype.card n - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) *
        RCLike.re (Xᴴ * X).det

name: NLAlib.sum_rowSubsetVolume_pos
statement:
theorem sum_rowSubsetVolume_pos (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (s : ℕ)
    (hX : IsUnit (Xᴴ * X)) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hsn : s ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    0 < ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard s, rowSubsetVolume X S

name: NLAlib.sum_rowSubsetVolume_powersetCard
statement:
theorem sum_rowSubsetVolume_powersetCard (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) :
    (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, rowSubsetVolume X S) =
      ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) * rowSubsetVolume X T

name: NLAlib.det_rowSubsetCrossGram_eq_sum_minors
statement:
theorem det_rowSubsetCrossGram_eq_sum_minors (A B : Matrix n d 𝕜) (S : Finset n) :
    (rowSubsetCrossGram A B S).det = ∑ J : SizedSubset n d,
      if J.val ⊆ S then star ((A.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det) *
        (B.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det else 0

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetGram_submatrix_succAbove
statement:
theorem rowSubsetGram_submatrix_succAbove {D : ℕ}
    (X : Matrix n (Fin (D + 1)) 𝕜) (S : Finset n) (i j : Fin (D + 1)) :
    (rowSubsetGram X S).submatrix j.succAbove i.succAbove =
      rowSubsetCrossGram (X.submatrix id j.succAbove) (X.submatrix id i.succAbove) S

name: NLAlib.sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_powersetCard
statement:
theorem sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_powersetCard (X : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) (hd : 0 < Fintype.card d) (hds : Fintype.card d - 1 ≤ s) :
    (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate) =
      ((T.card - (Fintype.card d - 1)).choose (s - (Fintype.card d - 1)) : 𝕜) •
        (rowSubsetGram X T).adjugate

name: NLAlib.sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_powersetCard_fin_succ
statement:
theorem sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_powersetCard_fin_succ {D : ℕ}
    (X : Matrix n (Fin (D + 1)) 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) (hDs : D ≤ s) :
    (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate) =
      ((T.card - D).choose (s - D) : 𝕜) • (rowSubsetGram X T).adjugate

name: NLAlib.sum_det_rowSubsetCrossGram_powersetCard
statement:
theorem sum_det_rowSubsetCrossGram_powersetCard (A B : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) :
    (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, (rowSubsetCrossGram A B S).det) =
      ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : 𝕜) *
        (rowSubsetCrossGram A B T).det

name: NLAlib.charpoly_add_vecMulVec_mul_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem charpoly_add_vecMulVec_mul_X_sub_C [Infinite K] {A : Matrix n n K}

    (X - C μ) * (A + Matrix.vecMulVec x y).charpoly =

name: NLAlib.det_add_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem det_add_vecMulVec {M : Matrix n n K} (hM : IsUnit M.det) (u v : n → K) :

name: NLAlib.eval_charpoly_add_vecMulVec_mul_sub
NLAlib.exists_charpoly_factor_add_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem exists_charpoly_factor_add_vecMulVec [Infinite K] {A : Matrix n n K}

name: NLAlib.exists_isTLSOptimal_iff_minimum_eigenvector_last_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_isTLSOptimal_iff_minimum_eigenvector_last_ne_zero (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (b : m → 𝕜) :

      ∃ v : n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 ∧ v (Sum.inr ()) ≠ 0 ∧

    ∃ v : n ⊕ Unit → 𝕜, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 ∧ v (Sum.inr ()) ≠ 0 ∧

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_multiterm_residual_mul_eq_zero_iff_unique_frobEnergy_minimizer
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_multiterm_residual_mul_eq_zero_iff_unique_frobEnergy_minimizer
    {p q : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    (A : ι → Matrix m m ℝ) (B : ι → Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ U V, frobInner U (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B V) =
      frobInner (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B U) V)
    (hpos : ∀ Z : Matrix m n ℝ, Z ≠ 0 → 0 < frobEnergy (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B) Z)
    (V : Matrix m p ℝ) (W : Matrix n q ℝ) (X F : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hX : matrixMultitermLinearMap A B X = F) (Y : Matrix p q ℝ) :
    Vᴴ * (F - ∑ i, A i * (V * Y * Wᴴ) * B i) * W = 0 ↔
      (∀ T : Matrix p q ℝ,
        frobEnergy (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B) (X - V * Y * Wᴴ) ≤
          frobEnergy (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B) (X - V * T * Wᴴ)) ∧
      (∀ T : Matrix p q ℝ,
        frobEnergy (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B) (X - V * T * Wᴴ) ≤
          frobEnergy (matrixMultitermLinearMap A B) (X - V * Y * Wᴴ) →
            V * T * Wᴴ = V * Y * Wᴴ)

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_residual_mul_eq_zero_iff_unique_frobEnergy_minimizer
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_residual_mul_eq_zero_iff_unique_frobEnergy_minimizer
    (S : Matrix m n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ U V, frobInner U (S V) = frobInner (S U) V)
    (hpos : ∀ Z : Matrix m n ℝ, Z ≠ 0 → 0 < frobEnergy S Z)
    (V : Matrix m p ℝ) (W : Matrix n q ℝ) (X F : Matrix m n ℝ) (hX : S X = F)
    (Y : Matrix p q ℝ) :
    Vᴴ * (F - S (V * Y * Wᴴ)) * W = 0 ↔
      (∀ T : Matrix p q ℝ,
        frobEnergy S (X - V * Y * Wᴴ) ≤ frobEnergy S (X - V * T * Wᴴ)) ∧
      (∀ T : Matrix p q ℝ,
        frobEnergy S (X - V * T * Wᴴ) ≤ frobEnergy S (X - V * Y * Wᴴ) →
          V * T * Wᴴ = V * Y * Wᴴ)

name: NLAlib.frobEnergy_add

theorem frobEnergy_add (S : Matrix m n ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix m n ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ U V, frobInner U (S V) = frobInner (S U) V) (U V : Matrix m n ℝ) :

    (C : Matrix m p ℝ) (hC : IsUnit (Cᵀ * C).det) (i : p) (t : p → ℝ) (d : m → ℝ)

name: NLAlib.mul_addGroupNorm_le_diagonal_residual
statement:
theorem mul_addGroupNorm_le_diagonal_residual (N : AddGroupNorm (n → ℂ))
    (hhom : ∀ (c : ℂ) (x : n → ℂ), N (c • x) = ‖c‖ * N x)
    (habs : ∀ (x y : n → ℂ), (∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ ‖y i‖) → N x ≤ N y)
    (d : n → ℂ) (μ : ℂ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i, δ ≤ ‖d i - μ‖) (x : n → ℂ) :
    δ * N x ≤ N (Matrix.diagonal d *ᵥ x - μ • x)

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_distance_le_euclidean_residual_div
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_distance_le_euclidean_residual_div
    {A V : Matrix n n ℂ} {d : n → ℂ} (hV : IsUnit V)
    (hA : A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal d) (x : n → ℂ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (μ : ℂ) :
    ∃ i, ‖d i - μ‖ ≤ (specNorm V * specNorm V⁻¹) *
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ /
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_distance_mul_euclidean_norm_le_residual
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_distance_mul_euclidean_norm_le_residual
    {A V : Matrix n n ℂ} {d : n → ℂ} (hV : IsUnit V)
    (hA : A * V = V * Matrix.diagonal d) (x : n → ℂ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (μ : ℂ) :
    ∃ i, ‖d i - μ‖ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ≤
      specNorm V * specNorm V⁻¹ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_spectrum_distance_le_euclidean_residual_div_of_normal
statement:
theorem exists_mem_spectrum_distance_le_euclidean_residual_div_of_normal
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) (x : n → ℂ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (μ : ℂ) :
    ∃ ν ∈ spectrum ℂ A, ‖ν - μ‖ ≤
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ /
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_spectrum_distance_le_norm_perturbation_of_normal
statement:
theorem exists_mem_spectrum_distance_le_norm_perturbation_of_normal
    {A E : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A * Aᴴ = Aᴴ * A) {μ : ℂ}
    (hμ : μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + E)) :
    ∃ ν ∈ spectrum ℂ A, ‖ν - μ‖ ≤ specNorm E

NLAlib.hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc_zero_of_spectral_vanishing
statement:
theorem hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc_zero_of_spectral_vanishing
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ i, g (hA.eigenvalues i) = 0)
    (hg' : ∀ i, HasDerivAt g 0 (hA.eigenvalues i)) :
    HasFDerivWithinAt (fun B : Matrix n n ℂ => cfc g B)
      (0 : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) {B | B.IsHermitian} A

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_pow_mulVec_le_sum_abs_eigenvalues_pow
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_pow_mulVec_le_sum_abs_eigenvalues_pow
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (y : ι → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    |y ⬝ᵥ (A ^ k *ᵥ y)| ≤
      ∑ i, ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : ι → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ y) ^ 2 * |hA.eigenvalues i| ^ k

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_prod_pow_mul_vecMulVec_le
statement:
theorem abs_trace_prod_pow_mul_vecMulVec_le
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (y : ι → ℝ)
    (ks : List ℕ) (hne : ks ≠ []) :
    |(ks.map fun k => A ^ k * vecMulVec y y).prod.trace| ≤
      (y ⬝ᵥ y) ^ (ks.length - 1) *
        (y ⬝ᵥ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ ks.sum) A *ᵥ y))

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_vecMulVec_pow_succ
statement:
theorem trace_mul_vecMulVec_pow_succ (C : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (y : ι → ℝ) (p : ℕ) :
    (C * vecMulVec y y ^ (p + 1)).trace =
      (y ⬝ᵥ y) ^ p * (y ⬝ᵥ (C *ᵥ y))

name: NLAlib.trace_prod_map_mul_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem trace_prod_map_mul_vecMulVec (y : ι → ℝ)
    (Bs : List (Matrix ι ι ℝ)) (hne : Bs ≠ []) :
    (Bs.map fun B => B * vecMulVec y y).prod.trace =
      (Bs.map fun B => y ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ y)).prod

name: NLAlib.vecMulVec_mul_mul_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_mul_mul_vecMulVec (y : ι → ℝ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    vecMulVec y y * B * vecMulVec y y =
      (y ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ y)) • vecMulVec y y

name: NLAlib.vecMulVec_mul_prod_map_mul_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_mul_prod_map_mul_vecMulVec (y : ι → ℝ)
    (Bs : List (Matrix ι ι ℝ)) :
    vecMulVec y y * (Bs.map fun B => B * vecMulVec y y).prod =
      (Bs.map fun B => y ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ y)).prod • vecMulVec y y

name: NLAlib.vecMulVec_pow_succ
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_pow_succ (y : ι → ℝ) (p : ℕ) :
    vecMulVec y y ^ (p + 1) = (y ⬝ᵥ y) ^ p • vecMulVec y y

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_le
statement:
theorem abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_le
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (y : ι → ℝ)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : 0 < w.count true) :
    |(insertionWord A (vecMulVec y y) w).trace| ≤
      (y ⬝ᵥ y) ^ (w.count true - 1) *
        (y ⬝ᵥ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A *ᵥ y))

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_le_trace_mul_pow
statement:
theorem abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_le_trace_mul_pow
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (y : ι → ℝ) (w : List Bool) :
    |(insertionWord A (vecMulVec y y) w).trace| ≤
      (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A *
        vecMulVec y y ^ w.count true).trace

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_pow_le_trace_cfc_abs_pow
NLAlib.count_false_add_count_true_eq_length
statement:
theorem count_false_add_count_true_eq_length (w : List Bool) :
    w.count false + w.count true = w.length

name: NLAlib.exists_trace_insertionWord_eq_prod_pow_mul
statement:
theorem exists_trace_insertionWord_eq_prod_pow_mul (A X : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : 0 < w.count true) :
    ∃ ks : List ℕ, ks ≠ [] ∧ ks.length = w.count true ∧ ks.sum = w.count false ∧
      (insertionWord A X w).trace = (ks.map fun k => A ^ k * X).prod.trace

name: NLAlib.insertionWordGaps_length_sum
statement:
theorem insertionWordGaps_length_sum (w : List Bool) :
    (insertionWordGaps w).1.length = w.count true ∧
      (insertionWordGaps w).1.sum + (insertionWordGaps w).2 = w.count false

name: NLAlib.insertionWord_eq_pow_of_count_true_eq_zero
statement:
theorem insertionWord_eq_pow_of_count_true_eq_zero (A X : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : w.count true = 0) :
    insertionWord A X w = A ^ w.count false

name: NLAlib.insertionWord_eq_prod_gaps_mul_pow
statement:
theorem insertionWord_eq_prod_gaps_mul_pow (A X : R) (w : List Bool) :
    insertionWord A X w =
      ((insertionWordGaps w).1.map fun k => A ^ k * X).prod *
        A ^ (insertionWordGaps w).2

name: NLAlib.re_trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_le
statement:
theorem re_trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_le
    (C : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (ev : ι → ℝ)
    {m l : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hl : l ≤ m) :
    (C * (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ l * C *
      (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ (m - l)).trace.re ≤
        (C ^ 2 * (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ m).trace.re

name: NLAlib.re_trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_mul_diagonal_pow
statement:
theorem re_trace_mul_diagonal_pow_mul_mul_diagonal_pow
    (C : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (ev : ι → ℝ) (a b : ℕ) :
    (C * (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ a * C *
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) ^ b).trace.re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖C i j‖ ^ 2 * ev j ^ a * ev i ^ b

name: NLAlib.re_trace_mul_pow_mul_le_trace_sq_mul_pow
statement:
theorem re_trace_mul_pow_mul_le_trace_sq_mul_pow
    (C H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    {m l : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hl : l ≤ m) :
    (C * H ^ l * C * H ^ (m - l)).trace.re ≤ (C ^ 2 * H ^ m).trace.re

name: NLAlib.re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow
statement:
theorem re_trace_pow_eq_sum_eigenvalues_pow
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (r : ℕ) :
    (A ^ r).trace.re = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i ^ r

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_pow_mul_mul_pow_conjStarAlgAut
statement:
theorem trace_mul_pow_mul_mul_pow_conjStarAlgAut
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (C H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (a b : ℕ) :
    let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix ι ι ℂ) U
    (E C * E H ^ a * E C * E H ^ b).trace = (C * H ^ a * C * H ^ b).trace

name: NLAlib.abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_sub_one_le_sum
statement:
theorem abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_sub_one_le_sum
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (y : ι → ℝ) (w : List Bool) :
    |(insertionWord A (vecMulVec y y - 1) w).trace| ≤
      ((subInsertionWords w).map fun v =>
        (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A *
          vecMulVec y y ^ v.2.count true).trace).sum

name: NLAlib.trace_insertionWord_le_of_count_true_eq_two
statement:
theorem trace_insertionWord_le_of_count_true_eq_two
    (A X : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hX : X.IsHermitian)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : w.count true = 2) (hn : Even (w.count false)) :
    (insertionWord A X w).trace ≤ (A ^ w.count false * X ^ 2).trace

name: NLAlib.trace_insertionWord_of_count_true_eq_one
statement:
theorem trace_insertionWord_of_count_true_eq_one (A X : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : w.count true = 1) :
    (insertionWord A X w).trace = (A ^ w.count false * X).trace

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_pow_mul_le_trace_sq_mul_pow
statement:
theorem trace_mul_pow_mul_le_trace_sq_mul_pow
    (C A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {n l : ℕ} (hn : Even n) (hl : l ≤ n) :
    (C * A ^ l * C * A ^ (n - l)).trace ≤ (C ^ 2 * A ^ n).trace

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_coordinateReflection
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_coordinateReflection (k : ι) :
    (coordinateReflection k)ᴴ = coordinateReflection k

name: NLAlib.coordinatePinch_apply
statement:
theorem coordinatePinch_apply (k : ι) (X : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (i j : ι) :
    coordinatePinch k X i j = if i = j ∨ i ≠ k ∧ j ≠ k then X i j else 0

name: NLAlib.coordinatePinched_apply_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatePinched_apply_self (s : Finset ι) (X : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (i : ι) :
    coordinatePinched s X i i = X i i

name: NLAlib.coordinatePinched_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatePinched_empty (X : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    coordinatePinched ∅ X = X

name: NLAlib.coordinatePinched_insert
statement:
theorem coordinatePinched_insert (s : Finset ι) (k : ι) (X : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    coordinatePinched (insert k s) X = coordinatePinch k (coordinatePinched s X)

name: NLAlib.coordinatePinched_univ
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatePinched_univ (X : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    coordinatePinched Finset.univ X = diagonal (fun i => X i i)

name: NLAlib.coordinateReflection_mul_diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem coordinateReflection_mul_diagonal_mul (k : ι) (a : ι → ℂ) :
    coordinateReflection k * diagonal a * coordinateReflection k = diagonal a

name: NLAlib.coordinateReflection_mul_self
statement:
theorem coordinateReflection_mul_self (k : ι) :
    coordinateReflection k * coordinateReflection k = 1

name: NLAlib.continuous_cyclicTraceWordMiddle
statement:
theorem continuous_cyclicTraceWordMiddle {𝕜 n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {m : ℕ} (Y : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n 𝕜) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    Continuous (fun Z => cyclicTraceWordMiddle Z Y j)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_cyclicTraceWordMiddle_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_cyclicTraceWordMiddle_le {𝕜 n : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {m : ℕ} (Z Y : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n 𝕜) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZ : ∀ l, specNorm (Z l) ≤ R) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    specNorm (cyclicTraceWordMiddle Z Y j) ≤
      R ^ m * ∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, specNorm (Y l)

name: NLAlib.trace_alternating_two_pairs_eq_cyclic_cut
statement:
theorem trace_alternating_two_pairs_eq_cyclic_cut
    {R n : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (Z Y : Fin 2 → Matrix n n R) (j : Fin 2) :
    (List.ofFn (fun l => Z l * Y l)).prod.trace =
      (Z (finRotate 2 j) * Y (finRotate 2 j) * Z j * Y j).trace

name: NLAlib.trace_alternating_word_eq_cyclic_cut
statement:
theorem trace_alternating_word_eq_cyclic_cut
    {S n : Type*} [CommSemiring S] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {m : ℕ}
    (Z Y : Fin (m + 2) → Matrix n n S) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    (List.ofFn (fun l => Z l * Y l)).prod.trace =
      (Z (finRotate (m + 2) j) * cyclicTraceWordMiddle Z Y j * Z j * Y j).trace

name: NLAlib.exists_hermite_polynomial_hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc
statement:
theorem exists_hermite_polynomial_hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ f (hA.eigenvalues i)) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], (∀ i, p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) = f (hA.eigenvalues i)) ∧
      (∀ i, p.derivative.eval (hA.eigenvalues i) = deriv f (hA.eigenvalues i)) ∧
      HasFDerivWithinAt (fun B : Matrix n n ℂ => cfc f B)
        (p.frechetDerivative A) {B | B.IsHermitian} A

name: NLAlib.dslope_polynomial_eq_eval_dividedDifference
statement:
theorem dslope_polynomial_eq_eval_dividedDifference (p : Polynomial ℝ) (x y : ℝ) :
    dslope (fun t => p.eval t) x y = (p.dividedDifference x).eval y

name: NLAlib.dslope_swap
statement: theorem dslope_swap (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x y : ℝ) : dslope f x y = dslope f y x

name: NLAlib.loewnerMatrix_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem loewnerMatrix_apply_of_ne {ι : Type*} (f : ℝ → ℝ) (nodes : ι → ℝ)
    (i j : ι) (h : nodes i ≠ nodes j) :
    loewnerMatrix f nodes i j = (f (nodes i) - f (nodes j)) / (nodes i - nodes j)

name: NLAlib.loewnerMatrix_apply_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem loewnerMatrix_apply_self {ι : Type*} (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (nodes : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) : loewnerMatrix f nodes i i = deriv f (nodes i)

name: NLAlib.loewnerMatrix_isSymm
statement:
theorem loewnerMatrix_isSymm {ι : Type*} (f : ℝ → ℝ) (nodes : ι → ℝ) :
    (loewnerMatrix f nodes).IsSymm

name: NLAlib.frechetDerivative_diagonal_apply
statement:
theorem frechetDerivative_diagonal_apply (p : ℝ[X]) (ev : n → ℝ) (H : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    p.frechetDerivative (diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ))) H =
      Matrix.of (fun i j => (((p.dividedDifference (ev i)).eval (ev j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * H i j)

name: NLAlib.frechetDerivative_eq_loewnerDerivative
statement:
theorem frechetDerivative_eq_loewnerDerivative (p : ℝ[X]) (ev : n → ℝ)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ)) *
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose) : p.frechetDerivative A = loewnerDerivative p.eval ev U

name: NLAlib.loewnerDerivative_apply
statement:
theorem loewnerDerivative_apply (f : ℝ → ℝ) (ev : n → ℝ)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (H : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    loewnerDerivative f ev U H = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) *
      ((loewnerMatrix f ev).map Complex.ofReal ⊙
        ((U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose * H * U)) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose

name: NLAlib.loewnerDerivative_eq_of_values_deriv
statement:
theorem loewnerDerivative_eq_of_values_deriv (p : ℝ[X]) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (ev : n → ℝ)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hv : ∀ i, p.eval (ev i) = f (ev i))
    (hd : ∀ i, p.derivative.eval (ev i) = deriv f (ev i)) :
    loewnerDerivative p.eval ev U = loewnerDerivative f ev U

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivAt_cfc_hermitian_loewner
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_cfc_hermitian_loewner
    (A : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ)) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ f ((show (A : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian from A.property).eigenvalues i))
    (ev : n → ℝ) (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hdiag : (A : Matrix n n ℂ) = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ)) *
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun B : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) => cfc f (B : Matrix n n ℂ))
      ((loewnerDerivative f ev U).comp (selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ)).subtypeL) A

name: NLAlib.hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc_loewner
statement:
theorem hasFDerivWithinAt_cfc_loewner {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ f (hA.eigenvalues i))
    (ev : n → ℝ) (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (hdiag : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ)) *
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose) :
    HasFDerivWithinAt (fun B : Matrix n n ℂ => cfc f B)
      (loewnerDerivative f ev U) {B | B.IsHermitian} A

name: NLAlib.mem_real_spectrum_of_unitary_diagonalization
statement:
theorem mem_real_spectrum_of_unitary_diagonalization (ev : n → ℝ)
    (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * diagonal (fun i => (ev i : ℂ)) *
      (U : Matrix n n ℂ).conjTranspose) (i : n) : ev i ∈ spectrum ℝ A

name: Matrix.PosDef.frobSq_sub_one_le_six_mul_of_exp_neg_le_det
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.frobSq_sub_one_le_six_mul_of_exp_neg_le_det
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (eps : ℝ)
    (htr : RCLike.re A.trace = (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
    (heps : eps ≤ 1 / 6) (hdet : Real.exp (-eps) ≤ RCLike.re A.det) :
    frobSq (A - 1) ≤ 6 * eps

name: Matrix.PosDef.detNormalizeScaling_pos
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.detNormalizeScaling_pos {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosDef) :
    0 < detNormalizeScaling X

name: Matrix.PosDef.det_smul_detNormalizeScaling_eq_one
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.det_smul_detNormalizeScaling_eq_one {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosDef)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) :
    (detNormalizeScaling X • X).det = 1

name: Matrix.PosDef.exists_det_eq_one_re_det_map_eq_div
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.PosDef.exists_det_eq_one_re_det_map_eq_div {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosDef)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ Y, Y.PosDef ∧ Y.det = 1 ∧ (T Y).det.re = (T X).det.re / X.det.re

name: NLAlib.detRatio_attainable_sets_eq
statement:
theorem detRatio_attainable_sets_eq (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n)
    (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) :
    {d : ℝ | ∃ X, X.PosDef ∧ X.det = 1 ∧ d = (T X).det.re} =
      {d : ℝ | ∃ X, X.PosDef ∧ d = (T X).det.re / X.det.re}

name: NLAlib.detRatio_normalized_sInf_eq
statement:
theorem detRatio_normalized_sInf_eq (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n)
    (T : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ) :
    sInf {d : ℝ | ∃ X, X.PosDef ∧ X.det = 1 ∧ d = (T X).det.re} =
