name: NLAlib.cfc_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem NLAlib.cfc_fromBlocks
    {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Nonempty κ]
    (A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (B : Matrix κ κ 𝕜)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B).IsHermitian ∧
    spectrum ℝ (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) = spectrum ℝ A ∪ spectrum ℝ B ∧
    cfc f (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (cfc f A) 0 0 (cfc f B)

    (I : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : OperatorConvexOn I f)
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAI : spectrum ℝ A ⊆ I)
    (K : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (hK : K.conjTranspose * K = 1) :
    (cfc f (K.conjTranspose * A * K)) ≤
      (K.conjTranspose * cfc f A * K)

statement:
theorem NLAlib.operator_jensen {d m n : ℕ} [NeZero d] [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (I : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : OperatorConvexOn I f)
    (A₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (A₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hA₁ : A₁.IsHermitian) (hA₂ : A₂.IsHermitian)
    (hA₁I : spectrum ℝ A₁ ⊆ I) (hA₂I : spectrum ℝ A₂ ⊆ I)
    (K₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin d) ℂ) (K₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hK : K₁.conjTranspose * K₁ + K₂.conjTranspose * K₂ = 1) :
    (cfc f (K₁.conjTranspose * A₁ * K₁ + K₂.conjTranspose * A₂ * K₂)) ≤
      (K₁.conjTranspose * cfc f A₁ * K₁ +
        K₂.conjTranspose * cfc f A₂ * K₂)

    (hA₁ : A₁.PosDef) (hA₂ : A₂.PosDef) (hH₁ : H₁.PosDef) (hH₂ : H₂.PosDef)

name: NLAlib.RankOneBarrier.exists_candidate
statement:
theorem exists_candidate [Nonempty n] (v : I → n → ℝ)
    (hframe : ∑ i, Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = 1)
    (MU : Matrix n n ℝ) (hMU : MU.PosDef)
    (ML : Matrix n n ℝ) (hML : ML.PosDef)
    (δU δL : ℝ) (hδU : 0 < δU) (hδL : 0 < δL)
    (hcap : δL * ML⁻¹.trace < 1)
    (hpot : 1 / δU + MU⁻¹.trace ≤ 1 / δL - ML⁻¹.trace) :
    ∃ i, v i ≠ 0 ∧
      0 < upperScore (upperMatrix MU δU) (upperGap MU δU) (v i) ∧
      upperScore (upperMatrix MU δU) (upperGap MU δU) (v i) ≤
        lowerScore (lowerMatrix ML δL) (lowerGap ML δL) (v i)

    (ML : Matrix n n ℝ) (hML : ML.PosDef)
    (δU δL : ℝ) (hδU : 0 < δU) (hδL : 0 < δL)
    (hcap : δL * ML⁻¹.trace < 1)
    (hpot : 1 / δU + MU⁻¹.trace ≤ 1 / δL - ML⁻¹.trace) :
    ∃ i, v i ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧
      upperScore (upperMatrix MU δU) (upperGap MU δU) (v i) ≤ 1 / t ∧
      1 / t ≤ lowerScore (lowerMatrix ML δL) (lowerGap ML δL) (v i)

name: NLAlib.intrinsicDimension_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem NLAlib.intrinsicDimension_fromBlocks {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (V₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hV₁ : V₁.PosSemidef) (hV₂ : V₂.PosSemidef) :
    let V := Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂
    V.PosSemidef ∧
    ‖V‖ = max (‖V₁‖) (‖V₂‖) ∧
    intrinsicDimension V =
      ((Matrix.trace V₁).re + (Matrix.trace V₂).re) /
        max (‖V₁‖) (‖V₂‖) ∧
    min (intrinsicDimension V₁) (intrinsicDimension V₂) ≤ intrinsicDimension V ∧
    intrinsicDimension V ≤ intrinsicDimension V₁ + intrinsicDimension V₂

      ((n : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),

      ((-∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Matrix.trace ((A t)⁻¹ ^ (n - i + 1) *

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransformDeriv_apply
statement:
theorem matrixKTransformDeriv_apply (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)))
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef) (Δ : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ = α⁻¹ • (S⁻¹ * Δ * S⁻¹) -
      ∫ T, T.val * (1 + S * T.val)⁻¹ * Δ * (1 + T.val * S)⁻¹ * T.val ∂ν

name: NLAlib.frobInner_matrixKTransformDeriv
statement:
theorem frobInner_matrixKTransformDeriv (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)))
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    (Δ : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S
    let H := R * Δ * R
    frobInner Δ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ) = α⁻¹ * frobInner H (H - matrixKStabilityMap ν α S H)

name: NLAlib.matrixKStabilityMap_apply

    matrixKStabilityMap ν α S H = α • ∫ T, matrixKCoefficient S T.val * H * matrixKCoefficient S T.val ∂ν

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransformDeriv_eq_congruence
statement:
theorem matrixKTransformDeriv_eq_congruence (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)))
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ) (hS : S.PosDef) (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S⁻¹ + T.val).PosDef)
    (Δ : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) S
    let H := R * Δ * R
    matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S Δ = α⁻¹ • (R * (H - matrixKStabilityMap ν α S H) * R)

theorem matrixKTransform_stability_iff [Nonempty n]
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hS : S.val.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S.val⁻¹+T.val).PosDef) :
    ((∀ Δ : Matrix n n ℂ, Δ.IsHermitian → Δ≠0 →
      0 < frobInner Δ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S.val Δ)) ↔
      ‖matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S.val hS hgap‖<1) ∧
    (‖matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S.val hS hgap‖<1 ↔
      ∃ Y : Matrix n n ℂ, Y.PosDef ∧ (Y-matrixKStabilityMap ν α S.val Y).PosDef) ∧
    ((∃ Y : Matrix n n ℂ, Y.PosDef ∧ (Y-matrixKStabilityMap ν α S.val Y).PosDef) ↔
      ∃ B : Matrix n n ℂ, B.PosDef ∧ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S.val B).PosDef)

    (∃ Y : Matrix n n ℂ, Y.PosDef ∧ (Y-matrixKStabilityMap ν α S Y).PosDef) ↔
    ∃ B : Matrix n n ℂ, B.PosDef ∧ (matrixKTransformDeriv ν α S B).PosDef

name: NLAlib.matrixKTransform_neumann_of_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem matrixKTransform_neumann_of_norm_lt_one
    (ν : Measure (selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ))) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hν : IsCompact ν.support) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α)
    (S : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) (hS : S.val.PosDef)
    (hgap : ∀ T ∈ ν.support, (S.val⁻¹+T.val).PosDef)
    (hnorm : ‖matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S.val hS hgap‖<1) :
    let L := matrixKStabilityFrobenius ν hν α hα.le S.val hS hgap
    let I := toHermitianFrobenius (Matrix.isHermitian_one : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ).IsHermitian)
    let Y := Ring.inverse (1-L) I
    (∀ x : HermitianFrobenius ℂ n, (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n x).PosSemidef →
      (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (Ring.inverse (1-L) x)).PosSemidef) ∧
    (hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y).PosDef ∧
      (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ≤ hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n Y ∧
      hermitianFrobeniusMatrix ℂ n (Y-L Y)=1

      HasDerivAt G B (u : ℂ) ∧

name: NLAlib.cayleyTransform_eq_one_add

theorem cayleyTransform_eq_one_add {K : Type*} [RCLike K] (A : Matrix n n K) (p : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.spectrum_cayleyTransform
statement:

name: NLAlib.lyapunovADI_residual
statement:

name: NLAlib.lyapunovADI_snd_nonneg_le_solution
statement:
theorem lyapunovADI_snd_nonneg_le_solution (A X : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K)

    (hEq : A * X + X * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0) (j : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.sub_lyapunovADI_snd
statement:
theorem sub_lyapunovADI_snd (A X : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K) (p : ℕ → ℝ)

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_lyapunovADI_residual
statement:
theorem frobNorm_lyapunovADI_residual (A : Matrix n n K) (B : Matrix n s K)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_lyapunovADI_residual
statement:
theorem specNorm_lyapunovADI_residual [DecidableEq s] (A : Matrix n n K)

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_eq_matrixDyson_congruence
statement:
theorem imaginaryPart_eq_matrixDyson_congruence
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    (z : ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (heq : (z • 1 - A + S X) * X = -1) :
    (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      Xᴴ * (z.im • 1 + S (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)) * X

name: NLAlib.imaginaryPart_matrixDysonCoefficient
statement:
theorem imaginaryPart_matrixDysonCoefficient
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)

    (z : ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (imaginaryPart (z • 1 - A + S X) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      z.im • 1 + S (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)

statement:
theorem matrix_map_imaginaryPart (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)

    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hpos : 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (heq : (z • 1 - A + S X) * X = -1) : specNorm X ≤ z.im⁻¹

name: NLAlib.mul_specNorm_le_one_add_of_matrixDyson
statement:
theorem mul_specNorm_le_one_add_of_matrixDyson
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    {z : ℂ} (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (heq : (z • 1 - A + S X) * X = -1) {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≤ |z.re|) :
    (c - specNorm A) * specNorm X ≤ 1 + ‖S‖ * specNorm X ^ 2

name: NLAlib.norm_imaginaryPart_le_matrixDyson_quadratic
statement:
theorem norm_imaginaryPart_le_matrixDyson_quadratic
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 ≤ z.im) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (heq : (z • 1 - A + S X) * X = -1) :
    ‖(imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤
      specNorm X ^ 2 * (z.im + ‖S‖ * ‖(imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ)‖)

name: NLAlib.norm_imaginaryPart_le_of_matrixDyson_exterior
statement:
theorem norm_imaginaryPart_le_of_matrixDyson_exterior
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : ContinuousOn M {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (heq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (z • 1 - A + S (M z)) * M z = -1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : specNorm A + 2 * Real.sqrt ‖S‖ < c)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) (hcz : c ≤ |z.re|) :
    ‖(imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤
      (4 / ((c - specNorm A) ^ 2 - 4 * ‖S‖)) * z.im

name: NLAlib.specNorm_lt_two_div_of_matrixDyson_exterior
statement:
theorem specNorm_lt_two_div_of_matrixDyson_exterior
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : ContinuousOn M {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (heq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (z • 1 - A + S (M z)) * M z = -1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : specNorm A + 2 * Real.sqrt ‖S‖ < c)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) (hcz : c ≤ |z.re|) :
    specNorm (M z) < 2 / (c - specNorm A)

name: NLAlib.tendsto_specNorm_matrixDyson_vertical
statement:
theorem tendsto_specNorm_matrixDyson_vertical
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    (M : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hpos : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart (M z) : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (heq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → (z • 1 - A + S (M z)) * M z = -1)
    (x : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => specNorm (M ((x : ℂ) + y * Complex.I))) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_matrixDyson_normalization_error_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_matrixDyson_normalization_error_le
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (z : ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (heq : (z • 1 - A + S X) * X = -1) :

name: NLAlib.specNorm_matrixDyson_normalization_error_mul_I_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_matrixDyson_normalization_error_mul_I_le
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (S : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ X : Matrix n n ℂ, 0 ≤ X → 0 ≤ S X)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hpos : 0 ≤ (imaginaryPart X : Matrix n n ℂ))
    (heq : (((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) • 1 - A + S X) * X = -1) :
    specNorm (((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) • X + 1) ≤
      specNorm A * y⁻¹ + ‖S‖ * (y⁻¹) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.tendsto_mul_I_smul_matrixDyson
statement:
theorem tendsto_mul_I_smul_matrixDyson
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)

    Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) • M ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      atTop (𝓝 (-1))

name: NLAlib.aeval_upperBlockThree
statement:
theorem aeval_upperBlockThree (p : 𝕜[X])
    (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (H : Matrix n o 𝕜) (C : Matrix o o 𝕜) :
    aeval (upperBlockThree A G B H C) p =
      Matrix.fromBlocks
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (aeval A p) (polynomialBlockDifference p A B G) 0 (aeval B p))
        (Matrix.fromRows (polynomialSecondBlockDifference p A B C G H)
          (polynomialBlockDifference p B C H)) 0 (aeval C p)

name: NLAlib.aeval_upperBlockTwo
statement:
theorem aeval_upperBlockTwo (p : 𝕜[X]) (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (H : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    aeval (upperBlockTwo A H B) p =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (aeval A p) (polynomialBlockDifference p A B H) 0 (aeval B p)

name: NLAlib.monomialBlockDifference_succ
statement:
theorem monomialBlockDifference_succ (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (H : Matrix m n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    monomialBlockDifference A B H (k + 1) =
      A ^ k * H + monomialBlockDifference A B H k * B

name: NLAlib.polynomialBlockDifference_upperBlockTwo
statement:
theorem polynomialBlockDifference_upperBlockTwo (p : 𝕜[X])
    (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (H : Matrix n o 𝕜) (C : Matrix o o 𝕜) :
    polynomialBlockDifference p (upperBlockTwo A G B) C (Matrix.fromRows 0 H) =
      Matrix.fromRows (polynomialSecondBlockDifference p A B C G H)
        (polynomialBlockDifference p B C H)

name: NLAlib.upperBlockTwo_pow
statement:
theorem upperBlockTwo_pow (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (H : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    upperBlockTwo A H B ^ k =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (A ^ k) (monomialBlockDifference A B H k) 0 (B ^ k)

name: NLAlib.isUnit_aeval_upperBlockThree
statement:
theorem isUnit_aeval_upperBlockThree (Q : 𝕜[X]) (A : Matrix m m 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (C : Matrix o o 𝕜) (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) (H : Matrix n o 𝕜)

statement:
theorem isUnit_aeval_upperBlockTwo (Q : 𝕜[X]) (A : Matrix m m 𝕜)

name: NLAlib.rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockThree
statement:
theorem rationalMatrixEval_upperBlockThree (P Q : 𝕜[X]) (A : Matrix m m 𝕜)
    (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) (C : Matrix o o 𝕜) (G : Matrix m n 𝕜) (H : Matrix n o 𝕜)
    (hA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) (hC : IsUnit (aeval C Q)) :
    rationalMatrixEval P Q (upperBlockThree A G B H C) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (rationalMatrixEval P Q A) (rationalBlockDifference P Q A B G)
          0 (rationalMatrixEval P Q B))
        (Matrix.fromRows (rationalSecondBlockDifference P Q A B C G H)
          (rationalBlockDifference P Q B C H)) 0 (rationalMatrixEval P Q C)

      Matrix.fromBlocks (rationalMatrixEval P Q A) (rationalBlockDifference P Q A B H)
        0 (rationalMatrixEval P Q B)

statement:
theorem rationalBlockDifference_mul (P Q R S : 𝕜[X]) (A B H : Matrix n n 𝕜)

    (hSA : IsUnit (aeval A S)) (hSB : IsUnit (aeval B S)) :

      rationalMatrixEval P Q A * rationalBlockDifference R S A B H +

statement:
theorem rationalBlockDifference_one (Q : 𝕜[X]) (A B H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :

      -((aeval A Q)⁻¹ * polynomialBlockDifference Q A B H * (aeval B Q)⁻¹)

name: NLAlib.rationalSecondBlockDifference_mul
statement:
theorem rationalSecondBlockDifference_mul (P Q R S : 𝕜[X]) (A B C G H : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (hQA : IsUnit (aeval A Q)) (hQB : IsUnit (aeval B Q)) (hQC : IsUnit (aeval C Q))
    (hSA : IsUnit (aeval A S)) (hSB : IsUnit (aeval B S)) (hSC : IsUnit (aeval C S)) :
    rationalSecondBlockDifference (P * R) (Q * S) A B C G H =
      rationalMatrixEval P Q A * rationalSecondBlockDifference R S A B C G H +
      rationalBlockDifference P Q A B G * rationalBlockDifference R S B C H +
      rationalSecondBlockDifference P Q A B C G H * rationalMatrixEval R S C

name: NLAlib.rationalSecondBlockDifference_one
statement:
theorem rationalSecondBlockDifference_one (Q : 𝕜[X]) (A B C G H : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    rationalSecondBlockDifference 1 Q A B C G H =
      (aeval A Q)⁻¹ * polynomialBlockDifference Q A B G * (aeval B Q)⁻¹ *
        polynomialBlockDifference Q B C H * (aeval C Q)⁻¹ -
      (aeval A Q)⁻¹ * polynomialSecondBlockDifference Q A B C G H * (aeval C Q)⁻¹

name: NLAlib.rationalSecondBlockDifference_resolvent

      (ζ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) - A)⁻¹ * G * (ζ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) - B)⁻¹ * H *
        (ζ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) - C)⁻¹

    resolventSquareDifference ζ A B H-resolventSquareDifference ζ C C H =
      resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C H (B-C) +

    (a : ℝ) (hBC : B-C = a • E) (hAC : A-C = a • F) :
    resolventSquareDifference ζ A B H - resolventSquareDifference ζ C C H =
      a • (resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A B C H E +
        resolventSquareSecondDifference ζ A C C F H)

      ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, R t^(a-i)*H*R t^(i+1)*S t^b)+

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_congruence_scaling
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_congruence_scaling (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n)

    (hT : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (T X).PosSemidef)

    (hS : ∀ X, S X = B * T (C * X * C.conjTranspose) * B.conjTranspose) :

name: NLAlib.exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem exists_krausTransition_eigenvalues
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 = 1)
    {X : Matrix n n ℂ} (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ W : Matrix n n ℝ, (∀ i j, 0 ≤ W i j) ∧
      (∀ j, ∑ i, W i j = 1) ∧
      (∑ i, (∑ j, W i j - 1) ^ 2) ≤ frobSq (krausMap A 1 - 1) ∧
      W *ᵥ hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues =
        (krausMap_posSemidef A X hX).isHermitian.eigenvalues

    ∃ W : Matrix n n ℝ, (∀ i j, 0 ≤ W i j) ∧
      (∀ i, ∑ j, W i j = 1) ∧
      (∑ j, (∑ i, W i j - 1) ^ 2) ≤
        frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) ∧
      W *ᵥ hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues =
        (krausMap_posSemidef A X hX).isHermitian.eigenvalues

      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ W i j) ∧
      (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 = 1 → ∀ j, ∑ i, W i j = 1) ∧
      (krausMap A 1 = 1 → ∀ i, ∑ j, W i j = 1) ∧
      (∑ i, (∑ j, W i j - 1) ^ 2) ≤ frobSq (krausMap A 1 - 1) ∧
      (∑ j, (∑ i, W i j - 1) ^ 2) ≤
        frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) ∧
      W *ᵥ hX.isHermitian.eigenvalues =
        (krausMap_posSemidef A X hX).isHermitian.eigenvalues

statement:
theorem exists_seq_det_tendsto_operatorCapacity

    (hT : ∀ X, X.PosSemidef → (T X).PosSemidef) :
    ∃ X : ℕ → Matrix n n ℂ,
      (∀ k, (X k).PosDef) ∧ (∀ k, (X k).det = 1) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => (T (X k)).det.re) atTop (𝓝 (operatorCapacity T))

name: NLAlib.exists_seq_unital_krausMap_scaling
statement:
theorem exists_seq_unital_krausMap_scaling
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hcap : 0 < operatorCapacity (krausMap A)) :
    ∃ L R : ℕ → Matrix n n ℂ,
      (∀ k, IsUnit (L k)) ∧ (∀ k, IsUnit (R k)) ∧
      (∀ k, krausMap (fun a => L k * A a * R k) 1 = 1) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => Complex.normSq (L k).det * Complex.normSq (R k).det)
        atTop (𝓝 ((operatorCapacity (krausMap A))⁻¹)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => frobSq
        (krausMap (fun a => (L k * A a * R k)ᴴ) 1 - 1)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_adjoint_krausMap_kronecker_sub_one
statement:
theorem frobSq_adjoint_krausMap_kronecker_sub_one
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (hA : krausMap A 1 = 1) (hB : krausMap B 1 = 1) :
    frobSq (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => (A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2)ᴴ) 1 - 1) =
      (Fintype.card m : ℝ) * frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) +
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * frobSq (krausMap (fun b => (B b)ᴴ) 1 - 1) +
      frobSq (krausMap (fun a => (A a)ᴴ) 1 - 1) *
        frobSq (krausMap (fun b => (B b)ᴴ) 1 - 1)

name: NLAlib.le_operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker_of_pos
statement:
theorem le_operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker_of_pos
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : 0 < Fintype.card m)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (hcapA : 0 < operatorCapacity (krausMap A))
    (hcapB : 0 < operatorCapacity (krausMap B)) :
    operatorCapacity (krausMap A) ^ Fintype.card m *
        operatorCapacity (krausMap B) ^ Fintype.card n ≤
      operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2))

statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : 0 < Fintype.card m)

    operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2)) =
      operatorCapacity (krausMap A) ^ Fintype.card m *
        operatorCapacity (krausMap B) ^ Fintype.card n

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker_le
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_krausMap_kronecker_le
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ) :
    operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2)) ≤
      operatorCapacity (krausMap A) ^ Fintype.card m *
        operatorCapacity (krausMap B) ^ Fintype.card n

name: NLAlib.operatorCapacity_scaled_krausMap_kronecker
statement:
theorem operatorCapacity_scaled_krausMap_kronecker
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card n) (hM : 0 < Fintype.card m)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : κ → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (L R : Matrix n n ℂ) (P Q : Matrix m m ℂ)
    (hL : IsUnit L) (hR : IsUnit R) (hP : IsUnit P) (hQ : IsUnit Q) :
    operatorCapacity (krausMap
      (fun p : ι × κ => (L * A p.1 * R) ⊗ₖ (P * B p.2 * Q))) =
      (Complex.normSq L.det * Complex.normSq R.det) ^ Fintype.card m *
      (Complex.normSq P.det * Complex.normSq Q.det) ^ Fintype.card n *
      operatorCapacity (krausMap (fun p : ι × κ => A p.1 ⊗ₖ B p.2))

name: NLAlib.nat_mul_mul_re_trace_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem nat_mul_mul_re_trace_mul_pow_le
    (V H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hV : V.PosSemidef) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (p : ℝ) * (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) * (V * H ^ (2 * p - 2)).trace.re ≤
      (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) ^ p * (V ^ p).trace.re +
        (p - 1 : ℕ) * (H ^ (2 * p)).trace.re

name: NLAlib.re_trace_diagonal_mul_conj_diagonal
statement:
theorem re_trace_diagonal_mul_conj_diagonal
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (a b : ι → ℝ) :
    (diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ)) *
      ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * diagonal (fun j => (b j : ℂ)) *
        star (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ))).trace.re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖(U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j‖ ^ 2 * a i * b j

name: NLAlib.re_trace_pow_mul_pow_eq_sum_overlap
statement:
theorem re_trace_pow_mul_pow_eq_sum_overlap
    (A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (r s : ℕ) :
    (A ^ r * B ^ s).trace.re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j,
        ‖((star hA.eigenvectorUnitary * hB.eigenvectorUnitary :
          Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) : Matrix ι ι ℂ) i j‖ ^ 2 *
          hA.eigenvalues i ^ r * hB.eigenvalues j ^ s

name: NLAlib.abs_re_trace_series_product_le
statement:
theorem abs_re_trace_series_product_le
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B C : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (r s : ℕ) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    |(B * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ r * C * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ s).trace.re| ≤
      (‖(reTraceCLM : Matrix ι ι ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ * ‖B‖ * ‖C‖ *
        (∑ i, ‖A i‖) ^ (r + s)) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (r + s)

name: NLAlib.continuous_re_trace_series_product
statement:
theorem continuous_re_trace_series_product

    Continuous (fun x : κ → ℝ =>
      (B * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ r * C * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ s).trace.re)

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_re_trace_mul_series_pow_update
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_re_trace_mul_series_pow_update
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (x : κ → ℝ)
    (i : κ) (t : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun y => (B * (∑ j, Function.update x i y j • A j) ^ q).trace.re)
      (∑ l ∈ Finset.range q,
        (B * (∑ j, Function.update x i t j • A j) ^ (q.pred - l) *
          A i * (∑ j, Function.update x i t j • A j) ^ l).trace.re) t

theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_derivative {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (p : ℝ[X]) :

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial

theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul

theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X]) :

      ((-1 : ℝ)^n / (n ! : ℝ)) * exponentialPolynomialMoment 1
        (X ^ n * (derivative : ℝ[X] → ℝ[X])^[n] p)

name: NLAlib.exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul_laguerrePolynomial

theorem exponentialPolynomialMoment_laguerrePolynomial_mul_laguerrePolynomial
    (i j : ℕ) :
    exponentialPolynomialMoment 1 (laguerrePolynomial i * laguerrePolynomial j) =

name: NLAlib.integrableOn_exp_quarter_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi

theorem resolvent_mul_resolvent_sub_eq_smul_add_smul_sq
    (A₀ D F : M) (a : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (hD : D.IsHermitian) (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    let R₀ := resolvent A₀ ζ
    let R₁ := resolvent (A₀ - a • D) ζ
    let R₂ := resolvent (A₀ - a • F) ζ
    R₀ * D * R₀ - R₁ * D * R₁ =
      a • ((2 : ℝ) • (R₂ * D * R₂ * D * R₂)) +
        a ^ 2 • resolventCubicRemainder A₀ D F a ζ

statement:
theorem matrix_sign_newton [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ A, z.re ≠ 0) :
    let S := matrixSign A
    let G := (A-S)*(A+S)⁻¹
    spectralRadius ℂ G<1 ∧
      (∀ k, IsUnit (signNewtonIterate A k) ∧
        signNewtonIterate A k=inverseCayley (G^(2^k))*S) ∧
      Tendsto (signNewtonIterate A) atTop (𝓝 S) ∧
      ∀ k, signNewtonIterate A (k+1)-S=
        (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • ((signNewtonIterate A k)⁻¹*(signNewtonIterate A k-S)^2) ∧
        specNorm (signNewtonIterate A (k+1)-S) ≤
          (1/2 : ℝ)*specNorm ((signNewtonIterate A k)⁻¹)*specNorm (signNewtonIterate A k-S)^2

name: NLAlib.exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_block_sum
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_weights_spectral_sandwich_of_block_sum
    (v : I → n → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (_hr : 0 < r) (k : ℕ) (B : ℝ)
    (w : I × Fin r → ℝ)
    (hw_nonneg : ∀ p, 0 ≤ w p)
    (hw_card : (Function.support w).ncard < r * (k + 1))
    (hw_lower : (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ) ≤
        ∑ p, w p • Matrix.vecMulVec (frameBlockVector v r p) (frameBlockVector v r p))
    (hw_upper : (∑ p, w p • Matrix.vecMulVec (frameBlockVector v r p) (frameBlockVector v r p)) ≤
        B • (1 : Matrix (n × Fin r) (n × Fin r) ℝ)) :
    ∃ s : I → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧ (Function.support s).ncard ≤ k ∧
      ((1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) ∧
      (∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) ≤ B • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))

    (hbeta : Tendsto beta atTop (nhds b))
    (hseq : ∀ m, ∃ s : I → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧ (Function.support s).ncard ≤ k ∧
      ((1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) ∧
      (∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) ≤ beta m • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))) :
    ∃ s : I → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧ (Function.support s).ncard ≤ k ∧
      ((1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) ∧
      (∑ i, s i • Matrix.vecMulVec (v i) (v i) ≤ b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))

    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {p q θ c : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hq : 0 < q) (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / 2 + θ / q)
    (a : Matrix n n ℝ) (ha : a.IsSymm) (ha0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ a i j)
    (hrow : (∑ i, (∑ j, a i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ≤ 1)
    (hentry : c ^ (θ * p) * (∑ i, ∑ j, a i j ^ p) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ U V : Matrix n n ℝ,
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ U i j) ∧ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ V i j) ∧ U.IsSymm ∧ V.IsSymm ∧
      (∀ i j, a i j = U i j ^ (1 - θ) * V i j ^ θ) ∧
      (∑ i, ∑ j, U i j ^ 2) ≤ 4 ∧
      (∑ i, (∑ j, V i j ^ 2) ^ (q / 2)) ≤ 1 ∧
      c ^ q * (∑ i, ∑ j, V i j ^ q) ≤ 1

name: NLAlib.exists_entire_symmetric_profile_family
statement:
theorem exists_entire_symmetric_profile_family
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {p q θ c : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hq : 0 < q) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hexp : 1 / p = (1 - θ) / 2 + θ / q)
    (b : Matrix n n ℂ) (hb : b.IsSymm)
    (hrow : (∑ i, (∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ≤ 1)
    (hentry : c ^ (θ * p) * (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖b i j‖ ^ p) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ (F : ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ) (B : ℝ),
      Differentiable ℂ F ∧ (∀ z, (F z).IsSymm) ∧ F (θ : ℂ) = b ∧ 0 ≤ B ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Complex.HadamardThreeLines.verticalClosedStrip 0 1, specNorm (F z) ≤ B) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖F ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i j‖ ^ 2) ≤ 4) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, (∑ i, (∑ j, ‖F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i j‖ ^ 2) ^ (q / 2)) ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, c ^ q * (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖F (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i j‖ ^ q) ≤ 1)

theorem reTracePowerSecond_le_even_moments (p : ℕ) (hp : Even p) (hp2 : 2 ≤ p)

    reTracePowerSecond p A H t ≤
      (p : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) - 1) * reTracePowerAlong p A H t ^ (1 - 2 / (p : ℝ)) *

name: NLAlib.re_trace_even_moment_smoothness
statement:
theorem re_trace_even_moment_smoothness (A H : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : Even p) (hp2 : 2 ≤ p) :
    ((((A + H) ^ p).trace.re + ((A - H) ^ p).trace.re) / 2) ^ (2 / (p : ℝ)) ≤
      (A ^ p).trace.re ^ (2 / (p : ℝ)) +
        ((p : ℝ) - 1) * (H ^ p).trace.re ^ (2 / (p : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul
    {branch : ℂ → ℂ} {a b t r : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (htr : |t| < r)
    (hbranch : ContinuousOn branch (sphere 0 r)) :
    (∫ s in a..b, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
      ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + s * z)))) =
    (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r),

    (∫ s in a..b, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
      ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + s * z)))) =
    (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *

    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hbranch : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (branch i) (sphere 0 r)) :
    (∫ s in l..u, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) * traceExponentialCircleDensity branch a r s) =
      ∑ i, ∫ s in a i..u, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *

statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms

    (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) {branch : ι → ℂ → ℂ} {q : ι → ℂ} {a : ι → ℝ}
    {l u t R r : ℝ} (hlu : l ≤ u) (hla : ∀ i, l ≤ a i) (hau : ∀ i, a i ≤ u)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hRr : R < r) (htr : |t| < r)
    (hbranch : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hlim : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (a i : ℂ) * z)
      (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (q i)))
    (htrace : ∀ z ∈ sphere 0 r,
      (∑ i, exp (branch i z)) = Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - z • B))) :
    (∫ s in l..u, exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) * traceExponentialCircleDensity branch a r s) =
      Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - (t : ℂ) • B)) - ∑ i, exp (q i - (t : ℂ) * a i)

    (hr : 0 < r) (hRr : R < r) (htr : |t| < r)
    (hbranch : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖})
    (hlim : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (a i : ℂ) * z)
      (cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (q i)))
    (hT : DifferentiableOn ℂ T (closedBall 0 r))
    (htrace : ∀ z ∈ sphere 0 r, (∑ i, exp (branch i z)) = T z) :

      ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + s * z)))) =

name: NLAlib.exists_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch
statement:
theorem exists_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch (μ a : ℂ)
    (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ) (hμ : μ ∉ spectrum ℂ B) :
    ∃ ψ : ℂ → ℂ, ψ 0 = 0 ∧ ContinuousAt ψ 0 ∧ HasDerivAt ψ a 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c (t, ψ t) = 0) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ × ℂ),
        simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c p = 0 ↔ ψ p.1 = p.2)

      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), ContinuousAt ψ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c (t, ψ t) = 0) ∧

name: NLAlib.det_scalar_block_eigenvalue_pencil_eq_schur
statement:
theorem det_scalar_block_eigenvalue_pencil_eq_schur
    {l n : Type*} [Unique l] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (μ a t s : ℂ) (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ)
    (hK : IsUnit ((μ + s) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - t • F)) :
    (((μ + s) • (1 : Matrix (l ⊕ n) (l ⊕ n) ℂ) -
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => μ)) 0 0 B +
        t • Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => a))
          (Matrix.replicateRow l b) (Matrix.replicateCol l c) F))).det =
      ((μ + s) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - t • F).det *
        simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c (t, s)

name: NLAlib.mem_spectrum_scalar_block_iff_schur_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_spectrum_scalar_block_iff_schur_eq_zero
    {l n : Type*} [Unique l] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (μ a t s : ℂ) (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ)
    (hK : IsUnit ((μ + s) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - B - t • F)) :
    μ + s ∈ spectrum ℂ
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => μ)) 0 0 B +
        t • Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => a))
          (Matrix.replicateRow l b) (Matrix.replicateCol l c) F) ↔
      simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c (t, s) = 0

name: NLAlib.exists_isolated_eigenvector_similarity
statement:
theorem exists_isolated_eigenvector_similarity {A : Matrix n n K} {x y : n → K} {μ : K}
    (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hyA : y ᵥ* A = μ • y) (hpair : y ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (S : Matrix n n K) (i : n), IsUnit S ∧ Matrix.col S i = x ∧
      (∀ j, S⁻¹ i j = y j / (y ⬝ᵥ x)) ∧
      (∀ j, (S⁻¹ * A * S) j i = if j = i then μ else 0) ∧
      (∀ j, (S⁻¹ * A * S) i j = if j = i then μ else 0) ∧
      (y ⬝ᵥ x)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec x y =
        S * Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i 1) * S⁻¹

statement:
theorem submatrix_eq_fromBlocks_of_isolated_coordinate (M : Matrix n n K) (i : n) (μ : K)

    (hrow : ∀ j, M i j = if j = i then μ else 0) :
    M.submatrix (Equiv.sumCompl (fun j => j = i)) (Equiv.sumCompl (fun j => j = i)) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : {j : n // j = i} => μ)) 0 0

      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : {j : n // j = i} => F i i))
        (Matrix.replicateRow {j : n // j = i} (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => F i j.val))
        (Matrix.replicateCol {j : n // j = i} (fun j : {j : n // j ≠ i} => F j.val i))

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_scalar_block
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_scalar_block
    {l : Type*} [Unique l] (μ a : ℂ)
    (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ) (hμ : μ ∉ spectrum ℂ B) :
    ∃ φ : ℂ → ℂ, φ 0 = μ ∧ ContinuousAt φ 0 ∧ HasDerivAt φ a 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), ContinuousAt φ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => μ)) 0 0 B +
          t • Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => a))
            (Matrix.replicateRow l b) (Matrix.replicateCol l c) F)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 ((0 : ℂ), μ), p.2 ∈ spectrum ℂ
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => μ)) 0 0 B +
          p.1 • Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : l => a))
            (Matrix.replicateRow l b) (Matrix.replicateCol l c) F) ↔ φ p.1 = p.2)

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (E : Matrix n n ℂ) {x y : n → ℂ} {μ : ℂ}
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x) (hyA : y ᵥ* A = μ • y)
    (hμ : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1) :
    ∃ φ : ℂ → ℂ, φ 0 = μ ∧ ContinuousAt φ 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt φ ((y ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x)) / (y ⬝ᵥ x)) 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), ContinuousAt φ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + t • E)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 ((0 : ℂ), μ), p.2 ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + p.1 • E) ↔ φ p.1 = p.2)

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_eigenvalue_branch_diagonal_expansion
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_eigenvalue_branch_diagonal_expansion
    (d : n → ℂ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (i : n) :
    ∃ φ g : ℂ → ℂ, φ 0 = d i ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ φ 0 ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ g 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ (Matrix.diagonal d + t • A)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ t = d i + t * A i i + t ^ 2 * g t)

statement:

      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ

name: NLAlib.exists_analytic_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch
statement:
theorem exists_analytic_simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction_branch (μ a : ℂ)
    (B F : Matrix n n ℂ) (b c : n → ℂ) (hμ : μ ∉ spectrum ℂ B) :
    ∃ ψ : ℂ → ℂ, ψ 0 = 0 ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ ψ 0 ∧ HasDerivAt ψ a 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c (t, ψ t) = 0) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ × ℂ),
        simpleEigenvalueSchurFunction μ a B F b c p = 0 ↔ ψ p.1 = p.2)

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branch_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branch_of_diagonal
    (d : n → ℂ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (i : n) :
    ∃ lam g : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ g 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ lam z) ∧
      (∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ,
        lam z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + z • Matrix.diagonal d)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ,
        lam z = z * d i + A i i + z⁻¹ * g z⁻¹) ∧
      (fun z => lam z - (z * d i + A i i)) =O[Bornology.cobounded ℂ] (fun z => z⁻¹)

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_of_diagonal
    (d : n → ℂ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z - z * d i) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
        (∀ i, branch i z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + z • Matrix.diagonal d)) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i z)

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_sub_real_diagonal
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_sub_real_diagonal
    (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
        (∀ i, branch i z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i z)

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_branches_integral_circleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_branches_integral_circleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
    (a : n → ℝ) (ha : Function.Injective a) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (a i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u → (∀ i, a i ∈ Set.Icc l u) → ∀ r : ℝ, R < r → ∀ t : ℝ,
        IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          traceExponentialCircleDensity branch a r s) volume l u ∧
        (∫ s in l..u, Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          traceExponentialCircleDensity branch a r s) =
          Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ)))) -
            ∑ i, Complex.exp (A i i - (t : ℂ) * a i)

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_branches_sum_integral_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_branches_sum_integral_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms
    (a : n → ℝ) (ha : Function.Injective a) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (a i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      ∀ b : ℝ, (∀ i, a i ≤ b) → ∀ t r : ℝ, R < r → |t| < r →
        (∑ i, ∫ s in a i..b, Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            (∮ z in C(0, r), Complex.exp (branch i z + s * z)))) =
          Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (a i : ℂ)))) -
            ∑ i, Complex.exp (A i i - (t : ℂ) * a i)

name: NLAlib.eventually_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_conj_eq
statement:
theorem eventually_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_conj_eq
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) {R : ℝ} {branch : n → ℂ → ℂ}
    (hlim : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
      (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i)))
    (hspec : ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
      (∀ i, branch i z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i z)) :
    ∀ᶠ z in Bornology.cobounded ℂ, ∀ i, branch i (conj z) = conj (branch i z)

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_branches_integral_real_circleDensity_eq_traceExp_sub_atoms
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_branches_integral_real_circleDensity_eq_traceExp_sub_atoms
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, R < r →
        (∀ s : ℝ, (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).im = 0) ∧
        ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u → (∀ i, b i ∈ Icc l u) → ∀ t : ℝ,
          IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Real.exp (-t * s) *
            (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) volume l u ∧
          (∫ s in l..u, Real.exp (-t * s) *
            (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) =
            traceExp (A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))) -
              ∑ i, Real.exp ((A i i).re - t * b i)

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_real_circle_density
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_eigenvalue_branches_real_circle_density
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i))) ∧
      (∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
        (∀ i, branch i z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
          Function.Injective (fun i => branch i z)) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, R < r → ∀ s : ℝ,
        (∑ i, if b i < s then (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch i z + (s : ℂ) * z)) else 0).im = 0

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_re_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_traceExp_sub_atoms
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_re_traceExponentialCircleDensity_eq_traceExp_sub_atoms
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {branch : n → ℂ → ℂ}
    (hbranch : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (b i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 (A i i)))
    (hspec : ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ →
      (∀ i, branch i z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A - z • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ)))) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun i => branch i z))
    {r : ℝ} (hRr : R < r) {l u : ℝ} (hlu : l ≤ u)
    (hbu : ∀ i, b i ∈ Icc l u) (t : ℝ) :
          IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Real.exp (-t * s) *
            (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) volume l u ∧
          (∫ s in l..u, Real.exp (-t * s) *
            (traceExponentialCircleDensity branch b r s).re) =
            traceExp (A - (t : ℂ) • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))) -
              ∑ i, Real.exp ((A i i).re - t * b i)

name: NLAlib.normalized_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_im_eq_zero
statement:
theorem normalized_circleIntegral_exp_add_mul_im_eq_zero
    {branch : ℂ → ℂ} {R r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hRr : R < r)
    (href : ∀ z, R < ‖z‖ → branch (conj z) = conj (branch z)) (s : ℝ) :
    ((2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∮ z in C(0, r), exp (branch z + (s : ℂ) * z))).im = 0

name: NLAlib.exists_inversePencilUpperRootSum_extension
statement:
theorem exists_inversePencilUpperRootSum_extension
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, s ≠ b i) {R : ℝ} (branch : n → ℂ → ℂ)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {u | R < ‖u‖})
    (hspec : ∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → ∀ i, u - (s : ℂ) * branch i u ∈ spectrum ℂ
      (A - branch i u • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i : ℂ))))
    (hroot : ∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → 0 < u.im →
      inversePencilUpperRootSum A (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ))) u =
        ∑ i, if b i < s then branch i u else 0)
    (href : ∀ i u, R < ‖u‖ → branch i (conj u) = conj (branch i u)) :
    ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ h ({u | u.im ≠ 0} ∪ {u | R < ‖u‖}) ∧
      (∀ u, R < ‖u‖ → h u = ∑ i, if b i < s then branch i u else 0) ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u.im → h u =
        inversePencilUpperRootSum A (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ))) u) ∧
      (∀ u, h (conj u) = conj (h u)) ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u.im → 0 ≤ (h u).im) ∧
      ∀ u, ‖h u‖ ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) *
        specNorm (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => ((b i - s : ℝ) : ℂ)))⁻¹ *
          (specNorm A + ‖u‖)

name: NLAlib.exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_with_derivatives
statement:
theorem exists_isCompactExpRepresentation_traceExp_with_derivatives
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A H : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ ν : FiniteMeasure ℝ,
      IsCompactExpRepresentation ν (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • H))
        (lambdaMin H) (lambdaMax H) ∧
      (ν : Measure ℝ).real Set.univ = traceExp A ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ,
        iteratedDeriv k (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) t =
          ∫ x, x ^ k * Real.exp (t * x) ∂(ν : Measure ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        0 ≤ Real.exp (t * lambdaMin H) *
          iteratedDeriv (2 * r) (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0 ∧
        Real.exp (t * lambdaMin H) *
          iteratedDeriv (2 * r) (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0 ≤
          iteratedDeriv (2 * r) (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) t ∧
        iteratedDeriv (2 * r) (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) t ≤
          Real.exp (t * lambdaMax H) *
            iteratedDeriv (2 * r) (fun x : ℝ => traceExp (A + x • H)) 0

name: NLAlib.exists_exterior_branches_integral_circleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem exists_exterior_branches_integral_circleDensity_eq_trace_matrixExp_sub_atoms_of_isHermitian
    (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective hB.eigenvalues) :
    let E := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star hB.eigenvectorUnitary)
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∃ branch : n → ℂ → ℂ,
      (∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (branch i) {z | R < ‖z‖} ∧
        Tendsto (fun z => branch i z + (hB.eigenvalues i : ℂ) * z)
          (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 ((E A) i i))) ∧
      ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u → (∀ i, hB.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc l u) →
        ∀ r : ℝ, R < r → ∀ t : ℝ,
        IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          traceExponentialCircleDensity branch hB.eigenvalues r s) volume l u ∧
        (∫ s in l..u, Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * s) *
          traceExponentialCircleDensity branch hB.eigenvalues r s) =
          Matrix.trace (matrixExp (A - (t : ℂ) • B)) -
            ∑ i, Complex.exp ((E A) i i - (t : ℂ) * hB.eigenvalues i)

name: NLAlib.traceHessianKernel_eq_spectral
statement:
theorem traceHessianKernel_eq_spectral {d p : ℕ}
    (C B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hC : C.transpose = C) (hB : B.transpose = B) :
    let hCh : C.IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mpr hC
    let U := star hCh.eigenvectorUnitary
    let B' := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U B
    traceHessianKernel p C B =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (p - 1), ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (B' i j) ^ 2 * (hCh.eigenvalues j) ^ ((p - 1).pred - k) *
          (hCh.eigenvalues i) ^ k

statement:
theorem relative_spectrum_characterizations {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) (a b : ℝ) :
    ((a • A ≤ B ∧ B ≤ b • A) ↔ spectrum ℝ (A⁻¹ * B) ⊆ Set.Icc a b) ∧
    (B ≤ A ↔ spectralRadius ℝ (A⁻¹ * B) ≤ 1) ∧
    (B ≤ A ↔ ∃ X : Matrix n n ℝ, 0 ≤ X ∧ X ≤ 1 ∧
      B = CFC.sqrt A * X * CFC.sqrt A) ∧
    (B ^ 2 ≤ A ^ 2 ↔ specNorm (A⁻¹ * B) ≤ 1) ∧
    (B ≤ A → B.det ≤ A.det ∧ (B.det = A.det ↔ B = A) ∧
      B.trace ≤ A.trace ∧ (B.trace = A.trace ↔ B = A) ∧
      (∀ k, hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ k ≤ hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ k) ∧
      CFC.sqrt B ≤ CFC.sqrt A ∧ (B.PosDef → A⁻¹ ≤ B⁻¹))

name: NLAlib.planeRotation_single_conjugation_diag
statement:
theorem planeRotation_single_conjugation_diag
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (k : n) :
    let Δ := 2 * c * s * A i j + s ^ 2 * (A j j - A i i)
    (planeRotation (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) c s * A *
      (planeRotation (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) c s)ᵀ) k k =
      A k k + if k = i then Δ else if k = j then -Δ else 0

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_diagonal_error_planeRotation_single_eq
statement:
theorem sum_sq_diagonal_error_planeRotation_single_eq
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (d : n → ℝ) (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    let Δ := 2 * c * s * A i j + s ^ 2 * (A j j - A i i)
    (∑ k, ((planeRotation (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) c s * A *
      (planeRotation (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) c s)ᵀ) k k - d k) ^ 2) -
      (∑ k, (A k k - d k) ^ 2) =
      2 * ((A i i - d i) - (A j j - d j)) * Δ + 2 * Δ ^ 2

statement:
theorem planeRotation_mul_mul_transpose_apply_diag_of_disjoint_eigenvectors
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (u v : n → ℝ)
    (hu : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (hv : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0)
    (α β : ℝ) (hAu : A *ᵥ u = α • u) (hAv : A *ᵥ v = β • v)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ i, u i * v i = 0) (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (i : n) :
    (planeRotation u v c s * A * (planeRotation u v c s)ᵀ) i i =
      A i i + s ^ 2 * (β - α) * (u i ^ 2 - v i ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.planeRotation_mul_mul_transpose_of_eigenvectors
statement:
theorem planeRotation_mul_mul_transpose_of_eigenvectors
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (u v : n → ℝ)
    (hu : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (hv : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ = 1) (huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0)
    (α β : ℝ) (hAu : A *ᵥ u = α • u) (hAv : A *ᵥ v = β • v)
    (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    planeRotation u v c s * A * (planeRotation u v c s)ᵀ =
      A + (s ^ 2 * (β - α)) • (Matrix.vecMulVec u u - Matrix.vecMulVec v v) +
        (c * s * (β - α)) • (Matrix.vecMulVec u v + Matrix.vecMulVec v u)

    (hdisjoint : ∀ i, u i * v i = 0) (c s : ℝ) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    (∑ i, ((planeRotation u v c s * A * (planeRotation u v c s)ᵀ) i i - d i) ^ 2) -
      (∑ i, (A i i - d i) ^ 2) =
      2 * s ^ 2 * (β - α) * (∑ i, (A i i - d i) * (u i ^ 2 - v i ^ 2)) +
        s ^ 4 * (β - α) ^ 2 * (∑ i, (u i ^ 2 - v i ^ 2) ^ 2)

    specNorm (Matrix.fromRows A (0 : Matrix n p ℝ)) ^ 2 = specNorm A ^ 2

name: NLAlib.specNorm_upper_block_sq_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_upper_block_sq_le {p q r : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [Fintype r] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q] [DecidableEq r]
    (F : Matrix p p ℝ) (T : Matrix p q ℝ) (D : Matrix r q ℝ) :
    specNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks F (F * T) 0 D) ^ 2 ≤
      specNorm F ^ 2 * (1 + frobSq T) + frobSq D

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_frobSq_single_columns
statement:
theorem frobSq_eq_sum_frobSq_single_columns {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    frobSq A = ∑ j, frobSq (A.submatrix id (fun _ : Fin 1 => j))

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_frobNorm_of_entrywise
statement:
theorem continuousAt_frobNorm_of_entrywise
    (hA : ∀ i j, ContinuousAt (fun y => A y i j) x) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => frobNorm (A y)) x

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_frobNorm_sub_of_entrywise
statement:
theorem continuousAt_frobNorm_sub_of_entrywise
    (hA : ∀ i j, ContinuousAt (fun y => A y i j) x) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => frobNorm (A y - A x)) x

name: NLAlib.continuousAt_specNorm_of_entrywise
statement:
theorem continuousAt_specNorm_of_entrywise [DecidableEq n]
    (hA : ∀ i j, ContinuousAt (fun y => A y i j) x) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y => specNorm (A y)) x

name: NLAlib.dilation_reindex
statement:
theorem dilation_reindex {m n p q : Type*} (A : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) :
    dilation (A.reindex em en) =
      (dilation A).reindex (em.sumCongr en) (em.sumCongr en)

name: NLAlib.sqrt_mul_sum_entry_rpow_root_le_two_row_profiles
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_sum_entry_rpow_root_le_two_row_profiles
    (b : Matrix m n ℝ) (hb : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ∑ j, b i j ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      2 * ((∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹ +
        Real.sqrt p * (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹)

name: NLAlib.sum_entry_rpow_le_row_profiles
statement:
theorem sum_entry_rpow_le_row_profiles
    (b : Matrix m n ℝ) (hb : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, b i j ^ p) ≤
      (∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ (2 / p) *
        (∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ^ (1 - 2 / p)

name: NLAlib.sum_entry_rpow_root_le_row_profiles
statement:
theorem sum_entry_rpow_root_le_row_profiles
    (b : Matrix m n ℝ) (hb : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ b i j) {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, b i j ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      ((∑ i, (∑ j, b i j ^ 2) ^ (p / 2)) ^ p⁻¹) ^ (2 / p) *
        ((∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ p) ^ p⁻¹) ^ (1 - 2 / p)

name: NLAlib.mul_frobSq_le_frobSq_mul_of_mulVec_sq_le
NLAlib.mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_mul_of_mulVec_sq_le
statement:
theorem mul_specNorm_le_specNorm_mul_of_mulVec_sq_le {T : Matrix m n ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ x : n → ℝ, c ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ (T *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (T *ᵥ x))
    (X : Matrix n p ℝ) : c * specNorm X ≤ specNorm (T * X)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_integral_linearMap_mul_le_card_sq_mul_entry_second_moment
statement:
theorem specNorm_integral_linearMap_mul_le_card_sq_mul_entry_second_moment
    (S : Matrix d d ℂ →L[ℂ] Matrix d d ℂ)
    (D : Ω → Matrix d d ℂ) (hD : AEStronglyMeasurable D μ)
    (hDi : ∀ a b, Integrable (fun x => ‖D x a b‖^2) μ)
    (V : ℝ) (hV : ∀ a b, (∫ x, ‖D x a b‖^2 ∂μ)≤V) :
    specNorm (∫ x, S (D x)*D x ∂μ)≤(Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2*‖S‖*V

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    |u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)| ≤ √(u ⬝ᵥ u) * (specNorm A * √(x ⬝ᵥ x))

name: NLAlib.exists_finset_net_specNorm_le
statement:
theorem exists_finset_net_specNorm_le (n : Type*) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {ε : ℝ}
    (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    ∃ N : Finset (n → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ N, x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) ∧
      (N.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 2 / ε) ^ Fintype.card n ∧
      ∀ (m : Type*) [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (M : ℝ), 0 ≤ M →
        (∀ x ∈ N, √((A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) ≤ M) → specNorm A ≤ M / (1 - ε)

name: NLAlib.exists_finset_sphere_net
statement:
theorem exists_finset_sphere_net (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : Finset (ι → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ N, x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) ∧
      (N.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 2 / ε) ^ Fintype.card ι ∧
      ∀ y : ι → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 → ∃ x ∈ N, (x - y) ⬝ᵥ (x - y) ≤ ε ^ 2

name: NLAlib.exists_unit_abs_quadForm_eq_specNorm
NLAlib.specNorm_le_div_of_net
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_div_of_net (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (N : Finset (n → ℝ)) {ε M : ℝ}
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    (hN : ∀ y : n → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 → ∃ x ∈ N, (x - y) ⬝ᵥ (x - y) ≤ ε ^ 2)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ N, √((A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) ≤ M) :
    specNorm A ≤ M / (1 - ε)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_div_of_net_bilinear
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_div_of_net_bilinear (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (N : Finset (n → ℝ))
    (N' : Finset (m → ℝ)) {ε M : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε < 1 / 2) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    (hN'unit : ∀ y ∈ N', y ⬝ᵥ y = 1)
    (hN : ∀ x : n → ℝ, x ⬝ᵥ x = 1 → ∃ x₀ ∈ N, (x₀ - x) ⬝ᵥ (x₀ - x) ≤ ε ^ 2)
    (hN' : ∀ y : m → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 → ∃ y₀ ∈ N', (y₀ - y) ⬝ᵥ (y₀ - y) ≤ ε ^ 2)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ y ∈ N', y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) ≤ M) :
    specNorm A ≤ M / (1 - 2 * ε)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_div_of_net_quadForm
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_div_of_net_quadForm {B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (N : Finset (n → ℝ)) {ε M : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε < 1 / 2) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    (hNunit : ∀ x ∈ N, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1)
    (hN : ∀ y : n → ℝ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ = 1 → ∃ x ∈ N, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - y)‖ ≤ ε)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ N, |quadForm B x| ≤ M) :
    specNorm B ≤ M / (1 - 2 * ε)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_of_forall_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_of_forall_sqrt_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (h : ∀ y : n → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 → √((A *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)) ≤ K) : specNorm A ≤ K

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_sub_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_sub_le (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    {U V : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    frobNorm (Uᴴ * A * U - Vᴴ * A * V) ≤ 2 * specNorm A * frobNorm (U - V)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_vecMulVec_sub_le_norm_sq_add
statement:
theorem frobSq_vecMulVec_sub_le_norm_sq_add {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (u u' : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (v v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ m)
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hu' : ‖u'‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (hv' : ‖v'‖ = 1) :
    frobSq (Matrix.vecMulVec v.ofLp u.ofLp - Matrix.vecMulVec v'.ofLp u'.ofLp)
      ≤ ‖u-u'‖ ^ 2 + ‖v-v'‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.frobSq_vecMulVec_sub_same_eq_norm_sq
statement:
theorem frobSq_vecMulVec_sub_same_eq_norm_sq {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (v v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) :
    frobSq (Matrix.vecMulVec v.ofLp u.ofLp - Matrix.vecMulVec v'.ofLp u.ofLp)
      = ‖v-v'‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_iff_abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_le_iff_abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    specNorm A ≤ ε ↔ ∀ x : n → ℝ, |x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)| ≤ ε * (x ⬝ᵥ x)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_inv_smul_le_one
statement:
theorem specNorm_inv_smul_le_one {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {S : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 < S) (hbound : specNorm A ≤ S) : specNorm (S⁻¹•A) ≤ 1

name: NLAlib.specNorm_real_smul
statement:
theorem specNorm_real_smul (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    specNorm (c•A)=|c| * specNorm A

name: NLAlib.rectDiag_smul
statement:
theorem rectDiag_smul {m n : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_rectangularDiagonal_sign
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_rectangularDiagonal_sign {m n : ℕ}
    (x ε : Fin (min m n) → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, |ε i| = 1) :
    ∃ U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ, HasOrthonormalCols U ∧

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_diagonal_of_abs_eq_one

theorem hasOrthonormalCols_permMatrix {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

name: NLAlib.prefixPermutation_apply_of_lt
statement:
theorem prefixPermutation_apply_of_lt {k m : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (hk : k ≤ m)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : i.val < k) :
    prefixPermutation σ hk i = Fin.castLE hk (σ ⟨i.val, hi⟩)

name: NLAlib.prefixPermutation_apply_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem prefixPermutation_apply_of_not_lt {k m : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (hk : k ≤ m)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : ¬ i.val < k) : prefixPermutation σ hk i = i

name: NLAlib.rectangularDiagonalLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectangularDiagonalLinear_apply {m n : ℕ} (x : Fin (min m n) → ℝ) :
    rectangularDiagonalLinear m n x = rectangularDiagonal x

name: NLAlib.rectangularDiagonal_apply_castLE
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectangularDiagonal_apply_castLE {m n : ℕ} (x : Fin (min m n) → ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (min m n)) :
    rectangularDiagonal x (Fin.castLE (min_le_left m n) i) (Fin.castLE (min_le_right m n) j) =
      if i = j then x i else 0

name: NLAlib.rectangularDiagonal_injective
statement:
theorem rectangularDiagonal_injective {m n : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (rectangularDiagonal (m := m) (n := n))

name: NLAlib.exists_orthogonal_rectangularDiagonal_perm
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_rectangularDiagonal_perm {m n : ℕ}
    (x : Fin (min m n) → ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (min m n))) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ),
      HasOrthonormalCols U ∧ HasOrthonormalCols V ∧ U * rectangularDiagonal x * V =
        rectangularDiagonal (x ∘ σ)

name: NLAlib.prefixPermutation_apply_lt_iff
statement:
theorem prefixPermutation_apply_lt_iff {k m : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (hk : k ≤ m)
    (i : Fin m) : (prefixPermutation σ hk i).val < k ↔ i.val < k

name: NLAlib.rectangularDiagonal_apply_eq_zero_of_not_lt_left
NLAlib.rectangularDiagonal_apply_eq_zero_of_not_lt_right
NLAlib.rectangularDiagonal_submatrix_prefixPermutation
statement:
theorem rectangularDiagonal_submatrix_prefixPermutation {m n : ℕ}
    (x : Fin (min m n) → ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (min m n))) :
    (rectangularDiagonal x).submatrix (prefixPermutation σ (min_le_left m n))
      (prefixPermutation σ (min_le_right m n)) = rectangularDiagonal (x ∘ σ)

name: NLAlib.abs_restrictedMinimum_sub_le_frobNorm
statement:
theorem abs_restrictedMinimum_sub_le_frobNorm (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {T : Set (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    (hunit : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :

name: NLAlib.abs_restrictedMinimum_sub_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem abs_restrictedMinimum_sub_le_specNorm (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜)
    {T : Set (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n)} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    (hunit : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :

name: NLAlib.exists_norm_eq_restrictedMinimum

theorem exists_norm_eq_restrictedMinimum (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)

statement:
theorem restrictedMinimum_le_norm (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)

name: NLAlib.restrictedMinimum_nonneg
statement:
theorem restrictedMinimum_nonneg (A : Matrix m n 𝕜)

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sq_replicateCol
statement:
theorem specNorm_sq_replicateCol {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (v : n → 𝕜) :

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem frobNorm_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols (U : Matrix m n K) (X : Matrix n p K)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) : frobNorm (U * X) = frobNorm X

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_left_unitary
statement:
theorem frobNorm_mul_left_unitary (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n K) (X : Matrix n p K) :
    frobNorm ((U : Matrix n n K) * X) = frobNorm X

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_right_unitary
statement:
theorem frobNorm_mul_right_unitary (X : Matrix m n K) (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n K) :
    frobNorm (X * (U : Matrix n n K)) = frobNorm X

name: NLAlib.abs_eigenvalue_sub_rayleigh_le_residual_sq_div
statement:
theorem abs_eigenvalue_sub_rayleigh_le_residual_sq_div {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) {ℓ δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hℓ : |ℓ-quadForm A x| < δ)
    (hiso : ∀ i, |hA.eigenvalues i-quadForm A x| < δ → hA.eigenvalues i = ℓ) :
    |ℓ-quadForm A x| ≤
      ((A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x)) / δ

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_rayleigh_residual_eq_zero
statement:
theorem dotProduct_rayleigh_residual_eq_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) :
    x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) = 0

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_rayleigh_add_sq
statement:
theorem dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_rayleigh_add_sq (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (μ : ℝ) :
    (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) =
      (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) +
        (μ - quadForm A x) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_sum
statement:
theorem dotProduct_shifted_residual_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (x : n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) :
    (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) =
      ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i - μ) ^ 2 * (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_abs_sub_le_residual
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_abs_sub_le_residual {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (μ : ℝ) :
    ∃ i, |hA.eigenvalues i - μ| ≤
      Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x - μ • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - μ • x))

name: NLAlib.kato_temple_eigenvalue_le
statement:
theorem kato_temple_eigenvalue_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) {α β ℓ : ℝ}
    (hαρ : α < quadForm A x) (_hρβ : quadForm A x < β)
    (hαℓ : α < ℓ) (hℓβ : ℓ < β)
    (hiso : ∀ i, α < hA.eigenvalues i → hA.eigenvalues i < β → hA.eigenvalues i = ℓ) :
    ℓ ≤ quadForm A x +
      ((A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x)) /
        (quadForm A x - α)

name: NLAlib.kato_temple_le_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem kato_temple_le_eigenvalue {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) {α β ℓ : ℝ}
    (hαρ : α < quadForm A x) (hρβ : quadForm A x < β)
    (hαℓ : α < ℓ) (hℓβ : ℓ < β)
    (hiso : ∀ i, α < hA.eigenvalues i → hA.eigenvalues i < β → hA.eigenvalues i = ℓ) :
    quadForm A x -
      ((A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x)) /
        (β - quadForm A x) ≤ ℓ

name: NLAlib.rayleigh_residual_le_shifted_residual
statement:
theorem rayleigh_residual_le_shifted_residual (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (μ : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x)) ≤
      Real.sqrt ((A *ᵥ x - μ • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - μ • x))

name: NLAlib.rayleigh_variance_add_mul_nonneg
statement:
theorem rayleigh_variance_add_mul_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (ℓ a : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (hA.eigenvalues i - ℓ) * (hA.eigenvalues i - a)) :
    0 ≤ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) +
      (quadForm A x - ℓ) * (quadForm A x - a)

name: NLAlib.shifted_residual_eq_rayleigh_residual_iff
statement:
theorem shifted_residual_eq_rayleigh_residual_iff (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (μ : ℝ) :
    (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - μ • x) =
      (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - quadForm A x • x) ↔
        μ = quadForm A x

name: NLAlib.eigenvalue_separation_of_interval_complement
NLAlib.frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester_div
statement:
theorem frobNorm_le_frobNorm_sylvester_div {L : Matrix m m ℝ} {M : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hL : L.IsHermitian) (hM : M.IsHermitian) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i j, δ ≤ |hL.eigenvalues i-hM.eigenvalues j|) (X : Matrix m n ℝ) :

statement:
theorem sylvester_separation_bounds {L : Matrix m m ℝ} {M : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hL : L.IsHermitian) (hM : M.IsHermitian) (X : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → (∀ i j, δ ≤ |hL.eigenvalues i-hM.eigenvalues j|) →
      δ*frobNorm X ≤ frobNorm (L*X-X*M)) ∧
    (∀ a b δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
      (∀ j, a ≤ hM.eigenvalues j ∧ hM.eigenvalues j ≤ b) →
      (∀ i, hL.eigenvalues i ≤ a-δ ∨ b+δ ≤ hL.eigenvalues i) →
      δ*specNorm X ≤ specNorm (L*X-X*M) ∧ δ*frobNorm X ≤ frobNorm (L*X-X*M)) ∧
    (∀ α δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → (∀ i, hL.eigenvalues i ≤ α-δ) →
      (∀ j, α ≤ hM.eigenvalues j) → δ*specNorm X ≤ specNorm (L*X-X*M))

statement:
theorem least_squares_forward_angle_coefficient_le {Q M a X b R ε L : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 < M) (hX : 0 < X) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hsmall : M * a * ε < 1)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hLX : L ≤ M * X) (hLb : L ≤ b)
    (hQ : Q ≤ a / (1 - M * a * ε) *
      (ε * b + ε * M * X + a * ε * M * R)) :
    Q / X ≤ ε * (2 * (M * a) / (L / b) + (M * a) ^ 2 * (R / L)) /
      (1 - M * a * ε)

    (_hb : 0 ≤ b) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hsmall : M * a * ε < 1)
    (hb : b ≤ M * X + R)
    (hQ : Q ≤ a / (1 - M * a * ε) *
      (ε * b + ε * M * X + a * ε * M * R)) :
    Q / X ≤ M * a * ε / (1 - M * a * ε) *
      (2 + (M * a + 1) * R / (M * X))

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalue_branch_of_simple_of_isHermitian
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (E : Matrix n n ℝ) (hAh : A.IsHermitian)
    {x : n → ℝ} {μ : ℝ} (hxn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1) (hAx : A *ᵥ x = μ • x)
    (hμ : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1) :
    ∃ φ : ℝ → ℂ, φ 0 = μ ∧ ContinuousAt φ 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt φ (Complex.ofReal (x ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x))) 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, ContinuousAt φ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ ((A + t • E).map Complex.ofReal)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p : ℝ × ℂ in 𝓝 (0, (μ : ℂ)),
        p.2 ∈ spectrum ℂ ((A + p.1 • E).map Complex.ofReal) ↔ φ p.1 = p.2)

    (hμ : A.charpoly.rootMultiplicity μ = 1) :
    ∃ φ : ℝ → ℂ, φ 0 = μ ∧ ContinuousAt φ 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt φ ((y ⬝ᵥ (E *ᵥ x)) / (y ⬝ᵥ x)) 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, ContinuousAt φ t) ∧
      (∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), φ t ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + (t : ℂ) • E)) ∧
      (∀ᶠ p : ℝ × ℂ in 𝓝 (0, μ),
        p.2 ∈ spectrum ℂ (A + (p.1 : ℂ) • E) ↔ φ p.1 = p.2)

      A a = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * T a * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ ∧

      A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (a i)) ∧ B.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (b i)) ∧

      B = (V : Matrix n n ℂ) * T₂ * (W : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ ∧

theorem eigenvalue_order_and_counting {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (∀ k, hA.neg.eigenvalues₀ k = -hA.eigenvalues₀ k.rev) ∧
    (∀ (k : Fin (Fintype.card n)) (S : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ)) (c : ℝ),
      (k : ℕ) + 1 ≤ finrank ℝ S →
      (∀ x ∈ S, x ≠ 0 → c * (x ⬝ᵥ x) < quadForm A x) → c < hA.eigenvalues₀ k) ∧
    (∀ S : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ quadForm A x) →
      finrank ℝ S ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i).card) ∧
    (∀ S : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ S, x ≠ 0 → 0 < quadForm A x) →
      finrank ℝ S ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 < hA.eigenvalues₀ i).card)

    (A S : Matrix n n K) (i : n) (μ : K) (hS : IsUnit S)

    (hA : A = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * S * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hB : B = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * T * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hS : S.IsUpperTriangular) (hT : T.IsUpperTriangular) (α β : ℂ) :
    (β • A - α • B).det = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ).det *
      (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ.det * ∏ i, (β * S i i - α * T i i)

name: NLAlib.pencilPolynomial_eq_prod_of_unitary_qz
statement:
theorem pencilPolynomial_eq_prod_of_unitary_qz
    (hA : A = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * S * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hB : B = (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * T * (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ)
    (hS : S.IsUpperTriangular) (hT : T.IsUpperTriangular) :
    pencilPolynomial A B = Polynomial.C ((Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ).det *
      (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)ᴴ.det) *
      ∏ i, (Polynomial.C (S i i) - Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (T i i))

name: NLAlib.finrank_ker_fromBlocks_eq_schur
statement:
theorem finrank_ker_fromBlocks_eq_schur {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAu : IsUnit A) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).mulVecLin) =
      finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).mulVecLin)

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_eq_congruence_diagonal
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_eq_congruence_diagonal {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hC : C.IsHermitian) :
    fromBlocks A 0 0 C =
      (fromBlocks (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix m m ℝ)ᵀ 0 0
        (hC.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ)ᵀ *
      diagonal (Sum.elim hA.eigenvalues hC.eigenvalues) *
      fromBlocks (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix m m ℝ)ᵀ 0 0
        (hC.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_eq_transpose_mul_schur_mul
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_eq_transpose_mul_schur_mul {A : Matrix m m ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAu : IsUnit A) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (C : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C =
      (fromBlocks 1 (A⁻¹ * B) 0 1)ᵀ *
      fromBlocks A 0 0 (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B) *
      fromBlocks 1 (A⁻¹ * B) 0 1

name: NLAlib.haynsworth_inertia_additivity
statement:
theorem haynsworth_inertia_additivity {A : Matrix m m ℝ} {C : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAu : IsUnit A) (hC : C.IsHermitian) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    inertiaPos (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C) = inertiaPos A + inertiaPos (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B) ∧
    inertiaNeg (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C) = inertiaNeg A + inertiaNeg (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B) ∧
    finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).mulVecLin) =
      finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).mulVecLin) ∧
    ((fromBlocks A B Bᵀ C).PosDef ↔ A.PosDef ∧ (C - Bᵀ * A⁻¹ * B).PosDef)

name: NLAlib.card_eigenvalues_lt_eq_card_sign_changes
statement:
theorem card_eigenvalues_lt_eq_card_sign_changes {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {x : ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ m → leadingMinor (A - x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) k ≠ 0) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i < x).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin m =>
        leadingMinor (A - x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) (k : ℕ) *
          leadingMinor (A - x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) ((k : ℕ) + 1) < 0).card

name: NLAlib.charpoly_bordered_diagonal_insertNth
statement:
theorem charpoly_bordered_diagonal_insertNth {n : ℕ}
    (d : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (p : Fin (n + 1)) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d)
      (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) (p.insertNth 0 v))
      (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) (p.insertNth 0 v))
      (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a))).charpoly =
      (X - C (d p)) *
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ p.succAbove))
          (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v)
          (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a))).charpoly

name: NLAlib.charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_insertNth
statement:
theorem charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_insertNth {n : ℕ}
    (d : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (p : Fin (n + 1)) (v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec (p.insertNth 0 v) (p.insertNth 0 v)).charpoly =
      (X - C (d p)) *
        (Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ p.succAbove) + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly

name: NLAlib.bordered_interlacing_converse_of_strict_cases
statement:
theorem bordered_interlacing_converse_of_strict_cases
    (hstrict : ∀ (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      StrictMono d → Monotone b → (∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ) →
      ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, ∃ a : ℝ,
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
          (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a))).charpoly =
          ∏ j, (X - C (b j))) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      Monotone d → Monotone b → (∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ) →
      ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, ∃ a : ℝ,
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
          (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a))).charpoly =
          ∏ j, (X - C (b j))

name: NLAlib.rank_one_interlacing_converse_of_strict_cases
statement:
theorem rank_one_interlacing_converse_of_strict_cases
    (hstrict : ∀ (n : ℕ) (d b : Fin n → ℝ), StrictMono d → Monotone b →
      (∀ i, d i ≤ b i) → (∀ i j, i.val + 1 = j.val → b i ≤ d j) →
      ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
        ∏ j, (X - C (b j))) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (d b : Fin n → ℝ), Monotone d → Monotone b →
      (∀ i, d i ≤ b i) → (∀ i j, i < j → b i ≤ d j) →
      ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
        ∏ j, (X - C (b j))

name: NLAlib.charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem charpoly_diagonal_add_vecMulVec
    [Infinite K] (d v : n → K) :
    (Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
      (∏ i, (X - C (d i))) -
        ∑ i, C ((v i) ^ 2) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X - C (d j))

name: NLAlib.charpoly_fromBlocks_diagonal_replicate
statement:
theorem charpoly_fromBlocks_diagonal_replicate
    [Infinite K] {l : Type*} [Unique l] [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l]
    (d v : n → K) (a : K) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol l v)
      (Matrix.replicateRow l v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : l => a)).charpoly =
      (X - C a) * (∏ i, (X - C (d i))) -
        ∑ i, C ((v i) ^ 2) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X - C (d j))

name: NLAlib.det_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_of_forall_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_diagonal_add_vecMulVec_of_forall_ne_zero

name: NLAlib.det_fromBlocks_diagonal_of_forall_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_fromBlocks_diagonal_of_forall_ne_zero
    {l : Type*} [Unique l] [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l]
    (d v : n → K) (a : K) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol l v)
      (Matrix.replicateRow l v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : l => a)).det =

theorem exists_bordered_diagonal_charpoly_of_strictMono

name: NLAlib.exists_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_diagonal_construction
statement:
theorem exists_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_diagonal_construction
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (d v : n → ℝ)
    (hd : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    ∃ u : n → ℝ, (A + Matrix.vecMulVec u u).charpoly =

name: NLAlib.exists_bordered_charpoly_of_diagonal_construction
statement:
theorem exists_bordered_charpoly_of_diagonal_construction
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (d v : n → ℝ) (a : ℝ)
    (hd : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    ∃ u : n → ℝ,
      (Matrix.fromBlocks A (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) u)
        (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) u) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)).charpoly =
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
        (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)).charpoly

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_mul_arrowhead_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_mul_arrowhead_mul_transpose
    (Q A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    let P : Matrix (n ⊕ Fin 1) (n ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ := Matrix.fromBlocks Q 0 0 1
    P * Matrix.fromBlocks A (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
      (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a) * Pᵀ =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Q * A * Qᵀ) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) (Q *ᵥ v))
        (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) (Q *ᵥ v)) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)

theorem mul_add_vecMulVec_mul_transpose (Q A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) :

theorem charpoly_diagonal_arrowhead_reindex (e : n ≃ m) (d v : n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :

    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
      (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)).charpoly

name: NLAlib.exists_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_interlacing
statement:
theorem exists_add_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_interlacing
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (d b : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (hd : Monotone d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (hchar : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i)))
    (hlo : ∀ i, d i ≤ b i)
    (hhi : ∀ i j, i.val + 1 = j.val → b i ≤ d j) :
    ∃ v : n → ℝ, (A + Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
      (∏ i, (X - C (b i))) ∧ (∑ i, (v i) ^ 2) = (∑ i, b i) - ∑ i, d i

name: NLAlib.exists_bordered_charpoly_of_interlacing
statement:
theorem exists_bordered_charpoly_of_interlacing
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (d : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (b : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hd : Monotone d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (hchar : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i)))
    (hinter : ∀ i, b i.castSucc ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ b i.succ) :
    ∃ v : n → ℝ, ∃ a : ℝ,
      (Matrix.fromBlocks A (Matrix.replicateCol (Fin 1) v)
        (Matrix.replicateRow (Fin 1) v) (Matrix.of fun _ _ : Fin 1 => a)).charpoly =
          (∏ i, (X - C (b i))) ∧ a = (∑ i, b i) - ∑ i, d i

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_interlacing
statement:
theorem exists_sub_vecMulVec_charpoly_of_interlacing
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (d b : Fin (Fintype.card n) → ℝ) (hd : Monotone d) (hb : Monotone b)
    (hchar : A.charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i)))
    (hlo : ∀ i, b i ≤ d i)
    (hhi : ∀ i j, i.val + 1 = j.val → d i ≤ b j) :
    ∃ v : n → ℝ, (A - Matrix.vecMulVec v v).charpoly =
      (∏ i, (X - C (b i))) ∧ (∑ i, (v i) ^ 2) = (∑ i, d i) - ∑ i, b i

name: NLAlib.eigenvalue_low_rank_interlacing
statement:
theorem eigenvalue_low_rank_interlacing {A B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (∀ (i : Fin (Fintype.card n))
      (hi : i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => 0 < hB.eigenvalues₀ j).card < Fintype.card n),
      (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀
        ⟨i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => 0 < hB.eigenvalues₀ j).card, hi⟩ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin (Fintype.card n))
      (hi : i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => hB.eigenvalues₀ j < 0).card < Fintype.card n),
      hA.eigenvalues₀
        ⟨i.val + (Finset.univ.filter fun j => hB.eigenvalues₀ j < 0).card, hi⟩ ≤
          (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ i) ∧
    (∀ r, B.rank ≤ r → ∀ (i : Fin (Fintype.card n)) (hi : i.val + r < Fintype.card n),
      (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + r, hi⟩ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i ∧
      hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + r, hi⟩ ≤ (hA.add hB).eigenvalues₀ i) ∧
    (∀ z i, hA.eigenvalues₀ i ≤
      (hA.add (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian).eigenvalues₀ i ∧
      (∀ hi : i.val + 1 < Fintype.card n,
        (hA.add (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian).eigenvalues₀
          ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩ ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i)) ∧
    (∀ z i, (hA.sub (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian).eigenvalues₀ i ≤
      hA.eigenvalues₀ i ∧ (∀ hi : i.val + 1 < Fintype.card n,
        hA.eigenvalues₀ ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩ ≤
          (hA.sub (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star z).isHermitian).eigenvalues₀ i))
