    {n ι : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hcomm : Pairwise fun a b => Commute (A a) (A b))
    (order : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n) (a₀ : ι) (d : n → ℂ)
    (hchar : (A a₀).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (d i))) :
    ∃ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ, ∃ T : ι → Matrix n n ℂ,
      (∀ a, A a = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * T a * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ ∧
        (∀ i j, order.symm j < order.symm i → T a i j = 0) ∧
        (A a).charpoly = ∏ i, (X - C (T a i i))) ∧
      ∀ i, T a₀ i i = d i

    (hstep : 2 * δ * T ≤ 1) :
    ∃ j : Fin (q + 1),
      ((M - δ • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ)).submatrix
        j.succAbove j.succAbove).PosDef ∧
      ((M - δ • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ)).submatrix
        j.succAbove j.succAbove)⁻¹.trace ≤ T

theorem reciprocal_gap_nonneg_and_sq_le {a b δ : ℝ}

    0 ≤ 1 / (a - b) - 1 / (a - (b - δ)) ∧
      δ / (a - (b - δ)) ^ 2 ≤

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.weighted_reciprocal_sq_le
statement:
theorem weighted_reciprocal_sq_le
    (a w : ι → ℝ) {b δ Λ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hb : δ < b)
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i = 0 ∨ b < a i)
    (hkernel : b * Λ ≤ δ * ∑ i, if a i = 0 then w i else 0) :
    let Δ := ∑ i, w i * (1 / (a i - b) - 1 / (a i - (b - δ)))
    0 < Δ ∧
      Λ * (∑ i, w i / (a i - (b - δ)) ^ 2) ≤ Δ * (Λ / δ + Δ)

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.lowerPotential_gap_pos_and_trace_sq_le
statement:
theorem lowerPotential_gap_pos_and_trace_sq_le
    {A H : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.PosSemidef)
    {b δ Λ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hb : δ < b) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hHle : H ≤ Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
    (hgap : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i = 0 ∨ b < hA.eigenvalues i)
    (hkernel : b * Λ ≤ δ * (H.trace - (A.rank : ℝ) * Λ)) :
    let Δ := lowerPotential H A b - lowerPotential H A (b - δ)
    0 < Δ ∧
      Λ * (H * ((A - (b - δ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹) ^ 2).trace ≤
        Δ * (Λ / δ + Δ)

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_column_interaction_lt_neg_one
statement:
theorem exists_column_interaction_lt_neg_one
    [Nonempty I] (v : I → n → ℝ) {H R : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hH : ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = H)
    (hHpos : H.PosSemidef) (hR : R.IsHermitian)
    {Δ Λ δ φ : ℝ} (hΔ : 0 < Δ) (_hΛ : 0 < Λ) (_hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hHle : H ≤ Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
    (htrace : (H * R).trace = φ - Δ)
    (hpot : φ ≤ -(Fintype.card I : ℝ) - Λ / δ)
    (hsq : Λ * (H * R ^ 2).trace ≤ Δ * (Λ / δ + Δ)) :
    ∃ i, quadForm R (v i) < -1 ∧
      quadForm (R * H * R) (v i) ≤ Δ * (-1 - quadForm R (v i))

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.lowerPotential_add_vecMulVec_le
statement:
theorem lowerPotential_add_vecMulVec_le
    {A H : Matrix n n ℝ} {b Δ φ : ℝ} (v : n → ℝ)
    (hunit : IsUnit (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)))
    (_hΔ : 0 < Δ)
    (htrace : lowerPotential H A b = φ - Δ)
    (hinteraction : quadForm (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ v < -1)
    (hcert : quadForm ((A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ * H *
        (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹) v ≤
      Δ * (-1 - quadForm (A - b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ v)) :
    lowerPotential H (A + vecMulVec v v) b ≤ φ

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_column_rank_eq_add_one_and_lowerPotential_le
statement:
theorem exists_column_rank_eq_add_one_and_lowerPotential_le
    {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] (v : I → n → ℝ)
    {A H : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hH : H.PosSemidef)
    (hframe : ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = H)
    {b δ Λ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hb : δ < b) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hHle : H ≤ Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
    (hgap : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i = 0 ∨ b < hA.eigenvalues i)
    (hkernel : b * Λ ≤ δ * (H.trace - (A.rank : ℝ) * Λ))
    (hpot : lowerPotential H A b ≤ -(Fintype.card I : ℝ) - Λ / δ) :
    ∃ i,
      (A + vecMulVec (v i) (v i)).rank = A.rank + 1 ∧
      (∀ j, (hA.add (by simpa only [star_trivial] using
        (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (v i)).isHermitian)).eigenvalues j = 0 ∨
        b - δ < (hA.add (by simpa only [star_trivial] using
          (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (v i)).isHermitian)).eigenvalues j) ∧
      lowerPotential H (A + vecMulVec (v i) (v i)) (b - δ) ≤
        lowerPotential H A b

      ∀ i, (hA.add (by simpa only [star_trivial] using
        (posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star v).isHermitian)).eigenvalues i = 0 ∨

name: NLAlib.RestrictedInvertibility.exists_selectedFrameOperator_rank_eq_and_eigenvalues_gap
statement:
theorem exists_selectedFrameOperator_rank_eq_and_eigenvalues_gap
    [Nonempty I] (v : I → n → ℝ) {H : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hH : H.PosSemidef) (hframe : ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = H)
    {b₀ δ Λ : ℝ} (hb₀ : 0 < b₀) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hHle : H ≤ Λ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))
    (hpot₀ : -H.trace / b₀ ≤ -(Fintype.card I : ℝ) - Λ / δ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : (k : ℝ) * δ < b₀) :
    ∃ s : Fin k → I,
      (selectedFrameOperator v s).rank = k ∧
      (∀ j, ((selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef v s).isHermitian).eigenvalues j = 0 ∨
        b₀ - (k : ℝ) * δ <
          ((selectedFrameOperator_posSemidef v s).isHermitian).eigenvalues j) ∧
      lowerPotential H (selectedFrameOperator v s) (b₀ - (k : ℝ) * δ) ≤
        -(Fintype.card I : ℝ) - Λ / δ

name: NLAlib.saddle_coupling_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem saddle_coupling_mul_conjTranspose {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (Shat : Matrix m m 𝕜) :
    let C := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat * B * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
    C * Cᴴ = cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat * saddleSchurComplement A B *
      cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat

name: NLAlib.symmetric_saddle_preconditioning_eq
statement:
theorem symmetric_saddle_preconditioning_eq [Nonempty n] [Nonempty m]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {Shat : Matrix m m 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hS : Shat.PosDef)
    (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    let R := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 Shat)
    let C := cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat * B * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
    R * kktMatrix A B * R = kktMatrix 1 C

theorem commute_blockDiagonal'_iff [IsAlgClosed K]

    (X : Matrix (Σ i, m i) (Σ i, m i) K) :

    {X : Matrix (Σ i, m i) (Σ i, n i) K}

theorem det_add_mul_mul_conjTranspose (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (C : Matrix k k K) (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det) :
    (D + U * C * Vᴴ).det = D.det * (inverseReductionCore D U V).det *
      (C + (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹).det

name: NLAlib.inverseReduction_conformalBlockDiagonal
statement:
theorem inverseReduction_conformalBlockDiagonal {ι : Type*} [LinearOrder ι]
    (row : n → ι) (coarse : k → ι) (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det)
    (hDb : ConformalBlockDiagonal D row row)
    (hUb : ConformalBlockDiagonal U row coarse)
    (hVb : ConformalBlockDiagonal V row coarse) :
    ConformalBlockDiagonal (inverseReductionLeft D U V) row coarse ∧
      ConformalBlockDiagonal (inverseReductionRight D U V) coarse row ∧
      ConformalBlockDiagonal (inverseReductionRemainder D U V) row row

name: NLAlib.inverseReduction_projection_idempotent
statement:
theorem inverseReduction_projection_idempotent (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det) :
    IsIdempotentElem (D⁻¹ * U * (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹ * Vᴴ)

name: NLAlib.inverse_add_mul_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem inverse_add_mul_mul_conjTranspose (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (C : Matrix k k K) (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det)
    (hS : IsUnit (C + (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹).det) :
    (D + U * C * Vᴴ)⁻¹ = inverseReductionLeft D U V *
      (C + (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹)⁻¹ * inverseReductionRight D U V +
        inverseReductionRemainder D U V

name: NLAlib.isUnit_add_mul_mul_conjTranspose_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_add_mul_mul_conjTranspose_iff (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (C : Matrix k k K) (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det) :
    IsUnit (D + U * C * Vᴴ) ↔ IsUnit (C + (inverseReductionCore D U V)⁻¹)

name: NLAlib.rank_inverseReductionRemainder
statement:
theorem rank_inverseReductionRemainder (D : Matrix n n K) (U V : Matrix n k K)
    (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hM : IsUnit (inverseReductionCore D U V).det) :
    (inverseReductionRemainder D U V).rank = Fintype.card n - Fintype.card k

name: NLAlib.det_cauchyMatrix_eq_prod_differences
statement:
theorem det_cauchyMatrix_eq_prod_differences {n : ℕ} (x y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hDen : ∀ i j, x i + y j ≠ 0) :
    (cauchyMatrix x y).det =
      (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (x j - x i)) *
        (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (y j - y i)) /
          (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j : Fin n, (x i + y j))

name: NLAlib.det_cauchyMatrix_eq_vandermonde
statement:
theorem det_cauchyMatrix_eq_vandermonde {n : ℕ} (x y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hDen : ∀ i j, x i + y j ≠ 0) :
    (cauchyMatrix x y).det = (Matrix.vandermonde x).det * (Matrix.vandermonde y).det /
      (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j : Fin n, (x i + y j))

name: NLAlib.det_cauchyMatrix_pos_of_strictMono
statement:
theorem det_cauchyMatrix_pos_of_strictMono {n : ℕ} (x y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : StrictMono x) (hy : StrictMono y) (hDen : ∀ i j, 0 < x i + y j) :
    0 < (cauchyMatrix x y).det

name: NLAlib.det_cauchyMatrix_succ
statement:
theorem det_cauchyMatrix_succ {n : ℕ} (x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hDen : ∀ i j, x i + y j ≠ 0) :
    (cauchyMatrix x y).det = 1 / (x 0 + y 0) *
      (∏ i : Fin n, (x i.succ - x 0) / (x i.succ + y 0)) *
      (∏ j : Fin n, (y j.succ - y 0) / (x 0 + y j.succ)) *
      (cauchyMatrix (fun i : Fin n => x i.succ) (fun j : Fin n => y j.succ)).det

name: NLAlib.det_hilbertMatrix_pos
statement: theorem det_hilbertMatrix_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < (hilbertMatrix n).det

name: NLAlib.hilbertMatrix_eq_cauchyMatrix
statement:
theorem hilbertMatrix_eq_cauchyMatrix (n : ℕ) :
    hilbertMatrix n = cauchyMatrix (fun i : Fin n => (i.val : ℝ) + 1)
      (fun j : Fin n => (j.val : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.det_cauchyMatrix_eq_vandermonde_fintype
statement:
theorem det_cauchyMatrix_eq_vandermonde_fintype {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (x y : n → ℝ) (hDen : ∀ i j, x i + y j ≠ 0) :
    (cauchyMatrix x y).det =
      (Matrix.vandermonde (x ∘ (Fintype.equivFin n).symm)).det *
        (Matrix.vandermonde (y ∘ (Fintype.equivFin n).symm)).det /
          (∏ i : n, ∏ j : n, (x i + y j))

name: NLAlib.commute_cyclicShift_iff_exists_circulant
statement:
theorem commute_cyclicShift_iff_exists_circulant {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    A * cyclicShiftMatrix n = cyclicShiftMatrix n * A ↔
      ∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, A = Matrix.circulant v

name: NLAlib.eq_circulant_of_commute_cyclicShift
statement:
theorem eq_circulant_of_commute_cyclicShift {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A * cyclicShiftMatrix n = cyclicShiftMatrix n * A) :
    A = Matrix.circulant (fun i => A i 0)

name: NLAlib.exists_circulant_iff_toeplitz_and_commute
statement:
theorem exists_circulant_iff_toeplitz_and_commute {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (∃ v : Fin n → ℝ, A = Matrix.circulant v) ↔
      (∃ t : ℤ → ℝ, A = toeplitzMatrix t) ∧
        A * cyclicShiftMatrix n = cyclicShiftMatrix n * A

name: NLAlib.exists_toeplitzMatrix_eq_circulant
statement:
theorem exists_toeplitzMatrix_eq_circulant {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∃ t : ℤ → ℝ, toeplitzMatrix t = Matrix.circulant v

name: NLAlib.exists_toeplitz_circulant_of_empty
statement:
theorem exists_toeplitz_circulant_of_empty (A : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 0) ℝ) :
    (∃ t : ℤ → ℝ, A = toeplitzMatrix t) ∧
      (∃ v : Fin 0 → ℝ, A = Matrix.circulant v)

name: NLAlib.displacementRank_le_iff_exists_generators
statement:
theorem displacementRank_le_iff_exists_generators {K m n : Type*} [RCLike K]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix n n K) (X : Matrix m n K) (r : ℕ) :
    displacementRank A B X ≤ r ↔
      ∃ (M : Matrix m (Fin r) K) (N : Matrix n (Fin r) K), A * X - X * B = M * Nᴴ

name: NLAlib.exists_eq_kronecker_one_of_ensemble_entry_invariant
statement:
theorem exists_eq_kronecker_one_of_ensemble_entry_invariant
    {𝕜 d n : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [CharZero 𝕜] [DecidableEq n]
    (M : Matrix (d × n) (d × n) 𝕜)
    (hperm : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm n) (a b : d) (r s : n),
      M (a,σ r) (b,σ s) = M (a,r) (b,s))
    (hflip : ∀ (t : n) (a b : d) (r s : n),
      M (a,r) (b,s) = (if r=t then (-1 : 𝕜) else 1)*M (a,r) (b,s)*
        (if s=t then (-1 : 𝕜) else 1)) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix d d 𝕜, M = Q⊗ₖ(1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation_apply [Fintype G]
    (h : G) (f : EuclideanSpace ℂ G) (g : G) :
    finiteGroupLeftRegularL2Representation h f g = f (h⁻¹ * g)

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupLeftRegularRepresentation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteGroupLeftRegularRepresentation_apply (h : G) (f : G → ℂ) (g : G) :

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupNormalizedBlock_apply
statement:
theorem finiteGroupNormalizedBlock_apply
    (ρ : ∀ p, Representation ℂ G (D p → ℂ)) (z : G → ℂ)
    (p : P) (a b : D p) :
    finiteGroupNormalizedBlock ρ z p a b =
      (finiteGroupCoefficientTransform ρ *ᵥ z) ⟨p, a, b⟩

name: NLAlib.sqrt_card_div_smul_finiteGroupNormalizedBlock
statement:
theorem sqrt_card_div_smul_finiteGroupNormalizedBlock
    [∀ p, Nonempty (D p)] (ρ : ∀ p, Representation ℂ G (D p → ℂ))
    (z : G → ℂ) (p : P) :
    Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card G : ℝ) / Fintype.card (D p)) •
      finiteGroupNormalizedBlock ρ z p = finiteGroupRepresentationBlock ρ z p

name: NLAlib.finiteGroupCoefficientTransform_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem finiteGroupCoefficientTransform_mul_conjTranspose

name: Matrix.eval_det_mvPolynomialX_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem eval_det_mvPolynomialX_mul_transpose (p m : ℕ) (G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun ab : Fin p × Fin m => G ab.1 ab.2)
      (mvPolynomialX (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ * (mvPolynomialX (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ)ᵀ).det
      = (G * Gᵀ).det

name: Matrix.eval_det_transpose_mvPolynomialX_mul
statement:
theorem eval_det_transpose_mvPolynomialX_mul (p m : ℕ) (G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ) :

      ((mvPolynomialX (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ)ᵀ * mvPolynomialX (Fin p) (Fin m) ℝ).det

name: Matrix.volume_det_mul_transpose_eq_zero

name: Matrix.volume_det_transpose_mul_eq_zero

      ((of fun i j => x (i, j))ᵀ * (of fun i j => x (i, j))).det = 0} = 0

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.degree_lower_le
statement: theorem degree_lower_le (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) : (a.lower i).degree ≤ a.degree

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.degree_raise
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_raise (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) (h : a.degree < p) :
    (raise a i h).degree = a.degree + 1

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.degree_raiseNext
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_raiseNext (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) :
    (a.raiseNext i).degree = a.degree + 1

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.degree_vacuum
statement: @[simp] theorem degree_vacuum : (vacuum : HermiteIndex ι p).degree = 0

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.embed_injective
statement:
theorem embed_injective {q : ℕ} (h : p ≤ q) :

statement:
@[simp] theorem embed_val {q : ℕ} (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (h : p ≤ q) (i : ι) :
    (a.embed h).val i = a.val i

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.lower_raise
statement:
@[simp] theorem lower_raise (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) (h : a.degree < p) :

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.lower_raise_of_ne
statement:
theorem lower_raise_of_ne (a : HermiteIndex ι p) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (h : a.degree < p) (h' : (a.lower i).degree < p) :
    (a.raise j h).lower i = (a.lower i).raise j h'

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.lower_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem lower_val (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i j : ι) :
    (lower a i).val j = if j = i then a.val i - 1 else a.val j

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.raiseNext_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem raiseNext_val (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i j : ι) :
    (a.raiseNext i).val j = if j = i then a.val i + 1 else a.val j

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.raise_lower
statement:
theorem raise_lower (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι) (hi : 0 < a.val i)
    (h : (lower a i).degree < p) : raise (lower a i) i h = a

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.raise_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem raise_val (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i j : ι) (h : a.degree < p) :
    (raise a i h).val j = if j = i then a.val i + 1 else a.val j

name: NLAlib.HermiteIndex.vacuum_val
statement: @[simp] theorem vacuum_val (i : ι) : (vacuum : HermiteIndex ι p).val i = 0

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_apply
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_apply (i : ι) (a b : HermiteIndex ι p) :
    hermiteCreation p i a b =
      if 0 < a.val i ∧ a.lower i = b then (Real.sqrt (a.val i) : ℂ) else 0

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_apply_of_lt
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_apply_of_lt (i : ι) (a b : HermiteIndex ι p)
    (hb : b.degree < p) :
    hermiteCreation p i a b =
      if a = b.raise i hb then (Real.sqrt (b.val i + 1) : ℂ) else 0

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_commutator
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_commutator (i j : ι) :
    ((hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ * hermiteCreation p j) * hermiteInterior p =
      ((if i = j then 1 else 0) + hermiteCreation p j * (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) *
        hermiteInterior p

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_commutator_apply
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_commutator_apply (i j : ι) (a b : HermiteIndex ι p)
    (hb : b.degree < p) :
    ((hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ * hermiteCreation p j) a b =
      (if i = j then (1 : Matrix (HermiteIndex ι p) (HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ) a b else 0) +
        (hermiteCreation p j * (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) a b

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_conjTranspose_mulVec
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_conjTranspose_mulVec (i : ι) (z : HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ)
    (a : HermiteIndex ι p) :
    ((hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ *ᵥ z) a =
      if h : a.degree < p then
        (Real.sqrt (a.val i + 1) : ℂ) * z (a.raise i h) else 0

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_mulVec
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_mulVec (i : ι) (z : HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ)
    (a : HermiteIndex ι p) :
    (hermiteCreation p i *ᵥ z) a =
      if 0 < a.val i then (Real.sqrt (a.val i) : ℂ) * z (a.lower i) else 0

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_mul_conjTranspose_self
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_mul_conjTranspose_self (i : ι) :
    hermiteCreation p i * (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ =
      diagonal (fun a : HermiteIndex ι p => (a.val i : ℂ))

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_mul_interior
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_mul_interior (i : ι) :
    hermiteCreation p i * hermiteInterior p = hermiteCreation p i

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_top
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_top (i : ι) (a b : HermiteIndex ι p) (hb : ¬ b.degree < p) :
    hermiteCreation p i a b = 0

name: NLAlib.sum_hermiteCreation_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem sum_hermiteCreation_mul_conjTranspose :
    (∑ i : ι, hermiteCreation p i * (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) = hermiteNumber p

name: NLAlib.hermiteInterior_le_one
statement:
theorem hermiteInterior_le_one :
    hermiteInterior (ι := ι) p ≤ (1 : Matrix (HermiteIndex ι p) (HermiteIndex ι p) ℂ)

name: NLAlib.hermiteInterior_mul_self
statement:
theorem hermiteInterior_mul_self :
    hermiteInterior (ι := ι) p * hermiteInterior p = hermiteInterior p

name: NLAlib.hermiteInterior_number_le
statement:
theorem hermiteInterior_number_le :
    hermiteInterior (ι := ι) p * hermiteNumber p * hermiteInterior p ≤
      ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) • hermiteInterior p

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_hermiteInterior
statement: theorem isHermitian_hermiteInterior : (hermiteInterior (ι := ι) p).IsHermitian

theorem leftRadauCorner_single_last_eq_charpoly_ratio {q : ℕ}

name: NLAlib.lobattoCouplingSq_and_corner_single_last_eq_charpoly_ratio
statement:
theorem lobattoCouplingSq_and_corner_single_last_eq_charpoly_ratio {q : ℕ}
    (J : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) (a c : ℝ)
    (hJa : (J - a • 1).PosDef) (hJc : (c • 1 - J).PosDef) :
    let e : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := Pi.single (Fin.last q) 1
    let r := fun z => (J.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc).charpoly.eval z / J.charpoly.eval z
    lobattoCouplingSq J e a c = (c - a) / (r c - r a) ∧
      lobattoCorner J e a c = a - lobattoCouplingSq J e a c * r a ∧
      lobattoCorner J e a c = c - lobattoCouplingSq J e a c * r c

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even
statement:
theorem abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    |chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * j)| =

name: NLAlib.abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even_eq_sub
statement:
theorem abs_chebyshevCoeff_abs_even_eq_sub (j : ℕ) :
    |chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (2 * (j + 1))| =

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_abs_eq_half_integral
statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_abs_eq_half_integral (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevCoeff (fun x : ℝ => |x|) k =
      (if k = 0 then 1 else 2) / Real.pi * (1 + (-1 : ℝ) ^ k) *
        ∫ θ in 0..Real.pi / 2, Real.cos θ * Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ)

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_abs_even

theorem chebyshevCoeff_abs_even {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :

name: NLAlib.chebyshevCoeff_abs_odd

statement:
theorem integral_cos_mul_cos_even_half_pi {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :

name: NLAlib.abs_absoluteFejerDual_le
statement:
theorem abs_absoluteFejerDual_le {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))

name: NLAlib.absoluteFejerDual_eq_sum
statement:
theorem absoluteFejerDual_eq_sum {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) (K : ℕ) :
    absoluteFejerDual K f = (K + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m ∈ range (K + 1),
      (cuspCosineMoment f (4 * K) + ∑ j ∈ range m,
        (cuspCosineMoment f (4 * K + 2 * (j + 1)) +
          cuspCosineMoment f (4 * K - 2 * (j + 1))))

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_comp_homeomorph_of_affine
statement:
theorem minimaxError_comp_homeomorph_of_affine {s t : Set ℝ}

    (α β : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0) (haff : ∀ x : s, (h x : ℝ) = α * (x : ℝ) + β) :
    minimaxError n (f.comp ⟨h, h.continuous⟩) = minimaxError n f

name: NLAlib.minimaxError_comp_le_of_affine
statement:
theorem minimaxError_comp_le_of_affine {s t : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s] [CompactSpace t]

    minimaxError n (f.comp h) ≤ minimaxError n f

name: NLAlib.exists_abs_sub_eval_ge_of_alternation
statement:
theorem exists_abs_sub_eval_ge_of_alternation {n : ℕ} (f : ℝ → ℝ) {p : ℝ[X]}

      (f (v i.castSucc) - p.eval (v i.castSucc)) *
        (f (v i.succ) - p.eval (v i.succ)) < 0)

statement:
theorem exists_interpolate_eq_of_alternation {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ} (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    {v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v) (hvab : ∀ i, v i ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    (hsign : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      (f (v i.castSucc) - p.eval (v i.castSucc)) *
        (f (v i.succ) - p.eval (v i.succ)) < 0) :
    ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, StrictMono c ∧ (∀ i, c i ∈ Set.Ioo a b) ∧
      (∀ i, f (c i) = p.eval (c i)) ∧
      Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ c (f ∘ c) = p

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_eq_minimaxError_of_equioscillation
statement:
theorem norm_sub_eq_minimaxError_of_equioscillation {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    {n : ℕ} (f : C(s, ℝ)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    {v : Fin (n + 2) → s} (hv : StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)))
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : |σ| = 1)
    (hosc : ∀ i, f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ) =
      σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn s‖) :
    ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn s‖ = minimaxError n f

name: NLAlib.exists_polynomial_extremal_sign_or_alternation
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_extremal_sign_or_alternation (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (e : ℝ → ℝ) (E a b : ℝ), Continuous e → 0 < E → a ≤ b → |e a| = E →
      (∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |e x| = E → 0 < e x * p.eval x) ∧
        (∀ x ≤ a, 0 < e a * p.eval x)) ∨
      (∃ v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ, StrictMono v ∧
        (∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b ∧ |e (v i)| = E) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), e (v i.castSucc) * e (v i.succ) < 0)

    (hfp : ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = minimaxError n f)

theorem exists_alternating_extrema_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hbest : ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = minimaxError n f)
    (hE : 0 < ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖) :
    ∃ v : Fin (n + 2) → Icc a b, StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ i, |f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ)| = ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
        (f (v i.castSucc) - p.eval (v i.castSucc : ℝ)) *
          (f (v i.succ) - p.eval (v i.succ : ℝ)) < 0

name: NLAlib.exists_equioscillation_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_equioscillation_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hbest : ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = minimaxError n f) :
    ∃ (v : Fin (n + 2) → Icc a b) (σ : ℝ),
      StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧ |σ| = 1 ∧
      ∀ i, f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ) =
        σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_eq_minimaxError_iff_equioscillation
statement:
theorem norm_sub_eq_minimaxError_iff_equioscillation {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) :
    ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = minimaxError n f ↔
      ∃ (v : Fin (n + 2) → Icc a b) (σ : ℝ),
        StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧ |σ| = 1 ∧
        ∀ i, f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ) =
          σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖

name: NLAlib.exists_interpolate_eq_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_interpolate_eq_of_norm_sub_eq_minimaxError {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hbest : ‖f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b)‖ = minimaxError n f) :
    ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → Ioo a b, StrictMono (fun i => (c i : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ i, f ⟨c i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (c i).property⟩ = p.eval (c i : ℝ)) ∧
      Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun i => (c i : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.exists_alternating_extrema_of_weighted_norm_sub_minimal
statement:
theorem exists_alternating_extrema_of_weighted_norm_sub_minimal {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f w : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hbest : ∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree ≤ n →
      ‖w * (f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖ ≤
        ‖w * (f - q.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖)
    (hE : 0 < ‖w * (f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖) :
    ∃ v : Fin (n+2) → Icc a b, StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ i, |w (v i) * (f (v i) - p.eval (v i : ℝ))| =
        ‖w * (f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin (n+1), (f (v i.castSucc) - p.eval (v i.castSucc : ℝ)) *
        (f (v i.succ) - p.eval (v i.succ : ℝ)) < 0

    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ n ∧ ∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree ≤ n →
      ‖w * (f - p.toContinuousMapOn s)‖ ≤ ‖w * (f - q.toContinuousMapOn s)‖

statement:
theorem exists_interpolate_eq_of_weighted_norm_sub_minimal {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f w : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n)
    (hbest : ∀ q : ℝ[X], q.degree ≤ n →
      ‖w * (f - p.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖ ≤
        ‖w * (f - q.toContinuousMapOn (Icc a b))‖) :
    ∃ c : Fin (n+1) → Ioo a b, StrictMono (fun i => (c i : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ i, f ⟨c i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (c i).property⟩ = p.eval (c i : ℝ)) ∧
      Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun i => (c i : ℝ))
        (fun i => f ⟨c i, Ioo_subset_Icc_self (c i).property⟩) = p

name: NLAlib.eval_pos_and_derivative_nonneg_of_exp_interpolation
statement:
theorem eval_pos_and_derivative_nonneg_of_exp_interpolation (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (p : ℝ[X]) (_hp : p.degree ≤ n) (v : Fin (n+1) → ℝ), StrictMono v →
      ∀ (A B : ℝ), 0 < A → 0 < B →
        (∀ i, p.eval (v i) = A * Real.exp (B*v i)) →
        ∀ x : ℝ, v (Fin.last n) ≤ x → 0 < p.eval x ∧ 0 ≤ p.derivative.eval x

theorem eval_pos_le_exp_and_derivative_nonneg_of_interpolation {n : ℕ}
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) {v : Fin (n+1) → ℝ} (hv : StrictMono v)
    {a x B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo 0 a)
    (hval : ∀ i, p.eval (v i) = Real.exp (B*v i)) (hx : a ≤ x) :
    0 < p.eval x ∧ p.eval x ≤ Real.exp (B*x) ∧ 0 ≤ p.derivative.eval x

name: NLAlib.laguerreResidual_le_reciprocal_error_truncation_bound

theorem laguerreResidual_le_reciprocal_error_truncation_bound
    {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ n) {a E : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)

statement:
theorem interpolationGapSign_relative {n : ℕ} {v : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ}
    (hv : StrictMono v) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≤ j) (k : Fin (n + 2)) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j.val - i.val) * interpolationGapSign n j k =
      if i.val < k.val ∧ k.val ≤ j.val then -interpolationGapSign n i k
        else interpolationGapSign n i k

statement:
theorem exists_interpolationGapPeak_nondegenerate {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ interiorNodeSimplex n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ∃ τ ∈ Ioo (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ),
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval τ = 0 ∧
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.derivative.eval τ < 0 ∧
      1 < (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval τ ∧
      interpolationGapPeak n t i = (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval τ ∧

    τ ∈ Ioo (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ) ∧
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval τ = 0 ∧
      (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.derivative.eval τ < 0 ∧
      1 < (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval τ ∧
      interpolationGapPeak n t i = (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).eval τ ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Ioo (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.castSucc) (canonicalIntervalNodes n t i.succ),
        (interpolationGapPolynomial n t i).derivative.eval y = 0 → y = τ)

      sin (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * π / N) /
        ((N : ℝ) * |cos ((k : ℝ) * π / N) - chebyshevZero N j|)

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_chebyshevZero_gap_logarithmic_lower_lt

name: NLAlib.IsGreedyOddMinimax.composition_error_le
statement:
theorem IsGreedyOddMinimax.composition_error_le {q : ℕ} {ell : ℝ}
    {c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {l u : ℕ → ℝ} (h : IsGreedyOddMinimax q ell c l u)
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hell1 : ell ≤ 1) {T : ℕ} (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc ell 1) :
    |1 - oddScalarComposition q c x T| ≤ 1 - l T ∧
      1 - l T ≤ (1 - ell ^ 2) ^ ((q + 1) ^ T)

name: NLAlib.IsGreedyOddMinimax.squared_ratio_gap_le
statement:
theorem IsGreedyOddMinimax.squared_ratio_gap_le {q : ℕ} {ell : ℝ}

theorem IsGreedyOddMinimax.uniform_error_le {q : ℕ} {ell : ℝ}

    (hell : 0 < ell) (hell1 : ell ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.IsOddMinimaxOn.squared_ratio_contraction
statement:
theorem IsOddMinimaxOn.squared_ratio_contraction {q : ℕ} {c : ℕ → ℝ} {a b m M : ℝ}
    (h : IsOddMinimaxOn q c a b) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hbounds : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, m ≤ oddScalarUpdate q c x ∧ oddScalarUpdate q c x ≤ M)
    (hm : ∃ x ∈ Icc a b, oddScalarUpdate q c x = m)
    (hM : ∃ x ∈ Icc a b, oddScalarUpdate q c x = M) :
    1 - (m / M) ^ 2 ≤ (1 - (a / b) ^ 2) ^ (q + 1) ∧
      oddUniformError q c a b ≤ (1 - (a / b) ^ 2) ^ (q + 1)

name: NLAlib.exists_denominator_ne_zero_of_cross_error_le
statement:
theorem exists_denominator_ne_zero_of_cross_error_le {a b E : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (p q : ℝ[X]) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (herror : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |f x * q.eval x - p.eval x| ≤ E * |q.eval x|) :
    ∃ P Q : ℝ[X], P.degree ≤ p.degree ∧ Q.degree ≤ q.degree ∧ q * P = p * Q ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, Q.eval x ≠ 0 ∧
        |f x * Q.eval x - P.eval x| ≤ E * |Q.eval x|

name: NLAlib.exists_cross_error_le_of_forall_pos
statement:
theorem exists_cross_error_le_of_forall_pos {m n : ℕ} {a b E : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f)
    (happrox : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ p q : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ m ∧ q.degree ≤ n ∧ q ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |f x * q.eval x - p.eval x| ≤ (E + ε) * |q.eval x|) :
    ∃ P Q : ℝ[X], P.degree ≤ m ∧ Q.degree ≤ n ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, Q.eval x ≠ 0 ∧
        |f x * Q.eval x - P.eval x| ≤ E * |Q.eval x|

name: NLAlib.exists_abs_sub_rationalContinuousMap_ge_of_alternation
statement:
theorem exists_abs_sub_rationalContinuousMap_ge_of_alternation {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ} (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r)
    {v : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2) → Icc a b}
    (hv : StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)))
    (hsign : ∀ i : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 1),
      (f (v i.castSucc) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.castSucc)) *
        (f (v i.succ) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.succ)) < 0)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : ∀ i, ε ≤ |f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i)|)
    (u : RatFunc ℝ) (hu : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n u) :
    ∃ i, ε ≤ |f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2 (v i)|

name: NLAlib.exists_pos_rational_perturbation_error_lt
statement:
theorem exists_pos_rational_perturbation_error_lt {s : Set ℝ} [CompactSpace s]
    (f : C(s, ℝ)) (p q P Q : ℝ[X])
    (hq : ∀ x : s, q.eval (x : ℝ) ≠ 0) {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 < E)
    (hbound : ∀ x : s, |f x - p.eval (x : ℝ) / q.eval (x : ℝ)| ≤ E)
    (hsign : ∀ x : s, |f x - p.eval (x : ℝ) / q.eval (x : ℝ)| = E →
      0 < (f x - p.eval (x : ℝ) / q.eval (x : ℝ)) * (P * q - p * Q).eval (x : ℝ)) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ ∀ x : s,
      (q + t • Q).eval (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 ∧
      |f x - (p + t • P).eval (x : ℝ) / (q + t • Q).eval (x : ℝ)| < E

name: NLAlib.exists_alternating_extrema_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_alternating_extrema_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ} (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r)
    (hbest : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f)
    (hE : 0 < ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖) :
    ∃ v : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2) → Icc a b,
      StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ i, |f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i)| =
        ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 1),
        (f (v i.castSucc) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.castSucc)) *
          (f (v i.succ) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i.succ)) < 0

name: NLAlib.exists_equioscillation_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError
statement:
theorem exists_equioscillation_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ} (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r)
    (hbest : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f) :
    ∃ (v : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2) → Icc a b) (σ : ℝ),
      StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧ |σ| = 1 ∧
      ∀ i, f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i) =
        σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖

name: NLAlib.exists_rational_direction
statement:
theorem exists_rational_direction {s : Set ℝ} {m n : ℕ} (r : RatFunc ℝ)

    ∃ P Q : ℝ[X], P.degree ≤ m ∧ Q.degree ≤ n ∧ P * r.denom - r.num * Q = H

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError_iff_equioscillation
statement:
theorem norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError_iff_equioscillation {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ} (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r) :
    ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f ↔
      ∃ (v : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2) → Icc a b) (σ : ℝ),
        StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ)) ∧ |σ| = 1 ∧
        ∀ i, f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i) =
          σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError_of_equioscillation
statement:
theorem norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError_of_equioscillation {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ} (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r)
    {v : Fin (rationalAlternationDegree m n r + 2) → Icc a b}
    (hv : StrictMono (fun i => (v i : ℝ))) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : |σ| = 1)
    (hosc : ∀ i, f (v i) - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2 (v i) =
      σ * (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖) :
    ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f

name: NLAlib.eq_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError
statement:
theorem eq_of_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) {m n : ℕ}
    (f : C(Icc a b, ℝ)) (r u : RatFunc ℝ)
    (hr : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n r)
    (hu : IsPoleFreeRationalApproximation (Icc a b) m n u)
    (hfr : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) r hr.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f)
    (hfu : ‖f - rationalContinuousMap (Icc a b) u hu.2.2‖ = rationalMinimaxError m n f) : r = u

name: NLAlib.exists_unique_norm_sub_eq_rationalMinimaxError
statement:

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolate_node_succ_eq_barycentric
statement:
theorem eval_interpolate_node_succ_eq_barycentric (k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ j ∈ range (k + 2), x ≠ node (k + 1) j) :
    (Lagrange.interpolate (range (k + 2)) (node (k + 1)) f).eval x =
      (∑ j ∈ range (k + 2), (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (if j = 0 ∨ j = k + 1 then 1 / 2 else 1) *
        (x - node (k + 1) j)⁻¹ * f j) /
      (∑ j ∈ range (k + 2), (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (if j = 0 ∨ j = k + 1 then 1 / 2 else 1) *
        (x - node (k + 1) j)⁻¹)

statement:

    Lagrange.nodalWeight (range (k + 2)) (node (k + 1)) j =

name: NLAlib.nodal_node_succ

name: NLAlib.charpoly_colleagueMatrix_of_chebyshev_expansion
statement:
theorem charpoly_colleagueMatrix_of_chebyshev_expansion (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : ℕ → ℝ)

name: NLAlib.colleagueMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem colleagueMatrix_apply (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (j k : Fin p.natDegree) :
    colleagueMatrix p hp j k = (chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp).repr
      (AdjoinRoot.root p * chebyshevQuotientBasis p hp j) k

name: NLAlib.colleagueMatrix_degree_one
statement:
theorem colleagueMatrix_degree_one (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : p = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), a j • T ℝ (j : ℤ))
    (han : a p.natDegree ≠ 0) (hn : p.natDegree = 1) (j k : Fin p.natDegree) :
    colleagueMatrix p hp j k = -a 0 / a 1

name: NLAlib.colleagueMatrix_interior_row
statement:
theorem colleagueMatrix_interior_row (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (j k : Fin p.natDegree) (hj0 : 0 < j.val) (hjn : j.val + 1 < p.natDegree) :
    colleagueMatrix p hp j k = (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      ((if j.val - 1 = k.val then 1 else 0) + (if j.val + 1 = k.val then 1 else 0))

name: NLAlib.colleagueMatrix_last_row
statement:
theorem colleagueMatrix_last_row (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : p = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), a j • T ℝ (j : ℤ))
    (han : a p.natDegree ≠ 0) (hn : 2 ≤ p.natDegree) (k : Fin p.natDegree) :
    colleagueMatrix p hp ⟨p.natDegree - 1, by omega⟩ k =
      (if p.natDegree - 2 = k.val then (1 / 2 : ℝ) else 0) - a k.val / (2 * a p.natDegree)

name: NLAlib.colleagueMatrix_zero_row
statement:
theorem colleagueMatrix_zero_row (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hn : 2 ≤ p.natDegree)

      if k.val = 1 then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.exists_holomorphic_extension_of_geometric_polynomial_approximation
statement:
theorem exists_holomorphic_extension_of_geometric_polynomial_approximation
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {q : ℕ → ℂ[X]} {C ρ : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hq : ∀ n, (q n).degree ≤ n)
    (hE : ∀ n x, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → ‖(q n).eval (x : ℂ) - f x‖ ≤ C / ρ ^ n) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F (x : ℂ) = f x) ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n z => (q n).eval z) F atTop (openBernsteinEllipse ρ)

name: NLAlib.exists_holomorphic_extension_of_polynomial_approximation_limsup
statement:
theorem exists_holomorphic_extension_of_polynomial_approximation_limsup
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {q : ℕ → ℂ[X]} {e : ℕ → ℝ} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hq : ∀ n, (q n).degree ≤ n) (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n)
    (hE : ∀ n x, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → ‖(q n).eval (x : ℂ) - f x‖ ≤ e n)
    (hlim : limsup (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (e n ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹))) atTop ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ρ⁻¹) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F (x : ℂ) = f x) ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n z => (q n).eval z) F atTop (openBernsteinEllipse ρ)

statement:
theorem exists_holomorphic_extension_of_polynomial_approximation_norm_limsup

    (hq : ∀ n, (q n).degree ≤ n)
    (hlim : limsup (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal
      (‖(⟨fun x : Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 => (q n).eval (x : ℂ), by fun_prop⟩ :
          C(Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ℂ)) - f‖ ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹))) atTop ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ρ⁻¹) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) ∧
      (∀ (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1), F (x : ℂ) = f ⟨x, hx⟩) ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n z => (q n).eval z) F atTop (openBernsteinEllipse ρ)

statement:
theorem exists_holomorphic_extension_of_polynomial_approximation_rates
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {q : ℕ → ℂ[X]} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hq : ∀ n, (q n).degree ≤ n)
    (hE : ∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → s < ρ → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ n x, x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 → ‖(q n).eval (x : ℂ) - f x‖ ≤ C / s ^ n) :
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ) ∧

    (α β c : ℕ → R) (y : ℕ → M)
    (hy : ∀ k, y (k + 2) = α (k + 1) • y (k + 1) - β (k + 1) • y k)
    (k n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range n, c (k + j) • y (k + j)) =
      (clenshawState α β c k n).1 • y k +
      (clenshawState α β c k n).2 • (y (k + 1) - α k • y k)

    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγone : γ < 1) (hε : ε < 1) (hp : p.degree ≤ q)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |p.eval x| ≤ M)
    (herr : ∀ x : ℝ, γ ≤ |x| → |x| ≤ 1 → |p.eval x - Real.sign x| ≤ ε) :
    (1 - ε) * √(1 - γ ^ 2) / γ ≤ (q : ℝ) * M

name: NLAlib.inv_mul_eval_T_le_of_abs_eval_sub_inv_le
statement:
theorem inv_mul_eval_T_le_of_abs_eval_sub_inv_le {a b ε : ℝ} {q : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hp : p.degree < q)
    (herr : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |p.eval x - 1 / x| ≤ ε) :
    1 / (b * (T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) ≤ ε

name: NLAlib.sq_degree_ge_of_abs_eval_sub_exp_neg_le
statement:
theorem sq_degree_ge_of_abs_eval_sub_exp_neg_le {p : ℝ[X]} {q : ℕ} {b δ : ℝ}
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hp : p.degree ≤ q)
    (herr : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 b, |p.eval x - exp (-x)| ≤ δ) :
    (1 - exp (-1) - 2 * δ) * b / (2 * (1 + δ)) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.sqrt_div_six_le_degree_of_abs_eval_sub_exp_neg_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_div_six_le_degree_of_abs_eval_sub_exp_neg_le {p : ℝ[X]} {q : ℕ} {b δ : ℝ}

    (herr : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 b, |p.eval x - exp (-x)| ≤ δ) :

name: NLAlib.sqrt_ratio_pow_div_le_of_abs_eval_sub_inv_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_ratio_pow_div_le_of_abs_eval_sub_inv_le {a b ε : ℝ} {q : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]}

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_resolvent_modulus_approximation
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_resolvent_modulus_approximation {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ Q : Polynomial ℝ, Q.degree ≤ r ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-M) M,
      |‖(z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹‖ - Q.eval x| ≤ 6 * M / ((r : ℝ) * z.im ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_resolvent_modulus_jackson
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_resolvent_modulus_jackson {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im)

    ∃ Q : Polynomial ℝ, Q.degree ≤ r ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-M) M,
      |‖(z - (x : ℂ))⁻¹‖ - Q.eval x| ≤
        Real.pi * M / (2 * (r + 1 : ℝ) * z.im ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.bernsteinIntervalLower_sq_one_add
statement:
theorem bernsteinIntervalLower_sq_one_add {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) :

name: NLAlib.exists_sign_polynomial_abs_sub_eval_le
statement:
theorem exists_sign_polynomial_abs_sub_eval_le {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hγone : γ < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : ℝ[X], q.degree ≤ n ∧
      (X * q.comp (X ^ 2)).degree ≤ ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, γ ≤ |x| → |x| ≤ 1 →
        |Real.sign x - (X * q.comp (X ^ 2)).eval x| ≤
          (4 / (√3 * γ ^ 2)) / (1 + γ) ^ n

name: NLAlib.exists_sign_polynomial_of_bernstein_radius
statement:
theorem exists_sign_polynomial_of_bernstein_radius {γ ρ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hγone : γ < 1) (hρ : 1 < ρ) (hr : ρ < (1 + γ) / (1 - γ)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : ℝ[X], q.degree ≤ n ∧
      (X * q.comp (X ^ 2)).degree ≤ ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, γ ≤ |x| → |x| ≤ 1 →
        |Real.sign x - (X * q.comp (X ^ 2)).eval x| ≤
          2 * (bernsteinIntervalLower (γ ^ 2) 1 ρ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) / ρ ^ n / (ρ - 1)

statement:
theorem chebyshevCoeff_sign_eq_half_integral (k : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.abs_re_sub_eval_chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem abs_re_sub_eval_chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant_le_of_open_ellipse
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) (N : ℕ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :

name: NLAlib.degree_le_and_abs_sub_chebyshev_approximations_le_of_open_ellipse
statement:
theorem degree_le_and_abs_sub_chebyshev_approximations_le_of_open_ellipse
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M)
    (hmatch : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F x = (f x : ℂ)) (N : ℕ) :
    (chebyshevAnalyticTrunc F N).degree ≤ N ∧ (chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant F N).degree ≤ N ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
        |f x - (chebyshevAnalyticTrunc F N).eval x| ≤ 2 * M / ρ ^ N / (ρ - 1) ∧
        |f x - (chebyshevAnalyticInterpolant F N).eval x| ≤ 4 * M / ρ ^ N / (ρ - 1)

theorem hasSum_chebyshevAnalyticCoeff_mul_eval_interpolate_T_of_open_ellipse

name: NLAlib.eval_interpolate_eq_circleIntegral
statement:
theorem eval_interpolate_eq_circleIntegral {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → ℂ) (hv : Set.InjOn v s) {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c x : ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball c R))
    (hvR : ∀ i ∈ s, v i ∈ Metric.ball c R) (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R) :
    (Lagrange.interpolate s v (f ∘ v)).eval x = (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      ∮ t in C(c, R), f t *
        (((Lagrange.nodal s v).eval t - (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x) /
          ((Lagrange.nodal s v).eval t * (t - x)))

name: NLAlib.nodal_resolvent_eq_sum_basis_div
statement:
theorem nodal_resolvent_eq_sum_basis_div {F : Type*} [Field F] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → F) (hv : Set.InjOn v s) {t x : F}
    (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, t ≠ v i) (hx : t ≠ x) :
    ((Lagrange.nodal s v).eval t - (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x) /
      ((Lagrange.nodal s v).eval t * (t - x)) =
        ∑ i ∈ s, (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval x / (t - v i)

name: NLAlib.sub_eval_interpolate_eq_circleIntegral
statement:
theorem sub_eval_interpolate_eq_circleIntegral {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → ℂ) (hv : Set.InjOn v s) {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c x : ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hf : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball c R))
    (hvR : ∀ i ∈ s, v i ∈ Metric.ball c R) (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R) :
    f x - (Lagrange.interpolate s v (f ∘ v)).eval x =
      (Lagrange.nodal s v).eval x * (2 * Real.pi * I : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        ∮ t in C(c, R), f t / ((Lagrange.nodal s v).eval t * (t - x))

theorem orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients_eq_of_moments_eq

    orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients L n = orthogonalPolynomialCoefficients M n

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_functional_polynomial
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_functional_polynomial
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ}
    {p : ℝ → ℝ[X]} {p' : ℝ[X]} {x : ℝ} {d : ℕ}
    (hp : ∀ y, (p y).degree < d) (hp' : p'.degree < d)
    (hc : HasCoeffDerivAt p p' x)
    (hL : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (p y)) (D (p x) + L x p') x

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_orthogonalPolynomialNorm
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L y) n)
      (D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n ^ 2)) x

name: NLAlib.hasPolynomialDerivAt_monicOrthogonalPolynomial
statement:
theorem hasPolynomialDerivAt_monicOrthogonalPolynomial

    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0) :
    HasCoeffDerivAt (fun y => monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L y) n)
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv L n x) x

name: NLAlib.functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_mul_eq_neg
statement:
theorem functional_monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_mul_eq_neg
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0) {q : ℝ[X]} (hq : q.degree < n) :
    L x (monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv L n x * q) =
      -D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n * q)

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_eq_sum
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv_eq_sum
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet (L x) k ≠ 0)
    (hh : ∀ k < n, orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) k ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomialDeriv L n x =
      -∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        (D (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) n * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) i) /
          orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) i) • monicOrthogonalPolynomial (L x) i

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
    {L : ℝ → (ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)} {D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ k, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) x)
    (hD : ∀ k, HasDerivAt (fun y => L y (X ^ k)) (D (X ^ k)) x)
    (hn : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet (L x) k ≠ 0)
    (hh : orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) n ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (L y) n)
      (D (orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial (L x) n)) x

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_affine
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_affine
    (L D : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hh : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (L + t • D) n)
      (D (orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial L n)) 0

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial_eq_adjacent
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial_eq_adjacent
    (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : ∀ k ≤ n + 1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hh : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n ≠ 0)
    (hprev : n ≠ 0 → orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n - 1) ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlphaSensitivityPolynomial L n =
      C (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L n)⁻¹ *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)) -
      if n = 0 then 0 else C (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L (n - 1))⁻¹ *
        (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n - 1) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n)

name: NLAlib.eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_weight_div
statement:
theorem eval_map_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_weight_div
    [Infinite 𝕜] {𝕜' : Type*} [Field 𝕜'] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (f : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜') (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (v w : ι → 𝕜)
    (hv : ∀ i, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval (v i) = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree < n → L p = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {z : 𝕜'} (hz : ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).map f).eval z ≠ 0)
    (hzv : ∀ i, z ≠ f (v i)) :
    ((secondKindPolynomial L n).map f).eval z /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).map f).eval z =
      ∑ i, f (w i) / (z - f (v i))

name: NLAlib.eval_secondKindPolynomial_at_node
statement:
theorem eval_secondKindPolynomial_at_node
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (v w : ι → 𝕜) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hroot : ∀ i, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval (v i) = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree < n → L p = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i)) (i : ι) :
    (secondKindPolynomial L n).eval (v i) =
      w i * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).derivative.eval (v i)

name: NLAlib.eval_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_weight_div
statement:
theorem eval_secondKindPolynomial_div_eq_sum_weight_div
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (v w : ι → 𝕜)
    (hv : ∀ i, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval (v i) = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree < n → L p = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {z : 𝕜} (hz : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0)
    (hzv : ∀ i, z ≠ v i) :
    (secondKindPolynomial L n).eval z / (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z =
      ∑ i, w i / (z - v i)

name: NLAlib.eval_secondKindPolynomial_eq_functional_dividedDifference
statement:
theorem eval_secondKindPolynomial_eq_functional_dividedDifference
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (z : 𝕜) :

theorem natDegree_secondKindPolynomial_le (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.secondKindPolynomial_add_two
statement:
theorem secondKindPolynomial_add_two (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) :
    secondKindPolynomial L (n + 2) =
      (X - C (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L (n + 1))) * secondKindPolynomial L (n + 1) -
        C (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n + 1)) * secondKindPolynomial L n

name: NLAlib.secondKindPolynomial_eq_sum_weight_mul_dividedDifference
statement:
theorem secondKindPolynomial_eq_sum_weight_mul_dividedDifference
    [Infinite 𝕜] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0) (v w : ι → 𝕜)
    (hexact : ∀ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree < n → L p = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i)) :
    secondKindPolynomial L n =
      ∑ i, C (w i) * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).dividedDifference (v i)

statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_orthogonalRecurrenceBeta

    (hn : hankelMomentDet (L x) n ≠ 0)

    (hh : orthogonalPolynomialNorm (L x) n ≠ 0)

name: NLAlib.X_sub_C_mul_christoffelPolynomial
statement:
theorem X_sub_C_mul_christoffelPolynomial (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) :
    (X - C z) * christoffelPolynomial L z n =
      monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1) -
        C ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n + 1)).eval z /

theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C

name: NLAlib.orthogonalPolynomialNorm_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem orthogonalPolynomialNorm_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
    (L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (n : ℕ) {z : 𝕜}

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_add_christoffelQuotient_christoffelElimination
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_add_christoffelQuotient_christoffelElimination
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (hL : QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional L) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : ∀ n, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L n = z + christoffelQuotient L z n +
      (if n = 0 then 0 else christoffelElimination L z (n - 1))

theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C

    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X - C z)) n =
      z + christoffelQuotient L z n + christoffelElimination L z n

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C

    (hz : ∀ n, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X - C z)) n =

name: NLAlib.christoffelPolynomial_eq_C_mul_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial
statement:
theorem christoffelPolynomial_eq_C_mul_monicOrthogonalKernelPolynomial

statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_add_christoffelQuotient_christoffelElimination_of_finite
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {n : ℕ} {z : 𝕜}

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_of_finite
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_of_finite
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {n : ℕ} {z : 𝕜}
    (hL : ∀ k ≤ n+1, hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0)
    (hz : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0)
    (hsucc : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n+1)).eval z ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z)) n =
      z + christoffelQuotient L z n + christoffelElimination L z n

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_of_finite
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C_of_finite

    (hz : ∀ k ≤ n+1, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval z ≠ 0) :

      christoffelQuotient L z n * christoffelElimination L z (n-1)

name: NLAlib.monicJacobiMatrix_christoffel_eq_reversed_factors_add_boundary
statement:
theorem monicJacobiMatrix_christoffel_eq_reversed_factors_add_boundary
    {L : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} (hL : QuasiDefinitePolynomialFunctional L) {z : 𝕜}
    (hz : ∀ n, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval z ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    monicJacobiMatrix n
        (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z)))
        (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (polynomialWeightedFunctional L (X-C z))) =
      darbouxUpperMatrix n (christoffelQuotient L z) *
        darbouxLowerMatrix n (christoffelElimination L z) + z • 1 +
          christoffelElimination L z (n-1) • terminalCoordinateMatrix n

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationConstraint_apply

    rationalModificationConstraint T u n i P =

statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationSmallBorderMatrix_eq
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u v : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)

statement:
theorem mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_small_expansion
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u v : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ}

      C u.leadingCoeff * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (u.natDegree+n) -

statement:
theorem hankelMomentDet_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_ne_zero
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (u v : ℝ[X]) (hdiv : HasDividedPolynomialMoments μ v)
    (hpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < u.eval x/v.eval x) {n : ℕ}
    (hs : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v)
      (hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v hdiv
        (hpos.mono fun _ h => h.le))) n ≠ 0

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq_det_div
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure_eq_det_div
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (u v : ℝ[X]) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hv0 : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, v.eval x ≠ 0)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 < u.eval x/v.eval x) {n : ℕ}
    (hcard : ((u.natDegree+n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let hμ := hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    let hdiv := hasDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hv0
    let hpa : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval x/v.eval x := hs.mono fun x hx => (hpos x hx).le
    let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v hdiv hpa
    let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    let T := dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv
    let D := rationalModificationSmallFirstRowMatrix L T u v n
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) hν) n =
      ((u.leadingCoeff / D.det.coeff (u.natDegree+n)) • D.det) / u ∧
      D.det.coeff (u.natDegree+n) ≠ 0

statement:
theorem eq_sum_C_mul_rootCofactor (z : Fin m → 𝕜) (hz : Function.Injective z)

theorem rationalModification_root_constraints_iff (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)

    (hz : ∀ᵐ (t : ℝ) ∂μ, ∀ i, (t : ℂ) ≠ z i) (p : ℂ[X]) (i : Fin m) :
    complexDividedPolynomialIntegral μ (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z) hdiv (p*rootCofactor z i) =

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_divisorModification
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_divisorModification
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {v : 𝕜[X]} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v * p) = L p) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0) (hn : hankelMomentDet T n ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial T n = monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n +
      ∑ j : Fin (min n v.natDegree), C (divisorModificationCoefficients L T v n j) *
        monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n - v.natDegree + j.val)

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_linearDivisor

theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_linearDivisor

    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ} (hsize : min n v.natDegree = 1)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0) (hn : hankelMomentDet T n ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial T n = monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n +
      C (linearDivisorCoefficient L T v n) * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-1)

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_quadraticDivisor

theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_quadraticDivisor
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {v : 𝕜[X]} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ} (hsize : min n v.natDegree = 2)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0) (hn : hankelMomentDet T n ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial T n = monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n +
      C (quadraticDivisorCoefficients L T v n).1 * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-1) +
      C (quadraticDivisorCoefficients L T v n).2 * monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n-2)

        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z‖ ≤
      orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n /
        (δ * ‖((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map
          Complex.ofRealHom).eval z‖^2)

statement:
theorem orthogonalMixedMoment_succ (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℝ[X])
    (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k l : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ k + 1, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hp : X * p l = p (l + 1) + C (a l) * p l +
      if l = 0 then 0 else C (b l) * p (l - 1)) :
    orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k + 1) l = orthogonalMixedMoment L p k (l + 1) +
      (a l - orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L k) * orthogonalMixedMoment L p k l -
      orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k * orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k - 1) l +
      if l = 0 then 0 else b l * orthogonalMixedMoment L p k (l - 1)

theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_mixed_ratio {L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {p : ℕ → ℝ[X]}
    {a b : ℕ → ℝ} {n k : ℕ} (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef)
    (hk : k < n) (hk0 : k ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ j, (p j).Monic)
    (hdeg : ∀ j, (p j).natDegree = j)
    (hrec : X * p k = p (k + 1) + C (a k) * p k +
      if k = 0 then 0 else C (b k) * p (k - 1)) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L k = a k +
      orthogonalMixedMoment L p k (k + 1) / orthogonalMixedMoment L p k k -
      orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k - 1) k / orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k - 1) (k - 1)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_zero_eq_modified_moments
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_zero_eq_modified_moments {L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ}
    {p : ℕ → ℝ[X]} {a : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hp0 : p 0 = 1) (hrec : X * p 0 = p 1 + C a * p 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L 0 = a + L (p 1) / L (p 0)

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_eq_mixed_ratio
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_eq_mixed_ratio {L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {p : ℕ → ℝ[X]}
    {n k : ℕ} (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef) (hk : k < n) (hk0 : k ≠ 0)
    (hp : ∀ j, (p j).Monic) (hdeg : ∀ j, (p j).natDegree = j) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k =
      orthogonalMixedMoment L p k k / orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k - 1) (k - 1)

name: NLAlib.modifiedChebyshevCoefficients_eq
statement:
theorem modifiedChebyshevCoefficients_eq (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℝ[X])
    (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef)
    (hp : ∀ j, (p j).Monic) (hdeg : ∀ j, (p j).natDegree = j)
    (hrec : ∀ j, X * p j = p (j + 1) + C (a j) * p j +
      if j = 0 then 0 else C (b j) * p (j - 1)) (k : Fin n) :
    modifiedChebyshevCoefficients a b (fun i : Fin (2 * n) => L (p i)) k =
      (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L k,
        if (k : ℕ) = 0 then L (p 0) else orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k)

name: NLAlib.modifiedChebyshevState_correct
statement:
theorem modifiedChebyshevState_correct (L : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℝ[X])
    (a b m : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hL : (hankelMomentMatrix L n).PosDef)
    (hp : ∀ j, (p j).Monic) (hdeg : ∀ j, (p j).natDegree = j)
    (hrec : ∀ j, X * p j = p (j + 1) + C (a j) * p j +
      if j = 0 then 0 else C (b j) * p (j - 1))
    (hm : ∀ l < 2 * n, m l = L (p l)) :
    ∀ k < n,
      (∀ l, k + l < 2 * n →
        (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).row l = orthogonalMixedMoment L p k l) ∧
      (∀ l, k + l < 2 * n →
        (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).prev l =
          if k = 0 then 0 else orthogonalMixedMoment L p (k - 1) l) ∧
      (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).alpha = orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L k ∧
      (modifiedChebyshevState a b m k).beta =
        if k = 0 then L (p 0) else orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L k

name: NLAlib.modifiedChebyshevCoefficients_integral_eq
NLAlib.modifiedChebyshevCoefficients_integral_formula
statement:
theorem modifiedChebyshevCoefficients_integral_formula {μ : Measure ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hμ : ∀ j < 2 * n, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ j) μ)
    (hs : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (p : ℕ → ℝ[X]) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ j, (p j).Monic) (hdeg : ∀ j, (p j).natDegree = j)
    (hrec : ∀ j, X * p j = p (j + 1) + C (a j) * p j +
      if j = 0 then 0 else C (b j) * p (j - 1)) (k : Fin n) :
    let π := monicOrthogonalPolynomial (finiteMeasureMomentFunctional μ n)
    modifiedChebyshevCoefficients a b (fun i : Fin (2 * n) => ∫ x, (p i).eval x ∂μ) k =
      ((∫ x, x * (π k).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) / (∫ x, (π k).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ),
        if (k : ℕ) = 0 then ∫ _, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ else
          (∫ x, (π k).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) / (∫ x, (π (k - 1)).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ))

statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix_nonmonic
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u v : 𝕜[X]} {cu cv : 𝕜}
    (hcu : cu ≠ 0) (hcv : cv ≠ 0) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (z : Fin m → 𝕜)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hu : u = C cu * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)
    (hv : v = C cv * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z)
    (hTv : ∀ p, T (v*p) = L p) {n : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ n)
    (hL : ∀ j ≤ l+n, hankelMomentDet L j ≠ 0)
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    let D := rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix L (cv • T) x z n
    let c := (-1 : 𝕜)^(l+m) * (rationalModificationRootMatrix L (cv • T) x z n).det / cu
    D.det = C c * u * monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ∧ c ≠ 0

name: NLAlib.polynomialWeightedFunctional_smul_nodal
statement:
theorem polynomialWeightedFunctional_smul_nodal
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} {cu : 𝕜} (hcu : cu ≠ 0)
    (cv : 𝕜) (x : Fin l → 𝕜) (hu : u = C cu * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x) :
    polynomialWeightedFunctional (cv • T) (Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x) =
      (cv/cu) • polynomialWeightedFunctional T u

name: NLAlib.smul_dividedFunctional_nodal_mul

theorem smul_dividedFunctional_nodal_mul
    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {v : 𝕜[X]} {cv : 𝕜} (z : Fin m → 𝕜)

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationAuxiliaryFirstRowMatrix_nonmonic
statement:

    (L T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} {cu cv : 𝕜}

name: NLAlib.exists_det_auxiliaryFirstRow_eq_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure
statement:
theorem exists_det_auxiliaryFirstRow_eq_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, t ∈ Icc a b) (u v : ℝ[X]) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hv0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, v.eval t ≠ 0)
    (hpos : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, 0 < u.eval t/v.eval t)
    (x : Fin u.natDegree → ℂ) (z : Fin v.natDegree → ℂ)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hux : u.map Complex.ofRealHom = C (u.leadingCoeff : ℂ)*Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)
    (hvz : v.map Complex.ofRealHom = C (v.leadingCoeff : ℂ)*Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z)
    {n : ℕ} (hm : n ≤ v.natDegree)
    (hcard : ((u.natDegree+n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let hμ := hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    let hr := hasDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hv0
    let hc := hasComplexDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
      (v := v.map Complex.ofRealHom) (by
        intro t ht
        change (v.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom t) ≠ 0
        rw [eval_map_apply]
        exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hv0 t ht))
    let hpa : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval t/v.eval t := hs.mono fun t ht => (hpos t ht).le
    let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v hr hpa
    let L := complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ
    let T := complexDividedPolynomialIntegral μ (v.map Complex.ofRealHom) hc
    ∃ c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧
      (rationalModificationAuxiliaryFirstRowMatrix L ((v.leadingCoeff : ℂ) • T) x z hm).det =
        C c * u.map Complex.ofRealHom *
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) hν) n).map
            Complex.ofRealHom ∧
      ∀ (p : ℂ[X]) (i : Fin v.natDegree),
        ((v.leadingCoeff : ℂ) • T) (p*rootCofactor z i) =
          ∫ t : ℝ, p.eval (t : ℂ)/((t : ℂ)-z i) ∂μ

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_weightedDivided_eq_sub_nextCoeff
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_weightedDivided_eq_sub_nextCoeff
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u v : ℝ[X]) (hdiv : HasDividedPolynomialMoments μ v) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ k ≤ n+1, hankelMomentDet
      (polynomialWeightedFunctional (dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv) u) k ≠ 0) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialWeightedFunctional (dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv) u) n =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional (dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv) u) n).nextCoeff -
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional (dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv) u) (n+1)).nextCoeff

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_weightedDivided_eq_integral_ratio
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_weightedDivided_eq_integral_ratio
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u v : ℝ[X]) (hdiv : HasDividedPolynomialMoments μ v) (n : ℕ) :
    let L := polynomialWeightedFunctional (dividedPolynomialIntegral μ v hdiv) u
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L (n+1) =
      (∫ x, u.eval x * ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L (n+1)).eval x)^2/v.eval x ∂μ) /
        (∫ x, u.eval x * ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial L n).eval x)^2/v.eval x ∂μ)

name: NLAlib.exists_det_rootFirstRow_eq_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure
statement:
theorem exists_det_rootFirstRow_eq_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, t ∈ Icc a b) (u v : ℝ[X]) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hv0 : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, v.eval t ≠ 0)
    (hpos : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, 0 < u.eval t/v.eval t)
    (x : Fin u.natDegree → ℂ) (z : Fin v.natDegree → ℂ)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (hux : u.map Complex.ofRealHom = C (u.leadingCoeff : ℂ) * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ x)
    (hvz : v.map Complex.ofRealHom = C (v.leadingCoeff : ℂ) * Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ z)
    {n : ℕ} (hm : v.natDegree ≤ n)
    (hcard : ((u.natDegree+n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let hμ := hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
    let hr := hasDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hv0
    let hc := hasComplexDividedPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hs
      (v := v.map Complex.ofRealHom) (by
        intro t ht
        change (v.map Complex.ofRealHom).eval (Complex.ofRealHom t) ≠ 0
        rw [eval_map_apply]
        exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hv0 t ht))
    let hpa : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, 0 ≤ u.eval t/v.eval t := hs.mono fun t ht => (hpos t ht).le
    let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v hr hpa
    let L := complexPolynomialIntegral μ hμ
    let T := complexDividedPolynomialIntegral μ (v.map Complex.ofRealHom) hc
    ∃ c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧
      (rationalModificationRootFirstRowMatrix L ((v.leadingCoeff : ℂ) • T) x z n).det =
        C c * u.map Complex.ofRealHom *
          (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (rationalPolynomialModifiedMeasure μ u v) hν) n).map
            Complex.ofRealHom

name: NLAlib.C_leadingCoeff_mul_det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix
statement:
theorem C_leadingCoeff_mul_det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}

name: NLAlib.det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix_eq
statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationBorderMatrix_eq
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}

statement:
theorem det_rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_eq

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_rationalModification_det_div
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_rationalModification_det_div
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n =

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_succ_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rationalModificationFirstRowMatrix_succ_apply
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) (u : 𝕜[X]) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (u.natDegree + n)) (j : Fin (u.natDegree + n + 1)) :

name: NLAlib.rationalModificationNumerator_eq_smul_det_firstRowMatrix
statement:
theorem rationalModificationNumerator_eq_smul_det_firstRowMatrix
    (T : 𝕜[X] →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) {u : 𝕜[X]} (hu : u ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : hankelMomentDet (polynomialWeightedFunctional T u) n ≠ 0) :

statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_two_mul_add_one_eq_X_mul_comp_X_sq

    (hk : (2 * k + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :

      X * (monicOrthogonalPolynomial

          (Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2)

statement:
theorem abs_le_power_envelope_of_descFactorial {ν n k : ℕ} {V a : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hnν : ν ≤ n) (hk : n < k)
    (hs : (ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2 < n + 1)
    (ha : |a| ≤ 2 * V / (Real.pi * (k.descFactorial (ν + 1) : ℝ))) :
    |a| ≤ (2 * V / (Real.pi * (1 - ((ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2) / (n + 1)))) /
      (k : ℝ) ^ (ν + 1)

name: NLAlib.bv_stronger_rate_le_eventual_of_quadratureBvThreshold_le

    14 * V / (Real.pi * (1 - ((ν : ℝ) * (ν + 1) / 2) / (n + 1)) * (n : ℝ) ^ (ν + 1)) ≤

theorem tsum_abs_mul_chebyshevMoment_alias_even_tail_le
    {c : ℕ → ℝ} (hcS : Summable (fun k => |c k|)) {n p : ℕ}
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hp : 2 ≤ p) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hc : ∀ k, n < k → |c k| ≤ A / (k : ℝ) ^ p) :
    (∑' j : ℕ, if n < 2 * j then
      |c (2 * j)| * |chebyshevMoment (chebyshevAliasIndex n (2 * j))| else 0) ≤

name: NLAlib.norm_integral_sub_sum_gaussWeights_le_of_polynomial_approx

theorem norm_integral_sub_sum_gaussWeights_le_of_polynomial_approx

    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) {p : ℂ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2*n : ℕ))
    {ε : ℝ} (happrox : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ‖f x - p.eval (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖(∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights μ hμ n i : ℂ) *
      f (gaussNodes μ hμ n i)‖ ≤ 2 * μ.real univ * ε

name: NLAlib.norm_stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_le_geometric
statement:
theorem norm_stieltjesTransform_sub_secondKind_div_le_geometric
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hRI : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, |x| ≤ R) {z : ℂ} (hz : R < ‖z‖) :
    ‖stieltjesTransform μ z -
      ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) n).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z‖ ≤
      2 * μ.real univ * R^(2*n) / (‖z‖^(2*n) * (‖z‖-R))

name: NLAlib.tendsto_secondKindPolynomial_div_stieltjesTransform
statement:
theorem tendsto_secondKindPolynomial_div_stieltjesTransform
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (hinf : μ.support.Infinite) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, z ≠ (x : ℂ)) :
    Tendsto (fun n =>
      ((secondKindPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (n+1)).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z /
        ((monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hμ) (n+1)).map Complex.ofRealHom).eval z)
      atTop (𝓝 (stieltjesTransform μ z))

statement:
theorem integral_eval_eq_endpoint_quadrature_of_modified_orthogonality
    {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {q : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (v : Fin q → ℝ)
    (hv : Function.Injective v) (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ v i)
    (horth : ∀ r : ℝ[X], r.degree < q →
      (∫ x, (x - a) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x * r.eval x ∂μ) = 0)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ)) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i : Fin (q + 1),
      (∫ x, (Lagrange.basis univ (endpointNodeFamily a v) i).eval x ∂μ) *
        p.eval (endpointNodeFamily a v i)

    (horth : ∀ r : ℝ[X], r.degree < q →
      (∫ x, (x - a) * (b - x) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x * r.eval x ∂μ) = 0)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < (2 * q + 2 : ℕ)) :
    (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i : Fin (q + 2),
      (∫ x, (Lagrange.basis univ (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v) i).eval x ∂μ) *
        p.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i)

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_eq
statement:
theorem exists_sub_eval_hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate_eq {q : ℕ}
    {a b x : ℝ} (hab : a < b) {v : Fin q → ℝ} (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 2, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
      f x - (Lagrange.hermiteTwoEndpointInterpolate a b (f a) (f b) v
        (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)).eval x =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f ξ / (2 * q + 2).factorial *
          ((x - a) * (x - b) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_eq
statement:
theorem exists_sub_eval_hermiteEndpointInterpolate_eq {q : ℕ}

    (hv : Function.Injective v) (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b) (htv : ∀ i, t ≠ v i)
    (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
      f x - (Lagrange.hermiteEndpointInterpolate t (f t) v (f ∘ v) (deriv f ∘ v)).eval x =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f ξ / (2 * q + 1).factorial *
          ((x - t) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_endpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_endpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b t : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) (ht : t = a ∨ t = b) {q : ℕ}
    (v : Fin q → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hva : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (endpointNodeFamily t v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
      (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i, w i * f (endpointNodeFamily t v i) =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f ξ / (2 * q + 1).factorial *
          ∫ x, (x - t) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ

name: NLAlib.exists_integral_sub_twoEndpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem exists_integral_sub_twoEndpoint_quadrature_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ}
