      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 2, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f) (Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a b,
      (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i, w i * f (twoEndpointNodeFamily a b v i) =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f ξ / (2 * q + 2).factorial *
          ∫ x, (x - a) * (x - b) * (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_endpoint_quadrature_of_integral_nodal_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_eq_endpoint_quadrature_of_integral_nodal_eq_zero
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b t : ℝ}

name: NLAlib.integral_eq_radau_degree_rule_of_both_endpoints
statement:
theorem integral_eq_radau_degree_rule_of_both_endpoints
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {q : ℕ} (v w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)
    (hv : Function.Injective v) (hvi : ∀ i, v i ∈ Icc a b)
    (hva : a ∈ Set.range v) (hvb : b ∈ Set.range v)

statement:

    (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ) {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c)
    (hμac : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ)
    (hs : (q + 2 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    a • 1 ≤ lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c ∧ lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c ≤ c • 1 ∧
      a ∈ spectrum ℝ (lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c) ∧
      c ∈ spectrum ℝ (lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c)

    let L := polynomialIntegral μ hμ
    a • 1 ≤ leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a ∧
      leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a ≤ orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1) ∧
      orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix L (q + 1) ≤ rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c ∧

    (v : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hvt : t ∈ Set.range v) (hvi : ∀ i, v i ≠ t → v i ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2 * q + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * p.eval (v i))
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a b))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a b)) :

      Function.Injective u ∧ (∀ i, u i ∈ Ioo a b) ∧

          (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∑ i, w i * f (v i) =
            iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f ξ / (2 * q + 1).factorial *
              ∫ x, (x - t) * (Lagrange.nodal univ u).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ

    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hcard : Fintype.card ι = n + 1) (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)

      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x * p.eval x = 0)
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ M : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M) :
    |(∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (F x).re) -
      ∑ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x) * (F (v i)).re| ≤

name: NLAlib.gauss_lebesgue_quadrature_of_orthogonal_nodal
statement:
theorem gauss_lebesgue_quadrature_of_orthogonal_nodal
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {n : ℕ} (hcard : Fintype.card ι = n + 1)
    (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v) (hvI : ∀ i, v i ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (horth : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < Fintype.card ι →
      ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.nodal univ v).eval x * p.eval x = 0) :
    (∀ i, 0 < ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x) ∧
    (∑ i, ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x) = 2 ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ (2 * n + 1 : ℕ) →
      (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, p.eval x) =
        ∑ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x) * p.eval (v i)) ∧
    (∃ σ : ι ≃ ι, (∀ i, v (σ i) = -v i) ∧
      ∀ i, (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v (σ i)).eval x) =
        ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Lagrange.basis univ v i).eval x)

name: NLAlib.polynomial_exactness_iff_rational_exactness

theorem polynomial_exactness_iff_rational_exactness (μ : Measure ℝ) (ω : ℝ[X])
    (hω : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < ω.eval x) {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (v w : ι → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i ∈ s, ω.eval (v i) ≠ 0) (d : ℕ) :
    (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < d →
      (∫ x, p.eval x ∂dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω) = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * p.eval (v i)) ↔
      (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < d →
        (∫ x, p.eval x / ω.eval x ∂μ) =
          ∑ i ∈ s, (w i * ω.eval (v i)) * (p.eval (v i) / ω.eval (v i)))

      ∑ i ∈ s, w i * (p.eval (v i) / ω.eval (v i))) ↔
      (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < d →

    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {ω : ℝ[X]}
    (hω : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 < ω.eval x) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) :
    let ν := dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω
    let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_dividedPolynomialMeasure_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hω
    (∀ i : Fin n, gaussNodes ν hν n i ∈ Icc a b ∧
      0 < gaussWeights ν hν n i * ω.eval (gaussNodes ν hν n i)) ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2*n : ℕ) → (∫ x, p.eval x/ω.eval x ∂μ) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, (gaussWeights ν hν n i * ω.eval (gaussNodes ν hν n i)) *
        (p.eval (gaussNodes ν hν n i)/ω.eval (gaussNodes ν hν n i)))

    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a b) {ω : ℝ[X]}
    (hω : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 < ω.eval x) {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard) (v w : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hexact : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < (2*n : ℕ) → (∫ x, p.eval x/ω.eval x ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, w i * (p.eval (v i)/ω.eval (v i))) :
    let ν := dividedPolynomialMeasure μ ω
    let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_dividedPolynomialMeasure_of_ae_mem_Icc hs hω
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (∀ i, v (e i) = gaussNodes ν hν n i) ∧
      (∀ i, w (e i)/ω.eval (v (e i)) = gaussWeights ν hν n i)

NLAlib.eval_div_linearPoleProduct_eq_partial_fractions
statement:
theorem eval_div_linearPoleProduct_eq_partial_fractions
    (v : ι → 𝕜) (s : ι → ℕ) (q : 𝕜[X])
    (c : (i : ι) → Fin (s i) → 𝕜) {t : 𝕜} (ht : ∀ i, t ≠ v i) :
    (q * linearPoleProduct v s + linearPoleRemainder v s c).eval t /

    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (X : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (ν R : ℝ) (T : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hi : ∀ j ≤ n, ∀ w ∈ insertionWords n j,
      Integrable (fun ω => (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace) μ)
    (hlinear : ∀ w ∈ insertionWords n 1,
      (∫ ω, (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace ∂μ) = 0)
    (hbudget : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → j ≤ n → ∀ w ∈ insertionWords n j,
      (∫ ω, (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace ∂μ) ≤
        (j.factorial : ℝ) / 2 * ν * R ^ (j - 2) * T (n - j)) :
    (∫ ω, ((A + X ω) ^ n).trace ∂μ) ≤ (A ^ n).trace +
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n - 1),

      (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ a * (x ⬝ᵥ x))
    (C : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hC : C.PosSemidef) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ (p + 1)).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ (p + 1)).trace ∂μ) ≤ a * C.trace

statement:
theorem integral_coord_mul_coord [DecidableEq n] {z : Ω → n → ℝ}

    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1) (i j : n) :
    ∫ ω, z ω i * z ω j ∂μ = if i = j then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.integral_coord_mul_coord_mul_coord_mul_coord
statement:
theorem integral_coord_mul_coord_mul_coord_mul_coord [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [DecidableEq n]
    {z : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun i ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    {m₄ : ℝ} (hm4 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 4 ∂μ = m₄) (i j k l : n) :
    ∫ ω, z ω i * z ω j * z ω k * z ω l ∂μ =
      (if i = j then 1 else 0) * (if k = l then 1 else 0) +
      (if i = k then 1 else 0) * (if j = l then 1 else 0) +
      (if i = l then 1 else 0) * (if j = k then 1 else 0) +
      (m₄ - 3) * ((if i = j then 1 else 0) * (if i = k then 1 else 0) *
        (if i = l then 1 else 0))

name: NLAlib.integral_quadForm_eq_trace
statement:
theorem integral_quadForm_eq_trace [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {z : Ω → n → ℝ} (hz : ∀ i, MemLp (fun ω => z ω i) 2 μ)
    (hind : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IndepFun (fun ω => z ω i) (fun ω => z ω j) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1) :
    ∫ ω, quadForm A (z ω) ∂μ = A.trace

name: NLAlib.integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_second_moments
statement:
theorem integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_second_moments [DecidableEq n]

    (∫ ω, quadForm A (z ω) ∂μ) = A.trace

name: NLAlib.integral_quadForm_sq
statement:
theorem integral_quadForm_sq [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {z : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun i ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (h4 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => z ω i ^ 4) μ) {m₄ : ℝ}
    (hm4 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 4 ∂μ = m₄) :
    ∫ ω, quadForm A (z ω) ^ 2 ∂μ =
      A.trace ^ 2 + ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 + ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * A j i +
        (m₄ - 3) * ∑ i, A i i ^ 2

name: NLAlib.sum_fourth_moment_contraction
statement:
theorem sum_fourth_moment_contraction [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (m₄ : ℝ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ l, A i j * A k l *
      ((if i = j then 1 else 0) * (if k = l then 1 else 0) +
        (if i = k then 1 else 0) * (if j = l then 1 else 0) +
        (if i = l then 1 else 0) * (if j = k then 1 else 0) +
        (m₄ - 3) * ((if i = j then 1 else 0) * (if i = k then 1 else 0) *
          (if i = l then 1 else 0))) =
      A.trace ^ 2 + ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 + ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * A j i +
        (m₄ - 3) * ∑ i, A i i ^ 2

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {z : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun i ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (h4 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => z ω i ^ 4) μ) {m₄ : ℝ}
    (hm4 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 4 ∂μ = m₄) :
    Var[fun ω => quadForm A (z ω); μ] =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j ^ 2 + ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * A j i + (m₄ - 3) * ∑ i, A i i ^ 2

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {z : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun i ω => z ω i) μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (h4 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => z ω i ^ 4) μ) {m₄ : ℝ}
    (hm4 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 4 ∂μ = m₄) :
    Var[fun ω => quadForm A (z ω); μ] =
      2 * (frobSq A - ∑ i, A i i ^ 2) + (m₄ - 1) * ∑ i, A i i ^ 2

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_fourth_moment_eq_one
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_fourth_moment_eq_one [DecidableEq n]

    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω i) μ)

    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ∂μ = 0) (hsq : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (h4 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => z ω i ^ 4) μ)
    (hm4 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 4 ∂μ = 1) :
    Var[fun ω => quadForm A (z ω); μ] = 2 * (frobSq A - ∑ i, A i i ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_fourth_moment_eq_three
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm_of_isHermitian_of_fourth_moment_eq_three [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : Ω → n → ℝ}
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (fun ω => z ω i) μ)

    (h4 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => z ω i ^ 4) μ)
    (hm4 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, z ω i ^ 4 ∂μ = 3) :

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_trace_add_centered_rankOne_pow_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_trace_add_centered_rankOne_pow_le
    (y : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hy : Measurable y)
    (hsecond : ∀ i j, (∫ ω, y ω i * y ω j ∂μ) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    {v R : ℝ} (hv : 2 ≤ v) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hraw : ∀ l, 2 ≤ l → l ≤ 2 * p → ∀ x : ι → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (l - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (l - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
          ((l.factorial : ℝ) / 2) * v * R ^ (l - 2) * (x ⬝ᵥ x)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ((A + (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1)) ^ (2 * p)).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, ((A + (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1)) ^ (2 * p)).trace ∂μ) ≤
        (A ^ (2 * p)).trace + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * p - 1),
          ((2 * p).choose (k + 2) : ℝ) * ((k + 2).factorial : ℝ) / 2 *
            (4 * v) * (2 * R) ^ k *
              (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ (2 * p - (k + 2))) A).trace

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_trace_centered_insertionWord_le_factorial
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_trace_centered_insertionWord_le_factorial
    (y : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hy : Measurable y)
    (hsecond : ∀ i j, (∫ ω, y ω i * y ω j ∂μ) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : List Bool)
    (hw : 2 ≤ w.count true) {v R : ℝ} (hv : 2 ≤ v) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hraw : ∀ l, 2 ≤ l → l ≤ w.count true → ∀ x : ι → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (l - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (l - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
          ((l.factorial : ℝ) / 2) * v * R ^ (l - 2) * (x ⬝ᵥ x)) :
    Integrable (fun ω =>
      (insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w).trace ∂μ) ≤
        ((w.count true).factorial : ℝ) / 2 * (4 * v) * (2 * R) ^ (w.count true - 2) *
          (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A).trace

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_trace_insertionWord_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_trace_insertionWord_sub_one_le
    (y : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hy : Measurable y)
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : List Bool) {B : ℝ}
    (hmoment : ∀ l ≤ w.count true,
      Integrable (fun ω => (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A *
        vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ l).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A *
        vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ l).trace ∂μ) ≤
          B * (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A).trace) :
    Integrable (fun ω =>
      (insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w).trace ∂μ) ≤
        2 ^ w.count true * B * (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A).trace

    (hind : iIndepFun X μ) (hX_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (hprod_int :
      Integrable
        (fun p : Ω × Ω =>
          exp (l * inner ℝ
            (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (cutMatrix A s) (randomVector X p.1))
            (randomVector X p.2))) (μ.prod μ)) :
    ∫ ω, exp (l * quadForm (cutMatrix A s) (fun i => X i ω)) ∂μ =
      ∫ p : Ω × Ω,
        exp (l * inner ℝ
          (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (cutMatrix A s) (randomVector X p.1))
          (randomVector X p.2)) ∂(μ.prod μ)

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_exchangeable
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_exchangeable
    {m mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : @Measure Ω mΩ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X X' : Ω → E}
    (hex : IdentDistrib (fun ω => (X ω, X' ω)) (fun ω => (X' ω, X ω)) μ μ)
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (f : E → F) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hfX : MemLp (f ∘ X) 2 μ)
    (hm : m ≤ mΩ)
    (hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable[m] (f ∘ X) μ)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (hreg : μ[X - X' | m] =ᵐ[μ] fun ω => α • (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ))
    (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) :
    (∫ ω, B (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) (f (X ω)) ∂μ) =
      (2 * α)⁻¹ • ∫ ω, B (X ω - X' ω) (f (X ω) - f (X' ω)) ∂μ

name: NLAlib.integral_coordinate_covariance_exchangeable
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_covariance_exchangeable
    {m mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : @Measure Ω mΩ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X X' : Ω → E}
    (hex : IdentDistrib (fun ω => (X ω, X' ω)) (fun ω => (X' ω, X ω)) μ μ)
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hm : m ≤ mΩ) (hXm : StronglyMeasurable[m] X)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (hreg : μ[X - X' | m] =ᵐ[μ] fun ω => α • (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ))
    (u v : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, u (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) * v (X ω - ∫ t, X t ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      (2 * α)⁻¹ * ∫ ω, u (X ω - X' ω) * v (X ω - X' ω) ∂μ

      (fun p => (resamplingPartner p, resamplingOriginal p))

      (ρ.prod (Measure.pi fun j => (ν j).prod (ν j)))

    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable (id : E → E) (ν i)) :
    condExp (MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst inferInstance) (independentResamplingMeasure ν)
      (independentResamplingOriginal - independentResamplingPartner) =ᵐ[independentResamplingMeasure ν]
      fun p => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        (independentResamplingOriginal p - ∑ j, ∫ t, t ∂ν j)

name: NLAlib.condExp_independentResampling_sum
statement:
theorem condExp_independentResampling_sum
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, Integrable (id : E → E) (ν i)) :
    condExp (MeasurableSpace.comap independentResamplingOriginal inferInstance)
      (independentResamplingMeasure ν)
      (independentResamplingOriginal - independentResamplingPartner) =ᵐ[independentResamplingMeasure ν]

        (independentResamplingOriginal p - ∫ t, independentResamplingOriginal t
          ∂independentResamplingMeasure ν)

name: NLAlib.integral_resamplingTriple_first_sub_second

name: NLAlib.covariance_resamplingTripleOriginal_eval
statement:
theorem covariance_resamplingTripleOriginal_eval
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) 2 (ν i)) (i j : κ) :
    cov[(fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) => resamplingTripleOriginal p i),
      (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) => resamplingTripleOriginal p j); resamplingTripleMeasure ν] =
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2 *
        ∫ p, (resamplingTripleOriginal p i - resamplingTripleFirst p i) *
          (resamplingTripleOriginal p j - resamplingTripleFirst p j)
          ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_resamplingTriple
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_resamplingTriple
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (g : E → F) (hgc : Continuous g) (C : ℝ) (hgb : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ C)
    (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    (∫ p, B (resamplingTripleOriginal p -
        ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
      (g (resamplingTripleOriginal p)) ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) =
      ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2) •
        ∫ p, B (resamplingTripleOriginal p - resamplingTripleFirst p)
          (g (resamplingTripleOriginal p) - g (resamplingTripleFirst p))
          ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν

name: NLAlib.integral_coordinate_covariance_resamplingTriple
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_covariance_resamplingTriple
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i)) (u v : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    (∫ p, u (resamplingTripleOriginal p -
        ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) *
      v (resamplingTripleOriginal p -
        ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν)
      ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) =
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2 *
        ∫ p, u (resamplingTripleOriginal p - resamplingTripleFirst p) *
          v (resamplingTripleOriginal p - resamplingTripleFirst p)
          ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν

name: NLAlib.integral_resamplingTripleOriginal_eq_canonical
statement:
theorem integral_resamplingTripleOriginal_eq_canonical
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :

      ∫ q, independentResamplingOriginal q ∂independentResamplingMeasure ν

name: NLAlib.memLp_resamplingTriple_sums
statement:
theorem memLp_resamplingTriple_sums
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]

      MemLp resamplingTripleFirst 2 (resamplingTripleMeasure ν) ∧
      MemLp resamplingTripleSecond 2 (resamplingTripleMeasure ν)

theorem norm_pow_le_wordMatrixVacuum_evenMoment [Fintype ι] (k q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (T : M) (hT : ∀ i j, T i j ∈ wordWickDegreeSpan (ι := ι) k) :
    ‖T‖ ^ (2 * q) ≤ ((Fintype.card D : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card D)) *
      ((2 * q * k + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (2 * q * k + 1)) *
        Real.sqrt ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
          ((star T * T) ^ (2 * q))).re)

    (hdeg : ∀ i j, ∀ w ∈
      (FreeAlgebra.equivMonoidAlgebraFreeMonoid (R := ℂ) (X := ι) (P i j)).coeff.support,
        w.toList.length ≤ k) :
    ‖wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P‖ ≤
      (Fintype.card D : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4 * q : ℝ)) *
        (2 * q * k + 1 : ℝ) ^ (3 / (4 * q : ℝ)) *
          ((wordMatrixVacuumExpectation (D := D) (ι := ι)
            ((star (wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P) *
              wordMatrixPolynomialEvaluation P) ^ (2 * q))).re) ^ (1 / (4 * q : ℝ))

    (f : E → F) (df : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (ddf : E → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (df x) x)
    (hdf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt df (ddf x) x) (hddfc : Continuous ddf)
    (C₀ C₁ C₂ : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖≤C₀)
    (hdfb : ∀ x, ‖df x‖≤C₁) (hddfb : ∀ x, ‖ddf x‖≤C₂)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) (ht1 : t<1) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun s : ℝ => ∫ q : E×E, f (Real.sqrt s•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-s)•q.2) ∂γY.prod γZ)
      ((1/2 : ℝ) • ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γY]-
          cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γZ]) •

        (cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γY]-

    (f : E → F) (df : E → E →L[ℝ] F)
    (g : E → G) (dg : E → E →L[ℝ] G)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (df x) x) (hdfc : Continuous df)
    (hg : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt g (dg x) x) (hdgc : Continuous dg)
    (Cf Cd Cg Ce : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ Cf) (hdfb : ∀ x, ‖df x‖ ≤ Cd)
    (hgb : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ Cg) (hdgb : ∀ x, ‖dg x‖ ≤ Ce)
    (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    (∫ y : E, B (f y) (g y) ∂gaussianVector κ) -
        B (∫ y : E, f y ∂gaussianVector κ) (∫ y : E, g y ∂gaussianVector κ) =
      ∫ t : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∑ k,
        ∫ q : E × E, B (df q.1 (Pi.single k 1))
          (dg (t • q.1 + Real.sqrt (1 - t ^ 2) • q.2) (Pi.single k 1))
            ∂(gaussianVector κ).prod (gaussianVector κ)

name: NLAlib.covariance_rotation_eq
statement:
theorem covariance_rotation_eq (X Y : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hXY : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => (fun t => X t ω, fun t => Y t ω)) P)
    (hX0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, X t ω ∂P = 0) (hY0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, Y t ω ∂P = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ s t, ∫ ω, X s ω * Y t ω ∂P = 0) (θ : ℝ) (i j : ι) :
    cov[fun ω => -Real.sin θ * X i ω + Real.cos θ * Y i ω,
      fun ω => Real.cos θ * X j ω + Real.sin θ * Y j ω; P]
      = Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ *
        (∫ ω, Y i ω * Y j ω ∂P - ∫ ω, X i ω * X j ω ∂P)

name: NLAlib.integral_le_integral_of_covariance_hessian_nonneg
statement:
theorem integral_le_integral_of_covariance_hessian_nonneg {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    (X Y : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hXY : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => (fun t => X t ω, fun t => Y t ω)) P)
    (hX0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, X t ω ∂P = 0) (hY0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, Y t ω ∂P = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ s t, ∫ ω, X s ω * Y t ω ∂P = 0)
    (F : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (g : ι → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (H : ι → ι → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt F
      (∑ i, g i x • ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) i) x)
    (hg : ∀ i x, HasFDerivAt (g i)
      (∑ j, H i j x • ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) j) x)
    (hHc : ∀ i j, Continuous (H i j))
    (C : ℝ) (hgb : ∀ i x, |g i x| ≤ C) (hHb : ∀ i j x, |H i j x| ≤ C)
    (K : ℝ) (hFb : ∀ x, |F x| ≤ ∑ t, |x t| + K)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j,
      (∫ ω, Y i ω * Y j ω ∂P - ∫ ω, X i ω * X j ω ∂P) * H i j x) :
    ∫ ω, F (fun t => X t ω) ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, F (fun t => Y t ω) ∂P

    (X : U → T → Ω → ℝ) (Y : U → T → Ω' → ℝ)
    (hX : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω (p : U × T) => X p.1 p.2 ω) P)

    (hX0 : ∀ u t, ∫ ω, X u t ω ∂P = 0) (hY0 : ∀ u t, ∫ ω, Y u t ω ∂Q = 0)
    (hsame : ∀ u t s,
      ∫ ω, (X u t ω - X u s ω) ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, (Y u t ω - Y u s ω) ^ 2 ∂Q)
    (hdiff : ∀ u v t s, u ≠ v →
      ∫ ω, (Y u t ω - Y v s ω) ^ 2 ∂Q ≤ ∫ ω, (X u t ω - X v s ω) ^ 2 ∂P) :

name: NLAlib.integrable_bilin_resamplingAffine
statement:
theorem integrable_bilin_resamplingAffine
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] (a b : ℝ)
    (f : E → F) (hfc : Continuous f) (C : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C)
    (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    Integrable (fun q => B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ)
      (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2)))
      ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) ∧
    Integrable (fun q => B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
      (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2) -
        f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2)))
      ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ)

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_resamplingAffine
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_resamplingAffine
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] (a b : ℝ)
    (f : E → F) (hfc : Continuous f) (C : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C)
    (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    (∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ)
      (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2))
      ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) =
      ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2) •
        ∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
          (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2) -
            f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2))
          ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ

theorem integrable_bilin_quadratic_resamplingTriple_affine
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (μ : κ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (df : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) (hdf : Continuous df)
    (C : ℝ) (hdfb : ∀ x, ‖df x‖ ≤ C)
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ) =>
      B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
        (df (μ + a • (resamplingTripleSecond q.1 - μ) + b • q.2)
          (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)))
      ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ)

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_quadratic_resamplingTriple_affine
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_quadratic_resamplingTriple_affine
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (μ : κ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (df : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) (hdf : Continuous df)
    (C : ℝ) (hdfb : ∀ x, ‖df x‖ ≤ C)
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    (∫ q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ),
      B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
        (df (μ + a • (resamplingTripleSecond q.1 - μ) + b • q.2)
          (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1))
      ∂((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ)) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (∫ p, (resamplingTripleOriginal p i - resamplingTripleFirst p i) *
          (resamplingTripleOriginal p j - resamplingTripleFirst p j) ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) •
        ∫ q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ),
          B (Pi.single i 1)
            (df (μ + a • (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ) + b • q.2) (Pi.single j 1))
          ∂((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ)

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_resamplingStein_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_resamplingStein_gaussian
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : κ → ℝ => z i), (fun z : κ → ℝ => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) => resamplingTripleOriginal p i),
          (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) => resamplingTripleOriginal p j);
          resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    (a b : ℝ) (f : (κ → ℝ) → F) (df : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F)
    (hf : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt f (df y) y) (hdf : Continuous df)

    (∫ q, B q.2 (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2))
      ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) =
      (b * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2) •
        ∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
          (df (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleSecond q.1) q.2)

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : κ → ℝ => z i), (fun z : κ → ℝ => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) => resamplingTripleOriginal p i),
          (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) => resamplingTripleOriginal p j);
          resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    (Φ : (κ → ℝ) → ℂ) (f : (κ → ℝ) → F) (df : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F)
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ)
    (hΦ : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt Φ (B.flip (f y)) y)
    (hf : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt f (df y) y) (hdf : Continuous df)
    (CΦ C C' : ℝ) (hΦb : ∀ y, ‖Φ y‖ ≤ CΦ)
    (hfb : ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ C) (hdfb : ∀ y, ‖df y‖ ≤ C')
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    let a := Real.sqrt t
    let b := Real.sqrt (1 - t)
    HasDerivAt (resamplingInterpolation ν γ Φ)
      (((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / (4 * a)) •
          (∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
            (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2) -
              f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2))
            ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) -
        ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 4) •
          ∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
            (df (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleSecond q.1) q.2)
              (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1))
            ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) t

    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {c : ℝ} (hLSI : HasEuclideanLogSobolev μ c)

    (hLip : ∀ x y, |f x - f y| ≤ L * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2))
    (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M) (s : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, s * f x * Real.exp (s * f x) ∂μ) -
      (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (s * f x) ∂μ) ≤

    ∃ F : ℕ → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ,
      (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ 1 (F n)) ∧

      (∀ n x, |F n x| ≤ (n : ℝ) + 2) ∧
      (∀ n x, |F n x| ≤ |f x| + 1) ∧

statement:
theorem gaussianPairingWeight_add_eq_sum_orientations {m : ℕ}
    (C D : Fin m → Fin m → ℝ) (π : GaussianPairings m) :
    gaussianPairingWeight (fun i j => C i j + D i j) π =
      ∑ flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool,
        ∏ e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length,
          if flip e then D ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1 ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2
          else C ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1 ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2

      ⟨2 * m ^ 2, by positivity⟩ μ)
    (hmean : κ * m ≤ ∫ y, Y y ∂μ) :
    gaussianHalfMeanProbability κ ≤ μ.real {ω | (∫ y, Y y ∂μ) / 2 ≤ Y ω}

theorem measure_ge_le_mul_measure_ge_div_of_gaussian_concentration
    {X Y : Ω → ℝ} {A κ c m : ℝ} (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X ω - ∫ y, X y ∂μ)
      ⟨2 * m ^ 2, by positivity⟩ μ)
    (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => Y ω - ∫ y, Y y ∂μ)
      ⟨2 * m ^ 2, by positivity⟩ μ)
    (hmean : (∫ y, X y ∂μ) ≤ A * ∫ y, Y y ∂μ)
    (hscale : κ * m ≤ ∫ y, Y y ∂μ)
    (hlower : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → c * Real.exp (-(u / m) ^ 2) ≤ μ.real {ω | u ≤ Y ω})
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ X ω} ≤ gaussianTailComparisonConstant A κ c *
      μ.real {ω | t / gaussianTailComparisonConstant A κ c ≤ Y ω}

name: NLAlib.singularValuePsi_eq_moments
statement:
theorem singularValuePsi_eq_moments (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {γ b y : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :
    singularValuePsi μ γ y =
      y * ((dTransformMoment μ 0 y - 2 * y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y) *
          singularValueCompanionPhi μ γ y + singularValuePhi μ y *
          (γ * (dTransformMoment μ 0 y - 2 * y ^ 2 * dTransformMoment μ 1 y) -
            (1 - γ) / y ^ 2)) /
        (singularValuePhi μ y * singularValueCompanionPhi μ γ y)

name: NLAlib.bisectionInterval_screeThreshold
statement:
theorem bisectionInterval_screeThreshold (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {γ b : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hbmem : b ∈ μ.support)
    (hthick : Tendsto (singularValueEdgeMoment μ) (𝓝[>] b) atTop) (j : ℕ) :
    let p := bisectionInterval (singularValuePsi μ γ) (-4) b (Real.sqrt 3 * b) j
    b ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 < screeThreshold μ γ b ∧ screeThreshold μ γ b ≤ p.2 ∧
      p.2 - p.1 = (Real.sqrt 3 - 1) * b / 2 ^ j

    (hthick : Tendsto (singularValueEdgeMoment μ) (𝓝[>] b) atTop) :

    (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hbmem : b ∈ μ.support)
    (hr : b < r) (hre : singularValuePsi μ γ r = -4) :

name: NLAlib.screeThreshold_spec
statement:
theorem screeThreshold_spec (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {γ b : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hbmem : b ∈ μ.support)
    (hthick : Tendsto (singularValueEdgeMoment μ) (𝓝[>] b) atTop) :
    b < screeThreshold μ γ b ∧ screeThreshold μ γ b ≤ Real.sqrt 3 * b ∧
      singularValuePsi μ γ (screeThreshold μ γ b) = -4

statement:
theorem singularValuePsi_eq_neg_four_iff_eq_screeThreshold

theorem tendsto_dTransformMoment_of_weak_convergence
    {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} {μs : I → ProbabilityMeasure ℝ} {μ : ProbabilityMeasure ℝ}
    (hweak : Tendsto μs l (𝓝 μ)) {bs : I → ℝ} {b y : ℝ}
    (hbs : Tendsto bs l (𝓝 b)) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hs : ∀ i, (μs i : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 (bs i))
    (hμ : (μ : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun i => dTransformMoment (μs i : Measure ℝ) k y) l

    (hbs : Tendsto bs l (𝓝 b)) (hγs : Tendsto γs l (𝓝 γ))
    (hbs0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ bs i) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hs : ∀ i, (μs i : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 (bs i))
    (hμ : (μ : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 b) (hy : b < y) :

statement:
theorem tendsto_screeThreshold_of_weak_convergence
    {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} {μs : I → ProbabilityMeasure ℝ} {μ : ProbabilityMeasure ℝ}
    (hweak : Tendsto μs l (𝓝 μ)) {bs γs : I → ℝ} {b γ : ℝ}
    (hbs : Tendsto bs l (𝓝 b)) (hγs : Tendsto γs l (𝓝 γ))
    (hbs0 : ∀ i, 0 < bs i) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hγs0 : ∀ i, 0 < γs i) (hγs1 : ∀ i, γs i ≤ 1) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hs : ∀ i, (μs i : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 (bs i))
    (hμ : (μ : Measure ℝ).support ⊆ Icc 0 b)
    (hsmem : ∀ i, bs i ∈ (μs i : Measure ℝ).support) (hbmem : b ∈ (μ : Measure ℝ).support)
    (hsthick : ∀ i, Tendsto (singularValueEdgeMoment (μs i : Measure ℝ)) (𝓝[>] (bs i)) atTop)
    (hthick : Tendsto (singularValueEdgeMoment (μ : Measure ℝ)) (𝓝[>] b) atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun i => screeThreshold (μs i : Measure ℝ) (γs i) (bs i)) l
      (𝓝 (screeThreshold (μ : Measure ℝ) γ b))

          (2 * (n.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * n)) ^ d * (a ⬝ᵥ a) ^ n)
    (x : Fin r → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤

    (hhigh : ∀ a : Fin r → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * (2 * p - 2))) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (a ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (2 * (2 * p - 2)) ∂μ) ≤
          B * (a ⬝ᵥ a) ^ (2 * p - 2))
    (x : Fin r → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (p - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
        Real.sqrt (A * (B * gaussianRadialMoment r (2 * p - 2) /

    (hweak : s ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt V * Real.sqrt W))

name: NLAlib.integral_nonneg_of_gaussian_coordinate_approximation
statement:
theorem integral_nonneg_of_gaussian_coordinate_approximation
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (F : ℕ → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (D DD : ℕ → ι → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (X A' B' C' : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ) (b K P : ℝ) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hψ0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ ψ t) (hψP : ∀ t, ψ t ≤ P)
    (hF : ∀ n i x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => F n (Function.update x i y))
      (D n i (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hD : ∀ n i x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => D n i (Function.update x i y))
      (DD n i (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hψi : ∀ n, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F n x))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hfi : ∀ n i, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F n x) * D n i x)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hxi : ∀ n i, Integrable (fun x => x i * (ψ (F n x) * D n i x))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hgi : ∀ n i, Integrable (fun x => deriv ψ (F n x) * D n i x ^ 2)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hddi : ∀ n i, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F n x) * DD n i x)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hupper : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1),
      (∑ i, DD n i x) ≤ K)
    (hFlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1),
      Tendsto (fun n => F n x) atTop (𝓝 (X x)))
    (hAlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1),
      Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i, D n i x ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (A' x)))
    (hBlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1),
      Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i, x i * D n i x) atTop (𝓝 (B' x)))
    (hClim : ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1),
      Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i, DD n i x) atTop (𝓝 (C' x)))
    (hC' : ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1), C' x ≤ b)
    (bound : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hboundi : Integrable bound (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1),
      ‖deriv ψ (F n x) * (∑ i, D n i x ^ 2) +
        (b - ∑ i, x i * D n i x) * ψ (F n x)‖ ≤ bound x) :
    0 ≤ ∫ x, deriv ψ (X x) * A' x + (b - B' x) * ψ (X x)
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)

name: NLAlib.integral_stein_energy_eq
statement:
theorem integral_stein_energy_eq
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (F : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (D DD : ι → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : Differentiable ℝ ψ)
    (hF : ∀ i x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => F (Function.update x i y))
      (D i (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hD : ∀ i x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => D i (Function.update x i y))
      (DD i (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hfi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F x) * D i x)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hxi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => x i * (ψ (F x) * D i x))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hgi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => deriv ψ (F x) * D i x ^ 2)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hddi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F x) * DD i x)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)) :
    (∫ x, deriv ψ (F x) * (∑ i, D i x ^ 2) + ψ (F x) * (∑ i, DD i x)
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)) =
    ∫ x, ψ (F x) * (∑ i, x i * D i x)
      ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1)

name: NLAlib.integral_stein_shift_eq
statement:
theorem integral_stein_shift_eq
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (F : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (D DD : ι → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hψ : Differentiable ℝ ψ) (b : ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ i x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => F (Function.update x i y))
      (D i (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hD : ∀ i x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => D i (Function.update x i y))
      (DD i (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hψi : Integrable (fun x => ψ (F x))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hfi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => ψ (F x) * D i x)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hxi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => x i * (ψ (F x) * D i x))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hgi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => deriv ψ (F x) * D i x ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.sum_trace_mul_gram_direction_mul_gram_direction
statement:
theorem sum_trace_mul_gram_direction_mul_gram_direction (X Y : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hX : Xᵀ = X) (hY : Yᵀ = Y) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ := Matrix.single i j 1
      Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ) * Y * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ))) =
      2 * Matrix.trace (X * Y * (G * Gᵀ)) +
        Matrix.trace X * Matrix.trace (Y * (G * Gᵀ)) +
        Matrix.trace Y * Matrix.trace (X * (G * Gᵀ))

name: NLAlib.sum_trace_mul_gram_direction_sq
statement:
theorem sum_trace_mul_gram_direction_sq (X : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hX : Xᵀ = X)
    (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ := Matrix.single i j 1
      Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ)) ^ 2) =
      4 * Matrix.trace (X ^ 2 * (G * Gᵀ))

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_gram_direction
statement:
theorem trace_mul_gram_direction (X : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hX : Xᵀ = X)
    (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ := Matrix.single i j 1
    Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ)) = 2 * (X * G) i j

name: NLAlib.trace_mul_gram_direction_mul_gram_direction
statement:
theorem trace_mul_gram_direction_mul_gram_direction (X Y : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hX : Xᵀ = X) (hY : Yᵀ = Y) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ := Matrix.single i j 1
    Matrix.trace (X * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ) * Y * (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ)) =
      2 * (X * G) i j * (Y * G) i j + X i i * (Gᵀ * Y * G) j j +
        Y i i * (Gᵀ * X * G) j j

statement:
theorem frobInner_gramSoftMinGradient_eq_trace (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) :
    frobInner G (gramSoftMinGradient n ε G) =
      2 * Matrix.trace (inversePowerSoftMinWeight n (regularizedGram ε G) * (G * Gᵀ))

name: NLAlib.frobSq_gramSoftMinGradient_eq_trace
statement:
theorem frobSq_gramSoftMinGradient_eq_trace (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ)
    (hpd : (regularizedGram ε G).PosDef) :
    frobSq (gramSoftMinGradient n ε G) = 4 *
      Matrix.trace (inversePowerSoftMinWeight n (regularizedGram ε G) ^ 2 * (G * Gᵀ))

name: NLAlib.gramSoftMinLaplacian_eq
statement:
theorem gramSoftMinLaplacian_eq (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ)
    (hpd : (regularizedGram ε G).PosDef) :
    let R := (regularizedGram ε G)⁻¹
    let T := Matrix.trace (R ^ n)
    gramSoftMinLaplacian n ε G =
      2 * Fintype.card κ * Matrix.trace (inversePowerSoftMinWeight n (regularizedGram ε G)) +
      4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * T ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 2) * Matrix.trace (R ^ (2 * n + 2) * (G * Gᵀ)) -
      T ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1) *
        ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (2 * Matrix.trace (R ^ (n + 2) * (G * Gᵀ)) +
            Matrix.trace (R ^ (n - a + 1)) * Matrix.trace (R ^ (a + 1) * (G * Gᵀ)) +
            Matrix.trace (R ^ (a + 1)) * Matrix.trace (R ^ (n - a + 1) * (G * Gᵀ)))

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_regularizedGram_add_smul
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_regularizedGram_add_smul (ε : ℝ) (G E : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => regularizedGram ε (G + x • E))
      (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ + (2 * t) • (E * Eᵀ)) t

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_regularizedGram_first
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_regularizedGram_first (G E : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ + (2 * x) • (E * Eᵀ))
      ((2 : ℝ) • (E * Eᵀ)) t

name: NLAlib.inversePowerSoftMinFirst_gram_single_eq_gradient
statement:
theorem inversePowerSoftMinFirst_gram_single_eq_gradient (n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (i : ι) (j : κ) (t : ℝ) :
    let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ := Matrix.single i j 1
    inversePowerSoftMinFirst n (regularizedGram ε (G + t • E))
      (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ + (2 * t) • (E * Eᵀ)) = gramSoftMinGradient n ε (G + t • E) i j

name: NLAlib.regularizedGram_add_smul
statement:
theorem regularizedGram_add_smul (ε t : ℝ) (G E : Matrix ι κ ℝ) :
    regularizedGram ε (G + t • E) = regularizedGram ε G +
      t • (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ) + t ^ 2 • (E * Eᵀ)

name: NLAlib.regularizedGram_posDef

name: NLAlib.sum_inversePowerHessianKernel_gram_direction_eq
statement:
theorem sum_inversePowerHessianKernel_gram_direction_eq
    (R : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hR : R.PosSemidef) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ := Matrix.single i j 1
      inversePowerHessianKernel R (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ) n) =
      ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (2 * Matrix.trace (R ^ (n + 2) * (G * Gᵀ)) +
          Matrix.trace (R ^ (n - a + 1)) * Matrix.trace (R ^ (a + 1) * (G * Gᵀ)) +
          Matrix.trace (R ^ (a + 1)) * Matrix.trace (R ^ (n - a + 1) * (G * Gᵀ)))

name: NLAlib.frobInner_gramSoftMinGradient_eq_spectral
statement:
theorem frobInner_gramSoftMinGradient_eq_spectral (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ)
    (hpd : (regularizedGram ε G).PosDef) :
    let b := hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues
    let T := ∑ i, b i ^ n
    frobInner G (gramSoftMinGradient n ε G) =
      2 * ∑ i, ((b i)⁻¹ - ε) * (T ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1) * b i ^ (n + 1))

name: NLAlib.frobSq_gramSoftMinGradient_eq_spectral
statement:
theorem frobSq_gramSoftMinGradient_eq_spectral (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ)

    let T := ∑ i, b i ^ n
    frobSq (gramSoftMinGradient n ε G) =

name: NLAlib.gramSoftMinLaplacian_eq_normalized
statement:
theorem gramSoftMinLaplacian_eq_normalized [Nonempty ι] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (ε : ℝ) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (hpd : (regularizedGram ε G).PosDef)
    (b₀ : ℝ) (hb₀ : 0 < b₀) :
    let b := hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues
    let ρ := fun i => b i / b₀
    let l := fun i => (b i)⁻¹ - ε
    let S := ∑ i, ρ i ^ n
    let c := S ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1)
    gramSoftMinLaplacian n ε G =
      2 * Fintype.card κ * c * (∑ i, ρ i ^ (n + 1)) +
        4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * b₀ * c *
          ((∑ i, l i * ρ i ^ (2 * n + 2)) / S - (∑ i, l i * ρ i ^ (n + 2))) -
        b₀ * c * ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          (l i + l j) * ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ρ i ^ (n - a + 1) * ρ j ^ (a + 1)

name: NLAlib.gramSoftMinLaplacian_eq_spectral
statement:
theorem gramSoftMinLaplacian_eq_spectral (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ)
    (hpd : (regularizedGram ε G).PosDef) :
    let b := hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues
    let l := fun i => (b i)⁻¹ - ε
    let T := ∑ i, b i ^ n
    gramSoftMinLaplacian n ε G =
      2 * Fintype.card κ * T ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1) * (∑ i, b i ^ (n + 1)) +
      4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * T ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 2) * (∑ i, l i * b i ^ (2 * n + 2)) -
      T ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1) *
        ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (2 * (∑ i, l i * b i ^ (n + 2)) +
            (∑ i, b i ^ (n - a + 1)) * (∑ i, l i * b i ^ (a + 1)) +
            (∑ i, b i ^ (a + 1)) * (∑ i, l i * b i ^ (n - a + 1)))

name: NLAlib.gramSoftMinLaplacian_eq_spectral_offDiag
statement:
theorem gramSoftMinLaplacian_eq_spectral_offDiag (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ)
    (hpd : (regularizedGram ε G).PosDef) :
    let b := hpd.inv.isHermitian.eigenvalues
    let l := fun i => (b i)⁻¹ - ε
    let T := ∑ i, b i ^ n
    let c := T ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1)
    gramSoftMinLaplacian n ε G =
      2 * Fintype.card κ * c * (∑ i, b i ^ (n + 1)) +
        4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) *
          (T ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 2) * (∑ i, l i * b i ^ (2 * n + 2)) -
            c * (∑ i, l i * b i ^ (n + 2))) -
        c * ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          (l i + l j) * ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), b i ^ (n - a + 1) * b j ^ (a + 1)

name: NLAlib.regularizedGram_inv_basis_conj_eq
statement:
theorem regularizedGram_inv_basis_conj_eq (ε : ℝ) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ)
    (hpd : (regularizedGram ε G).PosDef) :
    let hR := hpd.inv.isHermitian
    let b := hR.eigenvalues
    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (star hR.eigenvectorUnitary) (G * Gᵀ) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i)⁻¹ - ε)

name: NLAlib.regularizedGram_inv_basis_conj_weight_eq
statement:
theorem regularizedGram_inv_basis_conj_weight_eq (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ)

    let hR := hpd.inv.isHermitian
    let b := hR.eigenvalues
    let T := ∑ i, b i ^ n
    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (star hR.eigenvectorUnitary)
      (inversePowerSoftMinWeight n (regularizedGram ε G)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => T ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1) * b i ^ (n + 1))

name: NLAlib.normalized_inverse_power_laplacian_limit_le
statement:
theorem normalized_inverse_power_laplacian_limit_le
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ w : ι → ℝ) (i₀ : ι) (hρ₀ : ρ i₀ = 1)
    (hρ : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → 0 ≤ ρ i ∧ ρ i < 1)
    (b₀ k : ℝ) (hb₀ : 0 ≤ b₀) (hw₀ : 0 ≤ w i₀)
    (hrel : ∀ j, j ≠ i₀ → b₀ * ρ j * (w j - w i₀) = 1 - ρ j) :
    2 * k - 2 * b₀ *
      (∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else w j * ρ i * ρ j *
        (((if j = i₀ then 1 else 0) - (if i = i₀ then 1 else 0)) / (ρ j - ρ i)))
      ≤ 2 * (k - Fintype.card ι + 1)

name: NLAlib.sum_offDiagonal_inverse_power_limit_eq
statement:
theorem sum_offDiagonal_inverse_power_limit_eq

    (∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else w j * ρ i * ρ j *
      (((if j = i₀ then 1 else 0) - (if i = i₀ then 1 else 0)) / (ρ j - ρ i)))
      = ∑ j, if j = i₀ then 0 else (w i₀ + w j) * ρ j / (1 - ρ j)

name: NLAlib.tendsto_normalized_inverse_power_laplacian
statement:
theorem tendsto_normalized_inverse_power_laplacian
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ w : ι → ℝ) (i₀ : ι) (hρ₀ : ρ i₀ = 1)
    (hρ : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → 0 ≤ ρ i ∧ ρ i < 1)
    (hinj : Function.Injective ρ) (b₀ k : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      2 * k * (∑ i, ρ i ^ n) ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1) * (∑ i, ρ i ^ (n + 1)) +
      4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * b₀ * (∑ i, ρ i ^ n) ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1) *
        ((∑ i, w i * ρ i ^ (2 * n + 2)) / (∑ i, ρ i ^ n) -
          ∑ i, w i * ρ i ^ (n + 2)) -
      2 * b₀ * (∑ i, ρ i ^ n) ^ (-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1) *
        ∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else w j *
          ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ρ i ^ (n - a + 1) * ρ j ^ (a + 1))
      atTop (𝓝 (2 * k - 2 * b₀ *
        ∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else w j * ρ i * ρ j *
          (((if j = i₀ then 1 else 0) - (if i = i₀ then 1 else 0)) / (ρ j - ρ i))))

statement:

name: NLAlib.frobSq_gramSoftMinGradient_unshifted_eq

theorem frobSq_gramSoftMinGradient_unshifted_eq (n : ℕ)

name: NLAlib.inversePowerSoftMinFirst_unshifted_gram_single_eq_gradient
statement:
theorem inversePowerSoftMinFirst_unshifted_gram_single_eq_gradient (n : ℕ)
    (G : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (i : ι) (j : κ) (t : ℝ) :
    let E : Matrix ι κ ℝ := Matrix.single i j 1
    inversePowerSoftMinFirst n (regularizedGram 0 (G + t • E))
      (E * Gᵀ + G * Eᵀ + (2 * t) • (E * Eᵀ)) = gramSoftMinGradient n 0 (G + t • E) i j

name: NLAlib.lintegral_frobSq_transpose_mul_sketch_sub_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_frobSq_transpose_mul_sketch_sub_le {d₁ d₂ : Type*} [Fintype d₁]
    [Fintype d₂] (S : Ωs → Matrix k n ℝ) (hS : ∀ i j, Measurable fun ω => S ω i j) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hmom : ∀ x : n → ℝ, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (((S ω *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (S ω *ᵥ x) - x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2))
    (A : Matrix n d₁ ℝ) (B : Matrix n d₂ ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (frobSq (Aᵀ * (S ω)ᵀ * S ω * B - Aᵀ * B)) ∂μ
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε ^ 2 * frobSq A * frobSq B)

name: NLAlib.lintegral_mulVec_dotProduct_sub_sq_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_mulVec_dotProduct_sub_sq_le {S : Ωs → Matrix k n ℝ}
    (hS : ∀ i j, Measurable fun ω => S ω i j) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hmom : ∀ x : n → ℝ, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (((S ω *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (S ω *ᵥ x) - x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2))
    (a b : n → ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (((S ω *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (S ω *ᵥ b) - a ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε ^ 2 * (a ⬝ᵥ a) * (b ⬝ᵥ b))

name: NLAlib.lintegral_ofReal_sq_sub_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_ofReal_sq_sub_le {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    {X Y : α → ℝ} (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hXa : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (X ω ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (a ^ 2))
    (hYb : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Y ω ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b ^ 2)) :
    ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal ((X ω - Y ω) ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((a + b) ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.sub_eq_mulVec_dotProduct_sub_of_polarization

        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u + v)) ⬝ᵥ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u + v))) -
      ((S *ᵥ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u - v))) ⬝ᵥ (S *ᵥ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u - v))) -
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u - v)) ⬝ᵥ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u - v))) =
      (S *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (S *ᵥ v) - u ⬝ᵥ v

    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card)

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_sampled_mul_sub_of_columnRowProbabilities
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_sampled_mul_sub_of_columnRowProbabilities
    {m n t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix n t ℝ)
    (hW : 0 < ∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ ω : Fin c → n,
      frobSq (sampledColumnMatrix A (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω *
        sampledRowMatrix B (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω - A * B)
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw (columnRowProbabilities A B)
        (sum_columnRowProbabilities A B hW))) =
      ((∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) ^ 2 - frobSq (A * B)) / (c : ℝ) ∧
    (∫ ω : Fin c → n,
      frobSq (sampledColumnMatrix A (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω *
        sampledRowMatrix B (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω - A * B)
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw (columnRowProbabilities A B)
        (sum_columnRowProbabilities A B hW))) ≤ frobSq A * frobSq B / (c : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.integral_frobenius_average_sub_mean_sq
statement:
theorem integral_frobenius_average_sub_mean_sq
    {ι m n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    (p : ι → ℝ≥0) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1) (Z : ι → Matrix m n ℂ)
    {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∫ ω : Fin c → ι,

        ‖∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • Z i‖ ^ 2)

    ∫ ω : Fin c → n, ‖sampledColumnMatrix A p ω * sampledRowMatrix B p ω - A * B‖ ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw p hp) =
      (1 / (c : ℝ)) *

    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n t ℂ)
    (hW : 0 < ∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ ω : Fin c → n,

        sampledRowMatrix B (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω - A * B‖ ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw (columnRowProbabilities A B)
        (sum_columnRowProbabilities A B hW))) =
      ((∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) ^ 2 - ‖A * B‖ ^ 2) / (c : ℝ) ∧
    (∫ ω : Fin c → n,
      ‖sampledColumnMatrix A (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω *
        sampledRowMatrix B (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω - A * B‖ ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw (columnRowProbabilities A B)
