name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_siteKernel
statement:
theorem transpose_siteKernel (s : Site m n) (A : LevelOp) :
    (siteKernel s A).transpose = siteKernel s A.transpose

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_wordKernel
statement:
theorem transpose_wordKernel (s t : Site m n) (w : Word) :
    (wordKernel s t w).transpose = wordKernel t s w.orderedAdjoint

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.wordKernel_homogeneous
statement:
theorem wordKernel_homogeneous (w : Word) {s t : Site m n} (hst : s ≠ t) :
    IsGradeShift w.degree (wordKernel s t w)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.externalTensor_homogeneous
NLAlib.SparseSketch.orderedWordTerm_homogeneous
statement:
theorem orderedWordTerm_homogeneous
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (w : Word) :
    IsFullGradeShift w.degree (orderedWordTerm u r i j w)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_externalTensor
statement:
theorem transpose_externalTensor
    (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (K : FockOp m n) :
    (externalTensor M K).transpose = externalTensor M.transpose K.transpose

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_orderedWordTerm
statement:
theorem transpose_orderedWordTerm
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (r : Fin m) (i j : Fin n) (w : Word) :
    (orderedWordTerm u r i j w).transpose =
      orderedWordTerm u r j i w.orderedAdjoint

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.band_eq_three_families
statement:
theorem band_eq_three_families
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (δ : Shift) :
    band m u ρ δ =
      family m u δ .lightLight +
        ρ • family m u δ .lightHeavy +
        ρ ^ 2 • family m u δ .heavyHeavy

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.band_homogeneous
statement:
theorem band_homogeneous
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (δ : Shift) :
    IsFullGradeShift δ.degree (band m u ρ δ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.cell_heavyHeavy
statement:
theorem cell_heavyHeavy
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (δ : Shift) :
    cell m u ρ δ .heavyHeavy = ρ ^ 2 • family m u δ .heavyHeavy

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.cell_lightHeavy
statement:
theorem cell_lightHeavy
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (δ : Shift) :
    cell m u ρ δ .lightHeavy = ρ • family m u δ .lightHeavy

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.cell_lightLight
statement:
theorem cell_lightLight
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (δ : Shift) :
    cell m u ρ δ .lightLight = family m u δ .lightLight

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.jacobi_eq_weighted_legs
statement:
theorem jacobi_eq_weighted_legs (ρ : ℝ) :
    jacobi ρ = ∑ a : Leg, ρ ^ a.heavy • a.op

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.orderedJacobiTerm_eq_all_words
statement:
theorem orderedJacobiTerm_eq_all_words
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ)
    (r : Fin m) (i j : Fin n) :
    orderedJacobiTerm u ρ r i j =
      ∑ w : Word, ρ ^ w.heavy • orderedWordTerm u r i j w

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.pairKernel_jacobi_eq_all_words
statement:
theorem pairKernel_jacobi_eq_all_words
    (ρ : ℝ) (s t : Site m n) :
    pairKernel s t (jacobi ρ) (jacobi ρ) =
      ∑ w : Word, ρ ^ w.heavy • wordKernel s t w

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rawMultiplication_eq_all_words
statement:
theorem rawMultiplication_eq_all_words
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    rawMultiplication m u ρ =
      ∑ w : Word, ρ ^ w.heavy • physicalWordSum m u w

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rawMultiplication_eq_sum_bands
statement:
theorem rawMultiplication_eq_sum_bands
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    rawMultiplication m u ρ = ∑ δ : Shift, band m u ρ δ

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_all_cells
statement:
theorem sum_all_cells {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (f : Word → A) :
    (∑ δ : Shift, ∑ h : Heaviness, ∑ w ∈ wordsIn δ h, f w) =
      ∑ w : Word, f w

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_heaviness
statement:
theorem sum_heaviness {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (f : Heaviness → A) :
    ∑ h, f h = f .lightLight + f .lightHeavy + f .heavyHeavy

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_leg
statement:
theorem sum_leg {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (f : Leg → A) :
    ∑ a, f a = f .pUp + f .pDown + f .rUp + f .rDown

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_ordered_pairs_comm
statement:
theorem sum_ordered_pairs_comm {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] [Module ℝ A]
    (c : Word → ℝ) (f : Fin m → Fin n → Fin n → Word → A) :
    (∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ∑ w, c w • f r i j w) =
      ∑ w, c w • (∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, f r i j w)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_shift
statement:
theorem sum_shift {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (f : Shift → A) :
    ∑ δ, f δ = f .plus + f .zero + f .minus

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.asOperator_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem asOperator_apply (A : FullOp d m n)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    asOperator A (WithLp.toLp 2 x) =
      WithLp.toLp 2 (Matrix.mulVec A x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.fullGradeZ_eq_cast_grade
statement:
theorem fullGradeZ_eq_cast_grade (x : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    fullGradeZ x = (x.2.grade : ℤ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradeProjection_apply (nu : ℕ)
    (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) nu out inp =
      if out = inp ∧ out.2.grade = nu then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_mulVec
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_mulVec (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (a : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x a =
      if a.2.grade = nu then x a else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_mul_gradeProjection
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradeProjection_mul_gradeProjection
    {mu nu : ℕ} (h : mu ≠ nu) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) mu * gradeProjection nu = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_mul_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradeProjection_mul_self (nu : ℕ) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu * gradeProjection nu =
      gradeProjection nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_normSq
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_normSq (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) =
      ∑ a with a.2.grade = nu, x a ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_normSq_le
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_normSq_le (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤ sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_norm_le_one (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤ 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradeProjection_transpose (nu : ℕ) :
    (gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu).transpose =
      gradeProjection nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeZ_eq_cast_grade
statement:
theorem gradeZ_eq_cast_grade (p : Pattern m n) :
    Pattern.gradeZ p = (p.grade : ℤ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.homogeneous_add
statement:
theorem homogeneous_add {delta : ℤ} {A B : FullOp d m n}
    (hA : IsFullGradeShift delta A)
    (hB : IsFullGradeShift delta B) :
    IsFullGradeShift delta (A + B)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.homogeneous_grade_relation
statement:
theorem homogeneous_grade_relation {delta : ℤ} {A : FullOp d m n}
    (hA : IsFullGradeShift delta A)
    {out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n} (hentry : A out inp ≠ 0) :
    (out.2.grade : ℤ) = (inp.2.grade : ℤ) + delta

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.homogeneous_smul
NLAlib.SparseSketch.incompatible_grade_block_zero
statement:
theorem incompatible_grade_block_zero {delta : ℤ} {A : FullOp d m n}
    (hA : IsFullGradeShift delta A) (mu nu : ℕ)
    (hincompatible : (mu : ℤ) ≠ (nu : ℤ) + delta) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) mu * A * gradeProjection nu = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.input_grade_vanishes_of_no_output
statement:
theorem input_grade_vanishes_of_no_output {delta : ℤ} {A : FullOp d m n}
    (hA : IsFullGradeShift delta A) (nu : ℕ)
    (himpossible : ∀ mu : ℕ, (mu : ℤ) ≠ (nu : ℤ) + delta) :
    A * gradeProjection (d := d) nu = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.norm_asOperator
statement: theorem norm_asOperator (A : FullOp d m n) : ‖asOperator A‖ = ‖A‖

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.norm_le_of_normSq_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem norm_le_of_normSq_mulVec_le {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    {A : Matrix I J ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (henergy : ∀ x : J → ℝ,
      sumSq (Matrix.mulVec A x) ≤ C ^ 2 * sumSq x) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ C

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.norm_toLp_sq
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_sq {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (x : I → ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2 = sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.output_projection_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem output_projection_of_homogeneous {delta : ℤ} {A : FullOp d m n}
    (hA : IsFullGradeShift delta A) (mu nu : ℕ)
    (hcompatible : (mu : ℤ) = (nu : ℤ) + delta) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) mu * A * gradeProjection nu =
      A * gradeProjection nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq_eq_dotProduct
statement:
theorem sumSq_eq_dotProduct {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (x : I → ℝ) :
    sumSq x = dotProduct x x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq_nonneg
statement:
theorem sumSq_nonneg {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (x : I → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_add
statement:
theorem expect_add (μ : FiniteLaw α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    μ.expect (fun x => f x + g x) = μ.expect f + μ.expect g

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_congr
statement:
theorem expect_congr (μ : FiniteLaw α) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) : μ.expect f = μ.expect g

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem expect_const (μ : FiniteLaw α) (c : ℝ) :
    μ.expect (fun _ => c) = c

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_mono
statement:
theorem expect_mono (μ : FiniteLaw α) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (hfg : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) : μ.expect f ≤ μ.expect g

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_nonneg
statement:
theorem expect_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw α) {f : α → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) : 0 ≤ μ.expect f

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem expect_one (μ : FiniteLaw α) :
    μ.expect (fun _ => 1) = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_smul
statement:
theorem expect_smul (μ : FiniteLaw α) (c : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ) :
    μ.expect (fun x => c * f x) = c * μ.expect f

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_sub
statement:
theorem expect_sub (μ : FiniteLaw α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    μ.expect (fun x => f x - g x) = μ.expect f - μ.expect g

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem expect_zero (μ : FiniteLaw α) :
    μ.expect (fun _ => 0) = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.markov
statement:
theorem markov (μ : FiniteLaw α) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    {threshold : ℝ} (hthreshold : 0 < threshold) :
    μ.prob {x | threshold ≤ f x} ≤ μ.expect f / threshold

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.markov_mul
statement:
theorem markov_mul (μ : FiniteLaw α) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (threshold : ℝ) :
    threshold * μ.prob {x | threshold ≤ f x} ≤ μ.expect f

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_compl
statement:
theorem prob_compl (μ : FiniteLaw α) (s : Set α) :
    μ.prob sᶜ = 1 - μ.prob s

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem prob_empty (μ : FiniteLaw α) : μ.prob ∅ = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_le_one
statement: theorem prob_le_one (μ : FiniteLaw α) (s : Set α) : μ.prob s ≤ 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_mono
statement:
theorem prob_mono (μ : FiniteLaw α) {s t : Set α} (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    μ.prob s ≤ μ.prob t

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_nonneg
statement: theorem prob_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw α) (s : Set α) : 0 ≤ μ.prob s

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_singleton
statement:
theorem prob_singleton [DecidableEq α] (μ : FiniteLaw α) (a : α) :
    μ.prob {a} = μ.weight a

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_univ
statement: @[simp] theorem prob_univ (μ : FiniteLaw α) : μ.prob Set.univ = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_independentProduct_apply
statement:
theorem expect_independentProduct_apply
    (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (i : ι) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (independentProduct μ).expect (fun x => f (x i)) = (μ i).expect f

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_independentProduct_factorizes
statement:
theorem expect_independentProduct_factorizes
    (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (f : ι → α → ℝ) :
    (independentProduct μ).expect (fun x => ∏ i, f i (x i)) =
      ∏ i, (μ i).expect (f i)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_independentProduct_factorizes_on
statement:
theorem expect_independentProduct_factorizes_on
    (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α → ℝ) :
    (independentProduct μ).expect (fun x => ∏ i ∈ s, f i (x i)) =
      ∏ i ∈ s, (μ i).expect (f i)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.independentProduct_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem independentProduct_weight (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (x : ι → α) :
    (independentProduct μ).weight x = ∏ i, (μ i).weight (x i)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.indicator_cylinder
statement:
theorem indicator_cylinder (s : ι → Set α) (x : ι → α) :
    indicator (cylinder s) x = ∏ i, indicator (s i) (x i)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_independentProduct_apply
statement:
theorem prob_independentProduct_apply
    (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (i : ι) (s : Set α) :
    (independentProduct μ).prob {x | x i ∈ s} = (μ i).prob s

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_independentProduct_cylinder
statement:
theorem prob_independentProduct_cylinder
    (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (s : ι → Set α) :
    (independentProduct μ).prob (cylinder s) = ∏ i, (μ i).prob (s i)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_independentProduct_eq
statement:
theorem prob_independentProduct_eq
    [DecidableEq α] (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (i : ι) (a : α) :
    (independentProduct μ).prob {x | x i = a} = (μ i).weight a

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.coeff_basis
statement:
theorem coeff_basis (i j : I) :
    B.coeff i (B.basis j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.coeff_mul_sum
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_sum (i : I) (a : Omega → ℝ) (c : I → ℝ) :
    B.coeff i (fun x => a x * ∑ j, c j * B.basis j x) =
      ∑ j, c j * B.coeff i (fun x => a x * B.basis j x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.coeff_sum
statement:
theorem coeff_sum {K : Type*} [Fintype K] (i : I) (f : K → Omega → ℝ) :
    B.coeff i (fun x => ∑ k, f k x) = ∑ k, B.coeff i (f k)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.expect_one
statement: theorem expect_one : B.expect (fun _ => 1) = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.matrixMulOp_mul
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_mul (M N : Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) :
    B.matrixMulOp M * B.matrixMulOp N =
      B.matrixMulOp (fun x => M x * N x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.matrixMulOp_one
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_one :
    B.matrixMulOp (fun _ => (1 : Matrix A A ℝ)) = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.matrixMulOp_pow
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_pow (M : Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    B.matrixMulOp M ^ k = B.matrixMulOp (fun x => M x ^ k)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.matrix_vacuum_moment
statement:
theorem matrix_vacuum_moment (M : Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ a, (B.matrixMulOp M ^ k) (a, B.vacuum) (a, B.vacuum)) =
      B.expect (fun x => Matrix.trace (M x ^ k))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.mulOp_mul
statement:
theorem mulOp_mul (a b : Omega → ℝ) :
    B.mulOp a * B.mulOp b = B.mulOp (fun x => a x * b x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.reconstruct
statement:
theorem reconstruct (f : Omega → ℝ) (x : Omega) :
    f x = ∑ i, B.coeff i f * B.basis i x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.basis_orthonormal
statement:
theorem basis_orthonormal {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (i j : Level) :
    ternaryWeightedInner b (basisFun b i) (basisFun b j) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.basis_reconstruction
statement:
theorem basis_reconstruction {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (f : TernaryOutcome → ℝ) (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    f x = ∑ i, ternaryWeightedInner b (basisFun b i) f * basisFun b i x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.eta_cube
statement:
theorem eta_cube {b : ℕ} (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    eta b x ^ 3 = (b : ℝ) * eta b x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.eta_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem eta_zero (b : ℕ) : eta b .zero = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.expect_eta
statement: theorem expect_eta {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : expect b (eta b) = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.expect_eta_sq
statement:
theorem expect_eta_sq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    expect b (fun x => eta b x ^ 2) = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.law_expect_eta
statement:
theorem law_expect_eta {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (ternaryLaw b hb).expect (eta b) = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.law_expect_eta_sq
statement:
theorem law_expect_eta_sq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (ternaryLaw b hb).expect (fun x => eta b x ^ 2) = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mass_nonneg
statement:
theorem mass_nonneg {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    0 ≤ mass b x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mul_e0
statement:
theorem mul_e0 {b : ℕ} (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    eta b x * basisFun b .zero x = basisFun b .one x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mul_e1
statement:
theorem mul_e1 {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    eta b x * basisFun b .one x =
      basisFun b .zero x + Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) * basisFun b .two x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mul_e2
statement:
theorem mul_e2 {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    eta b x * basisFun b .two x =
      Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) * basisFun b .one x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.multiplication_matrix
statement:
theorem multiplication_matrix {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (i j : Level) :
    ternaryWeightedInner b (basisFun b i)
        (fun x => eta b x * basisFun b j x) =
      jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) i j

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.multiplication_recurrence
statement:
theorem multiplication_recurrence {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (j : Level) (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    eta b x * basisFun b j x =
      ∑ i, jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) i j * basisFun b i x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sq_sqrt_b_sub_one
statement:
theorem sq_sqrt_b_sub_one {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) ^ 2 = (b : ℝ) - 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sq_sqrt_nat
statement: theorem sq_sqrt_nat (b : ℕ) : (Real.sqrt b) ^ 2 = (b : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sqrt_b_sub_one_pos
statement:
theorem sqrt_b_sub_one_pos {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    0 < Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_mass
statement:
theorem sum_mass {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∑ x, mass b x = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.ternaryLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem ternaryLaw_weight (b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    (ternaryLaw b hb).weight z = mass b z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.univ_level
statement:
@[simp] theorem univ_level :
    (Finset.univ : Finset Level) = {.zero, .one, .two}

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.univ_ternaryOutcome
statement:
@[simp] theorem univ_ternaryOutcome :
    (Finset.univ : Finset TernaryOutcome) = {.neg, .zero, .pos}

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.coordinate_product_factorization
statement:
theorem coordinate_product_factorization {m n b : ℕ} (s : Site m n)
    (out inp : Pattern m n) (omega : Configuration m n) :
    productBasis b out omega *
        (etaCoordinate b s omega * productBasis b inp omega) =
      ∏ t, coordinateFactor b s out inp t (omega t)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iidLaw_weight (b : ℕ) (hb : 1 < b) (m n : ℕ)
    (omega : Configuration m n) :
    (iidLaw b hb m n).weight omega = ∏ s, mass b (omega s)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.local_reproducing
statement:
theorem local_reproducing {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (y x : TernaryOutcome) :
    mass b y *
        (∑ i, basisFun b i y * basisFun b i x) =
      if x = y then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mulOp_etaCoordinate
statement:
theorem mulOp_etaCoordinate {m n b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (s : Site m n) :
    (productONBasis b hb m n).mulOp (etaCoordinate b s) =
      siteKernel s (jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mulOp_etaCoordinate_mul
statement:
theorem mulOp_etaCoordinate_mul {m n b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (s t : Site m n) :
    (productONBasis b hb m n).mulOp
        (fun omega ↦ etaCoordinate b s omega * etaCoordinate b t omega) =
      siteKernel s (jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1))) *
        siteKernel t (jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.productBasis_orthonormal
statement:
theorem productBasis_orthonormal {m n b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (p q : Pattern m n) :
    productWeightedInner b hb (productBasis b p) (productBasis b q) =
      if p = q then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.productBasis_reconstruction
statement:
theorem productBasis_reconstruction {m n b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (f : Configuration m n → ℝ) (x : Configuration m n) :
    f x = ∑ p : Pattern m n,
      ((iidLaw b hb m n).expect (fun omega ↦ productBasis b p omega * f omega)) *
        productBasis b p x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.product_kernel_factor
statement:
theorem product_kernel_factor {m n b : ℕ} (omega x : Configuration m n) :
    (∑ p : Pattern m n, productBasis b p omega * productBasis b p x) =
      ∏ s, ∑ i, basisFun b i (omega s) *
        basisFun b i (x s)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.ternaryLaw_expect_eq
statement:
theorem ternaryLaw_expect_eq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (g : TernaryOutcome → ℝ) :
    (ternaryLaw b hb).expect g = expect b g

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.weighted_product_kernel
statement:
theorem weighted_product_kernel {m n b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (omega x : Configuration m n) :
    (iidLaw b hb m n).weight omega *
        (∑ p : Pattern m n, productBasis b p omega * productBasis b p x) =
      ∏ s, if x s = omega s then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.analysis_energy_eq
statement:
theorem analysis_energy_eq {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (x : EVec d) :
    (∑ i, (analyze F x i) ^ 2) = euclideanNormSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.applyMatrix_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem applyMatrix_one {d : ℕ} (x : EVec d) :
    applyMatrix (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) x = x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.euclideanNormSq_eq_norm_sq
statement: theorem euclideanNormSq_eq_norm_sq {d : ℕ} (x : EVec d) : euclideanNormSq x = ‖x‖ ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.parseval_iff_transpose_mul
statement:
theorem parseval_iff_transpose_mul {n d : ℕ} (u : Fin n → EVec d) :
    frameOperator u = (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) ↔
      (rowMatrix u).transpose * rowMatrix u = (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.partialFrameOperator_contraction
statement:
theorem partialFrameOperator_contraction {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : EVec d) :
    euclideanNormSq (applyMatrix (partialFrameOperator F S) x) ≤ euclideanNormSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.partialFrameOperator_mulVec
statement:
theorem partialFrameOperator_mulVec {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : EVec d) :
    applyMatrix (partialFrameOperator F S) x = synthesize F S (analyze F x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.reconstruct
statement:
theorem reconstruct {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (x : EVec d) :
    synthesize F Finset.univ (analyze F x) = x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.subset_analysis
statement:
theorem subset_analysis {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (x : EVec d) :
    (∑ i ∈ S, (analyze F x i) ^ 2) ≤ euclideanNormSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.subset_synthesis
statement:
theorem subset_synthesis {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    euclideanNormSq (synthesize F S a) ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, |a i| ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.synthesize_inner
statement:
theorem synthesize_inner {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : EVec d) :
    ⟪synthesize F S a, x⟫_ℝ = ∑ i ∈ S, a i * ⟪F.u i, x⟫_ℝ

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_mul_rowMatrix
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_rowMatrix {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) :
    (rowMatrix F.u).transpose * rowMatrix F.u =
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.vector_normSq_le_one
statement:
theorem vector_normSq_le_one {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (i : Fin n) :
    euclideanNormSq (F.u i) ≤ 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.vector_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem vector_norm_le_one {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (i : Fin n) :
    ‖F.u i‖ ≤ 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidGramError_apply
statement:
theorem iidGramError_apply {m n d : ℕ} (b : ℕ) (F : Frame n d)
    (omega : Configuration m n) (a c : Fin d) :
    iidGramError b F omega a c = (1 / (m : ℝ)) *
      ∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        etaCoordinate b (r, i) omega * etaCoordinate b (r, j) omega *
          F.u i a * F.u j c

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.matrixMulOp_finset_sum
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_finset_sum (B : WeightedONBasis Omega I)
    (S : Finset K) (M : K → Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) :
    B.matrixMulOp (fun omega ↦ ∑ k ∈ S, M k omega) =
      ∑ k ∈ S, B.matrixMulOp (M k)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.matrixMulOp_fintype_sum
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_fintype_sum (B : WeightedONBasis Omega I)
    (M : K → Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) :
    B.matrixMulOp (fun omega ↦ ∑ k, M k omega) =
      ∑ k, B.matrixMulOp (M k)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.matrixMulOp_scalar_external
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_scalar_external {m n d b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (a : Configuration m n → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    (productONBasis b hb m n).matrixMulOp (fun omega ↦ a omega • M) =
      externalTensor M ((productONBasis b hb m n).mulOp a)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.matrixMulOp_smul
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_smul (B : WeightedONBasis Omega I) (c : ℝ)
    (M : Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) :
    B.matrixMulOp (fun omega ↦ c • M omega) = c • B.matrixMulOp M

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.multiplicationOperator_eq_globalJacobi
statement:
theorem multiplicationOperator_eq_globalJacobi {m n d b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) :
    multiplicationOperator (m := m) b hb F = globalJacobiOperator (m := m) b F

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.vacuum_moment_identity
statement:
theorem vacuum_moment_identity {m n d b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ a : Fin d,
      (multiplicationOperator b hb F ^ k)
        (a, vacuumPattern m n) (a, vacuumPattern m n)) =
      (iidLaw b hb m n).expect
        (fun omega ↦ Matrix.trace ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ k))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.globalJacobiOperator_eq_smul_rawMultiplication
statement:
theorem globalJacobiOperator_eq_smul_rawMultiplication
    (F : Frame n d) :
    globalJacobiOperator (m := m) b F =
      (1 / (m : ℝ)) • rawMultiplication m (fun i a ↦ F.u i a)
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.multiplicationOperator_eq_sum_normalizedBands
statement:
theorem multiplicationOperator_eq_sum_normalizedBands
    (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d) :
    multiplicationOperator (m := m) b hb F =
      ∑ δ : Shift, normalizedBand m F b δ

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.nextGrade_compatible
NLAlib.SparseSketch.nextGrade_none_impossible
NLAlib.SparseSketch.normalizedBand_homogeneous
statement:
theorem normalizedBand_homogeneous (F : Frame n d) (b : ℕ)
    (δ : Shift) :
  IsFullGradeShift δ.degree (normalizedBand m F b δ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.normalizedBand_output_projection
statement:
theorem normalizedBand_output_projection
    (F : Frame n d) (b : ℕ) (delta : Shift)
    (nu mu : ℕ) (hnext : nextGrade delta nu = some mu) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) mu * normalizedBand m F b delta *
        gradeProjection nu =
      normalizedBand m F b delta * gradeProjection nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.normalizedBand_vanishes_of_nextGrade_none
statement:
theorem normalizedBand_vanishes_of_nextGrade_none
    (F : Frame n d) (b : ℕ) (delta : Shift)
    (nu : ℕ) (hnext : nextGrade delta nu = none) :
    normalizedBand m F b delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.siteJacobiProduct_eq_pairKernel
statement:
theorem siteJacobiProduct_eq_pairKernel
    (r : Fin m) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) (ρ : ℝ) :
    siteKernel (r, i) (jacobi ρ) * siteKernel (r, j) (jacobi ρ) =
      pairKernel (r, i) (r, j) (jacobi ρ) (jacobi ρ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.siteKernel_mul_siteKernel_of_ne
statement:
theorem siteKernel_mul_siteKernel_of_ne
    (s t : Site m n) (hst : s ≠ t) (A B : LevelOp) :
    siteKernel s A * siteKernel t B = pairKernel s t A B

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.vacuumPattern_grade
statement:
@[simp] theorem vacuumPattern_grade :
    (vacuumPattern m n).grade = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.vacuum_moment_identity_bands
statement:
theorem vacuum_moment_identity_bands
    (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ a : Fin d,
      ((∑ δ : Shift, normalizedBand m F b δ) ^ k)
        (a, vacuumPattern m n) (a, vacuumPattern m n)) =
      (iidLaw b hb m n).expect
        (fun omega ↦ Matrix.trace ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ k))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.band_minus_named
statement:
theorem band_minus_named (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    band m u ρ .minus =
      Lminus m u + ρ • (XplusAdj m u + YplusAdj m u) +
        ρ ^ 2 • Hminus m u

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.band_plus_named
statement:
theorem band_plus_named (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    band m u ρ .plus =
      Lplus m u + ρ • (Xplus m u + Yplus m u) + ρ ^ 2 • Hplus m u

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.band_zero_named
statement:
theorem band_zero_named (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    band m u ρ .zero = Lzero m u +
      ρ • (Xzero m u + XzeroAdj m u + Yzero m u + YzeroAdj m u) +
      ρ ^ 2 • Hzero m u

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_minus_heavyHeavy
statement:
theorem family_minus_heavyHeavy (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .minus .heavyHeavy = Hminus m u

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_minus_lightHeavy
statement:
theorem family_minus_lightHeavy (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .minus .lightHeavy = XplusAdj m u + YplusAdj m u

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_minus_lightLight
statement:
theorem family_minus_lightLight (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .minus .lightLight = Lminus m u

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_plus_heavyHeavy
statement:
theorem family_plus_heavyHeavy (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .plus .heavyHeavy = Hplus m u

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_plus_lightHeavy
statement:
theorem family_plus_lightHeavy (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .plus .lightHeavy = Xplus m u + Yplus m u

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_plus_lightLight
statement:
theorem family_plus_lightLight (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .plus .lightLight = Lplus m u

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_zero_heavyHeavy
statement:
theorem family_zero_heavyHeavy (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .zero .heavyHeavy = Hzero m u

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_zero_lightHeavy
statement:
theorem family_zero_lightHeavy (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .zero .lightHeavy =
      Xzero m u + XzeroAdj m u + Yzero m u + YzeroAdj m u

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_zero_lightLight
statement:
theorem family_zero_lightLight (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .zero .lightLight = Lzero m u

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.minus_band_envelope_of_components
statement:
theorem minus_band_envelope_of_components
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) {a c : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hlight :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lminus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ a + bTerm d nu m)
    (hmixed :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
        (XplusAdj m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) + YplusAdj m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ bTerm d nu m + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * c)
    (hheavy :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 •
        Hminus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x))) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ c)
    (hbTerm : 0 ≤ bTerm d nu m) :
    ‖normalizedBand m F b .minus * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      bandConstant * (a + bTerm d nu m + c)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.plus_band_envelope_of_components
statement:
theorem plus_band_envelope_of_components
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) {a c : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hlight :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lplus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ a + bTerm d nu m)
    (hmixed :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Xplus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) + Yplus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)))) *
            gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ bTerm d nu m + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * c)
    (hheavy :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 • Hplus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ c)
    (hbTerm : 0 ≤ bTerm d nu m) :
    ‖normalizedBand m F b .plus * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      bandConstant * (a + bTerm d nu m + c)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.zero_band_envelope_of_components
statement:
theorem zero_band_envelope_of_components
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hlight :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lzero m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ 3 * bTerm d nu m)
    (hmixed :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
        (Xzero m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) + XzeroAdj m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) +
          Yzero m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) + YzeroAdj m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)))) *
            gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        bTerm d nu m + (1 + Real.sqrt 2) * c)
    (hheavy :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 •
        Hzero m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x))) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ 2 * c)
    (hbTerm : 0 ≤ bTerm d nu m) (ha : 0 ≤ aTerm d nu m) :
    ‖normalizedBand m F b .zero * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      bandConstant * (aTerm d nu m + bTerm d nu m + c)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.blockGram_finite_row_bound
statement:
theorem blockGram_finite_row_bound
    {ell : ℕ} (diagonalIndex : Fin ell) (entry : Fin ell → ℝ)
    {d energy : ℝ}
    (hdiag : entry diagonalIndex ≤ d * energy)
    (hoff : ∀ j, j ≠ diagonalIndex → entry j ≤ energy) :
    (∑ j, entry j) ≤ (d + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * energy

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.blockGram_row_bound
statement:
theorem blockGram_row_bound
    {d ell energy diagonal cross : ℝ}
    (_henergy : 0 ≤ energy)
    (hdiag : diagonal ≤ d * energy)
    (hcross : cross ≤ (ell - 1) * energy) :
    diagonal + cross ≤ (d + ell - 1) * energy

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.dense_parameter_arithmetic
statement:
theorem dense_parameter_arithmetic
    {d ν m ε : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (hscale : d + ν ≤ ε ^ 2 * m) :
    (d + ν) / m ≤ ε ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.dense_sqrt_parameter_arithmetic
statement:
theorem dense_sqrt_parameter_arithmetic
    {d ν m ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (hscale : d + ν ≤ ε ^ 2 * m) :
    Real.sqrt ((d + ν) / m) ≤ ε

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.final_parameter_envelope
statement:
theorem final_parameter_envelope
    {d ν q m s ε : ℝ}
    (hν : ν ≤ 2 * q)
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hmScale : d + ν ≤ ε ^ 2 * m)
    (hsScale : 2 * q + 1 ≤ ε * s) :
    Real.sqrt ((d + ν) / m) + (d + ν) / m + (ν + 1) / s ≤ 3 * ε

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mixed_product_into_envelope
statement:
theorem mixed_product_into_envelope
    {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    Real.sqrt x * Real.sqrt y ≤ (x + y) / 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.parameter_envelope
statement:
theorem parameter_envelope
    {rootTerm linearTerm sparseTerm ε : ℝ}
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hroot : rootTerm ≤ ε)
    (hlinear : linearTerm ≤ ε ^ 2)
    (hsparse : sparseTerm ≤ ε) :
    rootTerm + linearTerm + sparseTerm ≤ 3 * ε

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparsity_parameter_arithmetic
statement:
theorem sparsity_parameter_arithmetic
    {ν q s ε : ℝ}
    (hν : ν + 1 ≤ 2 * q + 1)
    (_hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hs : 0 < s)
    (hscale : 2 * q + 1 ≤ ε * s) :
    (ν + 1) / s ≤ ε

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.directional_absorb
statement:
theorem directional_absorb {s b nu : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (nu : ℝ) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) / s

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mixed_plus_absorb
statement:
theorem mixed_plus_absorb {s b d nu : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu + 1))) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        (((d : ℝ) + nu + 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
          (nu : ℝ) / s)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mixed_zero_absorb
statement:
theorem mixed_zero_absorb {s b d nu : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    2 * (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu))) ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + nu) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) + (nu : ℝ) / s

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rho_div_stack_le_inv_s
statement:
theorem rho_div_stack_le_inv_s {s b : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / (s : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rho_div_stack_nonneg
statement:
theorem rho_div_stack_nonneg {s b : ℕ} :
    0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rho_sq_div_stack_le_inv_s
statement:
theorem rho_sq_div_stack_le_inv_s {s b : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / (s : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rho_sq_div_stack_nonneg
statement:
theorem rho_sq_div_stack_nonneg {s b : ℕ} :
    0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Profile.lightHop_grade

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Profile.lightHop_light
statement: @[simp] theorem lightHop_light (p : Profile) : p.lightHop.light = p.light

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Profile.light_le_grade
statement: theorem light_le_grade (p : Profile) : p.light ≤ p.grade

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Profile.two_mul_heavy_le_grade
statement: theorem two_mul_heavy_le_grade (p : Profile) : 2 * p.heavy ≤ p.grade

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Profile.yPlus_grade

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Profile.yPlus_heavy

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.agreesOutsidePair_setPair
statement:
theorem agreesOutsidePair_setPair (p : Pattern m n) (s t : Site m n)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.eq_setPair_iff
statement:
theorem eq_setPair_iff {out inp : Pattern m n} {s t : Site m n}
    (hst : s ≠ t) (a b : Level) :
    inp = setPair out s a t b ↔
      agreesOutsidePair s t out inp ∧ inp s = a ∧ inp t = b

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.frameRows_apply
statement:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprime_wordKernel_apply
statement:
theorem hprime_wordKernel_apply {r : Fin m} {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.pDown, .pUp) out inp =
      if out (r, i) = .zero ∧ out (r, j) = .one ∧
          inp = setPair out (r, i) .one (r, j) .zero then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.orderedHprime_mulVec
statement:
theorem orderedHprime_mulVec (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (orderedWordTerm u r i j (.pDown, .pUp)) x (k, σ) =
      if σ (r, i) = .zero ∧ σ (r, j) = .one then
        ∑ l, u i k * u j l *
          x (l, setPair σ (r, i) .one (r, j) .zero)
      else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.orderedYplus_mulVec
statement:
theorem orderedYplus_mulVec (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (orderedWordTerm u r i j (.rUp, .pUp)) x (k, σ) =
      if σ (r, i) = .two ∧ σ (r, j) = .one then
        ∑ l, u i k * u j l *
          x (l, setPair σ (r, i) .one (r, j) .zero)
      else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.orderedYzero_mulVec
statement:
theorem orderedYzero_mulVec (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (orderedWordTerm u r i j (.rDown, .pUp)) x (k, σ) =
      if σ (r, i) = .one ∧ σ (r, j) = .one then
        ∑ l, u i k * u j l *
          x (l, setPair σ (r, i) .two (r, j) .zero)
      else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.pairKernel_ketBra_apply
statement:
theorem pairKernel_ketBra_apply {s t : Site m n} (hst : s ≠ t)
    (os is ot it : Level) (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    pairKernel s t (ketBra os is) (ketBra ot it) out inp =
      if out s = os ∧ out t = ot ∧ inp = setPair out s is t it then 1 else 0

statement:
theorem yPlus_wordKernel_apply {r : Fin m} {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yZero_wordKernel_apply

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_mulVec_coeff
statement:
theorem Hprime_mulVec_coeff (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Hprime m (Frame.rows F)) x (k, σ) =
      ∑ r, ∑ a ∈ σ.freshInRow r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r,
        ∑ l, F.u a k * F.u c l *
          x (l, setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_mulVec_marked
statement:
theorem Hprime_mulVec_marked (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Hprime m (Frame.rows F)) x (k, σ) =
      ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r, hprimeMarked F x σ r c k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_mulVec_coeff
statement:
theorem Yplus_mulVec_coeff (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Yplus m (Frame.rows F)) x (k, σ) =
      ∑ r, ∑ a ∈ σ.heavyInRow r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r,
        ∑ l, F.u a k * F.u c l *
          x (l, setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_mulVec_marked
statement:
theorem Yplus_mulVec_marked (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Yplus m (Frame.rows F)) x (k, σ) =
      ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r, yPlusMarked F x σ r c k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_mulVec_coeff
statement:
theorem Yzero_mulVec_coeff (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Yzero m (Frame.rows F)) x (k, σ) =
      ∑ r, ∑ a ∈ σ.lightInRow r,
        ∑ c ∈ (σ.lightInRow r).erase a,
          ∑ l, F.u a k * F.u c l *
            x (l, setPair σ (r, a) .two (r, c) .zero)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_mulVec_marked
statement:
theorem Yzero_mulVec_marked (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Yzero m (Frame.rows F)) x (k, σ) =
      ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r, yZeroMarked F x σ r c k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract_eq_analyze
statement:
theorem contract_eq_analyze (F : Frame n d) (c : Fin n)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (τ : Pattern m n) :
    contract F c x τ = analyze F (fiber x τ) c

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem fiber_apply (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ)
    (τ : Pattern m n) (k : Fin d) : fiber x τ k = x (k, τ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem hprimeMarked_apply (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : Pattern m n)
    (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n) (k : Fin d) :
    hprimeMarked F x σ r c k =
      ∑ a ∈ σ.freshInRow r, F.u a k *
        contract F c x (setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked_normSq_le
statement:
theorem hprimeMarked_normSq_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : Pattern m n)
    (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n) :
    euclideanNormSq (hprimeMarked F x σ r c) ≤
      ∑ a ∈ σ.freshInRow r,
        (contract F c x (setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.sum_distinct_level_pairs
statement:
theorem sum_distinct_level_pairs (σ : Pattern m n) (r : Fin m)
    {a b : Level} (hab : a ≠ b) (f : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        if σ (r, i) = a ∧ σ (r, j) = b then f i j else 0) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i ↦ σ (r, i) = a),
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j ↦ σ (r, j) = b), f i j

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.sum_same_level_pairs
statement:
theorem sum_same_level_pairs (σ : Pattern m n) (r : Fin m)
    (a : Level) (f : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        if σ (r, i) = a ∧ σ (r, j) = a then f i j else 0) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i ↦ σ (r, i) = a),
        ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun j ↦ σ (r, j) = a)).erase i, f i j

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlusMarked_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem yPlusMarked_apply (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : Pattern m n)
    (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n) (k : Fin d) :
    yPlusMarked F x σ r c k =
      ∑ a ∈ σ.heavyInRow r, F.u a k *
        contract F c x (setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlusMarked_normSq_le
statement:
theorem yPlusMarked_normSq_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : Pattern m n)
    (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n) :
    euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x σ r c) ≤
      ∑ a ∈ σ.heavyInRow r,
        (contract F c x (setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yZeroMarked_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem yZeroMarked_apply (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : Pattern m n)
    (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n) (k : Fin d) :
    yZeroMarked F x σ r c k =
      ∑ a ∈ (σ.lightInRow r).erase c, F.u a k *
        contract F c x (setPair σ (r, a) .two (r, c) .zero)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yZeroMarked_normSq_le
statement:
theorem yZeroMarked_normSq_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : Pattern m n)
    (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n) :
    euclideanNormSq (yZeroMarked F x σ r c) ≤
      ∑ a ∈ (σ.lightInRow r).erase c,
        (contract F c x (setPair σ (r, a) .two (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_fullFiber
statement:
theorem Hprime_fullFiber (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    fiber (Matrix.mulVec (Hprime m (Frame.rows F)) x) σ =
      ∑ s ∈ σ.light, hprimeMarked F x σ s.1 s.2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_marked_reindex
statement:
theorem Hprime_marked_reindex (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ z : RowMark m n .zero .one,
      (contract F z.right x
        (setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) .one
          (z.row, z.right) .zero)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ z : RowMark m n .one .zero,
        (contract F z.right x z.pattern) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_fullFiber
statement:
theorem Yplus_fullFiber (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    fiber (Matrix.mulVec (Yplus m (Frame.rows F)) x) σ =
      ∑ s ∈ σ.light, yPlusMarked F x σ s.1 s.2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_marked_reindex
statement:
theorem Yplus_marked_reindex (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ z : RowMark m n .two .one,
      (contract F z.right x
        (setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) .one
          (z.row, z.right) .zero)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ z : RowMark m n .one .zero,
        (contract F z.right x z.pattern) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_fullFiber
statement:
theorem Yzero_fullFiber (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    fiber (Matrix.mulVec (Yzero m (Frame.rows F)) x) σ =
      ∑ s ∈ σ.light, yZeroMarked F x σ s.1 s.2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_marked_reindex
statement:
theorem Yzero_marked_reindex (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ z : RowMark m n .one .one,
      (contract F z.right x
        (setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) .two
          (z.row, z.right) .zero)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ z : RowMark m n .two .zero,
        (contract F z.right x z.pattern) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.full_normSq_eq_sum_fiber
statement:
theorem full_normSq_eq_sum_fiber (v : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :

NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.normSq_sum_le_card

NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.sum_rowMarkTransition
statement:
theorem sum_rowMarkTransition (oa ob ia ib : Level)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.sum_rowMark_eq_nested
statement:
theorem sum_rowMark_eq_nested (a b : Level)
    (g : Pattern m n → Fin m → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ z : RowMark m n a b, g z.pattern z.row z.left z.right) =
      ∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ levelInRow p r a,
        ∑ j ∈ (levelInRow p r b).erase i, g p r i j

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.sum_rows_light_eq_sum_light
statement:
theorem sum_rows_light_eq_sum_light (σ : Pattern m n)
    {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (f : Site m n → A) :
    (∑ r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r, f (r, c)) =
      ∑ s ∈ σ.light, f s

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.sum_subtype_eq_filter
statement:
theorem sum_subtype_eq_filter {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (g : α → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : {x // p x}, g x.1) = ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter p, g x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.heavy_fresh_energy_at_le
statement:
theorem heavy_fresh_energy_at_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    (∑ r, ∑ a ∈ p.heavyInRow r,
      ∑ c ∈ p.freshInRow r |>.erase a,
        (contract F c x p) ^ 2) ≤
      (p.heavy.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.light_fresh_energy_at_le
statement:
theorem light_fresh_energy_at_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    (∑ r, ∑ a ∈ p.lightInRow r,
      ∑ c ∈ p.freshInRow r |>.erase a,
        (contract F c x p) ^ 2) ≤
      (p.light.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.markedEnergy_eq_nested
statement:
theorem markedEnergy_eq_nested (a b : Level) (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    markedEnergy a b F x =
      ∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ levelInRow p r a,
        ∑ j ∈ (levelInRow p r b).erase i,
          (contract F j x p) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.markedEnergy_one_zero_le
statement:
theorem markedEnergy_one_zero_le (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x) :
    markedEnergy .one .zero F x ≤
      (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.physicalWordSum_homogeneous
statement:
theorem physicalWordSum_homogeneous (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (w : Word) :
    IsFullGradeShift w.degree (physicalWordSum m u w)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.two_mul_markedEnergy_two_zero_le
statement:
theorem two_mul_markedEnergy_two_zero_le (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x) :
    2 * markedEnergy .two .zero F x ≤
      (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_marked_synthesis_energy_le
statement:
theorem Hprime_marked_synthesis_energy_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
      euclideanNormSq (hprimeMarked F x p r c)) ≤
      markedEnergy .one .zero F x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_output_coeff_energy_eq
statement:
theorem Hprime_output_coeff_energy_eq (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
      ∑ a ∈ p.freshInRow r,
        (contract F c x
          (setPair p (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ z : RowMark m n .zero .one,
        (contract F z.right x
          (setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) .one
            (z.row, z.right) .zero)) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_output_energy_le_marked
statement:
theorem Hprime_output_energy_le_marked (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x) :
    sumSq
      (Matrix.mulVec (Hprime m (Frame.rows F)) x) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) * markedEnergy .one .zero F x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_output_fiber_le_marked
statement:
theorem Hprime_output_fiber_le_marked (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x)
    (p : Pattern m n) :
    euclideanNormSq
      (fiber (Matrix.mulVec (Hprime m (Frame.rows F)) x) p) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) * ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
        euclideanNormSq (hprimeMarked F x p r c)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_marked_synthesis_energy_le
statement:
theorem Yplus_marked_synthesis_energy_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
      euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x p r c)) ≤
      markedEnergy .one .zero F x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_output_coeff_energy_eq
statement:
theorem Yplus_output_coeff_energy_eq (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
      ∑ a ∈ p.heavyInRow r,
        (contract F c x
          (setPair p (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ z : RowMark m n .two .one,
        (contract F z.right x
          (setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) .one
            (z.row, z.right) .zero)) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_output_energy_le_marked
statement:
theorem Yplus_output_energy_le_marked (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x) :
    sumSq
      (Matrix.mulVec (Yplus m (Frame.rows F)) x) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) * markedEnergy .one .zero F x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_output_fiber_le_marked
statement:
theorem Yplus_output_fiber_le_marked (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x)
    (p : Pattern m n) :
    euclideanNormSq
      (fiber (Matrix.mulVec (Yplus m (Frame.rows F)) x) p) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) * ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
        euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x p r c)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_marked_synthesis_energy_le
statement:
theorem Yzero_marked_synthesis_energy_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
      euclideanNormSq (yZeroMarked F x p r c)) ≤

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_output_coeff_energy_eq
statement:
theorem Yzero_output_coeff_energy_eq (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
      ∑ a ∈ (p.lightInRow r).erase c,
        (contract F c x
          (setPair p (r, a) .two (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ z : RowMark m n .one .one,
        (contract F z.right x
          (setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) .two
            (z.row, z.right) .zero)) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_output_energy_le_marked
statement:
theorem Yzero_output_energy_le_marked (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x) :
    sumSq
      (Matrix.mulVec (Yzero m (Frame.rows F)) x) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) * markedEnergy .two .zero F x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_output_fiber_le_marked
statement:
theorem Yzero_output_fiber_le_marked (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x)
    (p : Pattern m n) :
    euclideanNormSq
      (fiber (Matrix.mulVec (Yzero m (Frame.rows F)) x) p) ≤

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_energy_of_supported
statement:
theorem Hprime_energy_of_supported (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x) :
    sumSq
      (Matrix.mulVec (Hprime m (Frame.rows F)) x) ≤

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_restricted_energy
statement:
theorem Hprime_restricted_energy (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq
      (Matrix.mulVec
        (Hprime m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_energy_of_supported
statement:
theorem Yplus_energy_of_supported (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x) :

      (Matrix.mulVec (Yplus m (Frame.rows F)) x) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_restricted_energy
statement:
theorem Yplus_restricted_energy (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq
      (Matrix.mulVec
        (Yplus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_restricted_energy
statement:
theorem Yzero_restricted_energy (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq
      (Matrix.mulVec
        (Yzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_restricted_two_mul_energy
statement:
theorem Yzero_restricted_two_mul_energy (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)

    2 * sumSq
      (Matrix.mulVec
        (Yzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_two_mul_energy_of_supported
statement:
theorem Yzero_two_mul_energy_of_supported (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x) :
    2 * sumSq
      (Matrix.mulVec (Yzero m (Frame.rows F)) x) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_Hprime_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_Hprime_restricted_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Hprime m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ (nu : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_Yplus_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_Yplus_restricted_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_Yzero_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_Yzero_restricted_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Yzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.YplusAdj_homogeneous
statement:
theorem YplusAdj_homogeneous (F : Frame n d) :
    IsFullGradeShift (-2) (YplusAdj m (Frame.rows F))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.YzeroAdj_homogeneous
statement:
theorem YzeroAdj_homogeneous (F : Frame n d) :
    IsFullGradeShift 0 (YzeroAdj m (Frame.rows F))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.gradeProjection_mul_eq_mul_gradeProjection_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_mul_eq_mul_gradeProjection_of_homogeneous
    {delta : ℤ} {A : FullOp d m n}
    (hA : IsFullGradeShift delta A) (mu nu : ℕ)
    (hcompatible : (mu : ℤ) = (nu : ℤ) + delta) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) mu * A = A * gradeProjection nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_YplusAdj_restricted_add_two_le
statement:
theorem norm_YplusAdj_restricted_add_two_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖YplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) (nu + 2)‖ ≤
      (nu : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_YplusAdj_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_YplusAdj_restricted_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖YplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      (nu : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_YzeroAdj_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_YzeroAdj_restricted_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖YzeroAdj m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      (nu : ℝ) / Real.sqrt 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_normalized_YplusAdj_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_YplusAdj_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • YplusAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      (nu : ℝ) / s

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_normalized_Yplus_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_Yplus_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • Yplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      (nu : ℝ) / s

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_normalized_YzeroAdj_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_YzeroAdj_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      ((nu : ℝ) / s) / Real.sqrt 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_normalized_Yzero_pair_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_Yzero_pair_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
            YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt 2 * ((nu : ℝ) / s)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_normalized_Yzero_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_Yzero_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      ((nu : ℝ) / s) / Real.sqrt 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_normalized_directional_term_eq
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_directional_term_eq {s b : ℕ}
    (A : FullOp d m n) (P : FullOp d m n) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • A)) * P‖ =
      (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) * ‖A * P‖

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.transpose_Yplus
statement:
@[simp] theorem transpose_Yplus (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :

@[simp] theorem transpose_YplusAdj (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.transpose_Yzero

statement:
@[simp] theorem transpose_YzeroAdj (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame.hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem Frame.hasOrthonormalCols (F : Frame n d) :

statement:
theorem embeddedGram_eq_transpose_mul_self (F : Frame n d) (S : Matrix k (Fin n) ℝ) :
    embeddedGram F S = (S * rowMatrix F.u)ᵀ * (S * rowMatrix F.u)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.embeddedGram_isHermitian
statement:
theorem embeddedGram_isHermitian (F : Frame n d) (S : Matrix k (Fin n) ℝ) :

statement:
theorem gramError_isHermitian (F : Frame n d) (S : Matrix k (Fin n) ℝ) :

statement:
theorem norm_gramError_le_iff_isSubspaceEmbedding (F : Frame n d)
    (S : Matrix k (Fin n) ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    ‖gramError F S‖ ≤ ε ↔ IsSubspaceEmbedding S (rowMatrix F.u) ε

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Sign.abs_val

theorem Sign.abs_val (z : Sign) : |z.val| = 1

statement: @[simp] theorem Sign.val_minus : Sign.minus.val = -1

statement: theorem Sign.val_ne_zero (z : Sign) : z.val ≠ 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Sign.val_plus
statement: @[simp] theorem Sign.val_plus : Sign.plus.val = 1
