statement:
@[simp]
theorem Sign.val_sq (z : Sign) : z.val ^ 2 = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.block_gram_apply
statement:
theorem block_gram_apply {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ a : Fin b, sparseStackMatrix Z (g, a) i * sparseStackMatrix Z (g, a) j) =
      invSqrt s ^ 2 * ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.embeddedGram_eq_fullExpansion
statement:
theorem embeddedGram_eq_fullExpansion {s b n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s) :
    embeddedGram F (sparseStackMatrix Z) = fullGramExpansion F Z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.exactly_one_nonzero_in_block
statement:
theorem exactly_one_nonzero_in_block {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s)
    (g : Fin s) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃! a : Fin b, sparseStackMatrix Z (g, a) i ≠ 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.fullExpansion_eq_one_add_hollow
statement:
theorem fullExpansion_eq_one_add_hollow {s b n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s) :
    fullGramExpansion F Z = 1 + hollowGram F Z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gramError_eq_block_first
statement:
theorem gramError_eq_block_first {s b n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s) :
    gramError F (sparseStackMatrix Z) = fun a c ↦ (1 / (s : ℝ)) *
      ∑ g, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ * F.u i a * F.u j c

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gramError_eq_hollow
statement:
theorem gramError_eq_hollow {s b n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s) :
    gramError F (sparseStackMatrix Z) = hollowGram F Z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.hollowGram_block_first
statement:
theorem hollowGram_block_first {s b n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) :
    hollowGram F Z = fun a c ↦ (1 / (s : ℝ)) *
      ∑ g, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ * F.u i a * F.u j c

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.inner_signedBasis
statement:
theorem inner_signedBasis {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (i j : Fin n) :
    ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ =
      if Z.hash g i = Z.hash g j
      then (Z.sgn g i).val * (Z.sgn g j).val else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.inner_signedBasis_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inner_signedBasis_self {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (i : Fin n) :
    ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g i⟫_ℝ = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.invSqrt_ne_zero
statement: theorem invSqrt_ne_zero {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) : invSqrt s ≠ 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.invSqrt_sq
statement:
theorem invSqrt_sq {s : ℕ} (_hs : 0 < s) :
    invSqrt s ^ 2 = 1 / (s : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.signedBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signedBasis_apply {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (i : Fin n) (a : Fin b) :
    signedBasis Z g i a = if a = Z.hash g i then (Z.sgn g i).val else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.signedBasis_normSq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signedBasis_normSq {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (i : Fin n) :
    euclideanNormSq (signedBasis Z g i) = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sketchGram_apply
statement:
theorem sketchGram_apply {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    sketchGram (sparseStackMatrix Z) i j =
      (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ g, ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ

name: NLAlib.card_filter_sparseStackMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.NLAlib.card_filter_sparseStackMatrix_ne_zero {s b n : ℕ}
    (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s)
    (i : Fin n) :
    Fintype.card {r : Fin s × Fin b // sparseStackMatrix Z r i ≠ 0} = s

name: NLAlib.sparseStackMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.NLAlib.sparseStackMatrix_apply {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (a : Fin b) (i : Fin n) :
    sparseStackMatrix Z (g, a) i = invSqrt s *
      (if a = Z.hash g i then (Z.sgn g i).val else 0)

name: NLAlib.sparseStackMatrix_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.NLAlib.sparseStackMatrix_ne_zero_iff {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (hs : 0 < s)
    (g : Fin s) (a : Fin b) (i : Fin n) :
    sparseStackMatrix Z (g, a) i ≠ 0 ↔ a = Z.hash g i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.card_sign
statement: @[simp] theorem card_sign : Fintype.card Sign = 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selector_hash_uniform
statement:
theorem selector_hash_uniform {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (a : Fin b) :
    (selectorLaw b hb).prob {x | x.1 = a} = 1 / (b : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selector_sign_uniform
statement:
theorem selector_sign_uniform {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (e : Sign) :
    (selectorLaw b hb).prob {x | x.2 = e} = 1 / 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selector_singleton
statement:
theorem selector_singleton {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    (selectorLaw b hb).prob {x} = 1 / (2 * (b : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.SparseStackSelectors.toSample_hash
statement:
@[simp] theorem _root_.NLAlib.SparseStackSelectors.toSample_hash {s b n : ℕ}
    (z : SparseStackSelectors s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (i : Fin n) :
    (SparseStackSelectors.toSample z).hash g i = (z (g, i)).1

name: NLAlib.SparseStackSelectors.toSample_sign
statement:
@[simp] theorem _root_.NLAlib.SparseStackSelectors.toSample_sign {s b n : ℕ}
    (z : SparseStackSelectors s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (i : Fin n) :
    (SparseStackSelectors.toSample z).sgn g i = (z (g, i)).2

name: NLAlib.sparseStackSelectorLaw_coordinate_singleton
statement:
theorem _root_.NLAlib.sparseStackSelectorLaw_coordinate_singleton {s b n : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (p : Fin s × Fin n) (x : SignedHash b) :
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob {z | z p = x} = 1 / (2 * (b : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.sparseStackSelectorLaw_cylinder
statement:
theorem _root_.NLAlib.sparseStackSelectorLaw_cylinder {s b n : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (events : (Fin s × Fin n) → Set (SignedHash b)) :
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob (FiniteLaw.cylinder events) =
      ∏ p, (selectorLaw b hb).prob (events p)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_le_norm_le_expect_trace_pow_div
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.prob_le_norm_le_expect_trace_pow_div {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (A : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ ω, (A ω).IsHermitian) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    μ.prob {ω | ε ≤ ‖A ω‖} ≤
      μ.expect (fun ω => ((A ω) ^ (2 * q)).trace) / ε ^ (2 * q)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseStack_matrix_markov_tail
statement:
theorem sparseStack_matrix_markov_tail {s b n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob
        {z | ε ≤ ‖gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))‖} ≤
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
          (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        ε ^ (2 * q)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseStack_ose_failure_tail
statement:
theorem sparseStack_ose_failure_tail {s b n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob
        {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) ε} ≤
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
          (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        ε ^ (2 * q)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseStack_ose_success_probability
statement:
theorem sparseStack_ose_success_probability {s b n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (δ : ℝ)
    (hmoment :
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
          (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        ε ^ (2 * q) ≤ δ) :
    1 - δ ≤ (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob
      {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) ε}

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.MarkedSite.ext'
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.agreesOutsideSite_setSite
statement:
theorem agreesOutsideSite_setSite (p : Pattern m n) (s : Site m n) (a : Level) :
    agreesOutsideSite s p (setSite p s a)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.card_heavyInRow_setSite_two
statement:
theorem card_heavyInRow_setSite_two {p : Pattern m n} {r : Fin m} {i : Fin n}
    (hi : p (r, i) = .one) :
    ((setSite p (r, i) .two).heavyInRow r).card =
      (p.heavyInRow r).card + 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.card_heavy_after_promote_le_rowGrade
statement:
theorem card_heavy_after_promote_le_rowGrade
    {p : Pattern m n} {r : Fin m} {i : Fin n}
    (hi : p (r, i) = .one) :
    ((setSite p (r, i) .two).heavyInRow r).card ≤ rowGrade p r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.card_lightInRow_setSite_one
statement:
theorem card_lightInRow_setSite_one {p : Pattern m n} {r : Fin m} {i : Fin n}
    (hi : p (r, i) = .two) :
    ((setSite p (r, i) .one).lightInRow r).card =
      (p.lightInRow r).card + 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.card_light_after_demote_le_rowGrade
statement:
theorem card_light_after_demote_le_rowGrade
    {p : Pattern m n} {r : Fin m} {i : Fin n}
    (hi : p (r, i) = .two) :
    ((setSite p (r, i) .one).lightInRow r).card ≤ rowGrade p r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.eq_setSite_iff
statement:
theorem eq_setSite_iff {out inp : Pattern m n} {s : Site m n} (a : Level) :
    inp = setSite out s a ↔ agreesOutsideSite s out inp ∧ inp s = a

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.heavyInRow_setSite_two
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.lightInRow_setSite_one
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.setSite_apply_of_ne
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.setSite_apply_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem setSite_apply_self (p : Pattern m n) (s : Site m n) (a : Level) :
    setSite p s a s = a

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.setSite_restore
statement:
theorem setSite_restore (p : Pattern m n) (s : Site m n) {a b : Level}
    (hs : p s = a) : setSite (setSite p s b) s a = p

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.siteKernel_ketBra_apply
statement:
theorem siteKernel_ketBra_apply (s : Site m n) (outLevel inpLevel : Level)
    (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    siteKernel s (ketBra outLevel inpLevel) out inp =
      if out s = outLevel ∧ inp = setSite out s inpLevel then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_markedSite
statement:
theorem sum_markedSite (a : Level) (f : Pattern m n → Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i ↦ p (r, i) = a), f p r i) =
      ∑ z : MarkedSite m n a, f z.pattern z.row z.col

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_markedTransition
statement:
theorem sum_markedTransition (a b : Level)
    (f : MarkedSite m n b → ℝ) :
    (∑ z : MarkedSite m n a, f (markedTransition a b z)) =
      ∑ z : MarkedSite m n b, f z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_marked_reindex
statement:
theorem sum_marked_reindex (a b : Level) (f : MarkedSite m n a → ℝ) :
    (∑ z : MarkedSite m n a, f z) =
      ∑ z : MarkedSite m n b, f ((markedTransition a b).symm z)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_rowGrade
statement:
theorem sum_rowGrade (p : Pattern m n) :
    (∑ r, rowGrade p r) = p.grade

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem ADownMatrix_mulVec (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (ADownMatrix F r) x σ =
      ∑ i ∈ σ.lightInRow r,
        analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .two)) i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem AUpMatrix_mulVec (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (AUpMatrix F r) x σ =
      ∑ i ∈ σ.heavyInRow r,
        analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.fiber_gradeProjection
statement:
theorem fiber_gradeProjection (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    Directional.fiber (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) p =
      if p.grade = nu then Directional.fiber x p else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.one_rDown_analysis
statement:
theorem one_rDown_analysis (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (σ : Pattern m n) :
    (∑ inp : Fin d × Pattern m n,
        (F.u i inp.1 * rDownAt r i σ inp.2) * x inp) =
      if σ (r, i) = .one then
        analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .two)) i else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.one_rUp_analysis
statement:
theorem one_rUp_analysis (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (σ : Pattern m n) :
    (∑ inp : Fin d × Pattern m n,
        (F.u i inp.1 * rUpAt r i σ inp.2) * x inp) =
      if σ (r, i) = .two then
        analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rDownAt_apply
statement:
theorem rDownAt_apply (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    rDownAt r i out inp =
      if out (r, i) = .one ∧ inp = setSite out (r, i) .two then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rDownAt_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem rDownAt_transpose (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    (rDownAt r i).transpose = rUpAt r i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rUpAt_apply
statement:
theorem rUpAt_apply (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    rUpAt r i out inp =
      if out (r, i) = .two ∧ inp = setSite out (r, i) .one then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rUpAt_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem rUpAt_transpose (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    (rUpAt r i).transpose = rDownAt r i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.weighted_gradeProjection
statement:
theorem weighted_gradeProjection (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq
      (Directional.fiber (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) p)) =
      (nu : ℝ) * sumSq
        (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUp_energy_le_weighted
statement:
theorem AUp_energy_le_weighted (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpMatrix F r) x)) ≤
      ∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADown_energy_le_weighted
statement:
theorem ADown_energy_le_weighted (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownMatrix F r) x)) ≤
      ∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADown_grade_energy
statement:
theorem ADown_grade_energy (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownMatrix F r)
      (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x))) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUp_grade_energy
statement:
theorem AUp_grade_energy (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpMatrix F r)
      (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x))) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownMatrix_grade_relation
statement:
theorem ADownMatrix_grade_relation (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {out : Pattern m n} {inp : Fin d × Pattern m n}
    (hentry : ADownMatrix F r out inp ≠ 0) :
    (out.grade : ℤ) + 1 = (inp.2.grade : ℤ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpMatrix_eq_sum_one
statement:
theorem AUpMatrix_eq_sum_one (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    AUpMatrix F r = ∑ i, AUpOne F r i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpMatrix_grade_relation
statement:
theorem AUpMatrix_grade_relation (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {out : Pattern m n} {inp : Fin d × Pattern m n}
    (hentry : AUpMatrix F r out inp ≠ 0) :
    (out.grade : ℤ) = (inp.2.grade : ℤ) + 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.BUpMatrix_eq_sum_one
statement:
theorem BUpMatrix_eq_sum_one (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    BUpMatrix F r = ∑ i, BUpOne F r i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.BUpMatrix_mul_AUpMatrix
statement:
theorem BUpMatrix_mul_AUpMatrix (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    BUpMatrix F r * AUpMatrix F r =
      ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rUp, .rUp)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.BUpOne_mul_AUpOne_of_ne
statement:
theorem BUpOne_mul_AUpOne_of_ne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    BUpOne F r i * AUpOne F r j =
      orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rUp, .rUp)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.BUpOne_mul_AUpOne_self
statement:
theorem BUpOne_mul_AUpOne_self (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    BUpOne F r i * AUpOne F r i = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.BUpStack_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem BUpStack_transpose (F : Frame n d) :
    (BUpStack (m := m) F).transpose = ADownStack (m := m) F

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hplus_eq_BUpStack_mul_AUpStack
statement:
theorem Hplus_eq_BUpStack_mul_AUpStack (F : Frame n d) :
    Hplus m (Frame.rows F) = BUpStack (m := m) F * AUpStack (m := m) F

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rUpAt_mul_rUpAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem rUpAt_mul_rUpAt_of_ne (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    rUpAt r i * rUpAt r j = wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.rUp, .rUp)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rUpAt_sq_zero
statement:
theorem rUpAt_sq_zero (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    rUpAt r i * rUpAt r i = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownStack_gradeProjection_zero
statement:
theorem ADownStack_gradeProjection_zero (F : Frame n d) :
    ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) 0 = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowGradeProjection_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem rowGradeProjection_norm_le_one (mu : ℕ) :
    ‖rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu‖ ≤ 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowGradeProjection_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowGradeProjection_transpose (mu : ℕ) :
    (rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu).transpose = rowGradeProjection mu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowProjection_ADownStack_input
statement:
theorem rowProjection_ADownStack_input (F : Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
    rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu * ADownStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (mu + 1) =
      rowGradeProjection mu * ADownStack (m := m) F

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowProjection_ADownStack_output
statement:
theorem rowProjection_ADownStack_output (F : Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
    rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu * ADownStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (mu + 1) =
      ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (mu + 1)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowProjection_AUpStack_gradeProjection
statement:
theorem rowProjection_AUpStack_gradeProjection (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1) * AUpStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu =
      AUpStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowProjection_AUpStack_input
statement:
theorem rowProjection_AUpStack_input (F : Frame n d) (k : ℕ) :
    rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1) * AUpStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) k =
      rowGradeProjection (k + 1) * AUpStack (m := m) F

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowProjection_zero_AUpStack
statement:
theorem rowProjection_zero_AUpStack (F : Frame n d) :
    rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) 0 * AUpStack (m := m) F = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownStack_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem ADownStack_gradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpStack_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem AUpStack_gradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖AUpStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.BUpMatrix_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem BUpMatrix_transpose (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    (BUpMatrix F r).transpose = ADownMatrix F r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.BUpStack_rowGradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem BUpStack_rowGradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
    ‖BUpStack (m := m) F * rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (mu + 1)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hplus_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem Hplus_gradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Hplus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ (nu : ℝ) + 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hplus_grade_factor
statement:
theorem Hplus_grade_factor (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    Hplus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu =
      (BUpStack (m := m) F * rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)) *
        (AUpStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.coordNormSq_ADownStack
statement:
theorem coordNormSq_ADownStack (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownStack F) x) =
      ∑ r, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownMatrix F r) x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.coordNormSq_AUpStack
statement:
theorem coordNormSq_AUpStack (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpStack F) x) =
      ∑ r, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpMatrix F r) x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sqrt_mul_sqrt_add_two_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_sqrt_add_two_le (nu : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (nu + 2) * Real.sqrt nu ≤ (nu : ℝ) + 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpStackTranspose_rowGradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem AUpStackTranspose_rowGradeProjection_norm
    (F : Frame n d) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖(AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose *
        rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hminus_eq_AUpStackTranspose_mul_ADownStack
statement:
theorem Hminus_eq_AUpStackTranspose_mul_ADownStack (F : Frame n d) :
    Hminus m (Frame.rows F) =
      (AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose * ADownStack (m := m) F

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hminus_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem Hminus_gradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Hminus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ (nu : ℝ) + 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hminus_gradeProjection_one
statement:
theorem Hminus_gradeProjection_one (F : Frame n d) :
    Hminus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) 1 = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hminus_gradeProjection_zero
statement:
theorem Hminus_gradeProjection_zero (F : Frame n d) :
    Hminus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) 0 = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hminus_grade_factor_add_two
statement:
theorem Hminus_grade_factor_add_two (F : Frame n d) (k : ℕ) :
    Hminus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2) =
      ((AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose *
        rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1)) *
      (ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hplus_transpose_eq_Hminus
statement:
theorem Hplus_transpose_eq_Hminus (F : Frame n d) :
    (Hplus m (Frame.rows F)).transpose = Hminus m (Frame.rows F)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownMatrix_eq_sum_one
statement:
theorem ADownMatrix_eq_sum_one (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    ADownMatrix F r = ∑ i, ADownOne F r i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownMatrix_gram_row
statement:
theorem ADownMatrix_gram_row (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    (ADownMatrix F r).transpose * ADownMatrix F r =
      (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rUp, .rDown)) +
      ∑ i, (ADownOne F r i).transpose * ADownOne F r i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownOne_transpose_mul_ADownOne_of_ne
statement:
theorem ADownOne_transpose_mul_ADownOne_of_ne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (ADownOne F r i).transpose * ADownOne F r j =
      orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rUp, .rDown)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownStack_gram
statement:
theorem ADownStack_gram (F : Frame n d) :
    (ADownStack (m := m) F).transpose * ADownStack (m := m) F =
      wordSum m (Frame.rows F) .rUp .rDown + DDown (m := m) F

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpMatrix_gram_row
statement:
theorem AUpMatrix_gram_row (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    (AUpMatrix F r).transpose * AUpMatrix F r =
      (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rDown, .rUp)) +
      ∑ i, (AUpOne F r i).transpose * AUpOne F r i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpOne_transpose_mul_AUpOne_of_ne
statement:
theorem AUpOne_transpose_mul_AUpOne_of_ne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (AUpOne F r i).transpose * AUpOne F r j =
      orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rDown, .rUp)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpStack_gram
statement:
theorem AUpStack_gram (F : Frame n d) :
    (AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose * AUpStack (m := m) F =
      wordSum m (Frame.rows F) .rDown .rUp + DUp (m := m) F

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rDownAt_mul_rUpAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem rDownAt_mul_rUpAt_of_ne (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    rDownAt r i * rUpAt r j = wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.rDown, .rUp)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rUpAt_mul_rDownAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem rUpAt_mul_rDownAt_of_ne (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    rUpAt r i * rDownAt r j = wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.rUp, .rDown)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownOne_mulVec
statement:
theorem ADownOne_mulVec (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (ADownOne F r i) x σ =
      if σ (r, i) = .one then
        analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .two)) i else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpOne_mulVec
statement:
theorem AUpOne_mulVec (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (AUpOne F r i) x σ =
      if σ (r, i) = .two then
        analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DDown_energy_le_weighted
statement:
theorem DDown_energy_le_weighted (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownOne F r i) x)) ≤
      ∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DUp_energy_le_weighted
statement:
theorem DUp_energy_le_weighted (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpOne F r i) x)) ≤
      ∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_gram_sub_diagonal
statement:
theorem Hzero_gram_sub_diagonal (F : Frame n d) :
    Hzero m (Frame.rows F) =
      (AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose * AUpStack (m := m) F +
      (ADownStack (m := m) F).transpose * ADownStack (m := m) F -
      (DUp (m := m) F + DDown (m := m) F)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.subset_analysis_le_card_mul
statement:
theorem subset_analysis_le_card_mul (F : Frame n d) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (v : EVec d) :
    (∑ i ∈ S, (analyze F v i) ^ 2) ≤
      (S.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq v

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DDown_energy_eq_heavy
statement:
theorem DDown_energy_eq_heavy (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownOne F r i) x)) =
      ∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ p.heavyInRow r,
        (analyze F (Directional.fiber x p) i) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DUp_energy_eq_light
statement:
theorem DUp_energy_eq_light (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpOne F r i) x)) =
      ∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ p.lightInRow r,
        (analyze F (Directional.fiber x p) i) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Dcombined_energy_le_weighted
statement:
theorem Dcombined_energy_le_weighted (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpOne F r i) x)) +
      (∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownOne F r i) x)) ≤
      ∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_gradeConj_isHermitian
statement:
theorem Hzero_gradeConj_isHermitian (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    (gradeProjection (d := d) nu * Hzero m (Frame.rows F) *
      gradeProjection nu).IsHermitian

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_gradeConj_quadratic_abs_le
statement:
theorem Hzero_gradeConj_quadratic_abs_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    |quadForm
      (gradeProjection (d := d) nu * Hzero m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection nu) x| ≤
      2 * (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem Hzero_gradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Hzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      2 * (nu : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_grade_factor
statement:
theorem Hzero_grade_factor (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) nu * Hzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection nu =
      Hzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_homogeneous
statement:
theorem Hzero_homogeneous (F : Frame n d) :
    IsFullGradeShift 0 (Hzero m (Frame.rows F))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_transpose
statement:
theorem Hzero_transpose (F : Frame n d) :
    (Hzero m (Frame.rows F)).transpose = Hzero m (Frame.rows F)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_DDown
statement:
theorem quadratic_DDown (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (DDown (m := m) F) x =
      ∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownOne F r i) x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_DUp
statement:
theorem quadratic_DUp (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (DUp (m := m) F) x =
      ∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpOne F r i) x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_Hzero
statement:
theorem quadratic_Hzero (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (Hzero m (Frame.rows F)) x =
      sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpStack (m := m) F) x) +
      sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownStack (m := m) F) x) -
      (quadForm (DUp (m := m) F) x + quadForm (DDown (m := m) F) x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_gradeConj
statement:
theorem quadratic_gradeConj (M : FullOp d m n) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (gradeProjection (d := d) nu * M * gradeProjection nu) x =
      quadForm M (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_gram
statement:
theorem quadratic_gram
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I]
    (A : Matrix I J ℝ) (x : J → ℝ) :
    quadForm (A.transpose * A) x =
      sumSq (Matrix.mulVec A x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.norm_normalized_Hminus_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_Hminus_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 •
          Hminus (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      cTerm (nu : ℝ) (s : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.norm_normalized_Hplus_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_Hplus_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 •
          Hplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      cTerm (nu : ℝ) (s : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.norm_normalized_Hzero_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_Hzero_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 •
          Hzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      2 * cTerm (nu : ℝ) (s : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.norm_normalized_heavy_term_eq
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_heavy_term_eq {s b : ℕ}
    (A : FullOp d m n) (P : FullOp d m n) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 • A)) * P‖ =
      (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) * ‖A * P‖

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockGram_of_pairwise_certificate
statement:
theorem blockGram_of_pairwise_certificate {ell : ℕ} (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    {d quadratic : ℝ}
    (energy diagonal : Fin ell → ℝ)
    (cross : Fin ell → Fin ell → ℝ)
    (hquadratic : quadratic ≤
      (∑ i, diagonal i) +
        ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), cross i j)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, diagonal i ≤ d * energy i)
    (hcross : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      cross i j ≤ (energy i + energy j) / 2) :
    quadratic ≤ (d + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.compressed_lightSector_bound
statement:
theorem compressed_lightSector_bound
    {d ell hard bosonic energy : ℝ}
    (hcompression : hard ≤ bosonic)
    (hbosonic : bosonic ≤ (d + ell - 1) * energy) :
    hard ≤ (d + ell - 1) * energy

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.offDiagonal_sum_le
statement:
theorem offDiagonal_sum_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (energy : Fin ell → ℝ) (cross : Fin ell → Fin ell → ℝ)
    (hcross : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      cross i j ≤ (energy i + energy j) / 2) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), cross i j) ≤
      ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_offDiagonal_left
statement:
theorem sum_offDiagonal_left {ell : ℕ} (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (energy : Fin ell → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ _j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), energy i) =
      ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_offDiagonal_right
statement:
theorem sum_offDiagonal_right {ell : ℕ} (_hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (energy : Fin ell → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), energy j) =
      ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_transpose_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem CMatrix_transpose_apply (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    (p : Pattern m n) (out : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    (CMatrix F r).transpose p out =
      ∑ i, F.u i out.1 * pAt r i p out.2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockProjection_apply (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    blockProjection (d := d) T ell out inp =
      if out = inp ∧ InBlock T ell out.2 then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockProjection_mul_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockProjection_mul_self (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    blockProjection (d := d) T ell * blockProjection T ell =
      blockProjection T ell

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockProjection_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockProjection_transpose (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    (blockProjection (d := d) T ell).transpose = blockProjection T ell

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.columnGramApply_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnGramApply_apply (F : Frame n d) (x : EVec n) (i : Fin n) :
    columnGramApply F x i = ∑ j, columnGram F i j * x j

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.columnGramApply_eq_analyze_synthesize
statement:
theorem columnGramApply_eq_analyze_synthesize (F : Frame n d) (x : EVec n)
    (i : Fin n) :
    columnGramApply F x i =
      analyze F (synthesize F Finset.univ (fun j ↦ x j)) i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.columnGram_energy_le
statement:
theorem columnGram_energy_le (F : Frame n d) (x : EVec n) :
    euclideanNormSq (columnGramApply F x) ≤
      euclideanNormSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_apply
statement:
theorem ghat_apply (F : Frame n d)
    (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    ghat (m := m) F out inp =
      ∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
          (pDagAt r i * pAt r j) out.2 inp.2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem ghat_transpose (F : Frame n d) :
    (ghat (m := m) F).transpose = ghat F

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sharedQ_apply
statement:
theorem sharedQ_apply (F : Frame n d)
    (out inp : Fin d × Site m n) :
    sharedQ F out inp =
      if out.2.1 = inp.2.1 then
        F.u out.2.2 out.1 * F.u inp.2.2 inp.1
      else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sharedVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sharedVector_apply (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    (a : Fin d) (s : Site m n) :
    sharedVector F r (a, s) = if s.1 = r then F.u s.2 a else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sharedVector_apply_index
statement:
@[simp] theorem sharedVector_apply_index (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    (z : Fin d × Site m n) :
    sharedVector F r z =
      if z.2.1 = r then F.u z.2.2 z.1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sharedVector_inner
statement:
theorem sharedVector_inner (F : Frame n d) (r q : Fin m) :
    inner ℝ (sharedVector F r) (sharedVector F q) =
      if r = q then (d : ℝ) else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sharedVector_normSq
statement:
theorem sharedVector_normSq (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    inner ℝ (sharedVector F r) (sharedVector F r) = (d : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_frame_coordinate_sq_eq_dim
statement:
theorem sum_frame_coordinate_sq_eq_dim (F : Frame n d) :
    (∑ a, ∑ i, F.u i a * F.u i a) = (d : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_frame_normSq_eq_dim
statement:
theorem sum_frame_normSq_eq_dim (F : Frame n d) :
    (∑ i, euclideanNormSq (F.u i)) = (d : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.two_columnGram_pairing_le
statement:
theorem two_columnGram_pairing_le (F : Frame n d) (x y : EVec n) :
    2 * inner ℝ (columnGramApply F x) y ≤
      euclideanNormSq x + euclideanNormSq y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.VMatrix_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem VMatrix_mul_transpose (F : Frame n d) (k : Fin ell) :
    VMatrix (m := m) F k * (VMatrix (m := m) F k).transpose =
      qSlot (m := m) F k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainOfWord_eq_iff
statement:
theorem domainOfWord_eq_iff {ell : ℕ} (k : Fin ell)
    (w v : Fin ell → Site m n) :
    domainOfWord k w = domainOfWord k v ↔
      (w k).1 = (v k).1 ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ k → w j = v j

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainOfWord_wordOfDomain
statement:
@[simp] theorem domainOfWord_wordOfDomain {ell : ℕ} (k : Fin ell)
    (z : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k) (i : Fin n) :
    domainOfWord k (wordOfDomain k z i) = z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.qSlot_relabelSlots
statement:
theorem qSlot_relabelSlots (F : Frame n d) (k : Fin ell)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell))
    (out inp : LabelledIndex d m n ell) :
    qSlot F k (relabelSlots pi out) (relabelSlots pi inp) =
      qSlot F (pi k) out inp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.transpose_VMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem transpose_VMatrix_mul (F : Frame n d) (k : Fin ell) :
    (VMatrix (m := m) F k).transpose * VMatrix (m := m) F k =
      (d : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k)
        (ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k) ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.transpose_VMatrix_mul_apply
statement:
theorem transpose_VMatrix_mul_apply (F : Frame n d) (k : Fin ell)
    (z z' : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k) :
    ((VMatrix (m := m) F k).transpose * VMatrix (m := m) F k) z z' =
      if z = z' then (d : ℝ) else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.wordOfDomain_at
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordOfDomain_at {ell : ℕ} (k : Fin ell)
    (z : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k) (i : Fin n) :
    wordOfDomain k z i k = (z.1, i)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.wordOfDomain_domainOfWord
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordOfDomain_domainOfWord {ell : ℕ} (k : Fin ell)
    (w : Fin ell → Site m n) :
    wordOfDomain k (domainOfWord k w) (w k).2 = w

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.wordOfDomain_off
statement:
theorem wordOfDomain_off {ell : ℕ} (k : Fin ell)
    (z : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k) (i : Fin n)
    (j : Fin ell) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    wordOfDomain k z i j = z.2 ⟨j, hjk⟩

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainKToFiber_fiberToDomainK
statement:
@[simp] theorem domainKToFiber_fiberToDomainK (k l : Fin ell)
    (hkl : k ≠ l) (z : CrossFiberIndex m n ell k l × Fin n) :
    domainKToFiber k l hkl (fiberToDomainK k l hkl z) = z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainLToFiber_fiberToDomainL
statement:
@[simp] theorem domainLToFiber_fiberToDomainL (k l : Fin ell)
    (hkl : k ≠ l) (z : CrossFiberIndex m n ell k l × Fin n) :
    domainLToFiber k l hkl (fiberToDomainL k l hkl z) = z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normSq_eq_coordinateEnergy
statement:
theorem normSq_eq_coordinateEnergy (x : EVec n) :
    euclideanNormSq x = sumSq (fun i ↦ x i)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_prod3
statement:
theorem sum_prod3 {A B C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype C]
    (f : A × B × C → ℝ) :
    (∑ t, f t) = ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, f (a, b, c)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.crossMatrix_energy_le
statement:
theorem crossMatrix_energy_le (F : Frame n d)
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l)
    (y : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell l → ℝ) :
    sumSq ((crossMatrix F k l hkl).mulVec y) ≤
      sumSq y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.crossMatrix_mulVec_fiber
statement:
theorem crossMatrix_mulVec_fiber (F : Frame n d)
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l)
    (y : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell l → ℝ)
    (fiber : CrossFiberIndex m n ell k l) (i : Fin n) :
    (crossMatrix F k l hkl).mulVec y
        (fiberToDomainK k l hkl (fiber, i)) =
      columnGramApply F (domainLSlice k l hkl y fiber) i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainKToFiber_domainOf_crossWord
statement:
@[simp] theorem domainKToFiber_domainOf_crossWord
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l)
    (fiber : CrossFiberIndex m n ell k l) (i j : Fin n) :
    domainKToFiber k l hkl (domainOfWord k (wordOfCross k l hkl fiber i j)) =
      (fiber, i)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainLSlice_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem domainLSlice_apply (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l)
    (y : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell l → ℝ)
    (fiber : CrossFiberIndex m n ell k l) (j : Fin n) :
    domainLSlice k l hkl y fiber j =
      y (fiberToDomainL k l hkl (fiber, j))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainLToFiber_domainOf_crossWord
statement:
@[simp] theorem domainLToFiber_domainOf_crossWord
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l)
    (fiber : CrossFiberIndex m n ell k l) (i j : Fin n) :
    domainLToFiber k l hkl (domainOfWord l (wordOfCross k l hkl fiber i j)) =
      (fiber, j)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.eq_domainOf_crossWord_k_iff
statement:
theorem eq_domainOf_crossWord_k_iff
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l)
    (zk : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k)
    (fiber : CrossFiberIndex m n ell k l) (i j : Fin n) :
    zk = domainOfWord k (wordOfCross k l hkl fiber i j) ↔
      domainKToFiber k l hkl zk = (fiber, i)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.eq_domainOf_crossWord_l_iff
statement:
theorem eq_domainOf_crossWord_l_iff
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l)
    (zl : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell l)
    (fiber : CrossFiberIndex m n ell k l) (i j : Fin n) :
    zl = domainOfWord l (wordOfCross k l hkl fiber i j) ↔
      domainLToFiber k l hkl zl = (fiber, j)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.transpose_VMatrix_mul_cross
statement:
theorem transpose_VMatrix_mul_cross (F : Frame n d)
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    (VMatrix (m := m) F k).transpose * VMatrix (m := m) F l =
      crossMatrix F k l hkl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.wordOfCross_at_k
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordOfCross_at_k (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l)
    (fiber : CrossFiberIndex m n ell k l) (i j : Fin n) :
    wordOfCross k l hkl fiber i j k = (fiber.1.1, j)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.wordOfCross_at_l
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordOfCross_at_l (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l)
    (fiber : CrossFiberIndex m n ell k l) (i j : Fin n) :
    wordOfCross k l hkl fiber i j l = (fiber.1.2, i)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.wordOfCross_off
statement:
theorem wordOfCross_off (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l)
    (fiber : CrossFiberIndex m n ell k l) (i j : Fin n)
    (t : Fin ell) (htk : t ≠ k) (htl : t ≠ l) :
    wordOfCross k l hkl fiber i j t = fiber.2 ⟨t, htk, htl⟩

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.crossPairingTotal_le_half
statement:
theorem crossPairingTotal_le_half (F : Frame n d) (z : DomainFamily m n ell)
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    crossPairingTotal F z k l ≤
      (componentEnergy z k + componentEnergy z l) / 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.crossPairing_le_half
statement:
theorem crossPairing_le_half (F : Frame n d) (z : DomainFamily m n ell)
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    crossPairing F z k l hkl ≤
      (componentEnergy z k + componentEnergy z l) / 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sharedLegGramQuadratic_le
statement:
theorem sharedLegGramQuadratic_le (F : Frame n d) (z : DomainFamily m n ell)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    sharedLegGramQuadratic F z ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ k, componentEnergy z k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.two_crossPairing_le
statement:
theorem two_crossPairing_le (F : Frame n d) (z : DomainFamily m n ell)
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    2 * crossPairing F z k l hkl ≤
      componentEnergy z k + componentEnergy z l

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.VAllMatrix_energy_le
statement:
theorem VAllMatrix_energy_le (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    sumSq ((VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell).mulVec z) ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * sumSq z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.VAllMatrix_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem VAllMatrix_mul_transpose (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ) :
    VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell * (VAllMatrix F ell).transpose =
      labelledG F ell

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockGramPairing_cross
statement:
theorem blockGramPairing_cross (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    blockGramPairing F ell z k l =
      crossPairing F (sigmaToFamily z) k l hkl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockGramPairing_self
statement:
theorem blockGramPairing_self (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) (k : Fin ell) :
    blockGramPairing F ell z k k =
      (d : ℝ) * componentEnergy (sigmaToFamily z) k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.coordinateEnergy_mulVec_eq_gram
statement:
theorem coordinateEnergy_mulVec_eq_gram
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (A : Matrix I J ℝ) (x : J → ℝ) :
    sumSq (A.mulVec x) =
      quadForm (A.transpose * A) x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.coordinateEnergy_sigma
statement:
theorem coordinateEnergy_sigma (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) :
    sumSq z = ∑ k, componentEnergy (sigmaToFamily z) k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.coordinateQuadratic_VAll_gram_eq_sharedLeg
statement:
theorem coordinateQuadratic_VAll_gram_eq_sharedLeg
    (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ) (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) :
    quadForm
        ((VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell).transpose * VAllMatrix F ell) z =
      sharedLegGramQuadratic F (sigmaToFamily z)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.coordinateQuadratic_VAll_gram_eq_sum_blocks
statement:
theorem coordinateQuadratic_VAll_gram_eq_sum_blocks
    (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ) (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) :
    quadForm
        ((VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell).transpose * VAllMatrix F ell) z =
      ∑ k, ∑ l, blockGramPairing F ell z k l

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.coordinate_dot_sq_le
statement:
theorem coordinate_dot_sq_le {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (x y : I → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, x i * y i) ^ 2 ≤ sumSq x * sumSq y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.gramQuadratic_le_of_energy_le
statement:
theorem gramQuadratic_le_of_energy_le
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (A : Matrix I J ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hA : ∀ z : J → ℝ,
      sumSq (A.mulVec z) ≤ c * sumSq z)
    (x : I → ℝ) :
    quadForm (A * A.transpose) x ≤
      c * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_coordinateQuadratic_le
statement:
theorem labelledG_coordinateQuadratic_le (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (x : LabelledIndex d m n ell → ℝ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    quadForm (labelledG F ell) x ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_coordinateQuadratic_nonneg
statement:
theorem labelledG_coordinateQuadratic_nonneg (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (x : LabelledIndex d m n ell → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ quadForm (labelledG F ell) x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_isHermitian
statement:
theorem labelledG_isHermitian (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ) :
    (labelledG (m := m) F ell).IsHermitian

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_norm_le
statement:
theorem labelledG_norm_le (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    ‖labelledG (m := m) F ell‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_norm_le_grade
statement:
theorem labelledG_norm_le_grade (F : Frame n d) (ell nu : ℕ)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hle : ell ≤ nu) :
    ‖labelledG (m := m) F ell‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_relabelSlots
statement:
theorem labelledG_relabelSlots (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell))
    (out inp : LabelledIndex d m n ell) :
    labelledG F ell (relabelSlots pi out) (relabelSlots pi inp) =
      labelledG F ell out inp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem labelledG_transpose (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ) :
    (labelledG (m := m) F ell).transpose = labelledG F ell

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.qSlot_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem qSlot_transpose (F : Frame n d) (k : Fin ell) :
    (qSlot (m := m) F k).transpose = qSlot F k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_blockGramPairing_eq_sharedLeg
statement:
theorem sum_blockGramPairing_eq_sharedLeg (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) :
    (∑ k, ∑ l, blockGramPairing F ell z k l) =
      sharedLegGramQuadratic F (sigmaToFamily z)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockLabel_eq_iff
statement:
theorem blockLabel_eq_iff (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (x y : BlockIndex d T ell) (pi sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) :
    blockLabel T ell x pi = blockLabel T ell y sigma ↔
      x = y ∧ pi = sigma

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.canonicalLightWord_injective
statement:
theorem canonicalLightWord_injective (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) :
    Function.Injective (canonicalLightWord T ell p)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.canonicalLightWord_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem canonicalLightWord_mem (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) (k : Fin ell) :
    canonicalLightWord T ell p k ∈ p.1.light

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.canonicalLightWord_surjective
statement:
theorem canonicalLightWord_surjective (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) (s : Site m n) :
    s ∈ p.1.light ↔ ∃ k, canonicalLightWord T ell p k = s

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_blockLabel_relative
statement:
theorem labelledG_blockLabel_relative
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (x y : BlockIndex d T ell)
    (pi sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) :
    labelledG F ell (blockLabel T ell x pi) (blockLabel T ell y sigma) =
      labelledG F ell
        (blockLabel T ell x (Equiv.refl (Fin ell)))
        (blockLabel T ell y (pi.symm.trans sigma))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pattern_eq_of_light_heavy_eq
statement:
theorem pattern_eq_of_light_heavy_eq {p q : Pattern m n}
    (hlight : p.light = q.light) (hheavy : p.heavy = q.heavy) : p = q

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutationCount_pos
statement: theorem permutationCount_pos (ell : ℕ) : 0 < permutationCount ell

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_eq_iff
statement:
theorem permutedLightWord_eq_iff
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p q : BlockPattern T ell)
    (pi sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) :
    permutedLightWord T ell p pi = permutedLightWord T ell q sigma ↔
      p = q ∧ pi = sigma

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_injective
statement:
theorem permutedLightWord_injective (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) :
    Function.Injective (permutedLightWord T ell p pi)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem permutedLightWord_mem (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) (k : Fin ell) :
    permutedLightWord T ell p pi k ∈ p.1.light

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_permutationOfLightWord
statement:
@[simp] theorem permutedLightWord_permutationOfLightWord
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) (p : BlockPattern T ell)
    (w : Fin ell → Site m n)
    (hmem : ∀ k, w k ∈ p.1.light) (hinj : Function.Injective w) :
    permutedLightWord T ell p
      (permutationOfLightWord T ell p w hmem hinj) = w

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_refl
statement:
@[simp] theorem permutedLightWord_refl (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) (k : Fin ell) :
    permutedLightWord T ell p (Equiv.refl (Fin ell)) k =
      canonicalLightWord T ell p k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_refl_fun
statement:
@[simp] theorem permutedLightWord_refl_fun
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) (p : BlockPattern T ell) :
    permutedLightWord T ell p (Equiv.refl (Fin ell)) =
      canonicalLightWord T ell p

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_surjective
statement:
theorem permutedLightWord_surjective (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) (s : Site m n) :
    s ∈ p.1.light ↔ ∃ k, permutedLightWord T ell p pi k = s

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.relabelSlots_blockLabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem relabelSlots_blockLabel
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (rho pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) (x : BlockIndex d T ell) :
    relabelSlots rho (blockLabel T ell x pi) =
      blockLabel T ell x (rho.trans pi)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_coordinateDelta_mul_coordinateDelta
statement:
theorem sum_coordinateDelta_mul_coordinateDelta
    {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (x y : I) :
    (∑ z, coordinateDelta z x * coordinateDelta z y) =
      coordinateDelta x y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_sum_labelledG_blockLabel
statement:
theorem sum_sum_labelledG_blockLabel
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (x y : BlockIndex d T ell) :
    (∑ pi, ∑ sigma,
      labelledG F ell (blockLabel T ell x pi) (blockLabel T ell y sigma)) =
      (permutationCount ell : ℝ) *
        ∑ tau, labelledG F ell
          (blockLabel T ell x (Equiv.refl (Fin ell)))
          (blockLabel T ell y tau)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_coordinateQuadratic_le
statement:
theorem hardCoreCompressedG_coordinateQuadratic_le
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (x : BlockIndex d T ell → ℝ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    quadForm (hardCoreCompressedG F T ell) x ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_coordinateQuadratic_nonneg
statement:
theorem hardCoreCompressedG_coordinateQuadratic_nonneg
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (x : BlockIndex d T ell → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ quadForm (hardCoreCompressedG F T ell) x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_isHermitian
statement:
theorem hardCoreCompressedG_isHermitian
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    (hardCoreCompressedG F T ell).IsHermitian

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_norm_le
statement:
theorem hardCoreCompressedG_norm_le
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    ‖hardCoreCompressedG F T ell‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_norm_le_grade
statement:
theorem hardCoreCompressedG_norm_le_grade
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell nu : ℕ)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hle : ell ≤ nu) :
    ‖hardCoreCompressedG F T ell‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem hardCoreCompressedG_transpose
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    (hardCoreCompressedG F T ell).transpose = hardCoreCompressedG F T ell

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreEmbedding_energy
statement:
theorem hardCoreEmbedding_energy (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (x : BlockIndex d T ell → ℝ) :
    sumSq ((hardCoreEmbedding (d := d) T ell).mulVec x) =
      sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreEmbedding_transpose_mul
statement:
theorem hardCoreEmbedding_transpose_mul
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    (hardCoreEmbedding (d := d) T ell).transpose *
        hardCoreEmbedding (d := d) T ell =
      (1 : Matrix (BlockIndex d T ell) (BlockIndex d T ell) ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreLift_compression_apply
statement:
theorem hardCoreLift_compression_apply
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (LabelledIndex d m n ell) (LabelledIndex d m n ell) ℝ)
    (x y : BlockIndex d T ell) :
    ((hardCoreLift (d := d) T ell).transpose * A *
      hardCoreLift (d := d) T ell) x y =
      ∑ pi, ∑ sigma, A (blockLabel T ell x pi) (blockLabel T ell y sigma)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreLift_transpose_mul
statement:
theorem hardCoreLift_transpose_mul (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    (hardCoreLift (d := d) T ell).transpose * hardCoreLift T ell =
      (permutationCount ell : ℝ) •
        (1 : Matrix (BlockIndex d T ell) (BlockIndex d T ell) ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_comm_four
statement:
theorem sum_comm_four
    {A B C D : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype C] [Fintype D]
    (f : A → B → C → D → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ d, f a b c d) =
      ∑ c, ∑ d, ∑ a, ∑ b, f a b c d

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.card_light_lightMove_of_legal
statement:
theorem card_light_lightMove_of_legal
    (inp : Pattern m n) (source target : Site m n)
    (hsource : inp source = .one)
    (havailable : target = source ∨ inp target = .zero) :
    (lightMove inp source target).light.card = inp.light.card

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.eq_update_iff
statement:
theorem eq_update_iff (s : Site m n) (v : Level)
    (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    out = Function.update inp s v ↔
      out s = v ∧ agreesOutsideSite s out inp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_apply_eq_zero_of_block_ne
statement:
theorem ghat_apply_eq_zero_of_block_ne
    (F : Frame n d) (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n)
    (hne : out.2.heavy ≠ inp.2.heavy ∨
      out.2.light.card ≠ inp.2.light.card) :
    ghat (m := m) F out inp = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.heavy_lightMove_of_legal
statement:
theorem heavy_lightMove_of_legal (inp : Pattern m n) (source target : Site m n)
    (hsource : inp source = .one)
    (havailable : target = source ∨ inp target = .zero) :
    (lightMove inp source target).heavy = inp.heavy

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.light_lightMove_of_legal
statement:
theorem light_lightMove_of_legal (inp : Pattern m n) (source target : Site m n)
    (_hsource : inp source = .one)
    (_havailable : target = source ∨ inp target = .zero) :
    (lightMove inp source target).light = insert target (inp.light.erase source)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pAt_apply_characterization
statement:
theorem pAt_apply_characterization (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    pAt r i out inp =
      if inp (r, i) = .one ∧
          out = Function.update inp (r, i) .zero then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_apply_characterization
statement:
theorem pDagAt_apply_characterization (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    pDagAt r i out inp =
      if inp (r, i) = .zero ∧
          out = Function.update inp (r, i) .one then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_mul_pAt_apply
statement:
theorem pDagAt_mul_pAt_apply (r : Fin m) (i j : Fin n)
    (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    (pDagAt r i * pAt r j) out inp =
      if inp (r, j) = .one ∧
          ((r, i) = (r, j) ∨ inp (r, i) = .zero) ∧
          out = lightMove inp (r, j) (r, i) then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.update_source_zero_apply_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem update_source_zero_apply_eq_zero_iff
    (inp : Pattern m n) (source target : Site m n) :
    Function.update inp source .zero target = .zero ↔
      target = source ∨ inp target = .zero

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.exists_permutation_of_legal_move
statement:
theorem exists_permutation_of_legal_move
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (out inp : BlockPattern T ell) (k : Fin ell)
    (r : Fin m) (i j : Fin n)
    (htarget : canonicalLightWord T ell out k = (r, i))
    (hsource : inp.1 (r, j) = .one)
    (_havailable : (r, i) = (r, j) ∨ inp.1 (r, i) = .zero)
    (hmove : out.1 = lightMove inp.1 (r, j) (r, i)) :
    ∃ tau : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell),
      domainOfWord k (canonicalLightWord T ell out) =
          domainOfWord k (permutedLightWord T ell inp tau) ∧
        permutedLightWord T ell inp tau k = (r, j)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.lightMove_legal_of_domain_eq
statement:
theorem lightMove_legal_of_domain_eq
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (out inp : BlockPattern T ell)
    (pi sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) (k : Fin ell)
    (hdom : domainOfWord k (permutedLightWord T ell out pi) =
      domainOfWord k (permutedLightWord T ell inp sigma)) :
    let O := permutedLightWord T ell out pi
    let I := permutedLightWord T ell inp sigma
    inp.1 (I k) = .one ∧
      (O k = I k ∨ inp.1 (O k) = .zero) ∧
      out.1 = lightMove inp.1 (I k) (O k)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghatBlock_norm_le
statement:
theorem ghatBlock_norm_le
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    ‖ghatBlock F T ell‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghatBlock_norm_le_grade
statement:
theorem ghatBlock_norm_le_grade
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell nu : ℕ)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hle : ell ≤ nu) :
    ‖ghatBlock F T ell‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) - 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_eq_ghatBlock
statement:
theorem hardCoreCompressedG_eq_ghatBlock
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    hardCoreCompressedG F T ell = ghatBlock F T ell

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreLift_labelledG_compression
statement:
theorem hardCoreLift_labelledG_compression
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    (hardCoreLift (d := d) T ell).transpose * labelledG F ell *
        hardCoreLift T ell =
      (permutationCount ell : ℝ) • ghatBlock F T ell

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.orbitToLegalMove_injective
statement:
theorem orbitToLegalMove_injective
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (out inp : BlockPattern T ell) :
    Function.Injective (orbitToLegalMove T ell out inp)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.orbitToLegalMove_surjective
statement:
theorem orbitToLegalMove_surjective
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.orbit_legal_weighted_sum
statement:
theorem orbit_legal_weighted_sum
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (out inp : BlockPattern T ell) (a b : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ k, ∑ tau,
      if OrbitCompatible T ell out inp (k, tau) then
        a (canonicalLightWord T ell out k).2 *
          b (permutedLightWord T ell inp tau k).2
      else 0) =
    ∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j,
      if LegalLightMove out.1 inp.1 (r, (i, j)) then a i * b j else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.orbit_sum_labelledG_eq_ghatBlock
statement:
theorem orbit_sum_labelledG_eq_ghatBlock
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (out inp : BlockIndex d T ell) :
    (∑ tau : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell), labelledG F ell
      (blockLabel T ell out (Equiv.refl (Fin ell)))
      (blockLabel T ell inp tau)) = ghatBlock F T ell out inp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockFiber_ghat_gradeProjection_mulVec
statement:
theorem blockFiber_ghat_gradeProjection_mulVec
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ)
    (q : FockBlockKey m n) :
    blockFiber
      (Matrix.mulVec
        (ghat (m := m) F *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu) x) q =
      if blockGrade q = nu then
        Matrix.mulVec (ghatBlock F q.1 q.2.1) (blockFiber x q)
      else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.fullIndexBlockEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem fullIndexBlockEquiv_symm_apply
    (q : FockBlockKey m n) (z : BlockIndex d q.1 q.2.1) :
    (fullIndexBlockEquiv (d := d) (m := m) (n := n)).symm ⟨q, z⟩ =
      (z.1, z.2.1)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghatBlock_zero_light
statement:
theorem ghatBlock_zero_light
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) :
    ghatBlock F T 0 = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_apply_eq_zero_of_key_ne
statement:
theorem ghat_apply_eq_zero_of_key_ne

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_mul_gradeProjection_apply
statement:
theorem ghat_mul_gradeProjection_apply
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)

    (ghat (m := m) F *

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.grade_eq_blockGrade
statement:
theorem grade_eq_blockGrade {q : FockBlockKey m n}

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normSq_eq_sum_blockFiber
statement:
theorem normSq_eq_sum_blockFiber (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.coordinateEnergy_mulVec_le_of_norm_le
statement:
theorem coordinateEnergy_mulVec_le_of_norm_le
    {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

    (_hC : 0 ≤ C) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ C) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghatBlock_isHermitian
statement:
theorem ghatBlock_isHermitian

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghatBlock_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem ghatBlock_transpose

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_apply_eq_zero_of_grade_ne
statement:
theorem ghat_apply_eq_zero_of_grade_ne

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_apply_eq_zero_of_input_light_card_zero

theorem ghat_apply_eq_zero_of_input_light_card_zero

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_gradeProjection_isHermitian

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_gradeProjection_normSq_le
statement:
theorem ghat_gradeProjection_normSq_le
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) (hnu : 1 ≤ nu)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq
        (Matrix.mulVec
          (ghat (m := m) F *
            gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu) x) ≤

statement:
theorem ghat_gradeProjection_norm_le
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) (hnu : 1 ≤ nu) :
    ‖ghat (m := m) F *

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_gradeProjection_norm_le_all
statement:
theorem ghat_gradeProjection_norm_le_all
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖ghat (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_gradeProjection_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem ghat_gradeProjection_transpose

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_gradeProjection_zero
statement:
theorem ghat_gradeProjection_zero

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.gradeProjection_mul_ghat_apply
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_mul_ghat_apply

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.gradeProjection_mul_ghat_eq_ghat_mul_gradeProjection
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_mul_ghat_eq_ghat_mul_gradeProjection

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_eq_sum_COne

@[simp] theorem CMatrix_eq_sum_COne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_grade_relation
statement:
theorem CMatrix_grade_relation (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)

statement:
theorem CMatrix_mul_cMatrix (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.COne_mul_cOne_of_ne
statement:
theorem COne_mul_cOne_of_ne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)

theorem COne_mul_cOne_self (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem CStack_mul_transpose (F : Frame n d) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Lplus_eq_CStack_mul_CreateAnalysisStack
statement:
theorem Lplus_eq_CStack_mul_CreateAnalysisStack (F : Frame n d) :

      CStack (m := m) F * CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Lplus_grade_factor
statement:
theorem Lplus_grade_factor (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    Lplus m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu =
      (gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 2) *
          CStack (m := m) F *
          Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)) *
        (CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.cMatrix_eq_sum_cOne
statement:
@[simp] theorem cMatrix_eq_sum_cOne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    cMatrix F r = ∑ i, cOne F r i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.cMatrix_grade_relation
statement:
theorem cMatrix_grade_relation (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {out : Pattern m n} {inp : Fin d × Pattern m n}
    (hentry : cMatrix F r out inp ≠ 0) :
    (out.grade : ℤ) = (inp.2.grade : ℤ) + 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.gradeProjection_CStack_rowProjection
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_CStack_rowProjection (F : Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1) *
        CStack (m := m) F *
        Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu =
      CStack (m := m) F *
        Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_apply
statement:
theorem pDagAt_apply (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    pDagAt r i out inp =
      if out (r, i) = .one ∧
          inp = Heavy.setSite out (r, i) .zero then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_mul_pDagAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem pDagAt_mul_pDagAt_of_ne (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pDagAt r i * pDagAt r j =
      wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.pUp, .pUp)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_sq_zero
statement:
theorem pDagAt_sq_zero (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    pDagAt r i * pDagAt r i = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem pDagAt_transpose (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    (pDagAt r i).transpose = pAt r i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.rowProjection_CreateAnalysisStack_gradeProjection
statement:
theorem rowProjection_CreateAnalysisStack_gradeProjection
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1) *
        CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu =
      CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem CreateAnalysisStack_gradeProjection_norm
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ((m : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_restricted_gram
statement:
theorem CreateAnalysisStack_restricted_gram (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    (CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu).transpose *
      (CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) =
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu *
          (D0 F + Hprime m (Frame.rows F)) *
            gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_transpose_mul_self
statement:
theorem CreateAnalysisStack_transpose_mul_self (F : Frame n d) :
    (CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F).transpose * CreateAnalysisStack F =
      D0 F + Hprime m (Frame.rows F)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row_apply
statement:
theorem D0Row_apply (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    D0Row F r out inp =
      if out.2 = inp.2 then
        partialFrameOperator F (out.2.freshInRow r) out.1 inp.1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row_fullFiber
statement:
theorem D0Row_fullFiber (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    fiber (Matrix.mulVec (D0Row F r) x) p =
      applyMatrix (partialFrameOperator F (p.freshInRow r)) (fiber x p)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem D0Row_norm_le_one (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    ‖D0Row F r‖ ≤ 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0_norm_le
statement:
theorem D0_norm_le (F : Frame n d) :
    ‖D0 (m := m) F‖ ≤ (m : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.cMatrix_transpose_mul_cMatrix
statement:
theorem cMatrix_transpose_mul_cMatrix (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    (cMatrix F r).transpose * cMatrix F r =
      D0Row F r +
        ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j
            (.pDown, .pUp)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.cOne_transpose_mul_cOne_of_ne
statement:
theorem cOne_transpose_mul_cOne_of_ne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (cOne F r i).transpose * cOne F r j =
      orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j
        (.pDown, .pUp)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.matrix_typed_block_cs
statement:
theorem matrix_typed_block_cs
    {I J K : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K]
    (B : Matrix K J ℝ) (A : Matrix J I ℝ) :
    ‖B * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖A.transpose * A‖ * ‖B * B.transpose‖

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pAt_mul_pDagAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem pAt_mul_pDagAt_of_ne (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pAt r i * pDagAt r j =
      wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.pDown, .pUp)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_column_inner
statement:
theorem pDagAt_column_inner (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (a b : Pattern m n) :
    (∑ p, pDagAt r i p a * pDagAt r i p b) =
      if a = b ∧ a (r, i) = .zero then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_mul_transpose_decomposition
statement:
theorem CMatrix_mul_transpose_decomposition (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    CMatrix F r * (CMatrix F r).transpose =
      D1Row F r +
        ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j
            (.pUp, .pDown)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.COne_mul_COne_transpose_of_ne
statement:
theorem COne_mul_COne_transpose_of_ne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    COne F r i * (COne F r j).transpose =
      orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j
        (.pUp, .pDown)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1Row_apply
statement:
theorem D1Row_apply (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    D1Row F r out inp =
      if out.2 = inp.2 then
        partialFrameOperator F (out.2.lightInRow r) out.1 inp.1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_apply
statement:
theorem D1_apply (F : Frame n d) (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    D1 (m := m) F out inp =
      if out.2 = inp.2 then
        ∑ r, partialFrameOperator F (out.2.lightInRow r) out.1 inp.1
      else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_fullFiber_rows
statement:
theorem D1_fullFiber_rows (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    fiber (Matrix.mulVec (D1 (m := m) F) x) p =
      ∑ r, applyMatrix (partialFrameOperator F (p.lightInRow r))
        (fiber x p)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_fullFiber_sites
statement:
theorem D1_fullFiber_sites (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    fiber (Matrix.mulVec (D1 (m := m) F) x) p =
      ∑ s ∈ p.light,
        (analyze F (fiber x p) s.2) • F.u s.2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem D1_gradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖D1 (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ (nu : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_output_fiber_energy_le
statement:
theorem D1_output_fiber_energy_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    euclideanNormSq
        (fiber (Matrix.mulVec (D1 (m := m) F) x) p) ≤
      (p.light.card : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        euclideanNormSq (fiber x p)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_restricted_energy
statement:
theorem D1_restricted_energy (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq
        (Matrix.mulVec
          (D1 (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_supported_energy_le
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Lzero_eq_ghat_sub_D1_add_Hprime
statement:
theorem Lzero_eq_ghat_sub_D1_add_Hprime (F : Frame n d) :
    Lzero m (Frame.rows F) =
      (ghat F - D1 F) + Hprime m (Frame.rows F)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.analyze_smul_frame_normSq_le
statement:
theorem analyze_smul_frame_normSq_le (F : Frame n d)
    (v : EVec d) (i : Fin n) :
    euclideanNormSq ((analyze F v i) • F.u i) ≤
      euclideanNormSq v

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_eq_D1_add_lightHop
statement:
theorem ghat_eq_D1_add_lightHop (F : Frame n d) :
    ghat (m := m) F = D1 F +
      wordSum m (Frame.rows F) .pUp .pDown

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_mul_pAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem pDagAt_mul_pAt_of_ne (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_row_inner
statement:
theorem pDagAt_row_inner (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)

      if a = b ∧ a (r, i) = .one then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_restricted_cogram
statement:
theorem CStack_restricted_cogram (F : Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
    let P := gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1)
    let R := Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu
    let B := P * CStack (m := m) F * R
    B * B.transpose = P * ghat F * P

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_restricted_norm

        Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ))

        (CStack (m := m) F).transpose *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1) =
      (CStack (m := m) F).transpose *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1)

    ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b shift * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤

        (aTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
          bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
