theorem closed_projected_word_norm_le
    (_F : Frame n d) (B : Shift → FullOp d m n)
    (hhom : ∀ delta, IsFullGradeShift delta.degree (B delta))
    {q t N nu : ℕ} {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ delta nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖B delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta)
    (w : BandWord N) (hlen : t + N = 2 * q)
    (hstart : nu ≤ 2 * t)
    (hwalk : walkGradeFrom nu w = some 0) :
    ‖gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w * gradeProjection nu‖ ≤
      beta ^ N

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iid_trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem iid_trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
    (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d) {q : ℕ} {beta : ℝ}
    (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ delta nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖normalizedBand m F b delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta) :
    (iidLaw b hb m n).expect
        (fun omega ↦ Matrix.trace ((iidGramError b F omega) ^
          (2 * q))) ≤
      (d : ℝ) * (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.nextGrade_backward_le
statement:
theorem nextGrade_backward_le {delta : Shift} {nu mu : ℕ}
    (h : nextGrade delta nu = some mu) : nu ≤ mu + 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.nextGrade_forward_le
statement:
theorem nextGrade_forward_le {delta : Shift} {nu mu : ℕ}
    (h : nextGrade delta nu = some mu) : mu ≤ nu + 2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.projected_power_norm_le
statement:
theorem projected_power_norm_le
    (F : Frame n d) (B : Shift → FullOp d m n)
    (hhom : ∀ delta, IsFullGradeShift delta.degree (B delta))
    {q : ℕ} {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ delta nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖B delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta) :
    ‖gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * (∑ delta : Shift, B delta) ^ (2 * q) *
        gradeProjection 0‖ ≤ (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.projected_word_eq_zero_of_walk_ne_zero
statement:
theorem projected_word_eq_zero_of_walk_ne_zero
    (_F : Frame n d) (B : Shift → FullOp d m n)
    (hhom : ∀ delta, IsFullGradeShift delta.degree (B delta))
    {N nu : ℕ} (w : BandWord N)
    (hwalk : walkGradeFrom nu w ≠ some 0) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w * gradeProjection nu = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.projected_word_norm_le
statement:
theorem projected_word_norm_le
    (F : Frame n d) (B : Shift → FullOp d m n)
    (hhom : ∀ delta, IsFullGradeShift delta.degree (B delta))
    {q : ℕ} {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ delta nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖B delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta)
    (w : BandWord (2 * q)) :
    ‖gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w * gradeProjection 0‖ ≤
      beta ^ (2 * q)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.startGrade_le_twice_length_of_walk_to_zero
statement:
theorem startGrade_le_twice_length_of_walk_to_zero
    {N nu : ℕ} (w : BandWord N)
    (h : walkGradeFrom nu w = some 0) : nu ≤ 2 * N

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_wordOperator_eq_pow
statement:
theorem sum_wordOperator_eq_pow (B : Shift → FullOp d m n) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ w : BandWord N, wordOperator B w) = (∑ delta : Shift, B delta) ^ N

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.vacuum_diagonal_sum_le
statement:
theorem vacuum_diagonal_sum_le
    (F : Frame n d) (B : Shift → FullOp d m n)
    (hhom : ∀ delta, IsFullGradeShift delta.degree (B delta))
    {q : ℕ} {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ delta nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖B delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta) :
    (∑ a : Fin d,
      ((∑ delta : Shift, B delta) ^ (2 * q))
        (a, vacuumPattern m n)
        (a, vacuumPattern m n)) ≤
      (d : ℝ) * (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q)

name: NLAlib.countSketchHollowCoefficient_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem countSketchHollowCoefficient_diag
    (h : ι → ρ) (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (a b : d) (i : ι) :
    countSketchHollowCoefficient h U a b i i = 0

name: NLAlib.countSketch_gram_error_eq
statement:
theorem countSketch_gram_error_eq
    (h : ι → ρ) (σ : ι → ℝ) (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    (countSketchMatrix h σ * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix h σ * U) - 1 =
      Uᵀ * ((countSketchMatrix h σ)ᵀ * countSketchMatrix h σ - 1) * U

name: NLAlib.mul_countSketchGram_sub_one_mul_apply_eq_quadForm
statement:
theorem mul_countSketchGram_sub_one_mul_apply_eq_quadForm
    (h : ι → ρ) (σ : ι → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ i, σ i ^ 2 = 1)
    (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (a b : d) :
    (Uᵀ * ((countSketchMatrix h σ)ᵀ * countSketchMatrix h σ - 1) * U : Matrix d d ℝ) a b =
      quadForm (countSketchHollowCoefficient h U a b) σ

name: NLAlib.transpose_countSketchMatrix_mul_apply
statement:
theorem transpose_countSketchMatrix_mul_apply
    (h : ι → ρ) (σ : ι → ℝ) (i j : ι) :
    ((countSketchMatrix h σ)ᵀ * countSketchMatrix h σ) i j =
      if h i = h j then σ i * σ j else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.le_product_prob
NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.product_expect_eq_iterated
statement:
theorem product_expect_eq_iterated (mu : FiniteLaw alpha) (nu : FiniteLaw beta)
    (f : alpha × beta → ℝ) :
    (product mu nu).expect f =
      mu.expect (fun a ↦ nu.expect (fun b ↦ f (a, b)))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.product_prob_eq_iterated
statement:
theorem product_prob_eq_iterated (mu : FiniteLaw alpha) (nu : FiniteLaw beta)
    (event : Set (alpha × beta)) :
    (product mu nu).prob event =
      mu.expect (fun a ↦ nu.prob {b | (a, b) ∈ event})

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.product_prob_le
NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.product_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem product_weight (mu : FiniteLaw alpha) (nu : FiniteLaw beta)
    (a : alpha) (b : beta) :
    (product mu nu).weight (a, b) = mu.weight a * nu.weight b

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo.mono
NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo.prob_cylinder_eq
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo.prob_cylinder_eq
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α]
    {μ ν : FiniteLaw (ι → α)} {k : ℕ}
    (h : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ ν k) (S : Finset ι) (hS : S.card ≤ k)
    (a : ι → α) :
    μ.prob {x | ∀ i ∈ S, x i = a i} =
      ν.prob {x | ∀ i ∈ S, x i = a i}

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo.refl
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo.refl [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α]
    (μ : FiniteLaw (ι → α)) (k : ℕ) : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ μ k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.congr
statement:
theorem congr {k : ℕ} {f g : (ι → α) → ℝ}
    (hf : HasLocalDegree k f) (hfg : f = g) : HasLocalDegree k g

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.constant
statement:
theorem constant (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    HasLocalDegree (ι := ι) (α := α) k (fun _ => c)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.expect_eq_of_matchesUpTo
statement:
theorem expect_eq_of_matchesUpTo [Fintype ι] [Fintype α]
    {μ ν : FiniteLaw (ι → α)} {k : ℕ} {f : (ι → α) → ℝ}
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ ν k) (hf : HasLocalDegree k f) :
    μ.expect f = ν.expect f

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.mono
statement:
theorem mono {k l : ℕ} {f : (ι → α) → ℝ}
    (hf : HasLocalDegree k f) (hkl : k ≤ l) : HasLocalDegree l f

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.mul
NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.neg
NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.sub
NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.sum_finset
statement:
theorem sum_finset {β : Type*} {k : ℕ} (T : Finset β)
    (f : β → (ι → α) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ T, HasLocalDegree k (f t)) :
    HasLocalDegree k (fun x => ∑ t ∈ T, f t x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.sum_fintype
statement:
theorem sum_fintype {β : Type*} [Fintype β] {k : ℕ}
    (f : β → (ι → α) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ t, HasLocalDegree k (f t)) :
    HasLocalDegree k (fun x => ∑ t, f t x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.ext_weight
statement:
theorem ext_weight [Fintype α] {μ ν : FiniteLaw α}
    (h : μ.weight = ν.weight) : μ = ν

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.map_expect
statement:
theorem map_expect [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (μ : FiniteLaw α) (f : α → β) (g : β → ℝ) :
    (map μ f).expect g = μ.expect (fun x => g (f x))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.map_uniform_equiv
statement:
theorem map_uniform_equiv [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β]
    (e : α ≃ β) :
    map (uniform : FiniteLaw α) e = (uniform : FiniteLaw β)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.map_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_weight [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (μ : FiniteLaw α) (f : α → β) (y : β) :
    (map μ f).weight y = ∑ x, if f x = y then μ.weight x else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.uniform_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem uniform_weight [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] (x : α) :
    (uniform : FiniteLaw α).weight x = 1 / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.cB_le_cStar
statement: theorem cB_le_cStar {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : cB b ≤ convexOrderConstant

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.flipSign_involutive
statement: @[simp] theorem flipSign_involutive (e : Sign) : flipSign (flipSign e) = e

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mem_support
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_support {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) (a : Fin b) :
    a ∈ support y ↔ y a ≠ .zero

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.negateOutcome_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem negateOutcome_involutive (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    negateOutcome (negateOutcome z) = z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.one_le_cB
statement: theorem one_le_cB {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : 1 ≤ cB b

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.one_sub_p0_pos
statement: theorem one_sub_p0_pos {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : 0 < 1 - p0 b

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.outcomeOfSign_flipSign
statement:
@[simp] theorem outcomeOfSign_flipSign (e : Sign) :
    outcomeOfSign (flipSign e) = negateOutcome (outcomeOfSign e)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.p0_le_exp_neg_one
statement:
theorem p0_le_exp_neg_one {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    p0 b ≤ Real.exp (-1)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.p0_lt_one
statement: theorem p0_lt_one {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : p0 b < 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.p0_nonneg
statement: theorem p0_nonneg {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : 0 ≤ p0 b

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.supportSize_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem supportSize_eq_zero_iff {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) :
    supportSize y = 0 ↔ y = zeroY b

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.yValue_negateOutcome
statement:
@[simp] theorem yValue_negateOutcome (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    yValue (negateOutcome z) = -yValue z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.yValue_outcomeOfSign
statement:
@[simp] theorem yValue_outcomeOfSign (e : Sign) :
    yValue (outcomeOfSign e) = e.val

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.yVectorLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem yVectorLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (y : YVector b) :
    (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y = ∏ a, mass b (y a)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.zeroY_weight
statement:
theorem zeroY_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (zeroY b) = p0 b

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.kernelWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem kernelWeight_nonneg {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (x : SignedHash b) : 0 ≤ kernelWeight hb y x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectionKernel_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem selectionKernel_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    (selectionKernel hb y).weight x = kernelWeight hb y x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_kernelWeight
statement:
theorem sum_kernelWeight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (y : YVector b) :
    ∑ x, kernelWeight hb y x = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.jointColumnLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem jointColumnLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, x) =
      (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y * kernelWeight hb y x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.kernelWeight_negateY
statement:
theorem kernelWeight_negateY {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (a : Fin b) (e : Sign) :
    kernelWeight hb (negateY y) (a, flipSign e) = kernelWeight hb y (a, e)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.kernelWeight_swapY
statement:
theorem kernelWeight_swapY {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (a c : Fin b) (e : Sign) :
    kernelWeight hb (swapY a c y) (c, e) = kernelWeight hb y (a, e)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mass_negateOutcome
statement:
theorem mass_negateOutcome (b : ℕ) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    mass b (negateOutcome z) = mass b z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.negateY_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem negateY_involutive {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) :
    negateY (negateY y) = y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_xMarginal
statement:
theorem sum_xMarginal {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∑ x, xMarginal hb x = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.supportSize_eq_sum
statement:
theorem supportSize_eq_sum {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) :
    supportSize y = ∑ a, if y a = .zero then 0 else 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.supportSize_negateY
statement:
@[simp] theorem supportSize_negateY {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) :
    supportSize (negateY y) = supportSize y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.supportSize_swapY
statement:
@[simp] theorem supportSize_swapY {b : ℕ} (a c : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    supportSize (swapY a c y) = supportSize y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.support_negateY
statement: theorem support_negateY {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) : support (negateY y) = support y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.swapY_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapY_involutive {b : ℕ} (a c : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    swapY a c (swapY a c y) = y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.xMarginal_constant
statement:
theorem xMarginal_constant {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x z : SignedHash b) :
    xMarginal hb x = xMarginal hb z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.xMarginal_eq_selectorWeight
statement:
theorem xMarginal_eq_selectorWeight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    xMarginal hb x = (selectorLaw b hb).weight x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.xMarginal_flip
statement:
theorem xMarginal_flip {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (a : Fin b) (e : Sign) :
    xMarginal hb (a, flipSign e) = xMarginal hb (a, e)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.xMarginal_swap
statement:
theorem xMarginal_swap {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (a c : Fin b) (e : Sign) :
    xMarginal hb (c, e) = xMarginal hb (a, e)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.yVectorLaw_weight_negateY
statement:
theorem yVectorLaw_weight_negateY {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (y : YVector b) :
    (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (negateY y) = (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.yVectorLaw_weight_swapY
statement:
theorem yVectorLaw_weight_swapY {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (a c : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (swapY a c y) = (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.cB_mul_one_sub_p0
statement:
theorem cB_mul_one_sub_p0 {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    cB b * (1 - p0 b) = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalYLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem conditionalYLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (x : SignedHash b) (y : YVector b) :
    (conditionalYLaw hb x).weight y =
      (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, x) / (selectorLaw b hb).weight x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_barycenter
statement:
theorem conditional_barycenter {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    conditionalBarycenter hb x = selectorVector x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_barycenter_coordinate
statement:
theorem conditional_barycenter_coordinate {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (x : SignedHash b) (a : Fin b) :
    (conditionalYLaw hb x).expect (fun y => cB b * yValue (y a)) =
      if a = x.1 then x.2.val else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_expect_yValue
statement:
theorem conditional_expect_yValue {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (x : SignedHash b) (a : Fin b) :
    (conditionalYLaw hb x).expect (fun y => yValue (y a)) =
      if a = x.1 then x.2.val * (1 - p0 b) else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.fiberMoment_off
statement:
theorem fiberMoment_off {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (x : SignedHash b) (a : Fin b) (ha : a ≠ x.1) :
    fiberMoment hb x a = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.fiberMoment_selected
statement:
theorem fiberMoment_selected {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    fiberMoment hb x x.1 =
      x.2.val * (selectorLaw b hb).weight x * (1 - p0 b)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.flipAt_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem flipAt_apply_of_ne {b : ℕ} {a k : Fin b} (hka : k ≠ a) (y : YVector b) :
    flipAt a y k = y k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.flipAt_apply_same
statement:
@[simp] theorem flipAt_apply_same {b : ℕ} (a : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    flipAt a y a = negateOutcome (y a)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.flipAt_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem flipAt_involutive {b : ℕ} (a : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    flipAt a (flipAt a y) = y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.jointColumn_disintegrates
statement:
theorem jointColumn_disintegrates {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, x) =
      (selectorLaw b hb).weight x * (conditionalYLaw hb x).weight y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.jointColumn_x_marginal
statement:
theorem jointColumn_x_marginal {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    (jointColumnLaw hb).prob {z | z.2 = x} = (selectorLaw b hb).weight x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.kernelWeight_flipAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem kernelWeight_flipAt_of_ne {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (x : SignedHash b) (a : Fin b) (ha : a ≠ x.1) :
    kernelWeight hb (flipAt a y) x = kernelWeight hb y x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.kernelWeight_mul_selectedValue
statement:
theorem kernelWeight_mul_selectedValue {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    kernelWeight hb y x * yValue (y x.1) =
      x.2.val * kernelWeight hb y x -
        x.2.val * (selectorLaw b hb).weight x *
          (if supportSize y = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorWeight_pos
statement:
theorem selectorWeight_pos {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    0 < (selectorLaw b hb).weight x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.supportSize_flipAt
statement:
@[simp] theorem supportSize_flipAt {b : ℕ} (a : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    supportSize (flipAt a y) = supportSize y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.yVectorLaw_weight_flipAt
statement:
theorem yVectorLaw_weight_flipAt {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (a : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (flipAt a y) = (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.zeroSupportMass
statement:
theorem zeroSupportMass {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (∑ y, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y *
      (if supportSize y = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) = p0 b

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.barycenter_apply
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.barycenter_apply {Omega A : Type*} [Fintype Omega]
    (mu : FiniteLaw Omega) (M : Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) (a c : A) :
    FiniteLaw.barycenter mu M a c = mu.expect (fun omega ↦ M omega a c)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_finset_sum
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.expect_finset_sum {Omega K : Type*} [Fintype Omega]
    (mu : FiniteLaw Omega) (S : Finset K) (f : K → Omega → ℝ) :
    mu.expect (fun omega ↦ ∑ k ∈ S, f k omega) = ∑ k ∈ S, mu.expect (f k)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_mul_const
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.expect_mul_const {Omega : Type*} [Fintype Omega]
    (mu : FiniteLaw Omega) (f : Omega → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    mu.expect (fun omega ↦ f omega * c) = mu.expect f * c

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_sum
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.expect_sum {Omega K : Type*} [Fintype Omega] [Fintype K]
    (mu : FiniteLaw Omega) (f : K → Omega → ℝ) :
    mu.expect (fun omega ↦ ∑ k, f k omega) = ∑ k, mu.expect (f k)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.map_barycenter_le_expect
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.map_barycenter_le_expect {Omega E : Type*} [Fintype Omega]
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (mu : FiniteLaw Omega) (p : Omega → E) (Phi : E → ℝ)
    (hPhi : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ Phi) :
    Phi (FiniteLaw.barycenter mu p) ≤ mu.expect (fun omega ↦ Phi (p omega))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.barycenter_scaledIID_eq_sparse
statement:
theorem barycenter_scaledIID_eq_sparse {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (x : XArray b s n) :
    FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalArrayLaw hb x) (scaledIIDSymmetricError F) =
      sparseSymmetricError F x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.coe_barycenter_scaledIID
statement:
theorem coe_barycenter_scaledIID {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (x : XArray b s n) :
    ((FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalArrayLaw hb x) (scaledIIDSymmetricError F) :
        symmetricMatrices d) : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) =
      FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalArrayLaw hb x) (scaledIIDVectorError F)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_convex_order
statement:
theorem conditional_convex_order {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (x : XArray b s n)
    (Phi : symmetricMatrices d → ℝ) (hPhi : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ Phi) :
    Phi (sparseSymmetricError F x) ≤
      (conditionalArrayLaw hb x).expect
        (fun y ↦ Phi (scaledIIDSymmetricError F y))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_cross_inner
statement:
theorem conditional_cross_inner
    {b s n : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : XArray b s n)
    {z z' : ArraySite s n} (hzz : z ≠ z') :
    (conditionalArrayLaw hb x).expect
        (fun y ↦ inner ℝ (scaledYVector (y z)) (scaledYVector (y z'))) =
      inner ℝ (selectorVector (x z)) (selectorVector (x z'))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_matrix_transfer
statement:
theorem conditional_matrix_transfer {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (x : XArray b s n) :
    FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalArrayLaw hb x) (scaledIIDVectorError F) =
      sparseVectorError F x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.expect_two_coordinates
statement:
theorem expect_two_coordinates
    {I A : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype A]
    (mu : I → FiniteLaw A) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (f g : A → ℝ) :
    (FiniteLaw.independentProduct mu).expect (fun x ↦ f (x i) * g (x j)) =
      (mu i).expect f * (mu j).expect g

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidVectorError_symmetric
NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledIIDVectorError_eq_smul
NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledIIDVectorError_symmetric
NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledYVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaledYVector_apply {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) (a : Fin b) :
    scaledYVector y a = cB b * yValue (y a)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaled_inner_eq
statement:
theorem scaled_inner_eq {b : ℕ} (y z : YVector b) :
    inner ℝ (scaledYVector y) (scaledYVector z) =
      cB b ^ 2 * inner ℝ (unscaledYVector y) (unscaledYVector z)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseVectorError_symmetric
NLAlib.SparseSketch.unscaledYVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem unscaledYVector_apply {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) (a : Fin b) :
    unscaledYVector y a = yValue (y a)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iidArrayLaw_expect
statement:
theorem conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iidArrayLaw_expect
    {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s n : ℕ) (f : YArray b s n → ℝ) :
    (conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).expect f =
      (iidArrayLaw hb s n).expect f

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iterated
statement:
theorem conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iterated
    {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s n : ℕ) (f : YArray b s n → ℝ) :
    (conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).expect f =
      (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun x ↦ (conditionalArrayLaw hb x).expect f)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem conditionalMixtureLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (s n : ℕ) (y : YArray b s n) :
    (conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).weight y =
      ∑ x, (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).weight x *
        (conditionalArrayLaw hb x).weight y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_weight_eq_iidArrayLaw_weight
statement:
theorem conditionalMixtureLaw_weight_eq_iidArrayLaw_weight
    {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s n : ℕ) (y : YArray b s n) :
    (conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).weight y =
      (iidArrayLaw hb s n).weight y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidArrayLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem iidArrayLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (s n : ℕ) (y : YArray b s n) :
    (iidArrayLaw hb s n).weight y =
      ∏ z : ArraySite s n, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (y z)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.oneColumn_mixture_weight
statement:
theorem oneColumn_mixture_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (y : YVector b) :
    (∑ x : SignedHash b, (selectorLaw b hb).weight x *
        (conditionalYLaw hb x).weight y) =
      (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorArrayLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem selectorArrayLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (s n : ℕ) (x : XArray b s n) :
    (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).weight x =
      ∏ z : ArraySite s n, (selectorLaw b hb).weight (x z)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.unconditional_convex_order
statement:
theorem unconditional_convex_order {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (Phi : symmetricMatrices d → ℝ)
    (hPhi : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ Phi) :
    (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun x ↦ Phi (sparseSymmetricError F x)) ≤
      (iidArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun y ↦ Phi (scaledIIDSymmetricError F y))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.eta_eq_sqrt_mul_yValue
statement:
theorem eta_eq_sqrt_mul_yValue (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    eta b z = Real.sqrt b * yValue z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.flattenY_apply_pair
statement:
@[simp] theorem flattenY_apply_pair (y : YArray b s n)
    (g : Fin s) (a : Fin b) (i : Fin n) :
    flattenY y (finProdFinEquiv (g, a), i) = y (g, i) a

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidArrayLaw_expect_flatten_eq_iidLaw_expect
statement:
theorem iidArrayLaw_expect_flatten_eq_iidLaw_expect (hb : 1 < b)
    (f : Configuration (s * b) n → ℝ) :
    (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun y ↦ f (flattenY y)) =
      (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect f

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidArrayLaw_weight_eq_iidLaw_weight
statement:
theorem iidArrayLaw_weight_eq_iidLaw_weight (hb : 1 < b)
    (y : YArray b s n) :
    (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).weight y =
      (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).weight (flattenY y)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidVectorError_eq_flattened_iidGramError
statement:
theorem iidVectorError_eq_flattened_iidGramError
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d) (y : YArray b s n) :
    iidVectorError F y = iidGramError b F (flattenY y)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorArrayLaw_eq_rawSampleLaw
statement:
theorem selectorArrayLaw_eq_rawSampleLaw (hb : 0 < b) :
    selectorArrayLaw hb s n = sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorVector_eq_signedBasis
statement:
theorem selectorVector_eq_signedBasis (x : XArray b s n)
    (g : Fin s) (i : Fin n) :
    selectorVector (x (g, i)) = signedBasis (toSample x) g i

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseVectorError_eq_gramError
statement:
theorem sparseVectorError_eq_gramError (hs : 0 < s)
    (F : Frame n d) (x : XArray b s n) :
    sparseVectorError F x = gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample x))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_eta_flatten_product
statement:
theorem sum_eta_flatten_product (_hb : 0 < b) (y : YArray b s n)
    (g : Fin s) (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ a : Fin b,
      eta b (flattenY y (finProdFinEquiv (g, a), i)) *
        eta b (flattenY y (finProdFinEquiv (g, a), j))) =
      (b : ℝ) * inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (y (g, i)))
        (unscaledYVector (y (g, j)))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.columnValue_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem columnValue_ne_zero_iff {m s : ℕ} (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) (r : Fin m) :
    UniformSparseColumn.value x r ≠ 0 ↔ r ∈ x.1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.columnValue_of_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnValue_of_mem {m s : ℕ} (x : UniformSparseColumn m s)
    {r : Fin m} (hr : r ∈ x.1) : UniformSparseColumn.value x r = (x.2 r).val

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.columnValue_of_notMem
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnValue_of_notMem {m s : ℕ} (x : UniformSparseColumn m s)
    {r : Fin m} (hr : r ∉ x.1) : UniformSparseColumn.value x r = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.columnValue_sq
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnValue_sq {m s : ℕ} (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) (r : Fin m) :
    UniformSparseColumn.value x r ^ 2 = supportIndicator x r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.embeddedGram_apply
statement:
theorem embeddedGram_apply {m s n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (X : UniformSparseSample m s n) (hs : 0 < s) (a c : Fin d) :
    embeddedGram F (uniformSparseMatrix X) a c =
      (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r) *
          F.u i a * F.u j c

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactColumnNonempty
statement:
theorem exactColumnNonempty {m s : ℕ} (hsm : s ≤ m) :
    Nonempty (UniformSparseColumn m s)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactSupportNonempty
statement:
theorem exactSupportNonempty {m s : ℕ} (hsm : s ≤ m) :
    Nonempty (UniformSparseSupport m s)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.gramError_eq_hollow
statement:
theorem gramError_eq_hollow {m s n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (X : UniformSparseSample m s n) (hs : 0 < s) :
    gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X) = UniformSparse.hollowGram F X

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.sketchGram_apply
statement:
theorem sketchGram_apply {m s n : ℕ} (X : UniformSparseSample m s n)
    (hs : 0 < s) (i j : Fin n) :
    sketchGram (uniformSparseMatrix X) i j =
      (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j)
          r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.sketchGram_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem sketchGram_diag {m s n : ℕ} (X : UniformSparseSample m s n)
    (hs : 0 < s) (i : Fin n) : sketchGram (uniformSparseMatrix X) i i = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.sum_columnValue_sq
statement:
theorem sum_columnValue_sq {m s : ℕ} (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) :
    ∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value x r ^ 2 = (s : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.card_filter_uniformSparseMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.NLAlib.card_filter_uniformSparseMatrix_ne_zero {m s n : ℕ}
    (X : UniformSparseSample m s n)
    (hs : 0 < s) (i : Fin n) :
    Fintype.card {r : Fin m // uniformSparseMatrix X r i ≠ 0} = s

name: NLAlib.uniformSparseMatrix_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.NLAlib.uniformSparseMatrix_ne_zero_iff {m s n : ℕ} (X : UniformSparseSample m s n)
    (hs : 0 < s) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    uniformSparseMatrix X r i ≠ 0 ↔ r ∈ (X i).1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.activeBlockCount_le_min
statement:
theorem activeBlockCount_le_min (y : NestedY b s) :
    activeBlockCount y ≤ min (totalSupport y) s

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.activeBlockCount_le_s
statement: theorem activeBlockCount_le_s (y : NestedY b s) : activeBlockCount y ≤ s

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.activeBlockCount_le_totalSupport
statement:
theorem activeBlockCount_le_totalSupport (y : NestedY b s) :
    activeBlockCount y ≤ totalSupport y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.choiceColumn_nonempty
statement:
theorem choiceColumn_nonempty {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (_hs : 0 < s)
    (y : NestedY b s) : Nonempty (ChoiceColumn y)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.compatible_inner_eq_min
statement:
theorem compatible_inner_eq_min {b s : ℕ} {y : NestedY b s}
    {x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s} (hxy : Compatible y x) :
    (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value x r * flatYValue y r) =
      (min (totalSupport y) s : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.couplingA_pos
statement:
theorem couplingA_pos {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) :
    0 < couplingA (s := s) hb

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScale_le_cB
statement:
theorem exactScale_le_cB {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) :
    exactScale (s := s) hb ≤ cB b

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScale_le_cStar
statement:
theorem exactScale_le_cStar {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) :
    exactScale (s := s) hb ≤ convexOrderConstant

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.expect_activeBlockCount
statement:
theorem expect_activeBlockCount {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => (activeBlockCount y : ℝ)) =
      (s : ℝ) * (1 - p0 b)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.expect_vectorActiveIndicator
statement:
theorem expect_vectorActiveIndicator {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (yVectorLaw b hb).expect vectorActiveIndicator = 1 - p0 b

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatOutcome_pair
statement:
@[simp] theorem flatOutcome_pair {b s : ℕ} (y : NestedY b s)
    (g : Fin s) (a : Fin b) :
    flatOutcome y (finProdFinEquiv (g, a)) = y g a

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.mem_flatSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_flatSupport {b s : ℕ} (y : NestedY b s)
    (r : Fin (s * b)) : r ∈ flatSupport y ↔ flatOutcome y r ≠ .zero

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.nestedYLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem nestedYLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s : ℕ)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y = ∏ g, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (y g)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.one_sub_p0_le_couplingA
statement:
theorem one_sub_p0_le_couplingA {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) :
    1 - p0 b ≤ couplingA (s := s) hb

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.outcomeOfSign_signOfOutcome_of_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem outcomeOfSign_signOfOutcome_of_ne_zero
    {z : TernaryOutcome} (hz : z ≠ .zero) : outcomeOfSign (signOfOutcome z) = z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.totalSupport_eq_sum
statement:
theorem totalSupport_eq_sum {b s : ℕ} (y : NestedY b s) :
    totalSupport y = ∑ g, supportSize (y g)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.actOutcome_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem actOutcome_eq_zero_iff (e : Sign) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    actOutcome e z = .zero ↔ z = .zero

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.actOutcome_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem actOutcome_involutive (e : Sign) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    actOutcome e (actOutcome e z) = z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.actOutcome_ne_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem actOutcome_ne_zero_iff (e : Sign) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    actOutcome e z ≠ .zero ↔ z ≠ .zero

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.actOutcome_plus
statement: @[simp] theorem actOutcome_plus (z : TernaryOutcome) : actOutcome .plus z = z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.actOutcome_signMul
statement:
@[simp] theorem actOutcome_signMul (e f : Sign) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    actOutcome (signMul e f) z = actOutcome e (actOutcome f z)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.columnValue_transformColumn
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnValue_transformColumn {m s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (eps : Fin m → Sign)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) (r : Fin m) :
    UniformSparseColumn.value (transformColumn pi eps x) r =
      (eps r).val * UniformSparseColumn.value x (pi.symm r)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatOutcome_transformY
statement:
@[simp] theorem flatOutcome_transformY {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    flatOutcome (transformY pi eps y) r =
      actOutcome (eps r) (flatOutcome y (pi.symm r))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.mass_actOutcome
statement:
theorem mass_actOutcome (b : ℕ) (e : Sign) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    mass b (actOutcome e z) = mass b z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.mem_transformSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_transformSupport {m s : ℕ} (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin m))
    (S : UniformSparseSupport m s) (r : Fin m) :
    r ∈ (transformSupport pi S : Finset (Fin m)) ↔ pi.symm r ∈ (S : Finset (Fin m))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.outcomeOfSign_signMul
statement:
@[simp] theorem outcomeOfSign_signMul (e f : Sign) :
    outcomeOfSign (signMul e f) = actOutcome e (outcomeOfSign f)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_assoc
statement:
@[simp] theorem signMul_assoc (e f g : Sign) :
    signMul (signMul e f) g = signMul e (signMul f g)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_left_cancel_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem signMul_left_cancel_self (e f : Sign) :
    signMul e (signMul e f) = f

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_plus_left
statement: @[simp] theorem signMul_plus_left (e : Sign) : signMul .plus e = e

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_plus_right
statement: @[simp] theorem signMul_plus_right (e : Sign) : signMul e .plus = e

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_right_cancel_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem signMul_right_cancel_self (e f : Sign) :
    signMul (signMul e f) f = e

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_self
statement: @[simp] theorem signMul_self (e : Sign) : signMul e e = .plus

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem signMul_val (e f : Sign) :
    (signMul e f).val = e.val * f.val

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformColumn_inverse_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem transformColumn_inverse_left {m s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (eps : Fin m → Sign)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) :
    transformColumn pi.symm (inverseMask pi eps) (transformColumn pi eps x) = x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformColumn_inverse_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem transformColumn_inverse_right {m s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (eps : Fin m → Sign)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) :
    transformColumn pi eps
      (transformColumn pi.symm (inverseMask pi eps) x) = x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformY_inverse_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem transformY_inverse_left {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    transformY pi.symm (inverseMask pi eps) (transformY pi eps y) = y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformY_inverse_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem transformY_inverse_right {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    transformY pi eps (transformY pi.symm (inverseMask pi eps) y) = y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.yValue_actOutcome
statement:
@[simp] theorem yValue_actOutcome (e : Sign) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    yValue (actOutcome e z) = e.val * yValue z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.choiceColumn_card_transform
statement:
theorem choiceColumn_card_transform {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    Nat.card (ChoiceColumn (transformY pi eps y)) =
      Nat.card (ChoiceColumn y)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.compatible_transform_iff
statement:
theorem compatible_transform_iff {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    Compatible (transformY pi eps y) (transformColumn pi eps x) ↔
      Compatible y x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatSupport_transformY
statement:
theorem flatSupport_transformY {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    flatSupport (transformY pi eps y) =
      (flatSupport y).map pi.toEmbedding

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.nestedYLaw_weight_eq_flat_prod
statement:
theorem nestedYLaw_weight_eq_flat_prod {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y =
      ∏ r : Fin (s * b), mass b (flatOutcome y r)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.nestedYLaw_weight_transformY
statement:
theorem nestedYLaw_weight_transformY {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    (nestedYLaw hb s).weight (transformY pi eps y) =
      (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.selectionKernel_weight_of_compatible
statement:
theorem selectionKernel_weight_of_compatible {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (y : NestedY b s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
    (hxy : Compatible y x) :
    (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight x =
      1 / (Nat.card (ChoiceColumn y) : ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.selectionKernel_weight_of_not_compatible
statement:
theorem selectionKernel_weight_of_not_compatible {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (y : NestedY b s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
    (hxy : ¬ Compatible y x) :
    (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight x = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.selectionKernel_weight_transform
statement:
theorem selectionKernel_weight_transform {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs (transformY pi eps y)).weight
        (transformColumn pi eps x) =
      (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.totalSupport_transformY
statement:
@[simp] theorem totalSupport_transformY {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    totalSupport (transformY pi eps y) = totalSupport y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exists_transformColumn_eq
statement:
theorem exists_transformColumn_eq {m s : ℕ}
    (x z : UniformSparseColumn m s) :
    ∃ (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (eps : Fin m → Sign),
      transformColumn pi eps x = z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw_weight_transform
statement:
theorem jointColumnLaw_weight_transform {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight
        (transformY pi eps y, transformColumn pi eps x) =
      (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.jointColumn_y_marginal
statement:
theorem jointColumn_y_marginal {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (y : NestedY b s) :
    (∑ x, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x)) =
      (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.le_rows
statement: theorem le_rows {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : s ≤ s * b

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.sum_xMarginal
statement:
theorem sum_xMarginal {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∑ x, UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x = 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.xMarginal_constant
statement:
theorem xMarginal_constant {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x = UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.xMarginal_eq_exactColumnWeight
statement:
theorem xMarginal_eq_exactColumnWeight {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x =
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.xMarginal_transform
statement:
theorem xMarginal_transform {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs (transformColumn pi eps x) = UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.compatible_congr_column
statement:
theorem compatible_congr_column {b s : ℕ} (y : NestedY b s)
    (x z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
    (hsupport : (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) =
      (z.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))))
    (hsign : ∀ r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))), x.2 r = z.2 r) :
    Compatible y x ↔ Compatible y z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw_mixture
statement:
theorem conditionalYLaw_mixture {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (y : NestedY b s) :
    (∑ x, (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
      (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).weight y) =
      (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem conditionalYLaw_weight {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).weight y =
      (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) /
        (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditional_expect_minSupport
statement:
theorem conditional_expect_minSupport {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).expect
      (fun y => (min (totalSupport y) s : ℝ)) =
      (s : ℝ) * couplingA (s := s) hb

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditional_expect_supportFunction
statement:
theorem conditional_expect_supportFunction {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (phi : ℕ → ℝ)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).expect (fun y => phi (totalSupport y)) =
      (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => phi (totalSupport y))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactColumnWeight_pos
statement:
theorem exactColumnWeight_pos {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    0 < (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw_weight_congr_column
statement:
theorem jointColumnLaw_weight_congr_column {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (y : NestedY b s)
    (x z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
    (hsupport : (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) =
      (z.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))))
    (hsign : ∀ r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))), x.2 r = z.2 r) :
    (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) =
      (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, z)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.jointColumn_disintegrates
statement:
theorem jointColumn_disintegrates {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (y : NestedY b s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) =
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
        (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).weight y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.selectionKernel_weight_congr_column
statement:
theorem selectionKernel_weight_congr_column {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (y : NestedY b s)
    (x z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
    (hsupport : (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) =
      (z.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))))
    (hsign : ∀ r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))), x.2 r = z.2 r) :
    (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight x =
      (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.sum_supportFiberMoment
statement:
theorem sum_supportFiberMoment {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (phi : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x) =
      (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => phi (totalSupport y))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.supportFiberMoment_constant
statement:
theorem supportFiberMoment_constant {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (phi : ℕ → ℝ)
    (x z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x = supportFiberMoment hb hs phi z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.supportFiberMoment_eq_weight_mul_expect
statement:
theorem supportFiberMoment_eq_weight_mul_expect {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (phi : ℕ → ℝ)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x =
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
        (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => phi (totalSupport y))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.supportFiberMoment_transform
statement:
theorem supportFiberMoment_transform {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (phi : ℕ → ℝ)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    supportFiberMoment hb hs phi (transformColumn pi eps x) =
      supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.aligned_coordinateFiberMoment_eq
statement:
theorem aligned_coordinateFiberMoment_eq {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r t : Fin (s * b))
    (hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))))
    (ht : t ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) :
    UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r =
      UniformSparseColumn.value x t * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x t

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.coordinateFiberMoment_off
statement:
theorem coordinateFiberMoment_off {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (q : Fin (s * b))
    (hq : q ∉ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) :
    coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x q = 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.coordinateFiberMoment_swap
statement:
theorem coordinateFiberMoment_swap {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r t : Fin (s * b))
    (hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))))
    (ht : t ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) :
    coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x t =
      (stabilizerMask x (Equiv.swap r t) t).val *
        coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatYValue_flipYAt_same
NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatYValue_transformY
statement:
@[simp] theorem flatYValue_transformY {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    flatYValue (transformY pi eps y) r =
      (eps r).val * flatYValue y (pi.symm r)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flipMask_of_ne
statement:
theorem flipMask_of_ne {m : ℕ} {q r : Fin m} (hrq : r ≠ q) :
    flipMask q r = .plus

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flipMask_same
statement:
@[simp] theorem flipMask_same {m : ℕ} (q : Fin m) :
    flipMask q q = .minus

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw_weight_flipYAt_off
statement:
theorem jointColumnLaw_weight_flipYAt_off {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (q : Fin (s * b))
    (hq : q ∉ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) (y : NestedY b s) :
    (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (flipYAt q y, x) =
      (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.swap_maps_support_self
statement:
theorem swap_maps_support_self {m s : ℕ} (x : UniformSparseColumn m s)
    (r t : Fin m) (hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)))
    (ht : t ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m))) :
    (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)).map (Equiv.swap r t).toEmbedding =
      (x.1 : Finset (Fin m))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformColumn_flip_off_sameActive
statement:
theorem transformColumn_flip_off_sameActive {b s : ℕ}
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (q : Fin (s * b))
    (hq : q ∉ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) :
    (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) =
        ((transformColumn (Equiv.refl _) (flipMask q) x).1 :
          Finset (Fin (s * b))) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))),
        x.2 r = (transformColumn (Equiv.refl _) (flipMask q) x).2 r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformColumn_stabilizer
statement:
theorem transformColumn_stabilizer {m s : ℕ}
    (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin m))
    (hsupport : (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)).map pi.toEmbedding =
      (x.1 : Finset (Fin m))) :
    transformColumn pi (stabilizerMask x pi) x = x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformColumn_swap_eq
statement:
theorem transformColumn_swap_eq {m s : ℕ} (x : UniformSparseColumn m s)
    (r t : Fin m) (hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)))
    (ht : t ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m))) :
    transformColumn (Equiv.swap r t)
      (stabilizerMask x (Equiv.swap r t)) x = x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.active_aligned_moment_value
statement:
theorem active_aligned_moment_value {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r : Fin (s * b))
    (hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) :
    UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r =
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
        couplingA (s := s) hb

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditional_barycenter_coordinate
statement:
theorem conditional_barycenter_coordinate {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).expect (fun y => flatYValue y r) =
      couplingA (s := s) hb * UniformSparseColumn.value x r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditional_scaled_barycenter_coordinate
statement:
theorem conditional_scaled_barycenter_coordinate {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).expect
      (fun y => exactScale (s := s) hb * flatYValue y r) =
      UniformSparseColumn.value x r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.coordinateFiberMoment_eq
statement:
theorem coordinateFiberMoment_eq {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r =
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
        couplingA (s := s) hb * UniformSparseColumn.value x r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq
statement:
theorem weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r) =
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
        ((s : ℝ) * couplingA (s := s) hb)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq_minFiber
statement:
theorem weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq_minFiber {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r) =
      supportFiberMoment hb hs (fun k => (min k s : ℝ)) x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq_s_mul_active
statement:
theorem weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq_s_mul_active {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r : Fin (s * b))
    (hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) :
    (∑ t, UniformSparseColumn.value x t * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x t) =
      (s : ℝ) * (UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_traceEvenPower_order
statement:
theorem conditional_traceEvenPower_order {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (x : XArray b s n) (q : ℕ) :
    traceEvenPower q (sparseSymmetricError F x) ≤
      (conditionalArrayLaw hb x).expect
        (fun y ↦ traceEvenPower q (scaledIIDSymmetricError F y))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iid_trace_moment_eq_product
statement:
theorem iid_trace_moment_eq_product (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun y ↦ ((iidVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
      (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
        (fun ω ↦ ((iidGramError b F ω) ^ (2 * q)).trace)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.raw_trace_moment_le_scaled_product
statement:
theorem raw_trace_moment_le_scaled_product (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)).expect
        (fun z ↦ ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) ≤
      cB b ^ (4 * q) *
        (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
          (fun omega ↦ ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ (2 * q)).trace)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledIIDVectorError_trace_even
statement:
theorem scaledIIDVectorError_trace_even (F : Frame n d)
    (y : YArray b s n) (q : ℕ) :
    ((scaledIIDVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace =
      cB b ^ (4 * q) * ((iidVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaled_iid_trace_moment_eq_product
statement:
theorem scaled_iid_trace_moment_eq_product (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun y ↦ ((scaledIIDVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
      cB b ^ (4 * q) *
        (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
          (fun ω ↦ ((iidGramError b F ω) ^ (2 * q)).trace)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selector_trace_moment_eq_raw
statement:
theorem selector_trace_moment_eq_raw (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun x ↦ ((sparseVectorError F x) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
        (fun ω ↦ ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample ω))) ^ (2 * q)).trace)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.unconditional_trace_moment_order
statement:
theorem unconditional_trace_moment_order (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun x ↦ ((sparseVectorError F x) ^ (2 * q)).trace) ≤
      (iidArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun y ↦ ((scaledIIDVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledFlatYVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem exactScaledFlatYVector_apply (hb : 0 < b)
    (Y : NestedY b s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    exactScaledFlatYVector hb Y r =
      exactScale (s := s) hb * flatYValue Y r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledFlatYVector_inner
statement:
theorem exactScaledFlatYVector_inner (hb : 0 < b)
    (Y Z : NestedY b s) :
    inner ℝ (exactScaledFlatYVector hb Y) (exactScaledFlatYVector hb Z) =
      exactScale (s := s) hb ^ 2 * inner ℝ (flatYVector Y) (flatYVector Z)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIIDError_apply_grouped
statement:
theorem exactScaledIIDError_apply_grouped (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (Y : IidColumnSample b s n) (a c : Fin d) :
    exactScaledIIDError hb F Y a c =
      (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (∑ g, exactScale (s := s) hb ^ 2 *
          inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (Y i g))
            (unscaledYVector (Y j g))) * F.u i a * F.u j c

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIIDError_eq_smul
statement:
theorem exactScaledIIDError_eq_smul (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (Y : IidColumnSample b s n) :
    exactScaledIIDError hb F Y =
      exactScale (s := s) hb ^ 2 • iidVectorError F (toYArray Y)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIIDError_symmetric
statement:
theorem exactScaledIIDError_symmetric (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (Y : IidColumnSample b s n) :
    (exactScaledIIDError hb F Y).transpose = exactScaledIIDError hb F Y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatYVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem flatYVector_apply (Y : NestedY b s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    flatYVector Y r = flatYValue Y r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatYVector_inner_eq_sum_blocks
statement:
theorem flatYVector_inner_eq_sum_blocks (Y Z : NestedY b s) :
    inner ℝ (flatYVector Y) (flatYVector Z) =
      ∑ g, inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (Y g)) (unscaledYVector (Z g))

theorem dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_cons {d : ℕ} {n : Fin (d + 1) → ℕ}
    (a : (∀ j : Fin (d + 1), Fin (n j)) → ℝ)
    (g₀ : Fin (n 0) → ℝ) (g : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ) → ℝ) :
    a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (Fin.cons g₀ g) =
      (fun i => ∑ b : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ),
        a (Fin.cons i b) * khatriRaoProbe g b) ⬝ᵥ g₀

      ∫ g, g a * g b ∂ν j = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (a b : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) :
    Integrable (fun g => khatriRaoProbe g a * khatriRaoProbe g b) (Measure.pi ν)

name: NLAlib.integral_khatriRaoProbe_mul_khatriRaoProbe
statement:
theorem integral_khatriRaoProbe_mul_khatriRaoProbe
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)]
    (hsecond : ∀ j (a b : Fin (n j)),
      ∫ g, g a * g b ∂ν j = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (a b : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) :
    ∫ g, khatriRaoProbe g a * khatriRaoProbe g b ∂Measure.pi ν =
      if a = b then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.integral_projected_khatriRaoProbe_mul_projected_khatriRaoProbe
statement:
theorem integral_projected_khatriRaoProbe_mul_projected_khatriRaoProbe
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)]
    (hsecond : ∀ j (a b : Fin (n j)),
      ∫ g, g a * g b ∂ν j = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    {r : ℕ} (U : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (Fin r) ℝ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (i j : Fin r) :
    ∫ g, (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) i * (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) j
        ∂Measure.pi ν = if i = j then 1 else 0

name: NLAlib.integral_quadForm_khatriRaoProbe_eq_trace
statement:
theorem integral_quadForm_khatriRaoProbe_eq_trace
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)]
    (hsecond : ∀ j (a b : Fin (n j)),
      ∫ g, g a * g b ∂ν j = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (A : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) ℝ) :
    (∫ g, quadForm A (khatriRaoProbe g) ∂Measure.pi ν) = A.trace

name: NLAlib.measurable_khatriRaoProbe
statement:
theorem measurable_khatriRaoProbe :
    Measurable (khatriRaoProbe (n := n))

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_tensor_slices
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_tensor_slices {d : ℕ} {n : Fin (d + 1) → ℕ}
    (a : (∀ j : Fin (d + 1), Fin (n j)) → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin (n 0), ∑ b : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ), a (Fin.cons i b) ^ 2) =
      ∑ b, a b ^ 2

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_le
    {d : ℕ} {n : Fin d → ℕ}
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)] {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hmoment : ∀ j (a : Fin (n j) → ℝ),
      Integrable (fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ g) ^ (2 * p)) (ν j) ∧
        (∫ g, (a ⬝ᵥ g) ^ (2 * p) ∂ν j) ≤ B * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p))
    (a : (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) ^ (2 * p)) (Measure.pi ν) ∧
      (∫ g, (a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) ^ (2 * p) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
        B ^ d * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_le_of_exp_sq
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_le_of_exp_sq
    {d : ℕ} {n : Fin d → ℕ}
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)] {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∀ j (u : Fin (n j) → ℝ), ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∫⁻ g, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((u ⬝ᵥ g / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν j ≤ 2)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (a : (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) ^ (2 * p)) (Measure.pi ν) ∧
      (∫ g, (a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) ^ (2 * p) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
        (2 * (p.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * p)) ^ d *
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_projected_khatriRaoProbe_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_projected_khatriRaoProbe_le
    {d : ℕ} {n : Fin d → ℕ}
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)] {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∀ j (u : Fin (n j) → ℝ), ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∫⁻ g, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((u ⬝ᵥ g / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν j ≤ 2)
    {r : ℕ} (U : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (Fin r) ℝ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (a : Fin r → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g)) ^ (2 * p)) (Measure.pi ν) ∧
      (∫ g, (a ⬝ᵥ (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g)) ^ (2 * p) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
        (2 * (p.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * p)) ^ d *
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p)

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_eq_sum_paths
statement:
theorem expErr_eq_sum_paths (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b xs x k = ∑ ω : Fin k → m,
      (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) * ((run A b k ω x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (run A b k ω x - xs))

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le
statement:
theorem expErr_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ) (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v : n → ℝ, σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b xs x k ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_succ
statement:
theorem expErr_succ (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    expErr A b xs x (k + 1) = ∑ i, prob A i * expErr A b xs (step A b x i) k

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_zero
statement:
theorem expErr_zero (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) :
    expErr A b xs x 0 = (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expected_sqErr_step_eq
statement:
theorem expected_sqErr_step_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs)) =
      (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs) - (A *ᵥ (x - xs)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x - xs)) / frobSq A

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expected_sqErr_step_le
statement:
theorem expected_sqErr_step_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : ∀ v : n → ℝ, σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) :
    ∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs)) ≤
      (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob_nonneg
statement: theorem prob_nonneg (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (i : m) : 0 ≤ prob A i

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range
statement:
theorem rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range [DecidableEq m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) :
    0 ≤ 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sqErr_step
statement:
theorem sqErr_step (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (i : m) :
    (step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs) =
      (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs) - (A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) ^ 2 / (A i ⬝ᵥ A i)

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step_sub_solution
statement:
theorem step_sub_solution (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b)
    (i : m) :
    step A b x i - xs = (x - xs) - ((A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) / (A i ⬝ᵥ A i)) • A i

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_paths_le
statement:
theorem sum_paths_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ) (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = b) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ v : n → ℝ, σ ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ ω : Fin k → m,
      (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) * ((run A b k ω x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (run A b k ω x - xs)) ≤
      (1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A) ^ k * ((x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_prob
statement: theorem sum_prob (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) : ∑ i, prob A i = 1

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.one_add_two_mul_sum_pow_succ_le
statement:
theorem one_add_two_mul_sum_pow_succ_le {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    1 + 2 * (∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, q ^ (t + 1)) ≤ (1 + q) / (1 - q)

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailInitialWeight_le_div
statement:
theorem tailInitialWeight_le_div {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    tailInitialWeight q N ≤ ((1 + q) / (1 - q)) / (1 - q)

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailInitialWeight_le_mul
statement:
theorem tailInitialWeight_le_mul {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    tailInitialWeight q N ≤ ((1 + q) / (1 - q)) * N

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailInitialWeight_le_sq
statement:
theorem tailInitialWeight_le_sq {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    tailInitialWeight q N ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ 2

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailInitialWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem tailInitialWeight_nonneg {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (N : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ tailInitialWeight q N

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailInitialWeight_succ
statement:
theorem tailInitialWeight_succ (q : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    tailInitialWeight q (N + 1) =
      1 + 2 * (∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, q ^ (t + 1)) + q * tailInitialWeight q N

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.tailInitialWeight_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem tailInitialWeight_zero (q : ℝ) : tailInitialWeight q 0 = 0
